--- FILE: app.py ---

import streamlit as st
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import plotly.express as px

st.set_page_config(page_title="Amazon Dashboard", layout="wide")

@st.cache_data
def load_data():
    file_path = '/Users/hassanmulla/Downloads/NOVA_Phase2/Test/amazon.csv'
    df = pd.read_csv(file_path)
    df['discounted_price_num'] = pd.to_numeric(df['discounted_price'].astype(str).str.replace(r'[^\d.]', '', regex=True), errors='coerce')
    df['actual_price_num'] = pd.to_numeric(df['actual_price'].astype(str).str.replace(r'[^\d.]', '', regex=True), errors='coerce')
    df['discount_pct_num'] = pd.to_numeric(df['discount_percentage'].astype(str).str.replace('%', '', regex=True), errors='coerce')
    df['rating_count_num'] = pd.to_numeric(df['rating_count'].astype(str).str.replace(',', '', regex=True), errors='coerce')
    df['rating_num'] = pd.to_numeric(df['rating'], errors='coerce')
    return df

df = load_data()

st.sidebar.header("Options")
cats = st.sidebar.multiselect("Category", df['category'].unique(), default=df['category'].unique()[:5])
rat_min, rat_max = st.sidebar.slider("Rating", 0.0, 5.0, (0.0, 5.0), 0.1)
p_min = float(df['discounted_price_num'].min())
p_max = float(df['discounted_price_num'].max())
pri_min, pri_max = st.sidebar.slider("Discounted Price", p_min, p_max, (p_min, p_max))

data = df[(df['category'].isin(cats)) & (df['rating_num'] >= rat_min) & (df['rating_num'] <= rat_max) & (df['discounted_price_num'] >= pri_min) & (df['discounted_price_num'] <= pri_max)]

st.title("Amazon Dataset Dashboard")

k1, k2, k3, k4 = st.columns(4)
k1.metric("Products", len(data))
k2.metric("Avg Rating", round(data['rating_num'].mean(), 2))
k3.metric("Avg Discount %", round(data['discount_pct_num'].mean(), 2))
k4.metric("Categories", data['category'].nunique())

c1, c2 = st.columns(2)
top_cats = data['category'].value_counts().head(10).reset_index()
top_cats.columns = ['category', 'count']
fig1 = px.bar(top_cats, x='category', y='count', title="Top 10 Categories")
c1.plotly_chart(fig1, use_container_width=True)

cat_sum = data.groupby('category')['discounted_price_num'].sum().reset_index().sort_values('discounted_price_num', ascending=False).head(10)
fig2 = px.bar(cat_sum, x='category', y='discounted_price_num', title="Top 10 Categories by Value")
c2.plotly_chart(fig2, use_container_width=True)

c3, c4 = st.columns(2)
fig3 = px.histogram(data, x='rating_num', nbins=10, title="Rating Distribution")
c3.plotly_chart(fig3, use_container_width=True)

fig4 = px.scatter(data, x='actual_price_num', y='discounted_price_num', color='rating_num', title="Actual vs Discounted Price", opacity=0.6)
c4.plotly_chart(fig4, use_container_width=True)

nums = ['actual_price_num', 'discounted_price_num', 'discount_pct_num', 'rating_num', 'rating_count_num']
corr = data[nums].corr()
fig5 = px.imshow(corr, text_auto=True, aspect="auto", title="Correlation Matrix")
st.plotly_chart(fig5, use_container_width=True)

st.subheader("Data Preview")
st.dataframe(data)

st.sidebar.markdown("---")
st.sidebar.caption("Data Source: Amazon Dataset")
if st.sidebar.button("Refresh"):
    st.rerun()

st.markdown("---")
st.caption("Data Source: Amazon Dataset | Built with Streamlit")

# ============================================
# FULL R SYSTEM TEST
# Tests:
# - Package installation
# - Package loading
# - Dataframes
# - Data manipulation
# - Visualization
# - Machine Learning
# - JSON handling
# ============================================

# ----------------------------
# INSTALL PACKAGES IF MISSING
# ----------------------------

required_packages <- c(
  "ggplot2",
  "dplyr",
  "jsonlite",
  "caret",
  "tidyr"
)

installed <- rownames(installed.packages())

for (pkg in required_packages) {
  if (!(pkg %in% installed)) {
    install.packages(pkg, repos = "https://cloud.r-project.org")
  }
}

# ----------------------------
# LOAD PACKAGES
# ----------------------------

library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(jsonlite)
library(caret)
library(tidyr)

cat("✅ All packages loaded successfully\n\n")

# ============================================
# CREATE DUMMY STARTUP DATA
# ============================================

startup_data <- data.frame(
  Month = c("Jan", "Feb", "Mar", "Apr", "May", "Jun"),
  Revenue = c(1200, 1800, 2500, 3200, 4100, 5300),
  Expenses = c(900, 1100, 1500, 1700, 2100, 2600),
  Users = c(50, 80, 120, 170, 240, 320)
)

cat("=== ORIGINAL DATA ===\n")
print(startup_data)

# ============================================
# DATA MANIPULATION WITH dplyr
# ============================================

startup_data <- startup_data %>%
  mutate(
    Profit = Revenue - Expenses,
    GrowthRate = c(NA, diff(Revenue) / Revenue[-length(Revenue)] * 100)
  )

cat("\n=== PROCESSED DATA ===\n")
print(startup_data)

# ============================================
# SUMMARY STATISTICS
# ============================================

cat("\n=== SUMMARY ===\n")
print(summary(startup_data))

# ============================================
# JSON TEST
# ============================================

json_output <- toJSON(startup_data, pretty = TRUE)

cat("\n=== JSON OUTPUT ===\n")
cat(json_output)

# Save JSON file
write(json_output, "startup_data.json")

cat("\n\n✅ JSON file saved as startup_data.json\n")

# ============================================
# VISUALIZATION WITH ggplot2
# ============================================

revenue_plot <- ggplot(startup_data, aes(x = Month, y = Revenue, group = 1)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  ggtitle("Bridgeye Revenue Growth") +
  xlab("Month") +
  ylab("Revenue")

print(revenue_plot)

# ============================================
# MACHINE LEARNING TEST (caret)
# ============================================

# Simple linear regression model
model <- train(
  Revenue ~ Users,
  data = startup_data,
  method = "lm"
)

cat("\n=== MODEL SUMMARY ===\n")
print(model)

# Predictions
predictions <- predict(model, startup_data)

cat("\n=== PREDICTIONS ===\n")
print(predictions)

# ============================================
# FILE EXPORT TEST
# ============================================

write.csv(startup_data, "startup_data.csv", row.names = FALSE)

cat("\n✅ CSV exported as startup_data.csv\n")

# ============================================
# SESSION INFO
# ============================================

cat("\n=== SESSION INFO ===\n")
sessionInfo()

cat("\n\n🎉 R SYSTEM TEST COMPLETED SUCCESSFULLY\n")

const http = require("http");

// ============================================
// DUMMY DATA
// ============================================

const startupData = [
  { month: "Jan", revenue: 1200, expenses: 900, users: 50 },
  { month: "Feb", revenue: 1800, expenses: 1100, users: 80 },
  { month: "Mar", revenue: 2500, expenses: 1500, users: 120 },
  { month: "Apr", revenue: 3200, expenses: 1700, users: 170 },
  { month: "May", revenue: 4100, expenses: 2100, users: 240 },
  { month: "Jun", revenue: 5300, expenses: 2600, users: 320 }
];

// ============================================
// PROCESS DATA
// ============================================

const processedData = startupData.map(item => ({
  ...item,
  profit: item.revenue - item.expenses
}));

// ============================================
// SAVE JSON FILE TEST
// ============================================

fs.writeFileSync(
  path.join(__dirname, "startup_data.json"),
  JSON.stringify(processedData, null, 2)
);

// ============================================
// CALCULATIONS
// ============================================

const totalRevenue = processedData.reduce(
  (sum, item) => sum + item.revenue,
  0
);

const totalExpenses = processedData.reduce(
  (sum, item) => sum + item.expenses,
  0
);

const totalUsers = processedData.reduce(
  (sum, item) => sum + item.users,
  0

--- FILE: nova_analysis.py ---

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

def load_and_clean(file_path):
    df = pd.read_csv(file_path)
    
    def clean_price(series):
        return pd.to_numeric(series.astype(str).str.replace(r'[^\d.]', '', regex=True), errors='coerce')
    
    def clean_pct(series):
        return pd.to_numeric(series.astype(str).str.replace('%', '', regex=True), errors='coerce')
    
    def clean_count(series):
        return pd.to_numeric(series.astype(str).str.replace(',', '', regex=True), errors='coerce')
    
    df['discounted_price_num'] = clean_price(df['discounted_price'])
    df['actual_price_num'] = clean_price(df['actual_price'])
    df['discount_pct_num'] = clean_pct(df['discount_percentage'])
    df['rating_count_num'] = clean_count(df['rating_count'])
    df['rating_num'] = pd.to_numeric(df['rating'], errors='coerce')
    
    return df

def analyze(file_path):
    df = load_and_clean(file_path)
    
    print("=== DATASET SHAPE ===")
    print(f"Rows: {df.shape[0]} | Columns: {df.shape[1]}\n")
    
    print("=== MISSING VALUES ===")
    print(df.isnull().sum().sort_values(ascending=False))
    print()
    
    numeric_cols = ['actual_price_num', 'discounted_price_num', 'discount_pct_num', 'rating_num', 'rating_count_num']
    
    print("=== DESCRIPTIVE STATISTICS ===")
    print(df[numeric_cols].describe().T)
    print()
    
    print("=== SKEWNESS & KURTOSIS ===")
    print(df[numeric_cols].agg(['skew', 'kurtosis']))
    print()
    
    print("=== CORRELATION MATRIX ===")
    print(df[numeric_cols].corr())
    print()
    
    print("=== TOP 10 CATEGORIES ===")
    print(df['category'].value_counts().head(10))
    print()
    
    print("=== RATING DISTRIBUTION ===")
    print(df['rating_num'].value_counts().sort_index())
    print()
    
    print("=== DUPLICATE PRODUCT_IDS ===")
    print(df['product_id'].duplicated().sum())
    print()
    
    print("=== ZERO/NEGATIVE PRICE ROWS ===")
    print(f"Actual price <= 0: {(df['actual_price_num'] <= 0).sum()}")
    print(f"Discounted price <= 0: {(df['discounted_price_num'] <= 0).sum()}")
    print()
    
    print("=== AVG RATING BY DISCOUNT BUCKET ===")
    df['discount_bucket'] = pd.cut(df['discount_pct_num'], bins=[0, 20, 40, 60, 80, 100])
    print(df.groupby('discount_bucket')['rating_num'].mean())
    print()
    
    return df

if __name__ == "__main__":
    analyze('/Users/hassanmulla/Downloads/NOVA_Phase2/Test/amazon.csv')

--- FILE: multipage-node-website/server.js ---

const express = require('express');
const path = require('path');

const app = express();
const PORT = 3000;

// Set EJS as templating engine
app.set('view engine', 'ejs');

// Static files
app.use(express.static(path.join(__dirname, 'public')));

// Routes
app.get('/', (req, res) => {
  res.render('index', {
    title: 'Home'
  });
});

app.get('/about', (req, res) => {
  res.render('about', {
    title: 'About'
  });
});

app.get('/services', (req, res) => {
  res.render('services', {
    title: 'Services'
  });
});

app.get('/contact', (req, res) => {
  res.render('contact', {
    title: 'Contact'
  });
});

app.listen(PORT, () => {
  console.log(`Server running on http://localhost:${PORT}`);
});

  <script>
    // Scroll Reveal
    const reveals = document.querySelectorAll('.reveal');
    const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
      entries.forEach(entry => {
        if (entry.isIntersecting) {
          entry.target.classList.add('active');
        }
      });
    }, { threshold: 0.1 });
    reveals.forEach(el => observer.observe(el));

    // Purchase Modal
    const purchaseModal = document.getElementById('purchaseModal');
    function openPurchase() { purchaseModal.classList.add('active'); document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden'; }
    function closePurchase(e) { if (!e || e.target === purchaseModal) { purchaseModal.classList.remove('active'); document.body.style.overflow = ''; } }

    // Detail Modal
    const detailModal = document.getElementById('detailModal');
    const detailContent = document.getElementById('detailContent');
    const details = [
      { title: 'iPhone 15 Pro', desc: 'Forged in titanium and featuring the groundbreaking A17 Pro chip, a customizable Action button, and a more versatile Pro camera system.', tags: ['A17 Pro', 'Titanium', 'USB-C'] },
      { title: 'MacBook Air', desc: 'Your go-to laptop is now up to the task, and then some. With the blazing-fast M3 chip and up to 18 hours of battery life.', tags: ['M3 Chip', '18h Battery', 'Silent'] },
      { title: 'iPad Pro', desc: 'The thinnest Apple product ever introduces the Ultra Retina XDR display, outrageous performance from the M4 chip, and fast wireless connectivity.', tags: ['M4', 'XDR Display', 'Apple Pencil Pro'] },
      { title: 'Apple Watch Series 9', desc: 'Smarter, brighter, and mightier. It features the S9 SiP, a magical new way to use your watch without touching the screen, and a display that is twice as bright.', tags: ['S9 SiP', 'Double Tap', 'Carbon Neutral'] },
      { title: 'AirPods Pro', desc: 'Rebuilt from the sound up. The H2 chip delivers smarter noise cancellation and three-dimensional sound. Now with USB-C charging.', tags: ['H2 Chip', 'Adaptive Audio', 'USB-C'] },
      { title: 'Apple Vision Pro', desc: 'Apple Vision Pro seamlessly blends digital content with your physical space. Navigate simply by using your eyes, hands, and voice.', tags: ['visionOS', 'EyeSight', 'Spatial'] }
    ];
    function openDetail(index) {
      const d = details[index];
      detailContent.innerHTML = `
        <div class="detail-visual">
          <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="currentColor"><path d="M12 2C6.48 2 2 6.48 2 12s4.48 10 10 10 10-4.48 10-10S17.52 2 12 2zm0 18c-4.41 0-8-3.59-8-8s3.59-8 8-8 8 3.59 8 8-3.59 8-8 8zm.5-13H11v6l5.25 3.15.75-1.23-4.5-2.67z"/></svg>
        </div>
        <div class="detail-text">
          <h3>${d.title}</h3>
          <p>${d.desc}</p>
          <div>${d.tags.map(t => `<span class="tag">${t}</span>`).join('')}</div>
          <button class="buy-btn" style="margin-top:24px" onclick="closeDetail(); openPurchase();">Buy Now</button>
        </div>
      `;
      detailModal.classList.add('active');
      document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
    }
    function closeDetail(e) { if (!e || e.target === detailModal) { detailModal.classList.remove('active'); document.body.style.overflow = ''; } }

    // Option selection
    function selectOption(el) {
      const parent = el.parentElement;
      parent.querySelectorAll('.option').forEach(opt => opt.classList.remove('selected'));
      el.classList.add('selected');
    }

    // Scroll spy for sub-nav
    const sections = document.querySelectorAll('section, footer');
    const navLinks = document.querySelectorAll('.sub-nav-links a');
    window.addEventListener('scroll', () => {
      let current = '';
      sections.forEach(section => {
        const sectionTop = section.offsetTop;
        if (scrollY >= sectionTop - 100) current = section.getAttribute('id');
      });
      navLinks.forEach(link => {
        link.classList.remove('active');
        if (link.getAttribute('href') === '#' + current) link.classList.add('active');
      });
    });
  </script>

  <script>
    // Mobile menu toggle
    const menuBtn = document.getElementById('menuBtn');
    const navLinks = document.getElementById('navLinks');
    menuBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
      navLinks.classList.toggle('open');
    });
    document.getElementById('year').textContent = new Date().getFullYear();

    // Revenue Line Chart
    (function drawRevenue() {
      const canvas = document.getElementById('revenueChart');
      if (!canvas) return;
      const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
      const dpr = window.devicePixelRatio || 1;
      const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
      canvas.width = rect.width * dpr;
      canvas.height = rect.height * dpr;
      ctx.scale(dpr, dpr);

      const width = rect.width;
      const height = rect.height;
      const padding = { top: 20, right: 20, bottom: 40, left: 50 };

      const data = [82000, 91000, 87000, 95000, 102000, 98000, 112000, 108000, 125000, 118000, 135000, 148200];
      const labels = ['Jun','Jul','Aug','Sep','Oct','Nov','Dec','Jan','Feb','Mar','Apr','May'];

      const maxVal = Math.max(...data) * 1.1;
      const chartW = width - padding.left - padding.right;
      const chartH = height - padding.top - padding.bottom;

      // Grid lines
      ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.06)';
      ctx.lineWidth = 1;
      for (let i = 0; i <= 5; i++) {
        const y = padding.top + (chartH * i / 5);
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(padding.left, y);
        ctx.lineTo(width - padding.right, y);
        ctx.stroke();

        const val = Math.round(maxVal - (maxVal * i / 5));
        ctx.fillStyle = '#6c757d';
        ctx.font = '12px Roboto';
        ctx.textAlign = 'right';
        ctx.fillText('$' + (val / 1000).toFixed(0) + 'k', padding.left - 8, y + 4);
      }

      // X labels
      ctx.fillStyle = '#6c757d';
      ctx.textAlign = 'center';
      data.forEach((_, i) => {
        const x = padding.left + (chartW * i / (data.length - 1));
        ctx.fillText(labels[i], x, height - 12);
      });

      // Line
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.strokeStyle = '#006A4E';
      ctx.lineWidth = 3;
      data.forEach((val, i) => {
        const x = padding.left + (chartW * i / (data.length - 1));
        const y = padding.top + chartH - ((val / maxVal) * chartH);
        if (i === 0) ctx.moveTo(x, y);
        else ctx.lineTo(x, y);
      });
      ctx.stroke();

      // Fill under line
      ctx.lineTo(padding.left + chartW, padding.top + chartH);
      ctx.lineTo(padding.left, padding.top + chartH);
      ctx.closePath();
      const grad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, padding.top, 0, padding.top + chartH);
      grad.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(0,106,78,0.15)');
      grad.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(0,106,78,0)');
      ctx.fillStyle = grad;
      ctx.fill();

      // Points
      data.forEach((val, i) => {
        const x = padding.left + (chartW * i / (data.length - 1));
        const y = padding.top + chartH - ((val / maxVal) * chartH);
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
        ctx.arc(x, y, 5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
        ctx.lineWidth = 2;
        ctx.strokeStyle = '#006A4E';
        ctx.stroke();
      });
    })();

    // Expense Bar Chart
    (function drawExpenses() {
      const canvas = document.getElementById('expenseChart');
      if (!canvas) return;
      const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
      const dpr = window.devicePixelRatio || 1;
      const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
      canvas.width = rect.width * dpr;
      canvas.height = rect.height * dpr;
      ctx.scale(dpr, dpr);

      const width = rect.width;
      const height = rect.height;
      const padding = { top: 20, right: 20, bottom: 40, left: 20 };

      const data = [
        { label: 'Infra', value: 4200, color: '#006A4E' },
        { label: 'Payroll', value: 18400, color: '#0044CC' },
        { label: 'Ads', value: 3100, color: '#4dabf7' },
        { label: 'Ops', value: 5600, color: '#74c0fc' },
        { label: 'Legal', value: 2200, color: '#212529' }
      ];

      const maxVal = Math.max(...data.map(d => d.value)) * 1.2;
      const chartW = width - padding.left - padding.right;
      const chartH = height - padding.top - padding.bottom;
      const barWidth = (chartW / data.length) * 0.5;
      const gap = (chartW / data.length);

      data.forEach((d, i) => {
        const barH = (d.value / maxVal) * chartH;
        const x = padding.left + (gap * i) + (gap - barWidth) / 2;
        const y = padding.top + chartH - barH;

        ctx.fillStyle = d.color;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.roundRect(x, y, barWidth, barH, [6, 6, 0, 0]);
        ctx.fill();

        // Label
        ctx.fillStyle = '#6c757d';
        ctx.font = '12px Roboto';
        ctx.textAlign = 'center';
        ctx.fillText(d.label, x + barWidth / 2, height - 12);

        // Value
        ctx.fillStyle = '#495057';
        ctx.fillText('$' + (d.value / 1000).toFixed(1) + 'k', x + barWidth / 2, y - 8);
      });
    })();
  </script>
</body>
</html>

  <script>
    const themeToggle = document.getElementById('themeToggle');
    const moon = document.getElementById('moon');
    const sun = document.getElementById('sun');
    const html = document.documentElement;

    const saved = localStorage.getItem('theme');
    if (saved) { html.setAttribute('data-theme', saved); updateIcon(saved); }

    themeToggle.addEventListener('click', () => {
      const curr = html.getAttribute('data-theme') || 'dark';
      const next = curr === 'dark' ? 'light' : 'dark';
      html.setAttribute('data-theme', next);
      localStorage.setItem('theme', next);
      updateIcon(next);
    });

    function updateIcon(theme) {
      if (theme === 'dark') { moon.style.display='block'; sun.style.display='none'; }
      else { moon.style.display='none'; sun.style.display='block'; }
    }

    const mobileBtn = document.getElementById('mobileMenuBtn');
    const navLinks = document.getElementById('navLinks');
    mobileBtn.addEventListener('click', () => { navLinks.classList.toggle('open'); });

    const reveals = document.querySelectorAll('.reveal');
    const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
      entries.forEach(entry => { if (entry.isIntersecting) { entry.target.classList.add('active'); } });
    }, { threshold: 0.1 });
    reveals.forEach(el => observer.observe(el));
  </script>

  <script>
    const themeToggle = document.getElementById('themeToggle');
    const moon = document.getElementById('moon');
    const sun = document.getElementById('sun');
    const html = document.documentElement;

    const saved = localStorage.getItem('theme');
    if (saved) { html.setAttribute('data-theme', saved); updateIcon(saved); }

    themeToggle.addEventListener('click', () => {
      const curr = html.getAttribute('data-theme') || 'dark';
      const next = curr === 'dark' ? 'light' : 'dark';
      html.setAttribute('data-theme', next);
      localStorage.setItem('theme', next);
      updateIcon(next);
    });

    function updateIcon(theme) {
      if (theme === 'dark') { moon.style.display='block'; sun.style.display='none'; }
      else { moon.style.display='none'; sun.style.display='block'; }
    }

    const mobileBtn = document.getElementById('mobileMenuBtn');
    const navLinks = document.getElementById('navLinks');
    mobileBtn.addEventListener('click', () => { navLinks.classList.toggle('open'); });

    const reveals = document.querySelectorAll('.reveal');
    const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
      entries.forEach(entry => { if (entry.isIntersecting) { entry.target.classList.add('active'); } });
    }, { threshold: 0.1 });
    reveals.forEach(el => observer.observe(el));
  </script>

  <script>
    const themeToggle = document.getElementById('themeToggle');
    const moon = document.getElementById('moon');
    const sun = document.getElementById('sun');
    const html = document.documentElement;

    const saved = localStorage.getItem('theme');
    if (saved) { html.setAttribute('data-theme', saved); updateIcon(saved); }

    themeToggle.addEventListener('click', () => {
      const curr = html.getAttribute('data-theme') || 'dark';
      const next = curr === 'dark' ? 'light' : 'dark';
      html.setAttribute('data-theme', next);
      localStorage.setItem('theme', next);
      updateIcon(next);
    });
    function updateIcon(theme) {
      if (theme === 'dark') { moon.style.display='block'; sun.style.display='none'; }
      else { moon.style.display='none'; sun.style.display='block'; }
    }

    const mobileBtn = document.getElementById('mobileMenuBtn');
    const navLinks = document.getElementById('navLinks');
    mobileBtn.addEventListener('click', () => { navLinks.classList.toggle('open'); });

    const reveals = document.querySelectorAll('.reveal');
    const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
      entries.forEach(entry => { if (entry.isIntersecting) { entry.target.classList.add('active'); } });
    }, { threshold: 0.1 });
    reveals.forEach(el => observer.observe(el));
  </script>

  <script>
    const themeToggle = document.getElementById('themeToggle');
    const moon = document.getElementById('moon');
    const sun = document.getElementById('sun');
    const html = document.documentElement;
    const saved = localStorage.getItem('theme');
    if (saved) { html.setAttribute('data-theme', saved); updateIcon(saved); }
    themeToggle.addEventListener('click', () => {
      const curr = html.getAttribute('data-theme') || 'dark';
      const next = curr === 'dark' ? 'light' : 'dark';
      html.setAttribute('data-theme', next);
      localStorage.setItem('theme', next);
      updateIcon(next);
    });
    function updateIcon(theme) {
      if (theme === 'dark') { moon.style.display='block'; sun.style.display='none'; }
      else { moon.style.display='none'; sun.style.display='block'; }
    }

    const mobileBtn = document.getElementById('mobileMenuBtn');
    const navLinks = document.getElementById('navLinks');
    mobileBtn.addEventListener('click', () => { navLinks.classList.toggle('open'); });

    const reveals = document.querySelectorAll('.reveal');
    const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
      entries.forEach(entry => { if (entry.isIntersecting) { entry.target.classList.add('active'); } });
    }, { threshold: 0.1 });
    reveals.forEach(el => observer.observe(el));
  </script>

    <!-- Application Logic -->
    <script>
        // --- Data State ---
        const users = ['Alex', 'Jordan', 'Casey', 'Taylor', 'Riley'];
        
        let expenses = [
            { id: 1, description: 'Space Station Dinner', amount: 120.00, payer: 'Alex', participants: ['Alex', 'Jordan', 'Casey'], date: '2024-05-20' },
            { id: 2, description: 'Hyperdrive Fuel', amount: 85.50, payer: 'Jordan', participants: ['Jordan', 'Casey'], date: '2024-05-21' },
            { id: 3, description: 'Quantum Drinks', amount: 45.00, payer: 'Casey', participants: ['Alex', 'Jordan', 'Casey', 'Taylor'], date: '2024-05-22' }
        ];

        let filterPerson = 'All';

        // --- DOM Elements ---
        const modal = document.getElementById('expenseModal');
        const modalPanel = document.getElementById('modalPanel');
        const expenseForm = document.getElementById('expenseForm');
        const expensesContainer = document.getElementById('expensesContainer');
        const emptyState = document.getElementById('emptyState');
        const balanceList = document.getElementById('balanceList');
        const personFilters = document.getElementById('personFilters');
        const payerInput = document.getElementById('payerInput');
        const participantsContainer = document.getElementById('participantsCheckboxes');
        const toast = document.getElementById('toast');
        const toastMsg = document.getElementById('toastMsg');

        // --- Event Listeners ---
        document.getElementById('openFormBtn').addEventListener('click', () => openModal());
        document.getElementById('navCtaBtn').addEventListener('click', () => openModal());
        document.getElementById('heroCtaBtn').addEventListener('click', () => openModal());
        document.getElementById('closeModalBtn').addEventListener('click', closeModal);
        document.getElementById('modalBackdrop').addEventListener('click', closeModal);
        document.getElementById('settleBtn').addEventListener('click', handleSettleUp);
        expenseForm.addEventListener('submit', handleFormSubmit);

        // --- Initialization ---
        function init() {
            populateSelectors();
            renderAll();
            setupScrollAnimations();
            setupParticles();
            setupHeroParallax();
        }

        // --- Rendering Functions ---
        function populateSelectors() {
            payerInput.innerHTML = users.map(u => `<option value="${u}">${u}</option>`).join('');
            
            participantsContainer.innerHTML = users.map(u => `
                <label class="flex items-center space-x-2 cursor-pointer p-2 border border-transparent rounded hover:bg-white/5 transition-colors">
                    <input type="checkbox" value="${u}" class="peer h-4 w-4 rounded border-gray-300 text-nova-primary focus:ring-nova-primary bg-black">
                    <span class="text-sm text-gray-300 peer-checked:text-white">${u}</span>
                </label>
            `).join('');
        }

        function renderAll() {
            renderFilters();
            renderExpenses();
            renderSummary();
        }

        function renderFilters() {
            personFilters.innerHTML = `
                <button onclick="setFilter('All')" class="text-sm w-full text-left px-3 py-2 rounded ${filterPerson === 'All' ? 'bg-nova-primary/20 text-nova-primary' : 'text-gray-400 hover:bg-white/5'}">
                    View All
                </button>
                ${users.map(u => `
                    <button onclick="setFilter('${u}')" class="text-sm w-full text-left px-3 py-2 rounded ${filterPerson === u ? 'bg-nova-primary/20 text-nova-primary' : 'text-gray-400 hover:bg-white/5'}">
                        ${u}
                    </button>
                `).join('')}
            `;
        }

        function setFilter(person) {
            filterPerson = person;
            renderFilters();
            renderExpenses();
        }

        function renderExpenses() {
            expensesContainer.innerHTML = '';
            
            let filtered = expenses;
            if (filterPerson !== 'All') {
                filtered = expenses.filter(e => e.participants.includes(filterPerson));
            }

            if (filtered.length === 0) {
                emptyState.classList.remove('hidden');
                return;
            } else {
                emptyState.classList.add('hidden');
            }

            filtered.forEach(exp => {
                const splitAmount = exp.amount / exp.participants.length;
                const dateObj = new Date(exp.date);
                const dateStr = dateObj.toLocaleDateString('en-US', { month: 'short', day: 'numeric' });

                const el = document.createElement('div');
                el.className = 'expense-row bg-nova-surface border-l-4 border-nova-primary p-4 flex flex-col sm:flex-row justify-between items-start sm:items-center gap-4 group hover:border-nova-accent transition-colors';
                el.innerHTML = `
                    <div class="flex-1 min-w-0">
                        <div class="flex items-center gap-3 mb-1">
                            <span class="text-xs text-gray-500 font-mono">${dateStr}</span>
                            <h4 class="text-white font-medium truncate">${exp.description}</h4>
                        </div>
                        <div class="text-xs text-gray-400 flex flex-wrap gap-2">
                            <span>Paid by <span class="text-nova-primary">${exp.payer}</span></span>
                            <span class="text-gray-600">|</span>
                            <span>Split among: ${exp.participants.map(p => `<span class="text-gray-300">${p}</span>`).join(', ')}</span>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                    <div class="flex items-center gap-6 w-full sm:w-auto justify-between sm:justify-end">
                        <div class="text-right">
                            <div class="text-xl font-heading text-white">$${formatMoney(exp.amount)}</div>
                            <div class="text-xs text-gray-500">~$${formatMoney(splitAmount)} / person</div>
                        </div>
                        <div class="flex gap-1 opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 transition-opacity">
                            <button onclick="editExpense(${exp.id})" class="p-2 text-gray-400 hover:text-nova-primary transition-colors" title="Edit">
                                <svg class="w-5 h-5" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M11 5H6a2 2 0 00-2 2v11a2 2 0 002 2h11a2 2 0 002-2v-5m-1.414-9.414a2 2 0 112.828 2.828L11.828 15H9v-2.828l8.586-8.586z"></path></svg>
                            </button>
                            <button onclick="deleteExpense(${exp.id})" class="p-2 text-gray-400 hover:text-red-500 transition-colors" title="Delete">
                                <svg class="w-5 h-5" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M19 7l-.867 12.142A2 2 0 0116.138 21H7.862a2 2 0 01-1.995-1.858L5 7m5 4v6m4-6v6m1-10V4a1 1 0 00-1-1h-4a1 1 0 00-1 1v3M4 7h16"></path></svg>
                            </button>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                `;
                expensesContainer.appendChild(el);
            });
        }

        function renderSummary() {
            balanceList.innerHTML = '';
            
            // Calculate totals per person
            const userSpent = {}; // Total amount spent (paid)
            const userOwed = {};  // Total amount owed (share)
            
            users.forEach(u => { userSpent[u] = 0; userOwed[u] = 0; });

            expenses.forEach(exp => {
                const share = exp.amount / exp.participants.length;
                userSpent[exp.payer] += exp.amount;
                exp.participants.forEach(p => {
                    userOwed[p] += share;
                });
            });

            const totalSpent = Object.values(userSpent).reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0);
            
            // Find max imbalance for progress bar scaling
            let maxBalance = 0;
            users.forEach(u => {
                const balance = userSpent[u] - userOwed[u];
                if (Math.abs(balance) > maxBalance) maxBalance = Math.abs(balance);
            });

            // Render Balance Bars
            users.forEach((u, index) => {
                const spent = userSpent[u];
                const owed = userOwed[u];
                const balance = spent - owed;
                const isPositive = balance >= 0;
                
                const percentage = maxBalance > 0 ? (Math.abs(balance) / maxBalance) * 100 : 0;
                
                const item = document.createElement('div');
                item.innerHTML = `
                    <div class="flex justify-between items-end mb-2">
                        <div>
                            <h4 class="text-white font-heading text-lg">${u}</h4>
                            <p class="text-xs text-gray-500">Paid $${formatMoney(spent)} · Owed $${formatMoney(owed)}</p>
                        </div>
                        <div class="text-right">
                            <span class="text-xl font-heading ${isPositive ? 'text-nova-primary' : 'text-nova-accent'}">
                                ${isPositive ? '+' : ''}$${formatMoney(balance)}
                            </span>
                            <p class="text-[10px] uppercase tracking-widest text-gray-500">${isPositive ? 'CREDITOR' : 'DEBTOR'}</p>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                    <div class="nova-progress-bg">
                        <div class="nova-progress-fill ${isPositive ? '' : 'bg-gradient-to-r from-nova-accent to-red-500'}" style="width: 0%" data-width="${Math.max(percentage, 5)}%"></div>
                    </div>
                `;
                balanceList.appendChild(item);
            });

            // Animate bars after render
            setTimeout(() => {
                document.querySelectorAll('.nova-progress-fill').forEach(bar => {
                    bar.style.width = bar.getAttribute('data-width');
                });
            }, 100);

            // Update Top Stats
            document.getElementById('totalSpent').innerText = '$' + formatMoney(totalSpent);
            document.getElementById('totalTransactions').innerText = expenses.length;
            
            const totalOwed = Object.values(userOwed).reduce((a,b) => a + b, 0) - totalSpent; // Rough approximation of net debt
            // Better: sum of negative balances
            let totalDebt = 0;
            users.forEach(u => {
                const bal = userSpent[u] - userOwed[u];
                if(bal < 0) totalDebt += Math.abs(bal);
            });
            document.getElementById('pendingDebts').innerText = '$' + formatMoney(totalDebt);
        }

        // --- Modal & Form Logic ---
        function openModal(expenseId = null) {
            modal.classList.remove('hidden');
            // Small delay for animation
            setTimeout(() => {
                modalPanel.classList.remove('scale-95', 'opacity-0');
                modalPanel.classList.add('scale-100', 'opacity-100');
            }, 10);
            
            document.getElementById('descError').classList.add('hidden');
            document.getElementById('participantsError').classList.add('hidden');
            
            if (expenseId) {
                const expense = expenses.find(e => e.id === expenseId);
                document.getElementById('modalTitle').innerText = 'Edit Transaction';
                document.getElementById('expenseId').value = expense.id;
                document.getElementById('descInput').value = expense.description;
                document.getElementById('amountInput').value = expense.amount;
                document.getElementById('payerInput').value = expense.payer;
                
                // Checkboxes
                const checkboxes = document.querySelectorAll('#participantsCheckboxes input');
                checkboxes.forEach(cb => {
                    cb.checked = expense.participants.includes(cb.value);
                });
            } else {
                document.getElementById('modalTitle').innerText = 'Log New Expense';
                expenseForm.reset();
                document.getElementById('expenseId').value = '';
                // Default check all checkboxes
                const checkboxes = document.querySelectorAll('#participantsCheckboxes input');
                checkboxes.forEach(cb => cb.checked = true);
            }
        }

        function closeModal() {
            modalPanel.classList.remove('scale-100', 'opacity-100');
            modalPanel.classList.add('scale-95', 'opacity-0');
            setTimeout(() => {
                modal.classList.add('hidden');
            }, 300);
        }

        function handleFormSubmit(e) {
            e.preventDefault();
            
            // Validation
            const description = document.getElementById('descInput').value.trim();
            const amount = parseFloat(document.getElementById('amountInput').value);
            const payer = document.getElementById('payerInput').value;
            const checkboxes = document.querySelectorAll('#participantsCheckboxes input:checked');
            
            let valid = true;
            
            if (!description) {
                document.getElementById('descError').classList.remove('hidden');
                valid = false;
            } else {
                document.getElementById('descError').classList.add('hidden');
            }

            const participants = Array.from(checkboxes).map(cb => cb.value);
            if (participants.length === 0) {
                document.getElementById('participantsError').classList.remove('hidden');
                valid = false;
            } else {
                document.getElementById('participantsError').classList.add('hidden');
            }

            if (!valid || isNaN(amount) || amount <= 0) return;

            const idStr = document.getElementById('expenseId').value;
            
            if (idStr) {
                // Edit
                const id = parseInt(idStr);
                const idx = expenses.findIndex(e => e.id === id);
                if (idx !== -1) {
                    expenses[idx] = { ...expenses[idx], description, amount, payer, participants };
                    showToast('Transaction updated successfully');
                }
            } else {
                // Add
                const newId = expenses.length > 0 ? Math.max(...expenses.map(e => e.id)) + 1 : 1;
                expenses.unshift({
                    id: newId,
                    description,
                    amount,
                    payer,
                    participants,
                    date: new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0]
                });
                showToast('New transaction processed');
            }
            
            closeModal();
            renderAll();
        }

        function editExpense(id) {
            openModal(id);
        }

        function deleteExpense(id) {
            if(confirm('Confirm transaction deletion?')) {
                expenses = expenses.filter(e => e.id !== id);
                renderAll();
                showToast('Transaction removed');
            }
        }

        function handleSettleUp() {
            showToast('Calculating optimal transfer routes...');
            setTimeout(() => {
                alert('Settle Up Logic: \n\n• Jordan pays Alex $20.50\n• Taylor pays Casey $15.00\n\nMinimum transactions required: 2');
            }, 800);
        }

        // --- Utilities ---
        function formatMoney(amount) {
            return amount.toLocaleString('en-US', { minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2 });
        }

        function showToast(message) {
            toastMsg.innerText = message;
            toast.classList.remove('translate-y-20');
            setTimeout(() => {
                toast.classList.add('translate-y-20');
            }, 3000);
        }

        // --- Animations & Effects ---
        function setupScrollAnimations() {
            const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
                entries.forEach(entry => {
                    if (entry.isIntersecting) {
                        entry.target.classList.add('visible');
                    }
                });
            }, { threshold: 0.1 });

            document.querySelectorAll('.fade-in-up').forEach(el => observer.observe(el));
        }

        function setupParticles() {
            const container = document.getElementById('particles');
            const particleCount = 30;
            
            for (let i = 0; i < particleCount; i++) {
                const p = document.createElement('div');
                p.classList.add('particle');
                
                const size = Math.random() * 4 + 1;
                p.style.width = `${size}px`;
                p.style.height = `${size}px`;
                
                p.style.left = `${Math.random() * 100}%`;
                p.style.animationDuration = `${Math.random() * 15 + 10}s`;
                p.style.animationDelay = `${Math.random() * 5}s`;
                
                if (Math.random() > 0.7) {
                    p.style.background = 'var(--accent)';
                }
                
                container.appendChild(p);
            }
        }

        function setupHeroParallax() {
            const bg = document.getElementById('heroBg');
            window.addEventListener('scroll', () => {
                const scrolled = window.scrollY;
                const parallax = scrolled * 0.4;
                bg.style.backgroundPosition = `center ${parallax}px`;
            });
        }

        // --- Active Nav Highlighting on Scroll ---
        window.addEventListener('scroll', () => {
            const sections = document.querySelectorAll('section');
            const navLinks = document.querySelectorAll('.nav-link');
            
            let current = '';
            sections.forEach(section => {
                const sectionTop = section.offsetTop;
                const sectionHeight = section.clientHeight;
                if (scrollY >= (sectionTop - 200)) {
                    current = section.getAttribute('id');
                }
            });

            navLinks.forEach(link => {
                link.classList.remove('active');
                if (link.getAttribute('href').includes(current)) {
                    link.classList.add('active');
                }
            });
        });

        // Run init when DOM is ready
        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', init);

    </script>

--- FILE: pytest/calculator.py ---

import tkinter as tk


class Calculator:
    def __init__(self):
        self.expression = ""

    def _is_valid_append(self, char):
        if self.expression.startswith("Error"):
            self.expression = ""
        if not self.expression:
            return True
        operators = "+-*/"
        last_char = self.expression[-1]
        if char in operators and last_char in operators:
            return False
        if char == ".":
            if last_char == ".":
                return False
            tokens = []
            current = ""
            for c in self.expression:
                if c in operators:
                    tokens.append(current)
                    current = ""
                else:
                    current += c
            tokens.append(current)
            if "." in tokens[-1]:
                return False
        return True

    def add_char(self, char):
        if self._is_valid_append(char):
            self.expression += char

    def clear(self):
        self.expression = ""

    def evaluate(self):
        if not self.expression:
            return "0"
        try:
            result = eval(self.expression, {"__builtins__": None}, {})
            return str(result)
        except ZeroDivisionError:
            return "Error: ÷0"
        except Exception:
            return "Error"

    def get_display(self):
        return self.expression or "0"


def create_root():
    root = tk.Tk()
    root.title("Calculator")
    root.geometry("320x420")
    root.resizable(False, False)
    return root


def create_display(root, calc):
    display_var = tk.StringVar(value=calc.get_display())
    entry = tk.Entry(root, textvariable=display_var, font=("Arial", 24), justify="right", state="readonly")
    entry.grid(row=0, column=0, columnspan=4, sticky="nsew", padx=5, pady=5)
    return display_var


def create_buttons(root, calc, display_var):
    def on_char(char):
        calc.add_char(char)
        display_var.set(calc.get_display())

    def on_clear():
        calc.clear()
        display_var.set(calc.get_display())

    def on_equals():
        result = calc.evaluate()
        calc.expression = result
        display_var.set(result)

    buttons = [
        ("C", 1, 0, 1, on_clear),
        ("(", 1, 1, 1, lambda: on_char("(")),
        (")", 1, 2, 1, lambda: on_char(")")),
        ("/", 1, 3, 1, lambda: on_char("/")),
        ("7", 2, 0, 1, lambda: on_char("7")),
        ("8", 2, 1, 1, lambda: on_char("8")),
        ("9", 2, 2, 1, lambda: on_char("9")),
        ("*", 2, 3, 1, lambda: on_char("*")),
        ("4", 3, 0, 1, lambda: on_char("4")),
        ("5", 3, 1, 1, lambda: on_char("5")),
        ("6", 3, 2, 1, lambda: on_char("6")),
        ("-", 3, 3, 1, lambda: on_char("-")),
        ("1", 4, 0, 1, lambda: on_char("1")),
        ("2", 4, 1, 1, lambda: on_char("2")),
        ("3", 4, 2, 1, lambda: on_char("3")),
        ("+", 4, 3, 1, lambda: on_char("+")),
        ("0", 5, 0, 2, lambda: on_char("0")),
        (".", 5, 2, 1, lambda: on_char(".")),
        ("=", 5, 3, 1, on_equals),
    ]

    for text, row, col, colspan, cmd in buttons:
        btn = tk.Button(root, text=text, command=cmd)
        btn.grid(row=row, column=col, columnspan=colspan, sticky="nsew", padx=2, pady=2)

    for i in range(4):
        root.grid_columnconfigure(i, weight=1)
    for i in range(1, 6):
        root.grid_rowconfigure(i, weight=1)


def main():
    root = create_root()
    calc = Calculator()
    display_var = create_display(root, calc)
    create_buttons(root, calc, display_var)
    root.mainloop()


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

  <script>
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
      /* Mobile Nav */
      const toggle = document.getElementById('mobile-toggle');
      const navLinks = document.getElementById('nav-links');
      toggle.addEventListener('click', () => {
        navLinks.classList.toggle('active');
      });

      document.querySelectorAll('a[href^="#"]').forEach(anchor => {
        anchor.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
          e.preventDefault();
          const target = document.querySelector(this.getAttribute('href'));
          if (target) target.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' });
          navLinks.classList.remove('active');
        });
      });

      /* Terminal Demo Animation */
      const termBody = document.getElementById('term-body');
      const lines = [
        { type: 'command', text: 'pip install nova-ai' },
        { type: 'output', text: 'Collecting nova-ai' },
        { type: 'output', text: 'Downloading nova_ai-2.1.0-py3-none-any.whl (142 kB)' },
        { type: 'output', text: 'Successfully installed nova-ai', style: 'success' },
        { type: 'spacer' },
        { type: 'command', text: 'nova overdrive' },
        { type: 'output', text: 'Activating AI co-pilot...' },
        { type: 'output', text: 'Context engine loaded. Model: frontier-v3' },
        { type: 'spacer' },
        { type: 'command', text: 'nova run app.py' },
        { type: 'output', text: 'Compiling...' },
        { type: 'output', text: '✓ Server started on port 3000', style: 'success' }
      ];

      async function typeLine(container, text, speed = 25) {
        for (let i = 0; i < text.length; i++) {
          container.append(text[i]);
          await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, speed));
        }
      }

      async function runTerminal() {
        termBody.innerHTML = '';
        for (const line of lines) {
          if (line.type === 'spacer') {
            termBody.appendChild(document.createElement('br'));
            continue;
          }
          const div = document.createElement('div');
          if (line.type === 'command') {
            const prompt = document.createElement('span');
            prompt.className = 'prompt';
            prompt.textContent = '$ ';
            div.appendChild(prompt);
            const cmd = document.createElement('span');
            cmd.className = 'command';
            div.appendChild(cmd);
            termBody.appendChild(div);
            await typeLine(cmd, line.text);
            await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 400));
          } else {
            div.className = line.style || 'output';
            div.textContent = line.text;
            termBody.appendChild(div);
            await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 350));
          }
          termBody.scrollTop = termBody.scrollHeight;
        }
      }

      /* Intersection Observer to trigger terminal once */
      const termSection = document.getElementById('terminal');
      let termPlayed = false;
      const termObserver = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
        entries.forEach(entry => {
          if (entry.isIntersecting && !termPlayed) {
            termPlayed = true;
            runTerminal();
            termObserver.unobserve(termSection);
          }
        });
      }, { threshold: 0.3 });
      termObserver.observe(termSection);

      /* Copy Buttons */
      document.querySelectorAll('.copy-btn').forEach(btn => {
        btn.addEventListener('click', async () => {
          const text = btn.getAttribute('data-text');
          await navigator.clipboard.writeText(text);
          const orig = btn.textContent;
          btn.textContent = 'Copied!';
          btn.classList.add('copied');
          setTimeout(() => {
            btn.textContent = orig;
            btn.classList.remove('copied');
          }, 2000);
        });
      });

      /* Run Command Demo */
      const runBtn = document.getElementById('run-btn');
      const runFeedback = document.getElementById('run-feedback');

      runBtn.addEventListener('click', async () => {
        runBtn.disabled = true;
        runFeedback.classList.remove('hidden');
        runFeedback.innerHTML = '<span class="prompt">$ </span><span class="command">nova run xyz.py</span>';
        const steps = [
          { text: 'Analyzing dependencies...', delay: 600, style: 'output' },
          { text: 'Executing xyz.py...', delay: 900, style: 'output' },
          { text: '✓ Finished in 0.42s — no errors', delay: 1100, style: 'success' }
        ];
        for (const step of steps) {
          await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, step.delay));
          const div = document.createElement('div');
          div.className = step.style;
          div.textContent = step.text;
          runFeedback.appendChild(div);
        }
        runBtn.disabled = false;
      });

      /* Contact Form */
      document.getElementById('contact-form').addEventListener('submit', (e) => {
        e.preventDefault();
        const btn = e.target.querySelector('button[type="submit"]');
        const orig = btn.textContent;
        btn.textContent = 'Request Sent!';
        btn.disabled = true;
        setTimeout(() => {
          btn.textContent = orig;
          btn.disabled = false;
          e.target.reset();
        }, 2500);
      });
    });
  </script>
</body>
</html>

          <div class="chart-wrapper"><canvas id="barChart" aria-label="Income versus expense bar chart"></canvas></div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="bottom-row">
        <div class="glass widget">
          <h3>Expense Breakdown</h3>
          <div class="chart-wrapper"><canvas id="doughnutChart" aria-label="Expense breakdown doughnut chart"></canvas></div>
        </div>
        <div class="glass widget">
          <h3>Recent Transactions</h3>
          <div class="transactions-wrap">
            <table id="txTable">
              <thead>
                <tr>
                  <th data-sort="date">Date</th>
                  <th data-sort="type">Type</th>

                  <th data-sort="amount">Amount</th>
                  <th>Note</th>
                  <th></th>
                </tr>
              </thead>
              <tbody></tbody>
            </table>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </main>

  <div id="transactionModal" class="modal" role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-hidden="true">
    <div class="modal-content glass">
      <div class="modal-header">
        <h2 id="modalTitle">Add Entry</h2>
        <button class="close-x" id="modalClose" aria-label="Close">&times;</button>
      </div>
      <form id="txForm">
        <input type="hidden" id="txId">
        <div class="form-group">
          <label for="txType">Type</label>
          <select id="txType" required>
            <option value="income">Income</option>
            <option value="expense">Expense</option>
          </select>
        </div>
        <div class="form-group">
          <label for="txAmount">Amount</label>
          <input type="number" id="txAmount" step="0.01" min="0.01" required placeholder="0.00">
        </div>
        <div class="form-group">
          <label for="txCategory">Category</label>
          <input list="categoryList" id="txCategory" required placeholder="e.g. Rent">
          <datalist id="categoryList"></datalist>
        </div>
        <div class="form-group">
          <label for="txDate">Date</label>
          <input type="date" id="txDate" required>
        </div>
        <div class="form-group">
          <label for="txNote">Note</label>
          <input type="text" id="txNote" placeholder="Optional note">
        </div>
        <div class="form-group" style="display:flex; align-items:center; gap:8px;">
          <input type="checkbox" id="txRecurring"><label for="txRecurring" style="margin:0;">Recurring</label>
        </div>
        <div class="form-actions">
          <button type="button" class="btn" id="modalCancel">Cancel</button>
          <button type="submit" class="btn btn-accent">Save</button>
        </div>
      </form>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div id="confirmModal" class="modal" role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-hidden="true">
    <div class="modal-content glass" style="max-width: 360px;">
      <div class="modal-header">
        <h3>Confirm</h3>
      </div>
      <p id="confirmMessage" style="margin-bottom: 20px;">Are you sure?</p>
      <div style="display:flex; justify-content:flex-end; gap: 10px;">
        <button id="confirmNo" class="btn">No</button>
        <button id="confirmYes" class="btn btn-danger">Yes</button>
      </div>

  <script>
    /* State */
    const state = {
      transactions: seedData(),
      filter: { text: '', category: '', type: '', startDate: '', endDate: '' },
      sort: { col: 'date', dir: 'desc' },
      charts: {},
      editingId: null
    };

    function uuid() {
      if (typeof crypto !== 'undefined' && crypto.randomUUID) return crypto.randomUUID();
      return 'xxxxxxxx-xxxx-4xxx-yxxx-xxxxxxxxxxxx'.replace(/[xy]/g, c => {
        const r = Math.random() * 16 | 0;
        return (c === 'x' ? r : (r & 0x3 | 0x8)).toString(16);
      });
    }

    function seedData() {
      const incCats = ['Salary', 'Freelance', 'Investments', 'Gift'];
      const expCats = ['Rent', 'Groelies', 'Utilities', 'Entertainment', 'Transport', 'Dining', 'Shopping', 'Health', 'Groceries'];
      const now = new Date();
      const txs = [];
      for (let i = 0; i < 42; i++) {
        const isInc = Math.random() > 0.65;
        const type = isInc ? 'income' : 'expense';
        const cats = isInc ? incCats : expCats;
        const category = cats[Math.floor(Math.random() * cats.length)];
        const date = new Date(now);
        date.setDate(date.getDate() - Math.floor(Math.random() * 180));
        const amount = isInc ? +(500 + Math.random() * 4500).toFixed(2) : +(5 + Math.random() * 600).toFixed(2);
        txs.push({
          id: uuid(),
          type,
          amount,
          category,
          date: date.toISOString().split('T')[0],
          note: '',
          recurring: Math.random() > 0.85
        });
      }
      return txs;
    }

    /* DOM refs */
    const els = {
      sidebar: document.getElementById('sidebar'),
      sidebarOverlay: document.getElementById('sidebarOverlay'),
      sidebarToggle: document.getElementById('sidebarToggle'),
      main: document.getElementById('main'),
      clock: document.getElementById('clock'),
      headerNet: document.getElementById('headerNet'),
      filterText: document.getElementById('filterText'),
      filterType: document.getElementById('filterType'),
      filterCategory: document.getElementById('filterCategory'),
      filterStart: document.getElementById('filterStart'),
      filterEnd: document.getElementById('filterEnd'),
      btnApply: document.getElementById('btnApply'),
      btnReset: document.getElementById('btnReset'),
      btnExport: document.getElementById('btnExport'),
      btnAddSidebar: document.getElementById('btnAddSidebar'),
      btnAddToolbar: document.getElementById('btnAddToolbar'),
      sumIncome: document.getElementById('sumIncome'),
      sumExpense: document.getElementById('sumExpense'),
      sumNet: document.getElementById('sumNet'),
      sumRate: document.getElementById('sumRate'),
      txForm: document.getElementById('txForm'),
      txId: document.getElementById('txId'),
      txType: document.getElementById('txType'),
      txAmount: document.getElementById('txAmount'),
      txCategory: document.getElementById('txCategory'),
      categoryList: document.getElementById('categoryList'),
      txDate: document.getElementById('txDate'),
      txNote: document.getElementById('txNote'),
      txRecurring: document.getElementById('txRecurring'),
      txModal: document.getElementById('transactionModal'),
      modalClose: document.getElementById('modalClose'),
      modalCancel: document.getElementById('modalCancel'),
      confirmModal: document.getElementById('confirmModal'),
      confirmMessage: document.getElementById('confirmMessage'),
      confirmYes: document.getElementById('confirmYes'),
      confirmNo: document.getElementById('confirmNo'),
      tableBody: document.querySelector('#txTable tbody'),
      tableHeaders: document.querySelectorAll('#txTable thead th[data-sort]')
    };

    /* Utils */
    function formatCurrency(n) {
      return new Intl.NumberFormat('en-US', { style: 'currency', currency: 'USD' }).format(n);
    }

    function animateValue(el, target, suffix) {
      const startText = el.textContent.replace(/[^0-9.-]+/g, '');
      const start = parseFloat(startText) || 0;
      if (start === target) return;
      const duration = 700;
      const startTime = performance.now();
      function step(now) {
        const p = Math.min((now - startTime) / duration, 1);
        const val = start + (target - start) * (1 - Math.pow(1 - p, 3));
        if (suffix === '%') el.textContent = val.toFixed(1) + '%';
        else el.textContent = formatCurrency(val);
        if (p < 1) requestAnimationFrame(step);
      }
      requestAnimationFrame(step);
    }

    /* Data ops */
    function getFiltered() {
      const { text, category, type, startDate, endDate } = state.filter;
      let res = state.transactions.filter(tx => {
        if (type && tx.type !== type) return false;
        if (category && tx.category !== category) return false;
        if (startDate && tx.date < startDate) return false;
        if (endDate && tx.date > endDate) return false;
        if (text) {
          const q = text.toLowerCase();
          return tx.category.toLowerCase().includes(q) || (tx.note && tx.note.toLowerCase().includes(q)) || String(tx.amount).includes(q);
        }
        return true;
      });
      const col = state.sort.col;
      const dir = state.sort.dir === 'asc' ? 1 : -1;
      res.sort((a, b) => {
        let cmp = 0;
        if (col === 'date') cmp = a.date.localeCompare(b.date);
        else if (col === 'amount') cmp = a.amount - b.amount;
        else if (col === 'category') cmp = a.category.localeCompare(b.category);
        else if (col === 'type') cmp = a.type.localeCompare(b.type);
        return cmp * dir;
      });
      return res;
    }

    function computeLineData(txs) {
      if (!txs.length) return { labels: [], data: [] };
      const daily = {};
      [...txs].sort((a, b) => a.date.localeCompare(b.date)).forEach(tx => {
        daily[tx.date] = (daily[tx.date] || 0) + (tx.type === 'income' ? tx.amount : -tx.amount);
      });
      const dates = Object.keys(daily).sort();
      let acc = 0;
      const data = dates.map(d => { acc += daily[d]; return acc; });
      return { labels: dates, data };
    }

    function computeBarData(txs) {
      const months = {};
      txs.forEach(tx => {
        const m = tx.date.slice(0, 7);
        if (!months[m]) months[m] = { income: 0, expense: 0 };
        months[m][tx.type] += tx.amount;
      });
      const labels = Object.keys(months).sort();
      return { labels, income: labels.map(m => months[m].income), expense: labels.map(m => months[m].expense) };
    }

    function computeDoughnutData(txs) {
      const cats = {};
      txs.filter(t => t.type === 'expense').forEach(t => { cats[t.category] = (cats[t.category] || 0) + t.amount; });
      return { labels: Object.keys(cats), data: Object.values(cats) };
    }

    function updateCategoryOptions() {
      const cats = [...new Set(state.transactions.map(t => t.category))].sort();
      const list = els.categoryList;
      list.innerHTML = cats.map(c => `<option value="${c}">`).join('');
      const sel = els.filterCategory;
      const prev = sel.value;
      sel.innerHTML = '<option value="">All Categories</option>' + cats.map(c => `<option value="${c}">${c}</option>`).join('');
      sel.value = prev;
    }

    /* Render */
    function renderAll() {
      const filtered = getFiltered();
      const totalInc = filtered.filter(t => t.type === 'income').reduce((s, t) => s + t.amount, 0);
      const totalExp = filtered.filter(t => t.type === 'expense').reduce((s, t) => s + t.amount, 0);
      const net = totalInc - totalExp;
      const rate = totalInc > 0 ? ((totalInc - totalExp) / totalInc) * 100 : 0;

      animateValue(els.sumIncome, totalInc);
      animateValue(els.sumExpense, totalExp);
      animateValue(els.sumNet, net);
      animateValue(els.sumRate, rate, '%');
      els.headerNet.textContent = formatCurrency(net);

      updateCategoryOptions();
      updateCharts(filtered);
      renderTable(filtered);
    }

    function renderTable(txs) {
      const html = txs.map(tx => `
        <tr data-id="${tx.id}">
          <td>${tx.date}</td>
          <td><span class="type-badge ${tx.type}">${tx.type}</span></td>
          <td>${tx.category}</td>
          <td>${formatCurrency(tx.amount)}</td>
          <td class="note-cell" title="${tx.note || ''}">${tx.note || '-'}</td>
          <td><button class="btn btn-sm btn-danger delete-btn" data-id="${tx.id}" aria-label="Delete ${tx.category} transaction">Delete</button></td>
        </tr>
      `).join('');
      els.tableBody.innerHTML = html;
    }

    /* Charts */
    function initCharts() {
      Chart.defaults.color = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.7)';
      Chart.defaults.borderColor = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.1)';

      state.charts.line = new Chart(document.getElementById('lineChart').getContext('2d'), {
        type: 'line',
        data: { labels: [], datasets: [{ label: 'Balance', data: [], borderColor: '#00d2ff', backgroundColor: 'rgba(0,210,255,0.12)', fill: true, tension: 0.4, pointRadius: 3, pointHoverRadius: 6 }] },
        options: { responsive: true, maintainAspectRatio: false, scales: { y: { beginAtZero: true, grid: { color: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.05)' } }, x: { grid: { display: false } } }, plugins: { legend: { display: false }, tooltip: { mode: 'index', intersect: false } } }
      });

      state.charts.bar = new Chart(document.getElementById('barChart').getContext('2d'), {
        type: 'bar',
        data: { labels: [], datasets: [{ label: 'Income', data: [], backgroundColor: '#00d2ff', borderRadius: 4 }, { label: 'Expense', data: [], backgroundColor: '#ff0055', borderRadius: 4 }] },
        options: { responsive: true, maintainAspectRatio: false, scales: { y: { beginAtZero: true, grid: { color: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.05)' } }, x: { grid: { display: false } } }, plugins: { legend: { labels: { color: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.9)' } } } }
      });

      state.charts.doughnut = new Chart(document.getElementById('doughnutChart').getContext('2d'), {
        type: 'doughnut',
        data: { labels: [], datasets: [{ data: [], backgroundColor: ['#00d2ff','#ff0055','#ccff00','#ff00cc','#00ffaa','#ffaa00','#aa00ff','#ffffff'], borderWidth: 0 }] },
        options: { responsive: true, maintainAspectRatio: false, cutout: '70%', plugins: { legend: { position: 'right', labels: { color: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.9)' } } } }
      });
    }

    function updateCharts(filtered) {
      const line = computeLineData(filtered);
      state.charts.line.data.labels = line.labels;
      state.charts.line.data.datasets[0].data = line.data;
      state.charts.line.update('active');

      const bar = computeBarData(filtered);
      state.charts.bar.data.labels = bar.labels;
      state.charts.bar.data.datasets[0].data = bar.income;
      state.charts.bar.data.datasets[1].data = bar.expense;
      state.charts.bar.update('active');

      const dough = computeDoughnutData(filtered);
      state.charts.doughnut.data.labels = dough.labels;
      state.charts.doughnut.data.datasets[0].data = dough.data;
      state.charts.doughnut.update('active');
    }

    /* Modal logic */
    let lastFocus = null;
    function openModal(edit, id) {
      lastFocus = document.activeElement;
      els.txModal.classList.add('open');
      els.txModal.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'false');
      if (edit && id) {
        const tx = state.transactions.find(t => t.id === id);
        state.editingId = id;
        document.getElementById('modalTitle').textContent = 'Edit Entry';
        els.txType.value = tx.type;
        els.txAmount.value = tx.amount;
        els.txCategory.value = tx.category;
        els.txDate.value = tx.date;
        els.txNote.value = tx.note || '';
        els.txRecurring.checked = tx.recurring;
      } else {
        state.editingId = null;
        document.getElementById('modalTitle').textContent = 'Add Entry';
        els.txForm.reset();
        els.txDate.valueAsDate = new Date();
      }
      setTimeout(() => els.txType.focus(), 50);
      document.addEventListener('keydown', trapModalKey);
    }

    function closeModal() {
      els.txModal.classList.remove('open');
      els.txModal.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
      document.removeEventListener('keydown', trapModalKey);
      if (lastFocus) { try { lastFocus.focus(); } catch(e){} }
    }

    function trapModalKey(e) {
      if (e.key === 'Escape') { closeModal(); return; }
      if (e.key !== 'Tab') return;
      const container = els.txModal.querySelector('.modal-content');
      const nodes = Array.from(container.querySelectorAll('button, [href], input, select, textarea, [tabindex]:not([tabindex="-1"])'));
      if (!nodes.length) return;
      const first = nodes[0];
      const last = nodes[nodes.length - 1];
      if (e.shiftKey) { if (document.activeElement === first) { last.focus(); e.preventDefault(); } }
      else { if (document.activeElement === last) { first.focus(); e.preventDefault(); } }
    }

    let confirmAction = null;
    function showConfirm(msg, onYes) {
      els.confirmMessage.textContent = msg;
      confirmAction = onYes;
      els.confirmModal.classList.add('open');
      els.confirmModal.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'false');
    }
    function hideConfirm() {
      els.confirmModal.classList.remove('open');
      els.confirmModal.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
      confirmAction = null;
    }

    /* Events */
    els.sidebarToggle.addEventListener('click', () => { els.sidebar.classList.add('open'); els.sidebarOverlay.classList.add('open'); });
    els.sidebarOverlay.addEventListener('click', () => { els.sidebar.classList.remove('open'); els.sidebarOverlay.classList.remove('open'); });

    els.btnAddSidebar.addEventListener('click', () => openModal(false));
    els.btnAddToolbar.addEventListener('click', () => openModal(false));

    els.btnApply.addEventListener('click', () => {
      state.filter.text = els.filterText.value.trim();
      state.filter.type = els.filterType.value;
      state.filter.category = els.filterCategory.value;
      state.filter.startDate = els.filterStart.value;
      state.filter.endDate = els.filterEnd.value;
      renderAll();
    });

    els.btnReset.addEventListener('click', () => {
      els.filterText.value = ''; els.filterType.value = ''; els.filterCategory.value = '';
      els.filterStart.value = ''; els.filterEnd.value = '';
      state.filter = { text: '', category: '', type: '', startDate: '', endDate: '' };
      renderAll();
    });

    els.btnExport.addEventListener('click', () => {
      const rows = [['ID','Date','Type','Category','Amount','Note','Recurring']];
      getFiltered().forEach(t => rows.push([t.id, t.date, t.type, t.category, t.amount, t.note || '', t.recurring]));
      const csv = rows.map(r => r.map(v => `"${String(v).replace(/"/g, '""')}"`).join(',')).join('\n');
      const blob = new Blob([csv], {type: 'text/csv'});
      const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
      const a = document.createElement('a'); a.href = url; a.download = 'transactions.csv'; a.click();
      URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
    });

    els.tableHeaders.forEach(th => {
      th.addEventListener('click', () => {
        const col = th.dataset.sort;
        if (state.sort.col === col) state.sort.dir = state.sort.dir === 'asc' ? 'desc' : 'asc';
        else { state.sort.col = col; state.sort.dir = 'asc'; }
        renderAll();
      });
    });

    els.tableBody.addEventListener('click', e => {
      const btn = e.target.closest('.delete-btn');
      if (!btn) return;
      const id = btn.dataset.id;
      showConfirm('Are you sure you want to delete this transaction?', () => {
        state.transactions = state.transactions.filter(t => t.id !== id);
        renderAll();
      });
    });

    els.txForm.addEventListener('submit', e => {
      e.preventDefault();
      const payload = {
        id: state.editingId || uuid(),
        type: els.txType.value,
        amount: parseFloat(els.txAmount.value),
        category: els.txCategory.value,
        date: els.txDate.value,
        note: els.txNote.value,
        recurring: els.txRecurring.checked
      };
      if (state.editingId) {
        const idx = state.transactions.findIndex(t => t.id === state.editingId);
        if (idx > -1) state.transactions[idx] = payload;
      } else {
        state.transactions.push(payload);
      }
      closeModal();
      renderAll();
    });

    [els.modalClose, els.modalCancel].forEach(b => b.addEventListener('click', closeModal));
    els.confirmYes.addEventListener('click', () => { if (confirmAction) confirmAction(); hideConfirm(); });
    els.confirmNo.addEventListener('click', hideConfirm);

    /* Theme */
    function applyChartTheme() {
      const isLight = document.body.getAttribute('data-theme') === 'light';
      Chart.defaults.color = isLight ? '#4a4c5a' : 'rgba(255,255,255,0.7)';
      Chart.defaults.borderColor = isLight ? 'rgba(0,0,0,0.08)' : 'rgba(255,255,255,0.1)';
      Object.values(state.charts).forEach(chart => chart && chart.update('none'));
    }

    function initTheme() {
      const saved = localStorage.getItem('nova-theme');
      if (saved) {
        document.body.setAttribute('data-theme', saved);
      } else if (window.matchMedia && window.matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: light)').matches) {
        document.body.setAttribute('data-theme', 'light');
      }
      const icon = document.getElementById('themeIcon');
      function updateIcon() {
        const isLight = document.body.getAttribute('data-theme') === 'light';
        if (isLight) {
          icon.innerHTML = '<path d="M21 12.79A9 9 0 1 1 11.21 3 7 7 0 0 0 21 12.79z"></path>';
        } else {
          icon.innerHTML = '<circle cx="12" cy="12" r="5"/><path d="M12 1v2M12 21v2M4.22 4.22l1.42 1.42M18.36 18.36l1.42 1.42M1 12h2M21 12h2M4.22 19.78l1.42-1.42M18.36 5.64l1.42-1.42"/>';
        }
      }
      updateIcon();
      applyChartTheme();
      document.getElementById('themeToggle').addEventListener('click', () => {
        const isLight = document.body.getAttribute('data-theme') === 'light';
        const next = isLight ? 'dark' : 'light';
        document.body.setAttribute('data-theme', next);
        localStorage.setItem('nova-theme', next);
        updateIcon();
        applyChartTheme();
      });
    }

    /* Clock */
    function startClock() {
      function tick() {
        const now = new Date();
        els.clock.textContent = now.toLocaleTimeString('en-US', {hour: '2-digit', minute:'2-digit'});
      }
      tick();
      setInterval(tick, 1000);
    }

    /* Boot */
    initCharts();
    renderAll();
    startClock();
    initTheme();
  </script>
</body>
</html>

// Intersection Observer for reveals
const revealEls = document.querySelectorAll('.reveal');
const io = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
  entries.forEach(entry => {
    if (entry.isIntersecting) {
      entry.target.classList.add('visible');
    }
  });
}, { threshold: 0.1 });
revealEls.forEach(el => io.observe(el));

// FAQ Accordion
document.querySelectorAll('.faq-question').forEach(btn => {
  btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
    const item = btn.parentElement;
    const isActive = item.classList.contains('active');
    document.querySelectorAll('.faq-item').forEach(i => i.classList.remove('active'));
    if (!isActive) item.classList.add('active');
  });
});

  }
}
mobileToggle.addEventListener('click', () => { navOpen = !navOpen; updateNav(); });

  let i = 0;
  function typeNext() {
    if (i < demoTokens.length) {
      codeEl.insertBefore(document.createRange().createContextualFragment(demoTokens[i]), codeEl.lastElementChild);
      i++;
      setTimeout(typeNext, Math.random() * 40 + 15);
    } else {
      consoleEl.innerHTML = '<span style="color:var(--accent)">Success:</span> Code generated in 0.4s • 14 lines';
      runBtn.textContent = 'Completed';
    }
  }
  setTimeout(typeNext, 400);
});

  <script>
    const header = document.getElementById('header');
    window.addEventListener('scroll', () => {
      if (window.scrollY > 50) {
        header.classList.add('scrolled');
      } else {
        header.classList.remove('scrolled');
      }
    });

    const observerOptions = {
      root: null,
      rootMargin: '0px',
      threshold: 0.1
    };

    const fadeObserver = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
      entries.forEach(entry => {
        if (entry.isIntersecting) {
          entry.target.classList.add('visible');
          if (entry.target.id === 'heroContainer') {
            entry.target.classList.add('active');
          }
          fadeObserver.unobserve(entry.target);
        }
      });
    }, observerOptions);

    document.querySelectorAll('.fade-up').forEach(el => fadeObserver.observe(el));
    const heroContainer = document.getElementById('heroContainer');
    if (heroContainer) fadeObserver.observe(heroContainer);

    window.addEventListener('load', () => {
      if (heroContainer) {
        const rect = heroContainer.getBoundingClientRect();
        if (rect.top < window.innerHeight && rect.bottom > 0) {
          heroContainer.classList.add('active');
        }
      }
    });

    document.querySelectorAll('.magnetic-btn').forEach(btn => {
      btn.addEventListener('mousemove', (e) => {
        const rect = btn.getBoundingClientRect();
        const x = e.clientX - rect.left - rect.width / 2;
        const y = e.clientY - rect.top - rect.height / 2;
        btn.style.transform = `translate(${x * 0.2}px, ${y * 0.2}px)`;
      });
      btn.addEventListener('mouseleave', () => {
        btn.style.transform = 'translate(0px, 0px)';
      });
    });
  </script>
</body>
</html>
