<script>// Production steps of ECMA-262, Edition 5, 15.4.4.18
// Reference: http://es5.github.io/#x15.4.4.18
if (!Array.prototype.forEach) {

  Array.prototype.forEach = function(callback, thisArg) {

    var T, k;

    if (this === null) {
      throw new TypeError(' this is null or not defined');
    }

    // 1. Let O be the result of calling toObject() passing the
    // |this| value as the argument.
    var O = Object(this);

    // 2. Let lenValue be the result of calling the Get() internal
    // method of O with the argument "length".
    // 3. Let len be toUint32(lenValue).
    var len = O.length >>> 0;

    // 4. If isCallable(callback) is false, throw a TypeError exception.
    // See: http://es5.github.com/#x9.11
    if (typeof callback !== "function") {
      throw new TypeError(callback + ' is not a function');
    }

    // 5. If thisArg was supplied, let T be thisArg; else let
    // T be undefined.
    if (arguments.length > 1) {
      T = thisArg;
    }

    // 6. Let k be 0
    k = 0;

    // 7. Repeat, while k < len
    while (k < len) {

      var kValue;

      // a. Let Pk be ToString(k).
      //    This is implicit for LHS operands of the in operator
      // b. Let kPresent be the result of calling the HasProperty
      //    internal method of O with argument Pk.
      //    This step can be combined with c
      // c. If kPresent is true, then
      if (k in O) {

        // i. Let kValue be the result of calling the Get internal
        // method of O with argument Pk.
        kValue = O[k];

        // ii. Call the Call internal method of callback with T as
        // the this value and argument list containing kValue, k, and O.
        callback.call(T, kValue, k, O);
      }
      // d. Increase k by 1.
      k++;
    }
    // 8. return undefined
  };
}

// Production steps of ECMA-262, Edition 5, 15.4.4.19
// Reference: http://es5.github.io/#x15.4.4.19
if (!Array.prototype.map) {

  Array.prototype.map = function(callback, thisArg) {

    var T, A, k;

    if (this == null) {
      throw new TypeError(' this is null or not defined');
    }

    // 1. Let O be the result of calling ToObject passing the |this|
    //    value as the argument.
    var O = Object(this);

    // 2. Let lenValue be the result of calling the Get internal
    //    method of O with the argument "length".
    // 3. Let len be ToUint32(lenValue).
    var len = O.length >>> 0;

    // 4. If IsCallable(callback) is false, throw a TypeError exception.
    // See: http://es5.github.com/#x9.11
    if (typeof callback !== 'function') {
      throw new TypeError(callback + ' is not a function');
    }

    // 5. If thisArg was supplied, let T be thisArg; else let T be undefined.
    if (arguments.length > 1) {
      T = thisArg;
    }

    // 6. Let A be a new array created as if by the expression new Array(len)
    //    where Array is the standard built-in constructor with that name and
    //    len is the value of len.
    A = new Array(len);

    // 7. Let k be 0
    k = 0;

    // 8. Repeat, while k < len
    while (k < len) {

      var kValue, mappedValue;

      // a. Let Pk be ToString(k).
      //   This is implicit for LHS operands of the in operator
      // b. Let kPresent be the result of calling the HasProperty internal
      //    method of O with argument Pk.
      //   This step can be combined with c
      // c. If kPresent is true, then
      if (k in O) {

        // i. Let kValue be the result of calling the Get internal
        //    method of O with argument Pk.
        kValue = O[k];

        // ii. Let mappedValue be the result of calling the Call internal
        //     method of callback with T as the this value and argument
        //     list containing kValue, k, and O.
        mappedValue = callback.call(T, kValue, k, O);

        // iii. Call the DefineOwnProperty internal method of A with arguments
        // Pk, Property Descriptor
        // { Value: mappedValue,
        //   Writable: true,
        //   Enumerable: true,
        //   Configurable: true },
        // and false.

        // In browsers that support Object.defineProperty, use the following:
        // Object.defineProperty(A, k, {
        //   value: mappedValue,
        //   writable: true,
        //   enumerable: true,
        //   configurable: true
        // });

        // For best browser support, use the following:
        A[k] = mappedValue;
      }
      // d. Increase k by 1.
      k++;
    }

    // 9. return A
    return A;
  };
}

var PagedTable = function (pagedTable) {
  var me = this;

  var source = function(pagedTable) {
    var sourceElems = [].slice.call(pagedTable.children).filter(function(e) {
      return e.hasAttribute("data-pagedtable-source");
    });

    if (sourceElems === null || sourceElems.length !== 1) {
      throw("A single data-pagedtable-source was not found");
    }

    return JSON.parse(sourceElems[0].innerHTML);
  }(pagedTable);

  var options = function(source) {
    var options = typeof(source.options) !== "undefined" &&
      source.options !== null ? source.options : {};

    var columns = typeof(options.columns) !== "undefined" ? options.columns : {};
    var rows = typeof(options.rows) !== "undefined" ? options.rows : {};

    var positiveIntOrNull = function(value) {
      return parseInt(value) >= 0 ? parseInt(value) : null;
    };

    return {
      pages: positiveIntOrNull(options.pages),
      rows: {
        min: positiveIntOrNull(rows.min),
        max: positiveIntOrNull(rows.max),
        total: positiveIntOrNull(rows.total)
      },
      columns: {
        min: positiveIntOrNull(columns.min),
        max: positiveIntOrNull(columns.max),
        total: positiveIntOrNull(columns.total)
      }
    };
  }(source);

  var Measurer = function() {

    // set some default initial values that will get adjusted in runtime
    me.measures = {
      padding: 12,
      character: 8,
      height: 15,
      defaults: true
    };

    me.calculate = function(measuresCell) {
      if (!me.measures.defaults)
        return;

      var measuresCellStyle = window.getComputedStyle(measuresCell, null);

      var newPadding = parsePadding(measuresCellStyle.paddingLeft) +
            parsePadding(measuresCellStyle.paddingRight);

      var sampleString = "ABCDEFGHIJ0123456789";
      var newCharacter = Math.ceil(measuresCell.clientWidth / sampleString.length);

      if (newPadding <= 0 || newCharacter <= 0)
        return;

      me.measures.padding = newPadding;
      me.measures.character = newCharacter;
      me.measures.height = measuresCell.clientHeight;
      me.measures.defaults = false;
    };

    return me;
  };

  var Page = function(data, options) {
    var me = this;

    var defaults = {
      max: 7,
      rows: 10
    };

    var totalPages = function() {
      return Math.ceil(data.length / me.rows);
    };

    me.number = 0;
    me.max = options.pages !== null ? options.pages : defaults.max;
    me.visible = me.max;
    me.rows = options.rows.min !== null ? options.rows.min : defaults.rows;
    me.total = totalPages();

    me.setRows = function(newRows) {
      me.rows = newRows;
      me.total = totalPages();
    };

    me.setPageNumber = function(newPageNumber) {
      if (newPageNumber < 0) newPageNumber = 0;
      if (newPageNumber >= me.total) newPageNumber = me.total - 1;

      me.number = newPageNumber;
    };

    me.setVisiblePages = function(visiblePages) {
      me.visible = Math.min(me.max, visiblePages);
      me.setPageNumber(me.number);
    };

    me.getVisiblePageRange = function() {
      var start = me.number - Math.max(Math.floor((me.visible - 1) / 2), 0);
      var end = me.number + Math.floor(me.visible / 2) + 1;
      var pageCount = me.total;

      if (start < 0) {
        var diffToStart = 0 - start;
        start += diffToStart;
        end += diffToStart;
      }

      if (end > pageCount) {
        var diffToEnd = end - pageCount;
        start -= diffToEnd;
        end -= diffToEnd;
      }

      start = start < 0 ? 0 : start;
      end = end >= pageCount ? pageCount : end;

      var first = false;
      var last = false;

      if (start > 0 && me.visible > 1) {
        start = start + 1;
        first = true;
      }

      if (end < pageCount && me.visible > 2) {
        end = end - 1;
        last = true;
      }

      return {
        first: first,
        start: start,
        end: end,
        last: last
      };
    };

    me.getRowStart = function() {
      var rowStart = page.number * page.rows;
      if (rowStart < 0)
        rowStart = 0;

      return rowStart;
    };

    me.getRowEnd = function() {
      var rowStart = me.getRowStart();
      return Math.min(rowStart + me.rows, data.length);
    };

    me.getPaddingRows = function() {
      var rowStart = me.getRowStart();
      var rowEnd = me.getRowEnd();
      return data.length > me.rows ? me.rows - (rowEnd - rowStart) : 0;
    };
  };

  var Columns = function(data, columns, options) {
    var me = this;

    me.defaults = {
      min: 5
    };

    me.number = 0;
    me.visible = 0;
    me.total = columns.length;
    me.subset = [];
    me.padding = 0;
    me.min = options.columns.min !== null ? options.columns.min : me.defaults.min;
    me.max = options.columns.max !== null ? options.columns.max : null;
    me.widths = {};

    var widthsLookAhead = Math.max(100, options.rows.min);
    var paddingColChars = 10;

    me.emptyNames = function() {
      columns.forEach(function(column) {
        if (columns.label !== null && columns.label !== "")
          return false;
      });

      return true;
    };

    var parsePadding = function(value) {
      return parseInt(value) >= 0 ? parseInt(value) : 0;
    };

    me.calculateWidths = function(measures) {
      columns.forEach(function(column) {
        var maxChars = Math.max(
          column.label.toString().length,
          column.type.toString().length
        );

        for (var idxRow = 0; idxRow < Math.min(widthsLookAhead, data.length); idxRow++) {
          maxChars = Math.max(maxChars, data[idxRow][column.name.toString()].length);
        }

        me.widths[column.name] = {
          // width in characters
          chars: maxChars,
          // width for the inner html columns
          inner: maxChars * measures.character,
          // width adding outer styles like padding
          outer: maxChars * measures.character + measures.padding
        };
      });
    };

    me.getWidth = function() {
      var widthOuter = 0;
      for (var idxCol = 0; idxCol < me.subset.length; idxCol++) {
        var columnName = me.subset[idxCol].name;
        widthOuter = widthOuter + me.widths[columnName].outer;
      }

      widthOuter = widthOuter + me.padding * paddingColChars * measurer.measures.character;

      if (me.hasMoreLeftColumns()) {
        widthOuter = widthOuter + columnNavigationWidthPX + measurer.measures.padding;
      }

      if (me.hasMoreRightColumns()) {
        widthOuter = widthOuter + columnNavigationWidthPX + measurer.measures.padding;
      }

      return widthOuter;
    };

    me.updateSlice = function() {
      if (me.number + me.visible >= me.total)
        me.number = me.total - me.visible;

      if (me.number < 0) me.number = 0;

      me.subset = columns.slice(me.number, Math.min(me.number + me.visible, me.total));

      me.subset = me.subset.map(function(column) {
        Object.keys(column).forEach(function(colKey) {
          column[colKey] = column[colKey] === null ? "" : column[colKey].toString();
        });

        column.width = null;
        return column;
      });
    };

    me.setVisibleColumns = function(columnNumber, newVisibleColumns, paddingCount) {
      me.number = columnNumber;
      me.visible = newVisibleColumns;
      me.padding = paddingCount;

      me.updateSlice();
    };

    me.incColumnNumber = function(increment) {
      me.number = me.number + increment;
    };

    me.setColumnNumber = function(newNumber) {
      me.number = newNumber;
    };

    me.setPaddingCount = function(newPadding) {
      me.padding = newPadding;
    };

    me.getPaddingCount = function() {
      return me.padding;
    };

    me.hasMoreLeftColumns = function() {
      return me.number > 0;
    };

    me.hasMoreRightColumns = function() {
      return me.number + me.visible < me.total;
    };

    me.updateSlice(0);
    return me;
  };

  var data = source.data;
  var page = new Page(data, options);
  var measurer = new Measurer(data, options);
  var columns = new Columns(data, source.columns, options);

  var table = null;
  var tableDiv = null;
  var header = null;
  var footer = null;
  var tbody = null;

  // Caches pagedTable.clientWidth, specially for webkit
  var cachedPagedTableClientWidth = null;

  var onChangeCallbacks = [];

  var clearSelection = function() {
    if(document.selection && document.selection.empty) {
      document.selection.empty();
    } else if(window.getSelection) {
      var sel = window.getSelection();
      sel.removeAllRanges();
    }
  };

  var columnNavigationWidthPX = 5;

  var renderColumnNavigation = function(increment, backwards) {
    var arrow = document.createElement("div");
    arrow.setAttribute("style",
      "border-top: " + columnNavigationWidthPX + "px solid transparent;" +
      "border-bottom: " + columnNavigationWidthPX + "px solid transparent;" +
      "border-" + (backwards ? "right" : "left") + ": " + columnNavigationWidthPX + "px solid;");

    var header = document.createElement("th");
    header.appendChild(arrow);
    header.setAttribute("style",
      "cursor: pointer;" +
      "vertical-align: middle;" +
      "min-width: " + columnNavigationWidthPX + "px;" +
      "width: " + columnNavigationWidthPX + "px;");

    header.onclick = function() {
      columns.incColumnNumber(backwards ? -1 : increment);

      me.animateColumns(backwards);
      renderFooter();

      clearSelection();
      triggerOnChange();
    };

    return header;
  };

  var maxColumnWidth = function(width) {
    var padding = 80;
    var columnMax = Math.max(cachedPagedTableClientWidth - padding, 0);

    return parseInt(width) > 0 ?
      Math.min(columnMax, parseInt(width)) + "px" :
      columnMax + "px";
  };

  var clearHeader = function() {
    var thead = pagedTable.querySelectorAll("thead")[0];
    thead.innerHTML = "";
  };

  var renderHeader = function(clear) {
    cachedPagedTableClientWidth = pagedTable.clientWidth;

    var fragment = document.createDocumentFragment();

    header = document.createElement("tr");
    fragment.appendChild(header);

    if (columns.number > 0)
      header.appendChild(renderColumnNavigation(-columns.visible, true));

    columns.subset = columns.subset.map(function(columnData) {
      var column = document.createElement("th");
      column.setAttribute("align", columnData.align);
      column.style.textAlign = columnData.align;

      column.style.maxWidth = maxColumnWidth(null);
      if (columnData.width) {
        column.style.minWidth =
          column.style.maxWidth = maxColumnWidth(columnData.width);
      }

      var columnName = document.createElement("div");
      columnName.setAttribute("class", "pagedtable-header-name");
      if (columnData.label === "") {
        columnName.innerHTML = "&nbsp;";
      }
      else {
        columnName.appendChild(document.createTextNode(columnData.label));
      }
      column.appendChild(columnName);

      var columnType = document.createElement("div");
      columnType.setAttribute("class", "pagedtable-header-type");
      if (columnData.type === "") {
        columnType.innerHTML = "&nbsp;";
      }
      else {
        columnType.appendChild(document.createTextNode("<" + columnData.type + ">"));
      }
      column.appendChild(columnType);

      header.appendChild(column);

      columnData.element = column;

      return columnData;
    });

    for (var idx = 0; idx < columns.getPaddingCount(); idx++) {
      var paddingCol = document.createElement("th");
      paddingCol.setAttribute("class", "pagedtable-padding-col");
      header.appendChild(paddingCol);
    }

    if (columns.number + columns.visible < columns.total)
      header.appendChild(renderColumnNavigation(columns.visible, false));

    if (typeof(clear) == "undefined" || clear) clearHeader();
    var thead = pagedTable.querySelectorAll("thead")[0];
    thead.appendChild(fragment);
  };

  me.animateColumns = function(backwards) {
    var thead = pagedTable.querySelectorAll("thead")[0];

    var headerOld = thead.querySelectorAll("tr")[0];
    var tbodyOld = table.querySelectorAll("tbody")[0];

    me.fitColumns(backwards);

    renderHeader(false);

    header.style.opacity = "0";
    header.style.transform = backwards ? "translateX(-30px)" : "translateX(30px)";
    header.style.transition = "transform 200ms linear, opacity 200ms";
    header.style.transitionDelay = "0";

    renderBody(false);

    if (headerOld) {
      headerOld.style.position = "absolute";
      headerOld.style.transform = "translateX(0px)";
      headerOld.style.opacity = "1";
      headerOld.style.transition = "transform 100ms linear, opacity 100ms";
      headerOld.setAttribute("class", "pagedtable-remove-head");
      if (headerOld.style.transitionEnd) {
        headerOld.addEventListener("transitionend", function() {
          var headerOldByClass = thead.querySelector(".pagedtable-remove-head");
          if (headerOldByClass) thead.removeChild(headerOldByClass);
        });
      }
      else {
        thead.removeChild(headerOld);
      }
    }

    if (tbodyOld) table.removeChild(tbodyOld);

    tbody.style.opacity = "0";
    tbody.style.transition = "transform 200ms linear, opacity 200ms";
    tbody.style.transitionDelay = "0ms";

    // force relayout
    window.getComputedStyle(header).opacity;
    window.getComputedStyle(tbody).opacity;

    if (headerOld) {
      headerOld.style.transform = backwards ? "translateX(20px)" : "translateX(-30px)";
      headerOld.style.opacity = "0";
    }

    header.style.transform = "translateX(0px)";
    header.style.opacity = "1";

    tbody.style.opacity = "1";
  }

  me.onChange = function(callback) {
    onChangeCallbacks.push(callback);
  };

  var triggerOnChange = function() {
    onChangeCallbacks.forEach(function(onChange) {
      onChange();
    });
  };

  var clearBody = function() {
    if (tbody) {
      table.removeChild(tbody);
      tbody = null;
    }
  };

  var renderBody = function(clear) {
    cachedPagedTableClientWidth = pagedTable.clientWidth

    var fragment = document.createDocumentFragment();

    var pageData = data.slice(page.getRowStart(), page.getRowEnd());

    pageData.forEach(function(dataRow, idxRow) {
      var htmlRow = document.createElement("tr");
      htmlRow.setAttribute("class", (idxRow % 2 !==0) ? "even" : "odd");

      if (columns.hasMoreLeftColumns())
        htmlRow.appendChild(document.createElement("td"));

      columns.subset.forEach(function(columnData) {
        var cellName = columnData.name;
        var dataCell = dataRow[cellName];
        var htmlCell = document.createElement("td");

        if (dataCell === "NA") htmlCell.setAttribute("class", "pagedtable-na-cell");
        if (dataCell === "__NA__") dataCell = "NA";

        var cellText = document.createTextNode(dataCell);
        htmlCell.appendChild(cellText);
        if (dataCell.length > 50) {
          htmlCell.setAttribute("title", dataCell);
        }
        htmlCell.setAttribute("align", columnData.align);
        htmlCell.style.textAlign = columnData.align;
        htmlCell.style.maxWidth = maxColumnWidth(null);
        if (columnData.width) {
          htmlCell.style.minWidth = htmlCell.style.maxWidth = maxColumnWidth(columnData.width);
        }
        htmlRow.appendChild(htmlCell);
      });

      for (var idx = 0; idx < columns.getPaddingCount(); idx++) {
        var paddingCol = document.createElement("td");
        paddingCol.setAttribute("class", "pagedtable-padding-col");
        htmlRow.appendChild(paddingCol);
      }

      if (columns.hasMoreRightColumns())
        htmlRow.appendChild(document.createElement("td"));

      fragment.appendChild(htmlRow);
    });

    for (var idxPadding = 0; idxPadding < page.getPaddingRows(); idxPadding++) {
      var paddingRow = document.createElement("tr");

      var paddingCellRow = document.createElement("td");
      paddingCellRow.innerHTML = "&nbsp;";
      paddingCellRow.setAttribute("colspan", "100%");
      paddingRow.appendChild(paddingCellRow);

      fragment.appendChild(paddingRow);
    }

    if (typeof(clear) == "undefined" || clear) clearBody();
    tbody = document.createElement("tbody");
    tbody.appendChild(fragment);

    table.appendChild(tbody);
  };

  var getLabelInfo = function() {
    var pageStart = page.getRowStart();
    var pageEnd = page.getRowEnd();
    var totalRows = data.length;

    var totalRowsLabel = options.rows.total ? options.rows.total : totalRows;
    var totalRowsLabelFormat = totalRowsLabel.toString().replace(/(\d)(?=(\d\d\d)+(?!\d))/g, '$1,');

    var infoText = (pageStart + 1) + "-" + pageEnd + " of " + totalRowsLabelFormat + " rows";
    if (totalRows < page.rows) {
      infoText = totalRowsLabel + " row" + (totalRows != 1 ? "s" : "");
    }
    if (columns.total > columns.visible) {
      var totalColumnsLabel = options.columns.total ? options.columns.total : columns.total;

      infoText = infoText + " | " + (columns.number + 1) + "-" +
        (Math.min(columns.number + columns.visible, columns.total)) +
        " of " + totalColumnsLabel + " columns";
    }

    return infoText;
  };

  var clearFooter = function() {
    footer = pagedTable.querySelectorAll("div.pagedtable-footer")[0];
    footer.innerHTML = "";

    return footer;
  };

  var createPageLink = function(idxPage) {
    var pageLink = document.createElement("a");
    pageLinkClass = idxPage === page.number ? "pagedtable-index pagedtable-index-current" : "pagedtable-index";
    pageLink.setAttribute("class", pageLinkClass);
    pageLink.setAttribute("data-page-index", idxPage);
    pageLink.onclick = function() {
      page.setPageNumber(parseInt(this.getAttribute("data-page-index")));
      renderBody();
      renderFooter();

      triggerOnChange();
    };

    pageLink.appendChild(document.createTextNode(idxPage + 1));

    return pageLink;
  }

  var renderFooter = function() {
    footer = clearFooter();

    var next = document.createElement("a");
    next.appendChild(document.createTextNode("Next"));
    next.onclick = function() {
      page.setPageNumber(page.number + 1);
      renderBody();
      renderFooter();

      triggerOnChange();
    };
    if (data.length > page.rows) footer.appendChild(next);

    var pageNumbers = document.createElement("div");
    pageNumbers.setAttribute("class", "pagedtable-indexes");

    var pageRange = page.getVisiblePageRange();

    if (pageRange.first) {
      var pageLink = createPageLink(0);
      pageNumbers.appendChild(pageLink);

      var pageSeparator = document.createElement("div");
      pageSeparator.setAttribute("class", "pagedtable-index-separator-left");
      pageSeparator.appendChild(document.createTextNode("..."))
      pageNumbers.appendChild(pageSeparator);
    }

    for (var idxPage = pageRange.start; idxPage < pageRange.end; idxPage++) {
      var pageLink = createPageLink(idxPage);

      pageNumbers.appendChild(pageLink);
    }

    if (pageRange.last) {
      var pageSeparator = document.createElement("div");
      pageSeparator.setAttribute("class", "pagedtable-index-separator-right");
      pageSeparator.appendChild(document.createTextNode("..."))
      pageNumbers.appendChild(pageSeparator);

      var pageLink = createPageLink(page.total - 1);
      pageNumbers.appendChild(pageLink);
    }

    if (data.length > page.rows) footer.appendChild(pageNumbers);

    var previous = document.createElement("a");
    previous.appendChild(document.createTextNode("Previous"));
    previous.onclick = function() {
      page.setPageNumber(page.number - 1);
      renderBody();
      renderFooter();

      triggerOnChange();
    };
    if (data.length > page.rows) footer.appendChild(previous);

    var infoLabel = document.createElement("div");
    infoLabel.setAttribute("class", "pagedtable-info");
    infoLabel.setAttribute("title", getLabelInfo());
    infoLabel.appendChild(document.createTextNode(getLabelInfo()));
    footer.appendChild(infoLabel);

    var enabledClass = "pagedtable-index-nav";
    var disabledClass = "pagedtable-index-nav pagedtable-index-nav-disabled";
    previous.setAttribute("class", page.number <= 0 ? disabledClass : enabledClass);
    next.setAttribute("class", (page.number + 1) * page.rows >= data.length ? disabledClass : enabledClass);
  };

  var measuresCell = null;

  var renderMeasures = function() {
    var measuresTable = document.createElement("table");
    measuresTable.style.visibility = "hidden";
    measuresTable.style.position = "absolute";
    measuresTable.style.whiteSpace = "nowrap";
    measuresTable.style.height = "auto";
    measuresTable.style.width = "auto";

    var measuresRow = document.createElement("tr");
    measuresTable.appendChild(measuresRow);

    measuresCell = document.createElement("td");
    var sampleString = "ABCDEFGHIJ0123456789";
    measuresCell.appendChild(document.createTextNode(sampleString));

    measuresRow.appendChild(measuresCell);

    tableDiv.appendChild(measuresTable);
  }

  me.init = function() {
    tableDiv = document.createElement("div");
    pagedTable.appendChild(tableDiv);
    var pagedTableClass = data.length > 0 ?
      "pagedtable pagedtable-not-empty" :
      "pagedtable pagedtable-empty";

    if (columns.total == 0 || (columns.emptyNames() && data.length == 0)) {
      pagedTableClass = pagedTableClass + " pagedtable-empty-columns";
    }

    tableDiv.setAttribute("class", pagedTableClass);

    renderMeasures();
    measurer.calculate(measuresCell);
    columns.calculateWidths(measurer.measures);

    table = document.createElement("table");
    table.setAttribute("cellspacing", "0");
    table.setAttribute("class", "table table-condensed");
    tableDiv.appendChild(table);

    table.appendChild(document.createElement("thead"));

    var footerDiv = document.createElement("div");
    footerDiv.setAttribute("class", "pagedtable-footer");
    tableDiv.appendChild(footerDiv);

    // if the host has not yet provided horizontal space, render hidden
    if (tableDiv.clientWidth <= 0) {
      tableDiv.style.opacity = "0";
    }

    me.render();

    // retry seizing columns later if the host has not provided space
    function retryFit() {
      if (tableDiv.clientWidth <= 0) {
        setTimeout(retryFit, 100);
      } else {
        me.render();
        triggerOnChange();
      }
    }
    if (tableDiv.clientWidth <= 0) {
      retryFit();
    }
  };

  var registerWidths = function() {
    columns.subset = columns.subset.map(function(column) {
      column.width = columns.widths[column.name].inner;
      return column;
    });
  };

  var parsePadding = function(value) {
    return parseInt(value) >= 0 ? parseInt(value) : 0;
  };

  me.fixedHeight = function() {
    return options.rows.max != null;
  }

  me.fitRows = function() {
    if (me.fixedHeight())
      return;

    measurer.calculate(measuresCell);

    var rows = options.rows.min !== null ? options.rows.min : 0;
    var headerHeight = header !== null && header.offsetHeight > 0 ? header.offsetHeight : 0;
    var footerHeight = footer !== null && footer.offsetHeight > 0 ? footer.offsetHeight : 0;

    if (pagedTable.offsetHeight > 0) {
      var availableHeight = pagedTable.offsetHeight - headerHeight - footerHeight;
      rows = Math.floor((availableHeight) / measurer.measures.height);
    }

    rows = options.rows.min !== null ? Math.max(options.rows.min, rows) : rows;

    page.setRows(rows);
  }

  // The goal of this function is to add as many columns as possible
  // starting from left-to-right, when the right most limit is reached
  // it tries to add columns from the left as well.
  //
  // When startBackwards is true columns are added from right-to-left
  me.fitColumns = function(startBackwards) {
    measurer.calculate(measuresCell);
    columns.calculateWidths(measurer.measures);

    if (tableDiv.clientWidth > 0) {
      tableDiv.style.opacity = 1;
    }

    var visibleColumns = tableDiv.clientWidth <= 0 ? Math.max(columns.min, 1) : 1;
    var columnNumber = columns.number;
    var paddingCount = 0;

    // track a list of added columns as we build the visible ones to allow us
    // to remove columns when they don't fit anymore.
    var columnHistory = [];

    var lastTableHeight = 0;
    var backwards = startBackwards;

    var tableDivStyle = window.getComputedStyle(tableDiv, null);
    var tableDivPadding = parsePadding(tableDivStyle.paddingLeft) +
      parsePadding(tableDivStyle.paddingRight);

    var addPaddingCol = false;
    var currentWidth = 0;

    while (true) {
      columns.setVisibleColumns(columnNumber, visibleColumns, paddingCount);
      currentWidth = columns.getWidth();

      if (tableDiv.clientWidth - tableDivPadding < currentWidth) {
        break;
      }

      columnHistory.push({
        columnNumber: columnNumber,
        visibleColumns: visibleColumns,
        paddingCount: paddingCount
      });

      if (columnHistory.length > 100) {
        console.error("More than 100 tries to fit columns, aborting");
        break;
      }

      if (columns.max !== null &&
        columns.visible + columns.getPaddingCount() >= columns.max) {
        break;
      }

      // if we run out of right-columns
      if (!backwards && columnNumber + columns.visible >= columns.total) {
        // if we started adding right-columns, try adding left-columns
        if (!startBackwards && columnNumber > 0) {
          backwards = true;
        }
        else if (columns.min === null || visibleColumns + columns.getPaddingCount() >= columns.min) {
          break;
        }
        else {
          paddingCount = paddingCount + 1;
        }
      }

      // if we run out of left-columns
      if (backwards && columnNumber == 0) {
        // if we started adding left-columns, try adding right-columns
        if (startBackwards && columnNumber + columns.visible < columns.total) {
          backwards = false;
        }
        else if (columns.min === null || visibleColumns + columns.getPaddingCount() >= columns.min) {
          break;
        }
        else {
          paddingCount = paddingCount + 1;
        }
      }

      // when moving backwards try fitting left columns first
      if (backwards && columnNumber > 0) {
        columnNumber = columnNumber - 1;
      }

      if (columnNumber + visibleColumns < columns.total) {
        visibleColumns = visibleColumns + 1;
      }
    }

    var lastRenderableColumn = {
        columnNumber: columnNumber,
        visibleColumns: visibleColumns,
        paddingCount: paddingCount
    };

    if (columnHistory.length > 0) {
      lastRenderableColumn = columnHistory[columnHistory.length - 1];
    }

    columns.setVisibleColumns(
      lastRenderableColumn.columnNumber,
      lastRenderableColumn.visibleColumns,
      lastRenderableColumn.paddingCount);

    if (pagedTable.offsetWidth > 0) {
      page.setVisiblePages(Math.max(Math.ceil(1.0 * (pagedTable.offsetWidth - 250) / 40), 2));
    }

    registerWidths();
  };

  me.fit = function(startBackwards) {
    me.fitRows();
    me.fitColumns(startBackwards);
  }

  me.render = function() {
    me.fitColumns(false);

    // render header/footer to measure height accurately
    renderHeader();
    renderFooter();

    me.fitRows();
    renderBody();

    // re-render footer to match new rows
    renderFooter();
  }

  var resizeLastWidth = -1;
  var resizeLastHeight = -1;
  var resizeNewWidth = -1;
  var resizeNewHeight = -1;
  var resizePending = false;

  me.resize = function(newWidth, newHeight) {

    function resizeDelayed() {
      resizePending = false;

      if (
        (resizeNewWidth !== resizeLastWidth) ||
        (!me.fixedHeight() && resizeNewHeight !== resizeLastHeight)
      ) {
        resizeLastWidth = resizeNewWidth;
        resizeLastHeight = resizeNewHeight;

        setTimeout(resizeDelayed, 200);
        resizePending = true;
      } else {
        me.render();
        triggerOnChange();

        resizeLastWidth = -1;
        resizeLastHeight = -1;
      }
    }

    resizeNewWidth = newWidth;
    resizeNewHeight = newHeight;

    if (!resizePending) resizeDelayed();
  };
};

var PagedTableDoc;
(function (PagedTableDoc) {
  var allPagedTables = [];

  PagedTableDoc.initAll = function() {
    allPagedTables = [];

    var pagedTables = [].slice.call(document.querySelectorAll('[data-pagedtable="false"],[data-pagedtable=""]'));
    pagedTables.forEach(function(pagedTable, idx) {
      pagedTable.setAttribute("data-pagedtable", "true");
      pagedTable.setAttribute("pagedtable-page", 0);
      pagedTable.setAttribute("class", "pagedtable-wrapper");

      var pagedTableInstance = new PagedTable(pagedTable);
      pagedTableInstance.init();

      allPagedTables.push(pagedTableInstance);
    });
  };

  PagedTableDoc.resizeAll = function() {
    allPagedTables.forEach(function(pagedTable) {
      pagedTable.render();
    });
  };

  window.addEventListener("resize", PagedTableDoc.resizeAll);

  return PagedTableDoc;
})(PagedTableDoc || (PagedTableDoc = {}));

window.onload = function() {
  PagedTableDoc.initAll();
};
</script>

<div id="note-on-dimensionality-and-positive-definiteness-n-p" class="section level2">
<h2>Note on Dimensionality and Positive Definiteness (<span class="math inline">\(n &gt; p\)</span>)</h2>
<p><span style="color:blue">The regression methods evaluated here,
including SR, GSR, Sh, DSh, SRR and PR (Parity Regression) require the
covariates’ covariance matrix (<span class="math inline">\(\mathbf{X}^T\mathbf{X}\)</span>) to be strictly
positive definite (<span class="math inline">\(\Sigma \succ 0\)</span>).
Because of this requirement, and the fact that PR rely on the initial
signs derived from Ordinary Least Squares (OLS), these estimators are
specifically designed for the case <span class="math inline">\(n&gt;p\)</span>. Therefore, all following
simulations strictly consider the case where the sample size exceeds the
number of predictors (<span class="math inline">\(n &gt;
p\)</span>).</span></p>
</div>
<div id="part-1-linear-regression-comparisons" class="section level2">
<h2>Part 1: Linear Regression Comparisons</h2>
<div id="data-generating-process-dgp-helper-function" class="section level3">
<h3>Data Generating Process (DGP) Helper function</h3>
<pre class="r"><code># Calculate L2 distance
calc_l2 &lt;- function(est_coef, true_coef) {
  sqrt(sum((est_coef - true_coef)^2))
}

# Correlation matrix
sigma.rho &lt;- function(rho, p) {
    rho ^ abs(outer(1:p, 1:p, &quot;-&quot;))
}

# Ture coefficients
theta_func &lt;- function(p) {
    sgn &lt;- rep(c(1, -1), length.out = p)
    mag &lt;- ceiling(seq_len(p) / 2)
    sgn * mag
}</code></pre>
</div>
<div id="run-all-models-exclude-lsh-and-compile-l_2-distances" class="section level3">
<h3>Run all models (Exclude <code>LSh</code>) and compile <span class="math inline">\(L_2\)</span> distances</h3>
<p><strong>Note:</strong> The <code>LSh</code> estimator is explicitly
excluded from this general comparison because it is mathematically
designed for centered data where an intercept is not needed. It is
evaluated in a separate, dedicated case using a DGP without an
intercept.</p>
<pre class="r"><code># Simulate data with intercept
generate_mvn_data &lt;- function(n_val, p_val, rho_val, sigma_val = 5, mu_val = 0) {
  Sigma &lt;- sigma.rho(rho_val, p_val)
  X &lt;- mvrnorm(n_val, mu = rep(mu_val, p_val), Sigma = Sigma)
  X_intercept &lt;- cbind(1, X)
  
  beta_true &lt;- theta_func(p_val + 1) 
  y &lt;- rnorm(n_val, mean = X_intercept %*% beta_true, sd = sigma_val)

  return(list(X = X, y = y, beta_true = beta_true))
}

run_simulations &lt;- function(X, y, beta_true) {
  # 1. OLS
  fit_ols &lt;- lm(y ~ X)
  coef_ols &lt;- as.vector(coef(fit_ols))
  
  # 2. Penalised Regressions (pkg: glmnet)
  fit_lasso &lt;- cv.glmnet(X, y, alpha = 1, family = &quot;gaussian&quot;, nlambda = 50, nfolds = 5)
  coef_lasso &lt;- as.vector(coef(fit_lasso, s = &quot;lambda.min&quot;))
  
  fit_rr &lt;- cv.glmnet(X, y, alpha = 0, family = &quot;gaussian&quot;, nlambda = 50, nfolds = 5)
  coef_rr &lt;- as.vector(coef(fit_rr, s = &quot;lambda.min&quot;))
  
  fit_en &lt;- cv.glmnet(X, y, alpha = 0.5, family = &quot;gaussian&quot;, nlambda = 50, nfolds = 5)
  coef_en &lt;- as.vector(coef(fit_en, s = &quot;lambda.min&quot;))
  
  # 3. Multiplicative Shrinkage (pkg: savvySh)
  multi_results &lt;- savvySh(X, y, model_class = &quot;Multiplicative&quot;, include_Sh = TRUE)
  coef_St  &lt;- as.vector(coef(multi_results, &quot;St&quot;))
  coef_DSh &lt;- as.vector(coef(multi_results, &quot;DSh&quot;))
  coef_Sh  &lt;- as.vector(coef(multi_results, &quot;Sh&quot;))
  
  # 4. Slab Regressions (pkg: savvySh)
  slab_results &lt;- savvySh(X, y, model_class = &quot;Slab&quot;)
  coef_SR  &lt;- as.vector(coef(slab_results, &quot;SR&quot;))
  coef_GSR &lt;- as.vector(coef(slab_results, &quot;GSR&quot;))
  
  # 5. Shrinkage Ridge Regression (pkg: savvySh)
  srr_results &lt;- savvySh(X, y, model_class = &quot;ShrinkageRR&quot;)
  coef_SRR &lt;- as.vector(coef(srr_results, &quot;SRR&quot;))
  
  # 6. Parity Regressions (savvyPR) - Budget Method
  fit_pr1_b &lt;- cv.savvyPR(X, y, method = &quot;budget&quot;, model_type = &quot;PR1&quot;, nval = 50, nlambda = 50, folds = 5)
  coef_pr1_b &lt;- as.vector(coef(fit_pr1_b))
  
  fit_pr2_b &lt;- cv.savvyPR(X, y, method = &quot;budget&quot;, model_type = &quot;PR2&quot;, nval = 50, nlambda = 50, folds = 5)
  coef_pr2_b &lt;- as.vector(coef(fit_pr2_b))
  
  fit_pr3_b &lt;- cv.savvyPR(X, y, method = &quot;budget&quot;, model_type = &quot;PR3&quot;, nval = 50, nlambda = 50, folds = 5)
  coef_pr3_b &lt;- as.vector(coef(fit_pr3_b))
  
  # 7. Parity Regressions (savvyPR) - Target Method
  fit_pr1_t &lt;- cv.savvyPR(X, y, method = &quot;target&quot;, model_type = &quot;PR1&quot;, nval = 50, nlambda = 50, folds = 5)
  coef_pr1_t &lt;- as.vector(coef(fit_pr1_t))
  
  fit_pr2_t &lt;- cv.savvyPR(X, y, method = &quot;target&quot;, model_type = &quot;PR2&quot;, nval = 50, nlambda = 50, folds = 5)
  coef_pr2_t &lt;- as.vector(coef(fit_pr2_t))
  
  fit_pr3_t &lt;- cv.savvyPR(X, y, method = &quot;target&quot;, model_type = &quot;PR3&quot;, nval = 50, nlambda = 50, folds = 5)
  coef_pr3_t &lt;- as.vector(coef(fit_pr3_t))
  
  l2_table &lt;- data.frame(
    Method = c(&quot;OLS&quot;, &quot;Lasso&quot;, &quot;Ridge&quot;, &quot;ElasticNet&quot;, 
               &quot;St&quot;, &quot;DSh&quot;, &quot;Sh&quot;, &quot;SR&quot;, &quot;GSR&quot;, &quot;SRR&quot;, 
               &quot;PR1 (Budget)&quot;, &quot;PR2 (Budget)&quot;, &quot;PR3 (Budget)&quot;,
               &quot;PR1 (Target)&quot;, &quot;PR2 (Target)&quot;, &quot;PR3 (Target)&quot;),
    
    L2_Distance = c(
      calc_l2(coef_ols, beta_true), calc_l2(coef_lasso, beta_true), calc_l2(coef_rr, beta_true),
      calc_l2(coef_en, beta_true), calc_l2(coef_St, beta_true), calc_l2(coef_DSh, beta_true),
      calc_l2(coef_Sh, beta_true), calc_l2(coef_SR, beta_true), calc_l2(coef_GSR, beta_true),
      calc_l2(coef_SRR, beta_true), calc_l2(coef_pr1_b, beta_true), calc_l2(coef_pr2_b, beta_true),
      calc_l2(coef_pr3_b, beta_true), calc_l2(coef_pr1_t, beta_true), calc_l2(coef_pr2_t, beta_true),
      calc_l2(coef_pr3_t, beta_true)
    )
  )
  
  coef_table &lt;- data.frame(
    True = beta_true,
    OLS = coef_ols,
    Lasso = coef_lasso,
    Ridge = coef_rr,
    ElasticNet = coef_en,
    St = coef_St,
    DSh = coef_DSh,
    Sh = coef_Sh,
    SR = coef_SR,
    GSR = coef_GSR,
    SRR = coef_SRR,
    PR1_Budget = coef_pr1_b,
    PR2_Budget = coef_pr2_b,
    PR3_Budget = coef_pr3_b,
    PR1_Target = coef_pr1_t,
    PR2_Target = coef_pr2_t,
    PR3_Target = coef_pr3_t
  )
  
  return(list(l2_table = l2_table, coef_table = coef_table))
}</code></pre>
<div id="case-1-baseline-n-100-p-10-rho-0.5" class="section level4">
<h4>Case 1: Baseline (<span class="math inline">\(n = 100\)</span>,
<span class="math inline">\(p = 10\)</span>, <span class="math inline">\(\rho = 0.5\)</span>)</h4>
<p>Print out the table to show the <span class="math inline">\(L_2\)</span> error comparison.</p>
<pre class="r"><code>set.seed(101)
data_case1 &lt;- generate_mvn_data(n_val = 100, p_val = 10, rho_val = 0.5)
results_case1 &lt;- run_simulations(data_case1$X, data_case1$y, data_case1$beta_true)
kable(results_case1$l2_table, digits = 4, caption = &quot;L2 Distances: Case 1 (n=100, p=10, rho=0.5)&quot;)</code></pre>

<div id="run-for-ols-and-lsh-models-and-compile-l_2-distances" class="section level3">
<h3>Run for OLS and LSh models and compile <span class="math inline">\(L_2\)</span> distances</h3>
<p>Because <code>LSh</code> strictly requires centered data, we need to
explicitly subtract the column means from both <span class="math inline">\(X\)</span> and <span class="math inline">\(y\)</span> before feeding them into the models.
When both the predictors and the response are centered, the theoretical
intercept becomes exactly zero. Therefore, we will only run to compare
with the OLS regression without an intercept (using - 1 in the formula)
and format the coefficient table.</p>
<pre class="r"><code># Simulate centred Data without intercept
generate_mvn_data_centered &lt;- function(n_val, p_val, rho_val, sigma_val = 5, mu_val = 0) {
  Sigma &lt;- sigma.rho(rho_val, p_val)
  temp &lt;- mvrnorm(n_val, mu = rep(mu_val, p_val), Sigma = Sigma)
  mu &lt;- colMeans(temp)
  X &lt;- sweep(temp, 2, mu, &quot;-&quot;)
  
  beta_true &lt;- theta_func(p_val) 
  y_temp &lt;- rnorm(n_val, mean = X %*% beta_true, sd = sigma_val)
  y &lt;- y_temp - mean(y_temp)

  return(list(X = X, y = y, beta_true = beta_true))
}

run_simulations_centered &lt;- function(X, y, beta_true) {
  
  # 1. OLS on centered data (Notice the &#39;- 1&#39; to exclude the intercept)
  fit_ols &lt;- lm(y ~ X - 1)
  coef_ols &lt;- as.vector(coef(fit_ols))
  
  # 2. LSh on centered data
  multi_results &lt;- savvySh(X, y, model_class = &quot;Linear&quot;)
  coef_lsh &lt;- as.vector(coef(multi_results, &quot;LSh&quot;))
  
  l2_table &lt;- data.frame(
    Method = c(&quot;OLS&quot;, &quot;LSh&quot;),
    L2_Distance = c(
      calc_l2(coef_ols, beta_true),
      calc_l2(coef_lsh, beta_true)
    )
  )
  
  coef_table &lt;- data.frame(
    True = beta_true,
    OLS = coef_ols,
    LSh = coef_lsh
  )
  
  return(list(l2_table = l2_table, coef_table = coef_table))
}</code></pre>
<p>Print out the table to show the <span class="math inline">\(L_2\)</span> error comparison.</p>
<pre class="r"><code>set.seed(102)
data_centered_case &lt;- generate_mvn_data_centered(n_val = 100, p_val = 10, rho_val = 0.5)
results_centered &lt;- run_simulations_centered(data_centered_case$X, data_centered_case$y, data_centered_case$beta_true)
kable(results_centered$l2_table, digits = 4, caption = &quot;L2 Distances: OLS vs LSh (No Intercept)&quot;)</code></pre>

<div id="part2-glm-on-real-insurance-data" class="section level2">
<h2>Part2: GLM on Real Insurance Data</h2>
<div id="setup-and-data-preparation" class="section level3">
<h3>Setup and Data Preparation</h3>
<pre class="r"><code>freq &lt;- read.csv(&quot;freMTPL2freq.csv&quot;)
sev &lt;- read.csv(&quot;freMTPL2sev.csv&quot;)

# Aggregate severity by policy ID
sev_agg &lt;- aggregate(ClaimAmount ~ IDpol, data = sev, FUN = sum)
data &lt;- merge(freq, sev_agg, by = &quot;IDpol&quot;)

# Filter for exactly 2 claims and positive claim amount
data_sev &lt;- data[data$ClaimNb == 2 &amp; data$ClaimAmount &gt; 0, ]

# Randomly sample exactly 500 rows
set.seed(123) 
data_sev &lt;- data_sev[sample(nrow(data_sev), 500), ]
data_sev$Severity &lt;- data_sev$ClaimAmount / data_sev$ClaimNb

matches &lt;- grepl(&quot;\\((\\d+),(\\d+)\\]&quot;, data_sev$AgeBand)
data_sev$AgeBandNum &lt;- NA
data_sev$AgeBandNum[matches] &lt;- as.numeric(sub(&quot;\\((\\d+),.*&quot;, &quot;\\1&quot;, data_sev$AgeBand[matches])) + 0.5
data_sev$AgeBandNum[is.na(data_sev$AgeBandNum)] &lt;- median(data_sev$AgeBandNum, na.rm = TRUE)

data_sev$VehPower_Log &lt;- log(pmax(pmin(data_sev$VehPower, 9), 1))
data_sev$Density_Log &lt;- log(pmax(data_sev$Density, 1))
data_sev$BonusMalus_Log &lt;- log(pmin(data_sev$BonusMalus, 150))</code></pre>
</div>
<div id="evaluation-metrics-helper-functions" class="section level3">
<h3>Evaluation Metrics Helper Functions</h3>
<pre class="r"><code>calc_rmse_win &lt;- function(actual, predicted, cap_val) {
  return(sqrt(mean((pmin(actual, cap_val) - pmin(predicted, cap_val))^2)))
}

calc_mae_win &lt;- function(actual, predicted, cap_val) {
  return(mean(abs(pmin(actual, cap_val) - pmin(predicted, cap_val))))
}

WeightedGini &lt;- function(actual, weights, predicted) {
  df &lt;- data.frame(actual = actual, weights = weights, predicted = predicted)
  df &lt;- df[order(df$predicted, decreasing = TRUE), ]
  df$random &lt;- cumsum(df$weights / sum(df$weights))
  totalPositive &lt;- sum(df$actual * df$weights)
  df$cumPosFound &lt;- cumsum(df$actual * df$weights)
  df$Lorentz &lt;- df$cumPosFound / totalPositive
  n &lt;- nrow(df)
  gini &lt;- sum(df$Lorentz[-n] * df$random[-1]) - sum(df$Lorentz[-1] * df$random[-n])
  return(gini)
}

NormalizedWeightedGini &lt;- function(actual, weights, predicted) {
  model_gini &lt;- WeightedGini(actual, weights, predicted)
  max_gini &lt;- WeightedGini(actual, weights, actual)
  return(model_gini / max_gini)
}</code></pre>
</div>
<div id="single-iteration-data-processing-model-fitting" class="section level3">
<h3>Single Iteration (Data Processing &amp; Model Fitting)</h3>
<pre class="r"><code>n_folds &lt;- 5
control_list &lt;- list(maxit = 250, epsilon = 1e-6, trace = FALSE)
family_type &lt;- Gamma(link = &quot;log&quot;)

run_single_iteration &lt;- function(i) {
  repeat_idx &lt;- floor((i - 1) / n_folds) + 1
  fold_idx &lt;- ((i - 1) %% n_folds) + 1
  set.seed(123 + repeat_idx)
  
  folds &lt;- sample(rep(1:n_folds, length.out = nrow(data_sev)))
  test_idx &lt;- which(folds == fold_idx)
  
  train_data &lt;- data_sev[-test_idx, ]
  test_data &lt;- data_sev[test_idx, ]
  
  # Splines
  driv_splines &lt;- ns(train_data$DrivAge, df = 3)
  veh_splines &lt;- ns(train_data$VehAge, df = 3)
  
  train_data$DrivAge_Sp1 &lt;- driv_splines[,1]
  train_data$DrivAge_Sp2 &lt;- driv_splines[,2]
  train_data$DrivAge_Sp3 &lt;- driv_splines[,3]
  train_data$VehAge_Sp1 &lt;- veh_splines[,1]
  train_data$VehAge_Sp2 &lt;- veh_splines[,2]
  train_data$VehAge_Sp3 &lt;- veh_splines[,3]
  
  test_driv_basis &lt;- predict(driv_splines, test_data$DrivAge)
  test_veh_basis &lt;- predict(veh_splines, test_data$VehAge)
  
  test_data$DrivAge_Sp1 &lt;- test_driv_basis[,1]
  test_data$DrivAge_Sp2 &lt;- test_driv_basis[,2]
  test_data$DrivAge_Sp3 &lt;- test_driv_basis[,3]
  test_data$VehAge_Sp1 &lt;- test_veh_basis[,1]
  test_data$VehAge_Sp2 &lt;- test_veh_basis[,2]
  test_data$VehAge_Sp3 &lt;- test_veh_basis[,3]
  
  # Target Encoding
  te_cols &lt;- c(&quot;Region&quot;, &quot;Area&quot;, &quot;VehBrand&quot;)
  global_mean_train &lt;- sum(train_data$ClaimAmount) / sum(train_data$ClaimNb) 
  k_smooth &lt;- 20 
  
  for (col in te_cols) {
    group_amt &lt;- tapply(train_data$ClaimAmount, train_data[[col]], sum)
    group_clm &lt;- tapply(train_data$ClaimNb, train_data[[col]], sum)
    
    own_amt &lt;- train_data$ClaimAmount
    own_clm &lt;- train_data$ClaimNb
    grp_idx &lt;- as.character(train_data[[col]])
    
    loo_amt &lt;- group_amt[grp_idx] - own_amt
    loo_clm &lt;- group_clm[grp_idx] - own_clm
    
    lambda_train &lt;- loo_clm / (loo_clm + k_smooth)
    mu_train &lt;- ifelse(loo_clm &gt; 0, loo_amt / loo_clm, global_mean_train)
    train_data[[paste0(&quot;TE_&quot;, col)]] &lt;- lambda_train * mu_train + (1 - lambda_train) * global_mean_train
    
    test_grp_idx &lt;- as.character(test_data[[col]])
    
    full_lambda &lt;- group_clm / (group_clm + k_smooth)
    full_mu &lt;- group_amt / group_clm
    smoothed_test_dict &lt;- full_lambda * full_mu + (1 - full_lambda) * global_mean_train
    
    test_data[[paste0(&quot;TE_&quot;, col)]] &lt;- smoothed_test_dict[test_grp_idx]
    test_data[[paste0(&quot;TE_&quot;, col)]][is.na(test_data[[paste0(&quot;TE_&quot;, col)]])] &lt;- global_mean_train
  }
  
  scale_cols &lt;- c(&quot;BonusMalus_Log&quot;, &quot;VehPower_Log&quot;, &quot;Density_Log&quot;, &quot;AgeBandNum&quot;, &quot;DrivAge_Sp1&quot;,
                  &quot;DrivAge_Sp2&quot;, &quot;DrivAge_Sp3&quot;, &quot;VehAge_Sp1&quot;, &quot;VehAge_Sp2&quot;, &quot;VehAge_Sp3&quot;, &quot;TE_Region&quot;, &quot;TE_Area&quot;, &quot;TE_VehBrand&quot;)
  train_means &lt;- colMeans(train_data[, scale_cols])
  train_sds &lt;- apply(train_data[, scale_cols], 2, sd)
  train_sds[train_sds == 0] &lt;- 1 
  
  for(col in scale_cols) {
    train_data[[col]] &lt;- (train_data[[col]] - train_means[col]) / train_sds[col]
    test_data[[col]] &lt;- (test_data[[col]] - train_means[col]) / train_sds[col]
  }
  
  glm_formula &lt;- Severity ~ BonusMalus_Log + VehPower_Log + Density_Log + AgeBandNum +
    DrivAge_Sp1 + DrivAge_Sp2 + DrivAge_Sp3 + VehAge_Sp1 + VehAge_Sp2 + VehAge_Sp3 + VehGas + TE_Region + TE_Area + TE_VehBrand 
  
  X_train &lt;- model.matrix(glm_formula, train_data)
  X_test &lt;- model.matrix(glm_formula, test_data)
  
  y_train &lt;- train_data$Severity
  y_test &lt;- test_data$Severity
  w_train &lt;- train_data$ClaimNb
  w_test &lt;- test_data$ClaimNb
  
  cap_99 &lt;- quantile(y_train, probs = 0.99, na.rm = TRUE)
  cap_95 &lt;- quantile(y_train, probs = 0.95, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  eval_model &lt;- function(coefs) {
    if (all(is.na(coefs))) return(rep(NA_real_, 10)) 
    
    safe_coefs &lt;- ifelse(is.na(coefs), 0, coefs)
    eta_test &lt;- as.numeric(X_test %*% safe_coefs)
    pred_test &lt;- exp(eta_test)
    
    rmse &lt;- sqrt(mean((y_test - pred_test)^2))
    mae &lt;- mean(abs(y_test - pred_test))
    
    rmse_win_99 &lt;- calc_rmse_win(y_test, pred_test, cap_99) 
    rmse_win_95 &lt;- calc_rmse_win(y_test, pred_test, cap_95) 
    mae_win_99 &lt;- calc_mae_win(y_test, pred_test, cap_99)
    mae_win_95 &lt;- calc_mae_win(y_test, pred_test, cap_95)
    
    raw_gini &lt;- WeightedGini(actual = y_test, weights = w_test, predicted = pred_test)
    norm_gini &lt;- NormalizedWeightedGini(actual = y_test, weights = w_test, predicted = pred_test)
    
    dev &lt;- sum(w_test * Gamma()$dev.resids(y_test, pred_test, 1))
    ae &lt;- sum(y_test * w_test) / sum(pred_test * w_test)
    
    return(c(rmse, mae, rmse_win_99, rmse_win_95, mae_win_99, mae_win_95, raw_gini, norm_gini, dev, ae))
  }
  
  # 1. GLM2
  t1 &lt;- system.time({ m1 &lt;- glm.fit2(x=X_train, y=y_train, weights=w_train, family=family_type, control=control_list) })
  c1 &lt;- m1$coefficients
  res1 &lt;- eval_model(c1)
  iter1 &lt;- m1$iter
  
  # 2. Ridge
  t2 &lt;- system.time({ m2 &lt;- cv.glmnet(X_train[,-1], y_train, weights=w_train, family=Gamma(link=&quot;log&quot;), alpha=0, nlambda=50, nfolds=5) })
  c2 &lt;- as.vector(coef(m2, s=&quot;lambda.min&quot;))
  res2 &lt;- eval_model(c2)
  iter2 &lt;- if(is.null(m2$glmnet.fit$npasses)) NA else m2$glmnet.fit$npasses[1]
  
  # 3. Elastic Net
  t3 &lt;- system.time({ m3 &lt;- cv.glmnet(X_train[,-1], y_train, weights=w_train, family=Gamma(link=&quot;log&quot;), alpha=0.5, nlambda=50, nfolds=5) })
  c3 &lt;- as.vector(coef(m3, s=&quot;lambda.min&quot;))
  res3 &lt;- eval_model(c3)
  iter3 &lt;- if(is.null(m3$glmnet.fit$npasses)) NA else m3$glmnet.fit$npasses[1]
  
  # 4. Savvy St
  t4 &lt;- system.time({ m4 &lt;- savvy_glm.fit2(x=X_train, y=y_train, weights=w_train, family=family_type, model_class = &quot;St&quot;, control=control_list) })
  c4 &lt;- m4$coefficients
  res4 &lt;- eval_model(c4)
  iter4 &lt;- m4$iter
  
  # 5. Savvy DSh
  t5 &lt;- system.time({ m5 &lt;- savvy_glm.fit2(x=X_train, y=y_train, weights=w_train, family=family_type, model_class = &quot;DSh&quot;, control=control_list) })
  c5 &lt;- m5$coefficients
  res5 &lt;- eval_model(c5)
  iter5 &lt;- m5$iter
  
  # 6. Savvy SR
  t6 &lt;- system.time({ m6 &lt;- savvy_glm.fit2(x=X_train, y=y_train, weights=w_train, family=family_type, model_class = &quot;SR&quot;, control=control_list) })
  c6 &lt;- m6$coefficients
  res6 &lt;- eval_model(c6)
  iter6 &lt;- m6$iter
  
  # 7. Savvy GSR
  t7 &lt;- system.time({ m7 &lt;- savvy_glm.fit2(x=X_train, y=y_train, weights=w_train, family=family_type, model_class = &quot;GSR&quot;, control=control_list) })
  c7 &lt;- m7$coefficients
  res7 &lt;- eval_model(c7)
  iter7 &lt;- m7$iter

  # 8. Savvy LW
  t8 &lt;- system.time({ m8 &lt;- savvy_glm.fit2(x=X_train, y=y_train, weights=w_train, family=family_type, model_class = &quot;LW&quot;, control=control_list) })
  c8 &lt;- m8$coefficients
  res8 &lt;- eval_model(c8)
  iter8 &lt;- m8$iter

  # 9. Savvy QIS 
  t9 &lt;- system.time({ m9 &lt;- savvy_glm.fit2(x=X_train, y=y_train, weights=w_train, family=family_type, model_class = &quot;QIS&quot;, control=control_list) })
  c9 &lt;- m9$coefficients
  res9 &lt;- eval_model(c9)
  iter9 &lt;- m9$iter

  models &lt;- c(&quot;GLM2&quot;, &quot;RR&quot;, &quot;EN&quot;, &quot;QIS&quot;, &quot;LW&quot;, &quot;SR&quot;, &quot;GSR&quot;, &quot;St&quot;, &quot;DSh&quot;)
  all_res &lt;- rbind(res1, res2, res3, res9, res8, res6, res7, res4, res5)
  
  times &lt;- c(t1[3], t2[3], t3[3], t9[3], t8[3], t6[3], t7[3], t4[3], t5[3])
  iters &lt;- c(iter1, iter2, iter3, iter9, iter8, iter6, iter7, iter4, iter5)
  
  df_metrics &lt;- data.frame(
    Iteration = i, 
    Model = models,
    RMSE = all_res[,1], MAE = all_res[,2], 
    RMSE_Win_99 = all_res[,3], RMSE_Win_95 = all_res[,4], 
    MAE_Win_99 = all_res[,5], MAE_Win_95 = all_res[,6], 
    Gini_Raw = all_res[,7], Gini_Norm = all_res[,8],     
    Dev = all_res[,9], AE_Ratio = all_res[,10],
    CT = as.numeric(times), NoIt = as.numeric(iters)
  )
  
  return(df_metrics)
}</code></pre>
</div>

<div id="summary-results-relative-ratios-compare-to-glm2" class="section level3">
<h3>Summary Results – Relative Ratios (Compare to GLM2)</h3>
<pre class="r"><code>ratio_list &lt;- lapply(split(final_results, final_results$Iteration), function(df) {
  base_rmse &lt;- df$RMSE[df$Model == &quot;GLM2&quot;]
  base_mae &lt;- df$MAE[df$Model == &quot;GLM2&quot;]
  base_rmse_win_99 &lt;- df$RMSE_Win_99[df$Model == &quot;GLM2&quot;]
  base_rmse_win_95 &lt;- df$RMSE_Win_95[df$Model == &quot;GLM2&quot;]
  base_mae_win_99 &lt;- df$MAE_Win_99[df$Model == &quot;GLM2&quot;]
  base_mae_win_95 &lt;- df$MAE_Win_95[df$Model == &quot;GLM2&quot;]
  base_dev &lt;- df$Dev[df$Model == &quot;GLM2&quot;]
  
  base_ct &lt;- ifelse(is.na(df$CT[df$Model == &quot;GLM2&quot;]) | df$CT[df$Model == &quot;GLM2&quot;] == 0, NA, df$CT[df$Model == &quot;GLM2&quot;])
  base_noit &lt;- ifelse(is.na(df$NoIt[df$Model == &quot;GLM2&quot;]) | df$NoIt[df$Model == &quot;GLM2&quot;] == 0, NA, df$NoIt[df$Model == &quot;GLM2&quot;])
  
  df$RMSE_Ratio &lt;- df$RMSE / base_rmse
  df$MAE_Ratio &lt;- df$MAE / base_mae
  df$RMSE_Win_99_Ratio &lt;- df$RMSE_Win_99 / base_rmse_win_99
  df$RMSE_Win_95_Ratio &lt;- df$RMSE_Win_95 / base_rmse_win_95
  df$MAE_Win_99_Ratio &lt;- df$MAE_Win_99 / base_mae_win_99
  df$MAE_Win_95_Ratio &lt;- df$MAE_Win_95 / base_mae_win_95
  df$Dev_Ratio &lt;- df$Dev / base_dev
  df$CT_Ratio &lt;- df$CT / base_ct
  df$NoIt_Ratio &lt;- df$NoIt / base_noit
  
  return(df)
})
all_ratios_df &lt;- do.call(rbind, ratio_list)
all_ratios_df$Model &lt;- factor(all_ratios_df$Model, levels = ordered_levels)
avg_ratios &lt;- aggregate(cbind(RMSE_Ratio, MAE_Ratio, RMSE_Win_99_Ratio, RMSE_Win_95_Ratio, MAE_Win_99_Ratio, MAE_Win_95_Ratio, Dev_Ratio, Gini_Raw, Gini_Norm, AE_Ratio, CT_Ratio, NoIt_Ratio) ~ Model, 
                        data = all_ratios_df, FUN = function(x) mean(x, na.rm = TRUE), na.action = na.pass)
knitr::kable(avg_ratios, digits = 4, row.names = FALSE, caption = &quot;Average Out-of-Sample Relative Ratios vs GLM2 (Gamma GLM)&quot;)</code></pre>

<div id="why-repeated-5-fold-cv-is-superior-to-repeated-random-subsampling" class="section level3">
<h3>Why Repeated 5-Fold CV is Superior to Repeated Random
Subsampling?</h3>
<p>When evaluating out-of-sample performance, it might seem sufficient
to simply run 500 independent random splits where 80% of the data is
used for training and 20% for testing. However, our evaluation uses
<strong>Repeated 5-Fold Cross-Validation (replicated 100 times)</strong>
because it provides a superior, lower-variance estimate of model
performance:</p>
<ul>
<li><strong>The Flaw of Independent Random Splits:</strong> If you
randomly draw an 80/20 split 500 times independently, the test coverage
is left entirely to chance. Some observations might randomly appear in
the test set 150 times, while others might only appear 50 times. In
insurance data, where claims are heavily right-skewed, if extreme claims
are unevenly tested, it will inject unnecessary noise and variance into
your final evaluation metrics.</li>
<li><strong>The Structure of 5-Fold CV:</strong> In a 5-fold CV, the
dataset is divided into 5 equal buckets. The model trains on 4 buckets
(80%) and tests on the remaining 1 bucket (20%). This rotates 5 times.
The crucial advantage here is that <strong>every single observation acts
as the out-of-sample test case exactly once</strong> per cycle.</li>
<li><strong>The Power of 100 Replications:</strong> By repeating this
structured 5-fold process 100 times with different random seeds, we
achieve 500 total evaluation runs. Because of the 5-fold structure, we
mathematically guarantee that <em>every single claim in the dataset is
tested exactly 100 times</em>.</li>
</ul>
<p>By enforcing this perfectly uniform test coverage, Repeated 5-Fold CV
prevents the “luck of the draw” from skewing the results, ensuring that
rare, high-severity claims are evaluated evenly. This results in highly
robust, unbiased metrics that truly reflect how the model will perform
in the real world.</p>
</div>
</div>




</div>

--- FILE: bayes/T2/final_model.R ---

# final_model.R
# Final model selection based on experiment results.
# Chosen model: Iteration 2 (log-transformed VehPower & BonusMalus) with Gamma family (log link)

library(readr)
library(dplyr)

# -------------------------------------------------
# Helper: Normalized Weighted Gini Coefficient
# -------------------------------------------------
normalized_weighted_gini <- function(y, pred, w = rep(1, length(y))) {
  weighted_gini <- function(y_i, pred_i, w_i) {
    ord <- order(pred_i, decreasing = TRUE)
    y_i <- y_i[ord]
    w_i <- w_i[ord]
    wy <- w_i * y_i
    cwy <- cumsum(wy)
    cw <- cumsum(w_i)
    total_w  <- sum(w_i)
    total_wy <- sum(wy)
    if (total_wy == 0) return(0)
    p <- c(0, cw / total_w)
    L <- c(0, cwy / total_wy)
    area <- sum(diff(p) * (L[-1] + utils::head(L, -1)) / 2)
    2 * area - 1
  }

  g_pred   <- weighted_gini(y, pred, w)
  g_actual <- weighted_gini(y, y, w)
  if (g_actual == 0) return(NA_real_)
  g_pred / g_actual
}

# -------------------------------------------------
# Data Loading & Preprocessing
# -------------------------------------------------
freq <- read_csv("freMTPL2freq.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
sev  <- read_csv("freMTPL2sev.csv",  show_col_types = FALSE)

# Aggregate claim severity to policy level
sev_agg <- sev %>%
  group_by(IDpol) %>%
  summarise(ClaimAmount = sum(ClaimAmount), .groups = "drop")

# Merge, filter, create response & log‑features
model_data <- freq %>%
  inner_join(sev_agg, by = "IDpol") %>%
  filter(ClaimNb == 2, ClaimAmount > 0) %>%
  mutate(
    Severity      = ClaimAmount / ClaimNb,
    log_VehPower = log(VehPower),
    log_BonusMalus = log(BonusMalus)
  )

cat("Observations after preprocessing:", nrow(model_data), "\n")

# -------------------------------------------------
# Model Specification (Gamma GLM, log link)
# -------------------------------------------------
formula_final <- Severity ~ log_VehPower + VehAge + DrivAge + log_BonusMalus +
  VehBrand + VehGas + Area + Density + Region + AgeBand + Exposure

final_model <- glm(
  formula = formula_final,
  family  = Gamma(link = "log"),
  data    = model_data,
  na.action = na.omit
)

cat("\n=== Final Model Summary ===\n")
print(summary(final_model))

# -------------------------------------------------
# Evaluation using Normalized Weighted Gini
# -------------------------------------------------
model_data$pred_final <- predict(final_model, newdata = model_data, type = "response")

gini_final <- normalized_weighted_gini(
  y = model_data$Severity,
  pred = model_data$pred_final,
  w = model_data$ClaimNb
)

cat("\nFinal Model Normalized Weighted Gini:", round(gini_final, 6), "\n")

# -------------------------------------------------
# Persist the trained model
# -------------------------------------------------
saveRDS(final_model, "experiments/final_model.rds")
cat("Final model saved to experiments/final_model.rds\n")

# experiments/experiment_1.R
# Iteration 1: Gamma GLM for Severity using raw features

library(readr)
library(dplyr)

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Helper: Normalized Weighted Gini Coefficient
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
normalized_weighted_gini <- function(y, pred, w = rep(1, length(y))) {
  weighted_gini <- function(y_i, pred_i, w_i) {
    ord <- order(pred_i, decreasing = TRUE)
    y_i <- y_i[ord]
    w_i <- w_i[ord]
    wy <- w_i * y_i
    cwy <- cumsum(wy)
    cw <- cumsum(w_i)
    total_w <- sum(w_i)
    total_wy <- sum(wy)
    if (total_wy == 0) return(0)
    p <- c(0, cw / total_w)
    L <- c(0, cwy / total_wy)
    area <- sum(diff(p) * (L[-1] + utils::head(L, -1)) / 2)
    return(2 * area - 1)
  }

  g_pred <- weighted_gini(y, pred, w)
  g_actual <- weighted_gini(y, y, w)
  if (g_actual == 0) return(NA_real_)
  return(g_pred / g_actual)
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Data Loading
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
freq <- read_csv("freMTPL2freq.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
sev <- read_csv("freMTPL2sev.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)

# Aggregate claim-level severity to policy-level total claim amount
sev_agg <- sev %>%
  group_by(IDpol) %>%
  summarise(ClaimAmount = sum(ClaimAmount), .groups = "drop")

# Merge and filter
model_data <- freq %>%
  inner_join(sev_agg, by = "IDpol") %>%
  filter(ClaimNb == 2, ClaimAmount > 0) %>%
  mutate(Severity = ClaimAmount / ClaimNb)

cat("Observations after filtering:", nrow(model_data), "\n")

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Iteration 1: Gamma GLM with raw features
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
formula_1 <- Severity ~ VehPower + VehAge + DrivAge + BonusMalus +
  VehBrand + VehGas + Area + Density + Region + AgeBand + Exposure

model_1 <- glm(
  formula = formula_1,
  family = Gamma(link = "log"),
  data = model_data,
  na.action = na.omit
)

cat("\n=== Model 1 Summary (Raw Features) ===\n")
print(summary(model_1))

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Predictions & Evaluation

# experiments/experiment_2.R
# Iteration 2: Gamma GLM for Severity with log-transformed VehPower & BonusMalus

library(readr)
library(dplyr)

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Helper: Normalized Weighted Gini Coefficient
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
normalized_weighted_gini <- function(y, pred, w = rep(1, length(y))) {
  weighted_gini <- function(y_i, pred_i, w_i) {
    ord <- order(pred_i, decreasing = TRUE)
    y_i <- y_i[ord]
    w_i <- w_i[ord]
    wy <- w_i * y_i
    cwy <- cumsum(wy)
    cw <- cumsum(w_i)
    total_w <- sum(w_i)
    total_wy <- sum(wy)
    if (total_wy == 0) return(0)
    p <- c(0, cw / total_w)
    L <- c(0, cwy / total_wy)
    area <- sum(diff(p) * (L[-1] + utils::head(L, -1)) / 2)
    return(2 * area - 1)
  }

  g_pred <- weighted_gini(y, pred, w)
  g_actual <- weighted_gini(y, y, w)
  if (g_actual == 0) return(NA_real_)
  return(g_pred / g_actual)
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Data Loading
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
freq <- read_csv("freMTPL2freq.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
sev <- read_csv("freMTPL2sev.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)

# Aggregate claim-level severity to policy-level total claim amount
sev_agg <- sev %>%
  group_by(IDpol) %>%
  summarise(ClaimAmount = sum(ClaimAmount), .groups = "drop")

# Merge, filter, and derive log-transformed features
model_data <- freq %>%
  inner_join(sev_agg, by = "IDpol") %>%
  filter(ClaimNb == 2, ClaimAmount > 0) %>%
  mutate(
    Severity = ClaimAmount / ClaimNb,
    log_VehPower = log(VehPower),
    log_BonusMalus = log(BonusMalus)
  )

cat("Observations after filtering:", nrow(model_data), "\n")

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Iteration 2: Gamma GLM with log(VehPower) and log(BonusMalus)
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
formula_2 <- Severity ~ log_VehPower + VehAge + DrivAge + log_BonusMalus +
  VehBrand + VehGas + Area + Density + Region + AgeBand + Exposure

model_2 <- glm(
  formula = formula_2,
  family = Gamma(link = "log"),
  data = model_data,
  na.action = na.omit
)

cat("\n=== Model 2 Summary (Log-Transformed Features) ===\n")

# Research Log

## Data Discovery
- Files identified:
  - `freMTPL2freq.csv`: Frequency dataset (policy-level).
  - `freMTPL2sev.csv`: Severity dataset (claim-level).

## Initial Profiling (`experiments/discovery.R`)
- Loaded both files using `readr::read_csv`.
- Frequency: 677,991 rows × 13 columns.
- Severity: 26,444 rows × 2 columns.

## Turn 1 — Iteration 1: Raw Features (`experiments/experiment_1.R`)

### Preprocessing
- Aggregated `freMTPL2sev.csv` to policy-level total `ClaimAmount` by `IDpol`.
- Inner-joined with `freMTPL2freq.csv` on `IDpol`.
- Filtered to policies with exactly `ClaimNb == 2` and positive total claim amount.
- Derived response: `Severity = ClaimAmount / ClaimNb`.

### Model Specification
- **Family**: Gamma with log-link.
- **Features**: All raw policy/vehicle attributes (`VehPower`, `VehAge`, `DrivAge`, `BonusMalus`, `VehBrand`, `VehGas`, `Area`, `Density`, `Region`, `AgeBand`, `Exposure`), excluding identifiers and the constant `ClaimNb`.

### Evaluation Metric
- Implemented **Normalized Weighted Gini Coefficient** (`normalized_weighted_gini`) using `ClaimNb` as weights.
- Calculation sorts predictions descending, constructs the Lorenz curve, and normalizes by the Gini of the actuals.

### Outputs
- Model object saved to `experiments/model_1.rds`.
- Script prints model summary and the Iteration 1 Gini score.

## Turn 2 — Iteration 2: Log-Transformed VehPower & BonusMalus (`experiments/experiment_2.R`)

### Preprocessing
- Same preprocessing pipeline as Iteration 1.
- Derived additional columns `log_VehPower = log(VehPower)` and `log_BonusMalus = log(BonusMalus)`.

### Model Specification
- **Family**: Gamma with log-link.
- **Features**: Replaced raw `VehPower` and `BonusMalus` with their natural-logarithm transforms (`log_VehPower`, `log_BonusMalus`). All remaining covariates (`VehAge`, `DrivAge`, `VehBrand`, `VehGas`, `Area`, `Density`, `Region`, `AgeBand`, `Exposure`) retained as raw features.

### Evaluation Metric
- Normalized Weighted Gini Coefficient (weights = `ClaimNb`), identical to Iteration 1.

### Outputs
- Model object saved to `experiments/model_2.rds`.
- Script prints model summary and the Iteration 2 Gini score.
- Observed **Iteration 2 Normalized Weighted Gini: 0.756235**.

## Turn 3 — Iteration 3: Natural Cubic Splines on DrivAge & VehAge (`experiments/experiment_3.R`)

### Preprocessing
- Same preprocessing pipeline as Iteration 2 (log-transformed `VehPower` and `BonusMalus` retained).
- Loaded the `splines` package for natural cubic spline basis expansion.

### Model Specification
- **Family**: Gamma with log-link.
- **Features**: Retained `log_VehPower` and `log_BonusMalus` from Iteration 2. Replaced the linear terms for `DrivAge` and `VehAge` with natural cubic splines (`splines::ns(DrivAge)` and `splines::ns(VehAge)`). All other covariates (`VehBrand`, `VehGas`, `Area`, `Density`, `Region`, `AgeBand`, `Exposure`) retained.

### Evaluation Metric
- Normalized Weighted Gini Coefficient (weights = `ClaimNb`), identical to previous iterations.

### Outputs
- Model object saved to `experiments/model_3.rds`.
- Script prints model summary and the Iteration 3 Gini score.

## Next Steps
- **Selection**: Compare the three iterations using the Normalized Weighted Gini Coefficient and select the best-performing model.
- **Final Delivery**: Produce `final_model.r` (training, evaluation, and persistence code for the chosen model) and a PDF interpretation report summarizing methodology, coefficient interpretation, and model diagnostics for the professor.

--- FILE: bayes/bayes/calculator_gui.py ---

import ast
import operator
import tkinter as tk


class CalculationEngine:
    _ALLOWED_OPS = {
        ast.Add: operator.add,
        ast.Sub: operator.sub,
        ast.Mult: operator.mul,
        ast.Div: operator.truediv,
        ast.USub: operator.neg,
    }

    @staticmethod
    def safe_divide(a, b):
        if b == 0:
            raise ZeroDivisionError
        return a / b

    @staticmethod
    def evaluate(expr):
        if not expr:
            raise ValueError
        tree = ast.parse(expr, mode="eval")

        def _eval(node):
            if isinstance(node, ast.Expression):
                return _eval(node.body)
            if isinstance(node, ast.Constant):
                if isinstance(node.value, (int, float)):
                    return node.value
                raise ValueError
            if isinstance(node, ast.Num):
                return node.n
            if isinstance(node, ast.BinOp):
                left = _eval(node.left)
                right = _eval(node.right)
                op_type = type(node.op)
                if op_type is ast.Div:
                    return CalculationEngine.safe_divide(left, right)
                if op_type not in CalculationEngine._ALLOWED_OPS:
                    raise ValueError
                return CalculationEngine._ALLOWED_OPS[op_type](left, right)
            if isinstance(node, ast.UnaryOp):
                operand = _eval(node.operand)
                op_type = type(node.op)
                if op_type not in CalculationEngine._ALLOWED_OPS:
                    raise ValueError
                return CalculationEngine._ALLOWED_OPS[op_type](operand)
            raise ValueError

        return _eval(tree)


class CalculatorApp(tk.Tk):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.title("Calculator")
        self.geometry("400x500")
        self.configure(bg="#f5f5f5")
        self.resizable(False, False)

        self.engine = CalculationEngine()
        self.current_expr = "0"

        self.columnconfigure(0, weight=1)
        self.rowconfigure(1, weight=1)

        self.display = tk.Entry(
            self,
            font=("Segoe UI", 28),
            bd=0,
            bg="#ffffff",
            fg="#333333",
            justify="right",
            state="readonly",
            readonlybackground="#ffffff",
            highlightthickness=0,
        )
        self.display.grid(row=0, column=0, sticky="nsew", padx=10, pady=20)
        self.display.insert(0, self.current_expr)

        btn_frame = tk.Frame(self, bg="#f5f5f5")
        btn_frame.grid(row=1, column=0, sticky="nsew", padx=10, pady=10)

        for i in range(5):
            btn_frame.columnconfigure(i, weight=1)
        for i in range(4):
            btn_frame.rowconfigure(i, weight=1)

        buttons = [
            ("C", 0, 0), ("/", 0, 1), ("*", 0, 2), ("-", 0, 3), ("", 0, 4),
            ("7", 1, 0), ("8", 1, 1), ("9", 1, 2), ("+", 1, 3), ("", 1, 4),
            ("4", 2, 0), ("5", 2, 1), ("6", 2, 2), ("=", 2, 3), ("", 2, 4),
            ("1", 3, 0), ("2", 3, 1), ("3", 3, 2), ("0", 3, 3), ("", 3, 4),
        ]

        for char, r, c in buttons:
            if not char:
                continue
            action = lambda x=char: self.on_button(x)
            btn = tk.Button(
                btn_frame,
                text=char,
                font=("Segoe UI", 14),
                width=4,
                height=2,
                bd=0,
                bg="#e0e0e0",
                fg="#333333",
                activebackground="#d0d0d0",
                activeforeground="#000000",
                command=action,
            )
            btn.grid(row=r, column=c, sticky="nsew", padx=4, pady=4)

    def on_button(self, char):
        if char == "C":
            self.clear()
        elif char == "=":
            self.calculate()
        else:
            self.append_char(char)

    def append_char(self, char):
        if self.current_expr == "Error":
            self.current_expr = ""
        if self.current_expr == "0" and char not in "+-*/":
            self.current_expr = char
        else:
            self.current_expr += char
        self.update_display()

    def clear(self):
        self.current_expr = "0"
        self.update_display()

    def calculate(self):
        try:
            result = self.engine.evaluate(self.current_expr)
            self.current_expr = str(result)
        except Exception:
            self.current_expr = "Error"
        self.update_display()

    def update_display(self):
        self.display.configure(state="normal")
        self.display.delete(0, tk.END)
        self.display.insert(0, self.current_expr)
        self.display.configure(state="readonly")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    app = CalculatorApp()
    app.mainloop()

# final_model.R
# -------------------------------------------------
# Final model selection based on experiment outcomes.
# Chosen model: Gamma GLM with log-link using natural cubic splines
# for VehAge and DrivAge (df = 3 each).
# -------------------------------------------------

# Load required libraries -------------------------------------------------
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(splines)

# -------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Helper: Weighted Gini (Lorenz curve method) – retained for optional eval
# -------------------------------------------------------------------------
weighted_gini <- function(actual, predicted, weights = NULL) {
  if (is.null(weights)) weights <- rep(1, length(actual))
  df <- data.frame(actual = actual, predicted = predicted, weights = weights)
  df <- df[order(df$predicted), ]
  cum_wt  <- cumsum(df$weights)
  cum_pos <- cumsum(df$actual * df$weights)
  total_wt  <- sum(df$weights)
  total_pos <- sum(df$actual * df$weights)
  if (total_wt == 0 || total_pos == 0) return(0)
  x <- c(0, cum_wt / total_wt)
  y <- c(0, cum_pos / total_pos)
  auc <- sum(diff(x) * (y[-1] + y[-length(y)]) / 2)
  1 - 2 * auc
}
normalized_weighted_gini <- function(actual, predicted, weights = NULL) {
  g_pred <- weighted_gini(actual, predicted, weights)
  g_max  <- weighted_gini(actual, actual, weights)
  if (abs(g_max) < 1e-12) return(0)
  g_pred / g_max
}

# -------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Data loading and preparation (identical to experiments)
# -------------------------------------------------------------------------
freq_path <- "freMTPL2freq.csv"
sev_path  <- "freMTPL2sev.csv"

freq_data <- read_csv(freq_path, show_col_types = FALSE)
sev_data  <- read_csv(sev_path,  show_col_types = FALSE)

# Merge on policy identifier
merged <- left_join(sev_data, freq_data, by = "IDpol")

# Keep policies with exactly 2 claims and positive claim amounts
filtered <- merged %>%
  filter(ClaimNb == 2, ClaimAmount > 0)

# Aggregate to policy level and compute per‑claim severity
policy_data <- filtered %>%
  group_by(IDpol) %>%
  summarise(
    VehPower   = first(VehPower),
    VehAge     = first(VehAge),
    DrivAge    = first(DrivAge),
    BonusMalus = first(BonusMalus),
    VehBrand   = first(VehBrand),
    VehGas     = first(VehGas),
    Area       = first(Area),
    Density    = first(Density),
    Region     = first(Region),
    AgeBand    = first(AgeBand),
    ClaimNb    = first(ClaimNb),
    ClaimAmount = sum(ClaimAmount)
  ) %>%
  mutate(Severity = ClaimAmount / ClaimNb) %>%
  ungroup()

# -------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Fit final model on the entire prepared dataset
# -------------------------------------------------------------------------
formula_final <- Severity ~ VehPower +
  ns(VehAge, df = 3) +
  ns(DrivAge, df = 3) +
  BonusMalus +
  VehBrand + VehGas + Area + Density + Region + AgeBand

final_glm <- glm(formula_final,
                 data = policy_data,
                 family = Gamma(link = "log"))

# -------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Save the fitted model
# -------------------------------------------------------------------------
saveRDS(final_glm, "final_model.rds")

# Optional: evaluate on the same data (for reporting purposes)
policy_data$pred <- predict(final_glm, newdata = policy_data, type = "response")
gini_val <- normalized_weighted_gini(
  actual   = policy_data$Severity,
  predicted = policy_data$pred,
  weights   = policy_data$ClaimNb
)
cat("Final model Normalized Weighted Gini (on training data):", gini_val, "\n")

# Helper function to profile a data frame ---------------------------------
profile_data <- function(df, name) {
  cat("\n--- Profile of", name, "---\n")
  cat("Rows:", nrow(df), "Columns:", ncol(df), "\n")
  cat("\nColumn Types:\n")
  print(sapply(df, class))
  
  cat("\nMissing values per column:\n")
  miss <- sapply(df, function(col) sum(is.na(col)))
  print(miss)
  
  cat("\nFirst few rows:\n")
  print(head(df))
  
  cat("\nSummary statistics (numeric columns):\n")
  num_cols <- df %>% select(where(is.numeric))
  if (ncol(num_cols) > 0) {
    print(summary(num_cols))
  } else {
    cat("No numeric columns to summarize.\n")
  }
}
