  <!-- Limitations -->
  <section class="section" id="limitations">
    <h2>Limitations &amp; Further Improvements</h2>
    <ul>
      <li>Sample size limited to 500 policies; extending to the full dataset may expose additional variance.</li>
      <li>Feature set relies on engineered encodings; exploring richer interaction terms or alternative embedding techniques could yield gains.</li>
      <li>Model evaluation focused on RMSE, Gini, and AE Ratio; incorporating tail‑risk metrics (e.g., CVaR) would address extreme loss behaviour.</li>
      <li>Random Forest hyper‑parameters were left at defaults; targeted tuning might improve RMSE without sacrificing stability.</li>
      <li>Temporal validation (train on earlier years, test on later) was not performed; implementing a time‑split would assess real‑world robustness.</li>
    </ul>
  </section>

--- FILE: bayes/T8/experiments/experiment_1.R ---

#!/usr/bin/env Rscript
# experiments/experiment_1.R
# Actuarial Severity Benchmarking Pipeline
# ----------------------------------------------------------
# Repeated 5-Fold Cross-Validation (5 repeats)
# Split: 80 % train / 20 % test per fold
# Target: Average claim severity for policies with exactly 2 claims

# ----------------------------------------------------------
# 0. Setup
# ----------------------------------------------------------
library(data.table)
library(splines)
library(glmnet)
library(ranger)
library(jsonlite)
library(ggplot2)

# Ensure artifacts directory exists
dir.create("experiments/artifacts", recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

set.seed(42)

# ----------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Data Preparation
# ----------------------------------------------------------
freq <- fread("freMTPL2freq.csv")
sev <- fread("freMTPL2sev.csv")

# Aggregate severity to policy level
sev_agg <- sev[, .(ClaimTotal = sum(ClaimAmount), ClaimCount = .N), by = IDpol]

# Inner join (keep only policies with at least one claim)
df <- merge(freq, sev_agg, by = "IDpol", all = FALSE)

# Filter policies with exactly 2 claims
df <- df[ClaimNb == 2]

# Compute average severity per claim
df[, Severity := ClaimTotal / ClaimCount]

# Retain only necessary columns
df <- df[, .(VehPower, VehAge, DrivAge, BonusMalus, VehBrand, VehGas,
             Area, Density, Region, Severity)]

# Sample exactly 500 rows if more are available
if (nrow(df) > 500) {
  df <- df[sample(.N, 500)]
} else if (nrow(df) < 500) {
  warning(sprintf("Only %d policies with exactly 2 claims available; using all.", nrow(df)))
}

cat(sprintf("Dataset prepared: %d rows, %d columns\n", nrow(df), ncol(df)))

# ----------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Helper Functions
# ----------------------------------------------------------

#' Smoothed Leave-One-Out Target Encoding
smooth_loo_te <- function(train, test, col_name, target_name, smoothing = 10) {
  train <- as.data.frame(train)
  test <- as.data.frame(test)
  
  global_mean <- mean(train[[target_name]])
  
  # Category-level sums and counts from training data
  agg <- aggregate(
    train[[target_name]],
    by = list(train[[col_name]]),
    FUN = function(x) c(sum = sum(x), n = length(x))
  )
  names(agg) <- c(col_name, "stats")
  agg$grp_sum <- agg$stats[, "sum"]
  agg$grp_n   <- agg$stats[, "n"]
  
  # Training: LOO encoding
  train_tmp <- data.frame(
    idx     = seq_len(nrow(train)),
    col_val = train[[col_name]],
    target  = train[[target_name]]
  )
  merged <- merge(train_tmp, agg[, c(col_name, "grp_sum", "grp_n")],
                  by.x = "col_val", by.y = col_name, all.x = TRUE, sort = FALSE)
  merged <- merged[order(merged$idx), ]
  
  loo_mean <- (merged$grp_sum - merged$target) / (merged$grp_n - 1)
  loo_mean[is.na(loo_mean) | is.infinite(loo_mean)] <- global_mean
  
  weight <- merged$grp_n / (merged$grp_n + smoothing)
  train_te <- weight * loo_mean + (1 - weight) * global_mean
  
  # Test: regular target encoding (smoothed training mean)
  test_tmp <- data.frame(col_val = test[[col_name]])
  merged_test <- merge(test_tmp, agg[, c(col_name, "grp_sum", "grp_n")],
                       by.x = "col_val", by.y = col_name, all.x = TRUE, sort = FALSE)
  test_mean <- merged_test$grp_sum / merged_test$grp_n
  test_mean[is.na(test_mean)] <- global_mean
  
  weight_test <- merged_test$grp_n / (merged_test$grp_n + smoothing)
  weight_test[is.na(weight_test)] <- 0
  test_te <- weight_test * test_mean + (1 - weight_test) * global_mean
  test_te[is.na(test_te)] <- global_mean
  
  list(train = train_te, test = test_te)
}

#' Standardize features based on training moments
scale_train_test <- function(train_mat, test_mat) {
  means <- colMeans(train_mat, na.rm = TRUE)
  sds   <- apply(train_mat, 2, sd, na.rm = TRUE)
  sds[sds == 0] <- 1
  list(
    train = scale(train_mat, center = means, scale = sds),
    test  = scale(test_mat, center = means, scale = sds),
    means = means,
    sds   = sds
  )
}

#' Build engineered feature matrices for a CV fold
build_features <- function(train_df, test_df, target_col = "Severity") {
  # Log transforms
  train_log <- data.table(
    VehPower_log   = log(train_df$VehPower),
    Density_log    = log(train_df$Density),
    BonusMalus_log = log(train_df$BonusMalus)
  )
  test_log <- data.table(
    VehPower_log   = log(test_df$VehPower),
    Density_log    = log(test_df$Density),
    BonusMalus_log = log(test_df$BonusMalus)
  )
  
  # Smoothed LOO target encodings
  te_region <- smooth_loo_te(train_df, test_df, "Region", target_col, smoothing = 10)
  te_area   <- smooth_loo_te(train_df, test_df, "Area",   target_col, smoothing = 10)
  te_brand  <- smooth_loo_te(train_df, test_df, "VehBrand", target_col, smoothing = 10)
  
  train_te <- data.table(
    Region_TE   = te_region$train,
    Area_TE     = te_area$train,
    VehBrand_TE = te_brand$train
  )
  test_te <- data.table(
    Region_TE   = te_region$test,
    Area_TE     = te_area$test,
    VehBrand_TE = te_brand$test
  )
  
  # Natural splines (df = 3)
  ns_driv <- ns(train_df$DrivAge, df = 3)
  ns_driv_test <- predict(ns_driv, test_df$DrivAge)
  ns_veh  <- ns(train_df$VehAge, df = 3)
  ns_veh_test  <- predict(ns_veh, test_df$VehAge)
  
  train_ns_driv <- as.data.table(as.matrix(ns_driv))
  setnames(train_ns_driv, paste0("DrivAge_ns", 1:ncol(train_ns_driv)))
  test_ns_driv  <- as.data.table(as.matrix(ns_driv_test))
  setnames(test_ns_driv, paste0("DrivAge_ns", 1:ncol(test_ns_driv)))
  
  train_ns_veh <- as.data.table(as.matrix(ns_veh))
  setnames(train_ns_veh, paste0("VehAge_ns", 1:ncol(train_ns_veh)))
  test_ns_veh  <- as.data.table(as.matrix(ns_veh_test))
  setnames(test_ns_veh, paste0("VehAge_ns", 1:ncol(test_ns_veh)))
  
  # Additional raw feature
  train_other <- data.table(VehGasDiesel = as.numeric(train_df$VehGas == "Diesel"))
  test_other  <- data.table(VehGasDiesel = as.numeric(test_df$VehGas == "Diesel"))
  
  # Assemble
  train_X <- cbind(train_log, train_te, train_ns_driv, train_ns_veh, train_other)
  test_X  <- cbind(test_log, test_te, test_ns_driv, test_ns_veh, test_other)
  
  # Standardize
  scaled <- scale_train_test(as.matrix(train_X), as.matrix(test_X))
  
  list(
    train_X = scaled$train,
    test_X  = scaled$test,
    train_y = train_df[[target_col]],
    test_y  = test_df[[target_col]]
  )
}

#' Fit helper for Gamma GLM (glm2 with fallback to glm)
glm2_fit <- function(formula, data) {
  if (requireNamespace("glm2", quietly = TRUE)) {
    glm2::glm2(formula, family = Gamma(link = "log"), data = data,
               control = glm.control(maxit = 100))
  } else {
    glm(formula, family = Gamma(link = "log"), data = data,
        control = glm.control(maxit = 100))
  }
}

#' Metrics
compute_metrics <- function(actual, predicted) {
  rmse <- sqrt(mean((actual - predicted)^2))
  ae_ratio <- sum(actual) / sum(predicted)
  
  n <- length(actual)
  gini_pred <- sum((2 * rank(predicted, ties.method = "random") - n - 1) * actual) /
               (n * sum(actual))
  gini_max  <- sum((2 * rank(actual, ties.method = "random") - n - 1) * actual) /
               (n * sum(actual))
  gini_norm <- ifelse(gini_max == 0, 0, gini_pred / gini_max)
  
  c(RMSE = rmse, Gini_Norm = gini_norm, AE_Ratio = ae_ratio)
}

# ----------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Model Definitions
# ----------------------------------------------------------
models <- list()

models[["GLM2"]] <- function(train_X, train_y, test_X, test_y) {
  df_train <- as.data.frame(cbind(train_X, Severity = train_y))
  df_test  <- as.data.frame(cbind(test_X, Severity = test_y))
  fit <- glm2_fit(Severity ~ ., df_train)
  pred <- predict(fit, newdata = df_test, type = "response")
  list(pred = as.vector(pred))
}

models[["Ridge"]] <- function(train_X, train_y, test_X, test_y) {
  cv_fit <- cv.glmnet(train_X, train_y, family = "gaussian", alpha = 0, nfolds = 5)
  pred <- predict(cv_fit, newx = test_X, s = "lambda.min")
  list(pred = as.vector(pred))
}

models[["ElasticNet"]] <- function(train_X, train_y, test_X, test_y) {
  cv_fit <- cv.glmnet(train_X, train_y, family = "gaussian", alpha = 0.5, nfolds = 5)
  pred <- predict(cv_fit, newx = test_X, s = "lambda.min")
  list(pred = as.vector(pred))
}

models[["Lasso"]] <- function(train_X, train_y, test_X, test_y) {
  cv_fit <- cv.glmnet(train_X, train_y, family = "gaussian", alpha = 1, nfolds = 5)
  pred <- predict(cv_fit, newx = test_X, s = "lambda.min")
  list(pred = as.vector(pred))
}

models[["RandomForest"]] <- function(train_X, train_y, test_X, test_y) {
  df_train <- as.data.frame(cbind(train_X, Severity = train_y))
  df_test  <- as.data.frame(cbind(test_X, Severity = test_y))
  fit <- ranger(Severity ~ ., data = df_train, num.trees = 500, verbose = FALSE)
  pred <- predict(fit, data = df_test)$predictions
  list(pred = as.vector(pred))
}

# ----------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Repeated 5-Fold Cross-Validation
# ----------------------------------------------------------
n_repeats <- 5
n_folds   <- 5

records <- list()
last_fold_preds <- list()
counter <- 1

for (r in 1:n_repeats) {
  # Create fold indices for this repeat
  fold_ids <- sample(rep(1:n_folds, length.out = nrow(df)))
  
  for (f in 1:n_folds) {
    train_idx <- which(fold_ids != f)
    test_idx  <- which(fold_ids == f)
    
    train_raw <- df[train_idx, ]
    test_raw  <- df[test_idx, ]
    
    feats <- build_features(train_raw, test_raw, target_col = "Severity")
    
    for (mname in names(models)) {
      res <- models[[mname]](feats$train_X, feats$train_y, feats$test_X, feats$test_y)
      pred <- pmax(as.vector(res$pred), 1e-6)  # floor at small positive
      
      mets <- compute_metrics(feats$test_y, pred)
      
      records[[counter]] <- data.table(
        Repeat   = r,
        Fold     = f,
        Model    = mname,
        RMSE     = mets["RMSE"],
        Gini_Norm= mets["Gini_Norm"],
        AE_Ratio = mets["AE_Ratio"]
      )
      counter <- counter + 1
      
      # Capture predictions from the very last fold for diagnostic plotting
      if (r == n_repeats && f == n_folds) {
        last_fold_preds[[mname]] <- data.table(
          Model = mname,
          Actual = feats$test_y,
          Predicted = pred
        )
      }
    }
    
    cat(sprintf("Repeat %d | Fold %d complete.\n", r, f))
  }
}

results_dt <- rbindlist(records)

# ----------------------------------------------------------
# 5. Summarise Results
# ----------------------------------------------------------

# Absolute metrics
abs_metrics <- results_dt[, .(
  RMSE      = mean(RMSE),
  Gini_Norm = mean(Gini_Norm),
  AE_Ratio  = mean(AE_Ratio)
), by = Model]
setorder(abs_metrics, RMSE)

# Ratios vs GLM2 (per-fold then averaged to preserve fold-wise pairing)
glm2_ref <- results_dt[Model == "GLM2", .(Repeat, Fold, GLM2_RMSE = RMSE,
                                          GLM2_Gini = Gini_Norm, GLM2_AE = AE_Ratio)]
ratio_dt <- merge(results_dt, glm2_ref, by = c("Repeat", "Fold"))
ratio_dt[, RMSE_Ratio  := RMSE / GLM2_RMSE]
ratio_dt[, Gini_Ratio  := Gini_Norm / GLM2_Gini]
ratio_dt[, AE_Ratio_Ratio := AE_Ratio / GLM2_AE]

ratio_summary <- ratio_dt[, .(
  RMSE_Ratio  = mean(RMSE_Ratio),
  Gini_Ratio  = mean(Gini_Ratio),
  AE_Ratio_Ratio = mean(AE_Ratio_Ratio)
), by = Model]
setorder(ratio_summary, RMSE_Ratio)

# Best model identification
best_model <- ratio_summary[which.min(RMSE_Ratio), Model]
best_rationale <- sprintf(
  "%s achieved the lowest RMSE_Ratio (%.4f) versus the Gamma GLM baseline. Shrinkage estimators regularize coefficient magnitudes, reducing variance and improving stability when predicting right-skewed severity distributions with heavy-tailed noise.",
  best_model, ratio_summary[Model == best_model, RMSE_Ratio]
)

cat("Absolute metrics:\n"); print(abs_metrics)
cat("\nRelative ratios vs GLM2:\n"); print(ratio_summary)
cat("\nBest model:\n"); print(best_rationale)

# ----------------------------------------------------------
# 6. Save Artifacts (JSON + PNG)
# ----------------------------------------------------------

# JSON metrics
write_json(abs_metrics,   "experiments/artifacts/metrics_absolute.json", pretty = TRUE)
write_json(ratio_summary, "experiments/artifacts/metrics_ratios.json",   pretty = TRUE)
write_json(results_dt,    "experiments/artifacts/fold_results.json",     pretty = TRUE)

# Best model summary
best_summary <- list(
  best_model = best_model,
  rationale  = best_rationale
)
write_json(best_summary, "experiments/artifacts/best_model_summary.json", pretty = TRUE, auto_unbox = TRUE)

# Plot: Absolute RMSE
p_rmse <- ggplot(abs_metrics, aes(x = reorder(Model, RMSE), y = RMSE, fill = Model)) +
  geom_col(show.legend = FALSE) +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(title = "Average Out-of-Sample RMSE",
       x = "Model", y = "RMSE") +
  theme_minimal()
ggsave("experiments/artifacts/metric_plot_rmse.png", p_rmse, width = 6, height = 4, dpi = 150)

# Plot: Normalized Gini
p_gini <- ggplot(abs_metrics, aes(x = reorder(Model, -Gini_Norm), y = Gini_Norm, fill = Model)) +
  geom_col(show.legend = FALSE) +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(title = "Average Out-of-Sample Normalized Gini",
       x = "Model", y = "Gini_Norm") +
  theme_minimal()
ggsave("experiments/artifacts/metric_plot_gini.png", p_gini, width = 6, height = 4, dpi = 150)

# Plot: AE Ratio
p_ae <- ggplot(abs_metrics, aes(x = reorder(Model, AE_Ratio), y = AE_Ratio, fill = Model)) +
  geom_col(show.legend = FALSE) +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(title = "Average Out-of-Sample AE Ratio (Actual / Expected)",
       x = "Model", y = "AE Ratio") +
  theme_minimal() +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed", color = "red")
ggsave("experiments/artifacts/metric_plot_ae.png", p_ae, width = 6, height = 4, dpi = 150)

# Plot: RMSE Ratio vs GLM2
p_ratio <- ggplot(ratio_summary, aes(x = reorder(Model, RMSE_Ratio), y = RMSE_Ratio, fill = Model)) +
  geom_col(show.legend = FALSE) +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(title = "Relative RMSE Ratio vs GLM2",
       x = "Model", y = "RMSE Ratio (Model / GLM2)") +

ggsave("experiments/artifacts/rmse_ratio_plot.png", p_ratio, width = 6, height = 4, dpi = 150)

# Plot: RMSE distribution across all folds

if (length(last_fold_preds) > 0) {
  pred_df <- rbindlist(last_fold_preds)

# Research Log: Actuarial Severity Benchmarking

## Phase 1 – Discovery (2026-06-11)
**Objective:** Initial exploration of the French MTPL frequency (`freMTPL2freq.csv`) and severity (`freMTPL2sev.csv`) datasets. Identify structure, missingness, and basic statistics to inform subsequent data preparation and modeling steps.

**Tasks Performed:**
- Load both CSV files.
- Inspect dimensions, column names, and data types.
- Generate summary statistics for numeric variables.
- Check for duplicate IDs and basic join feasibility on `IDpol`.

## Phase 2 – Experiment 1: Severity Benchmarking (2026-06-11)

**Hypothesis:**  
Shrinkage estimators (Ridge, Elastic Net, Lasso) will outperform the Gamma GLM baseline on out-of-sample RMSE because their L2/L1 penalty structure stabilizes coefficient estimates in the presence of right-skewed severity noise and multicollinearity among splines and target-encoded features.

**Methodology:**  
- **Data Preparation:** Inner join of `freMTPL2freq` and aggregated `freMTPL2sev` on `IDpol`; filter to policies with exactly 2 claims; randomly sample 500 rows.
- **Feature Engineering:**  
  - Log-transforms: `VehPower`, `Density`, `BonusMalus`.  
  - Smoothed LOO target encoding: `Region`, `Area`, `VehBrand` (smoothing = 10).  
  - Natural cubic splines: `DrivAge`, `VehAge` (df = 3).  
  - Standardization of all final inputs based on training moments.
- **Validation:** Repeated 5-Fold Cross-Validation (5 repeats). Each fold uses an 80/20 training-test split. Target encoding and scaling are fit strictly inside each training fold to prevent leakage.
- **Models:** Gamma GLM (`glm2` baseline), Ridge Regression, Elastic Net (α=0.5), Lasso (α=1), and Random Forest.
- **Metrics:** RMSE (error scale), Normalized Gini (ranking power), and AE Ratio (Actual vs Expected).

**Expected Artifacts (saved to `experiments/artifacts/`):**
| Artifact | Format | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `metrics_absolute.json` | JSON | Average absolute out-of-sample performance per model |
| `metrics_ratios.json` | JSON | Average out-of-sample relative ratios vs GLM2 |
| `fold_results.json` | JSON | Fold-by-fold raw results for reproducibility |
| `best_model_summary.json` | JSON | Best-performing model name and selection rationale |
| `metric_plot_rmse.png` | PNG | Bar chart of mean RMSE by model |
| `metric_plot_gini.png` | PNG | Bar chart of mean Normalized Gini by model |
| `metric_plot_ae.png` | PNG | Bar chart of mean AE Ratio by model |
| `rmse_ratio_plot.png` | PNG | Bar chart of RMSE Ratio vs GLM2 |
| `rmse_boxplot.png` | PNG | Boxplot of RMSE distribution across all folds |
| `prediction_scatter.png` | PNG | Actual vs Predicted scatter (last fold) |

**Next Steps:**  
Execute `experiments/experiment_1.R`, verify artifacts, and compile the final PDF report (`Actuarial_Severity_Report.pdf`) incorporating the methodology description, parameter tables, metric definitions, and model-selection narrative.

# experiments/discovery.R
# --------------------------------------------
# Profile CSV data files in the repository and
# generate a quick summary for each.
# --------------------------------------------

# Load required libraries
if (!requireNamespace("data.table", quietly = TRUE)) {
  install.packages("data.table")
}
library(data.table)

# Helper: summarize a data.table
summarise_dt <- function(dt) {
  cat("\n--- Summary for", dt$file_name, "---\n")
  cat("Rows :", nrow(dt), "\n")
  cat("Cols :", ncol(dt), "\n")
  cat("Column Types:\n")
  print(sapply(dt, class))
  cat("\nMissing values per column:\n")
  print(colSums(is.na(dt)))
  cat("\n--- End of summary ---\n")
}

# Identify CSV files in the repository (recursive)
csv_files <- list.files(path = ".", pattern = "\\.csv$", full.names = TRUE, recursive = TRUE)

if (length(csv_files) == 0) {
  cat("No CSV files found in the repository.\n")
} else {
  cat("Found", length(csv_files), "CSV file(s):\n")
  print(csv_files)
  for (f in csv_files) {
    # Read with data.table for speed; use first 10,000 rows to avoid memory overload
    dt <- fread(f, nrows = 10000, showProgress = FALSE)
    dt$file_name <- f
    summaraise_dt <- tryCatch(
      summaraise_dt(dt),
      error = function(e) {
        cat("Failed to summarise", f, ":", e$message, "\n")
      }
    )
  }
}

function addRow(tbody, cells) {
  const tr = document.createElement('tr');

    const td = document.createElement('td');

    tr.appendChild(td);
  });
  tbody.appendChild(tr);
}

# final_model.R
# Actuarial Severity Benchmarking Pipeline (rewritten)
# -----------------------------------------------------
# 1. Load & prepare French MTPL data
# 2. Feature engineering via recipes (log, dummy, splines, scaling)
# 3. Repeated 5‑fold CV (5 repeats) with 80/20 splits
# 4. Models: Gamma GLM2, Ridge, Elastic Net, RF, XGBoost (optional)
# 5. JSON + PNG artifacts
# 6. PDF report

# ---- 0. Packages ------------------------------------------------
core_pkgs <- c(
  "data.table", "dplyr", "caret", "glm2", "glmnet",
  "recipes", "splines", "jsonlite", "ggplot2", "rmarkdown"
)
opt_pkgs <- c("randomForest", "xgboost")

for (p in c(core_pkgs, opt_pkgs)) {
  if (!requireNamespace(p, quietly = TRUE)) {
    install.packages(p, repos = "https://cloud.r-project.org")
  }
}

for (p in core_pkgs) {
  library(p, character.only = TRUE)
}

HAS_RF  <- FALSE
HAS_XGB <- FALSE
for (p in opt_pkgs) {
  if (requireNamespace(p, quietly = TRUE)) {
    library(p, character.only = TRUE)
    if (p == "randomForest") HAS_RF <- TRUE
    if (p == "xgboost")      HAS_XGB <- TRUE
  } else {
    warning(paste("Optional package", p, "not installed; skipping related model."))
  }
}

# ---- 1. Constants & Helpers -------------------------------------
set.seed(123)
freq_path   <- "freMTPL2freq.csv"
sev_path    <- "freMTPL2sev.csv"
target_var  <- "ClaimAmount"
sample_nrow <- 500
art_dir     <- "experiments/artifacts"
report_rmd  <- "experiments/report.Rmd"
output_pdf  <- "Actuarial_Severity_Report.pdf"

dir.create(art_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(dirname(report_rmd), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

gini_norm <- function(y, pred) {
  ord <- order(pred, decreasing = TRUE)
  cum_y <- cumsum(y[ord]) / sum(y)
  2 * (mean(cum_y) - 0.5)
}

ae_ratio <- function(y, pred) {
  mean(pred) / mean(y)
}

# ---- 2. Load & prepare data -------------------------------------
freq <- fread(freq_path)
sev  <- fread(sev_path)

df <- as.data.frame(merge(freq, sev, by = "IDpol"))

df_filtered <- df %>%
  group_by(IDpol) %>%
  filter(n() == 2) %>%
  ungroup()

df_sampled <- df_filtered %>%
  sample_n(min(sample_nrow, nrow(df_filtered))) %>%
  as.data.frame()

# Ensure known categoricals are factors for dummy encoding
potential_cat <- c("Area", "VehBrand", "Region", "VehGas")
cat_cols <- intersect(potential_cat, names(df_sampled))
for (col in cat_cols) {
  df_sampled[[col]] <- as.factor(df_sampled[[col]])
}

# ---- 3. Feature engineering recipe ------------------------------
potential_log    <- c("VehPower", "Density", "BonusMalus")
log_cols    <- intersect(potential_log, names(df_sampled))

potential_spline <- c("DrivAge", "VehAge", "Exposure")
spline_cols <- intersect(potential_spline, names(df_sampled))

rec <- recipe(as.formula(paste(target_var, "~ .")), data = df_sampled) %>%
  step_rm(all_of("IDpol"))

if (length(log_cols) > 0) {
  rec <- rec %>% step_log(all_of(log_cols), offset = 1)
}

rec <- rec %>% step_dummy(all_nominal_predictors())

if (length(spline_cols) > 0) {
  rec <- rec %>% step_ns(all_of(spline_cols), deg_free = 4)
}

rec <- rec %>%
  step_normalize(all_numeric_predictors(), -all_outcomes()) %>%
  step_zv(all_predictors())

rec_prepped <- prep(rec, training = df_sampled, retain = TRUE)
train_data_full <- as.data.frame(bake(rec_prepped, new_data = NULL))

# ---- 4. Model fitting functions ---------------------------------
fit_gamma_glm2 <- function(train_df, test_df) {
  fit <- glm2(as.formula(paste(target_var, "~ .")),
              data = train_df,
              family = Gamma(link = "log"))
  pred <- predict(fit, newdata = test_df, type = "response")
  list(model = fit, pred = as.numeric(pred))
}

fit_glmnet_ridge <- function(train_df, test_df) {
  pred_names <- setdiff(names(train_df), target_var)
  x_train <- as.matrix(train_df[, pred_names, drop = FALSE])
  y_train <- train_df[[target_var]]
  fit <- cv.glmnet(x_train, y_train, alpha = 0, nfolds = 5, family = "gaussian")
  x_test <- as.matrix(test_df[, pred_names, drop = FALSE])
  pred <- predict(fit, newx = x_test, s = "lambda.min")
  list(model = fit, pred = as.numeric(pred))
}

fit_glmnet_enet <- function(train_df, test_df) {
  pred_names <- setdiff(names(train_df), target_var)
  x_train <- as.matrix(train_df[, pred_names, drop = FALSE])
  y_train <- train_df[[target_var]]
  fit <- cv.glmnet(x_train, y_train, alpha = 0.5, nfolds = 5, family = "gaussian")
  x_test <- as.matrix(test_df[, pred_names, drop = FALSE])
  pred <- predict(fit, newx = x_test, s = "lambda.min")
  list(model = fit, pred = as.numeric(pred))
}

fit_random_forest <- function(train_df, test_df) {
  fit <- randomForest(as.formula(paste(target_var, "~ .")),
                      data = train_df,
                      ntree = 200)
  pred <- predict(fit, newdata = test_df)
  list(model = fit, pred = as.numeric(pred))
}

fit_xgboost <- function(train_df, test_df) {
  pred_names <- setdiff(names(train_df), target_var)
  x_train <- as.matrix(train_df[, pred_names, drop = FALSE])
  y_train <- train_df[[target_var]]
  dtrain <- xgb.DMatrix(data = x_train, label = y_train)
  fit <- xgb.train(params = list(objective = "reg:squarederror", eval_metric = "rmse"),
                   data = dtrain,
                   nrounds = 150,
                   verbose = 0)
  x_test <- as.matrix(test_df[, pred_names, drop = FALSE])
  dtest <- xgb.DMatrix(data = x_test)
  pred <- predict(fit, dtest)
  list(model = fit, pred = as.numeric(pred))
}

model_fns <- list(
  Gamma_GLM2 = fit_gamma_glm2,
  Ridge      = fit_glmnet_ridge,
  ElasticNet = fit_glmnet_enet
)
if (HAS_RF)  model_fns$RandomForest <- fit_random_forest
if (HAS_XGB) model_fns$XGBoost      <- fit_xgboost

# ---- 5. Cross‑validation loop -----------------------------------
folds <- createMultiFolds(train_data_full[[target_var]], k = 5, times = 5)

cv_results <- list()

for (fold_name in names(folds)) {
  train_idx <- folds[[fold_name]]
  test_idx  <- setdiff(seq_len(nrow(train_data_full)), train_idx)
  
  train_df <- train_data_full[train_idx, , drop = FALSE]
  test_df  <- train_data_full[test_idx, , drop = FALSE]
  
  for (model_id in names(model_fns)) {
    fit_res <- tryCatch(
      model_fns[[model_id]](train_df, test_df),
      error = function(e) {
        warning(paste("Model", model_id, "failed on", fold_name, ":", e$message))
        NULL
      }
    )
    
    if (is.null(fit_res)) next
    
    pred   <- fit_res$pred
    actual <- test_df[[target_var]]
    
    rmse_val <- sqrt(mean((pred - actual)^2))
    mae_val  <- mean(abs(pred - actual))
    gini_val <- gini_norm(actual, pred)
    ae_val   <- ae_ratio(actual, pred)
    
    cv_results[[length(cv_results) + 1]] <- data.frame(
      Fold      = fold_name,
      Model     = model_id,
      RMSE      = rmse_val,
      MAE       = mae_val,
      Gini_Norm = gini_val,
      AE_Ratio  = ae_val,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  }
}

cv_all <- do.call(rbind, cv_results)

# ---- 6. Aggregate metrics ---------------------------------------
abs_summary <- cv_all %>%
  group_by(Model) %>%
  summarise(
    RMSE      = mean(RMSE),
    MAE       = mean(MAE),
    Gini_Norm = mean(Gini_Norm),
    AE_Ratio  = mean(AE_Ratio),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

baseline_metrics <- abs_summary %>% filter(Model == "Gamma_GLM2")

rel_summary <- abs_summary %>%
  mutate(
    RMSE_Ratio      = RMSE / baseline_metrics$RMSE,
    MAE_Ratio       = MAE / baseline_metrics$MAE,
    Gini_Norm_Ratio = Gini_Norm / baseline_metrics$Gini_Norm,
    AE_Ratio_Ratio  = AE_Ratio / baseline_metrics$AE_Ratio
  )

# ---- 7. Winning model -------------------------------------------
best_model_id <- rel_summary %>%
  arrange(RMSE_Ratio) %>%
  slice(1) %>%
  pull(Model)

best_model_json <- list(
  best_model = best_model_id,
  metrics = as.list(rel_summary %>% filter(Model == best_model_id))
)

# ---- 8. JSON artifacts ------------------------------------------
write_json(abs_summary,    file.path(art_dir, "abs_metrics.json"),       pretty = TRUE, auto_unbox = TRUE)
write_json(rel_summary,    file.path(art_dir, "rel_metrics.json"),       pretty = TRUE, auto_unbox = TRUE)
write_json(list(
  RMSE      = "Root Mean Squared Error (lower is better)",
  MAE       = "Mean Absolute Error (lower is better)",
  Gini_Norm = "Normalized Gini (higher is better)",
  AE_Ratio  = "Actual-to-Expected Ratio (close to 1 is ideal)"
), file.path(art_dir, "metrics_definitions.json"), pretty = TRUE, auto_unbox = TRUE)
write_json(best_model_json, file.path(art_dir, "best_model.json"),        pretty = TRUE, auto_unbox = TRUE)
write_json(cv_all,          file.path(art_dir, "cv_fold_results.json"),   pretty = TRUE, auto_unbox = TRUE)

# ---- 9. PNG visualizations --------------------------------------
p_rmse <- ggplot(abs_summary, aes(x = reorder(Model, RMSE), y = RMSE, fill = Model)) +
  geom_col(show.legend = FALSE) + coord_flip() +
  labs(title = "Average Out-of-Sample RMSE by Model", x = "Model", y = "RMSE") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12)
ggsave(file.path(art_dir, "model_comparison.png"), p_rmse, width = 8, height = 5, dpi = 150)

p_ae <- ggplot(abs_summary, aes(x = reorder(Model, AE_Ratio), y = AE_Ratio)) +
  geom_point(size = 4, color = "steelblue") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 1.0, linetype = "dashed", color = "firebrick") +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(title = "Actual-to-Expected Ratio by Model", x = "Model", y = "AE Ratio") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12)
ggsave(file.path(art_dir, "ae_ratio_plot.png"), p_ae, width = 8, height = 5, dpi = 150)

p_gini <- ggplot(abs_summary, aes(x = reorder(Model, Gini_Norm), y = Gini_Norm, fill = Model)) +
  geom_col(show.legend = FALSE) + coord_flip() +
  labs(title = "Normalized Gini by Model", x = "Model", y = "Gini_Norm") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12)
ggsave(file.path(art_dir, "gini_comparison.png"), p_gini, width = 8, height = 5, dpi = 150)

--- FILE: bayes/T7/experiments/experiment_1.R ---

#!/usr/bin/env Rscript
# experiments/experiment_1.R
# Actuarial Severity Benchmarking Pipeline for French MTPL
# -------------------------------------------------
# Repeated 5-Fold CV (5 repeats) with 80/20 split per fold.
# Models: Gamma GLM2, Ridge, Elastic Net, Random Forest, XGBoost (optional).
# Artifacts saved to experiments/artifacts/ as JSON and PNG.

# ---- 0. Libraries ------------------------------------------------
core_pkgs <- c("data.table", "dplyr", "caret", "glm2", "glmnet", "splines")
opt_pkgs  <- c("randomForest", "xgboost", "ggplot2", "jsonlite")

for (p in core_pkgs) {
  if (!requireNamespace(p, quietly = TRUE)) {
    install.packages(p, repos = "https://cloud.r-project.org")
  }
  library(p, character.only = TRUE)
}

HAS_RF       <- FALSE
HAS_XGB      <- FALSE
HAS_GGPLOT2  <- FALSE
HAS_JSONLITE <- FALSE

for (p in opt_pkgs) {
  if (requireNamespace(p, quietly = TRUE)) {
    library(p, character.only = TRUE)
    if (p == "randomForest") HAS_RF       <- TRUE
    if (p == "xgboost")      HAS_XGB      <- TRUE
    if (p == "ggplot2")      HAS_GGPLOT2  <- TRUE
    if (p == "jsonlite")     HAS_JSONLITE <- TRUE
  } else {
    warning(paste("Optional package", p, "not available. Some models or artifacts will be skipped."))
  }
}

# ---- 1. Constants & Setup ----------------------------------------
set.seed(123)
target_var     <- "ClaimAmount"
cat_cols       <- c("Region", "Area", "VehBrand")
log_cols       <- c("VehPower", "Density", "BonusMalus")
spline_cols    <- c("DrivAge", "VehAge")
spline_df      <- 3
smooth_te      <- 10
art_dir        <- "experiments/artifacts"
dir.create(art_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# ---- 2. Load & Filter Data ---------------------------------------
freq <- fread("freMTPL2freq.csv")
sev  <- fread("freMTPL2sev.csv")
df   <- inner_join(freq, sev, by = "IDpol")

df_filtered <- df %>%
  group_by(IDpol) %>%
  filter(n() == 2) %>%
  ungroup()

sampled <- df_filtered %>%
  sample_n(min(500, nrow(df_filtered))) %>%
  as.data.frame()

sampled$IDpol <- NULL
sampled <- sampled %>% filter(!is.na(.data[[target_var]]))

# Ensure strictly positive target for Gamma GLM
sampled[[target_var]] <- pmax(sampled[[target_var]], 1e-6)

# ---- 3. Helper Functions -----------------------------------------

calc_loo_target_encode <- function(train, test, col, target, smooth) {
  global_mean <- mean(train[[target]], na.rm = TRUE)
  
  stats <- train %>%
    group_by(!!sym(col)) %>%
    summarise(
      cat_sum = sum(.data[[target]], na.rm = TRUE),
      cat_cnt = n(),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      cat_mean        = cat_sum / cat_cnt,
      smoothed_mean   = (cat_cnt * cat_mean + smooth * global_mean) / (cat_cnt + smooth)
    )
  
  train_enc <- train %>%
    left_join(stats, by = col) %>%
    mutate(
      loo_mean  = ifelse(cat_cnt > 1, (cat_sum - .data[[target]]) / (cat_cnt - 1), global_mean),
      loo_smooth = (cat_cnt * loo_mean + smooth * global_mean) / (cat_cnt + smooth)
    ) %>%
    pull(loo_smooth)
  
  test_enc <- test %>%
    left_join(stats, by = col) %>%
    mutate(
      test_smooth = ifelse(is.na(cat_cnt), global_mean,
                           (cat_cnt * cat_mean + smooth * global_mean) / (cat_cnt + smooth))
    ) %>%
    pull(test_smooth)
  
  list(train = train_enc, test = test_enc)
}

apply_feature_engineering <- function(train, test, target) {
  # --- LOO Target Encoding ---
  for (col in cat_cols) {
    if (col %in% names(train)) {
      enc <- calc_loo_target_encode(train, test, col, target, smooth_te)
      train[[col]] <- enc$train
      test[[col]]  <- enc$test
    }
  }
  
  # --- Log Transforms ---
  for (col in log_cols) {
    if (col %in% names(train)) {
      train[[col]] <- log(train[[col]] + 1)
      test[[col]]  <- log(test[[col]] + 1)
    }
  }
  
  # --- Natural Splines ---
  for (col in spline_cols) {
    if (col %in% names(train) && col %in% names(test)) {
      ok_train <- complete.cases(train[[col]])
      if (sum(ok_train) < spline_df + 1) next
      ns_obj <- tryCatch(ns(train[[col]][ok_train], df = spline_df), error = function(e) NULL)
      if (is.null(ns_obj)) next
      
      train_ns <- predict(ns_obj, train[[col]])
      test_ns  <- predict(ns_obj, test[[col]])
      cnames   <- paste0(col, "_ns", seq_len(ncol(train_ns)))
      colnames(train_ns) <- cnames
      colnames(test_ns)  <- cnames
      
      train[[col]] <- NULL
      test[[col]]  <- NULL
      train <- cbind(train, as.data.frame(train_ns))
      test  <- cbind(test, as.data.frame(test_ns))
    }
  }
  
  # --- Remaining factors -> integer codes ---
  rem_fac <- setdiff(names(train), target)
  rem_fac <- rem_fac[sapply(train[rem_fac], function(x) is.factor(x) || is.character(x))]
  for (col in rem_fac) {
    lev <- levels(factor(train[[col]]))
    train[[col]] <- as.integer(factor(train[[col]], levels = lev))
    test[[col]]  <- as.integer(factor(test[[col]], levels = lev))
    test[[col]][is.na(test[[col]])] <- 0
  }
  
  # --- Standardization ---
  pred_names <- setdiff(names(train), target)
  for (col in pred_names) {
    m <- mean(train[[col]], na.rm = TRUE)
    s <- sd(train[[col]], na.rm = TRUE)
    if (is.na(s) || s == 0) {
      train[[col]] <- 0
      test[[col]]  <- 0
    } else {
      train[[col]] <- (train[[col]] - m) / s
      test[[col]]  <- (test[[col]] - m) / s
    }
  }
  
  list(train = train, test = test)
}

normalized_gini <- function(actual, pred) {
  valid <- complete.cases(actual, pred)
  actual <- actual[valid]
  pred   <- pred[valid]
  n <- length(actual)
  if (n < 2 || sum(actual) == 0) return(NA_real_)
  
  gini_sorted <- function(a, ord) {
    y <- a[order(ord, decreasing = TRUE)]
    sum((2 * seq_along(y) - length(y) - 1) * y) / (length(y) * sum(y))
  }
  
  g_pred   <- gini_sorted(actual, pred)
  g_actual <- gini_sorted(actual, actual)
  if (g_actual == 0) return(NA_real_)
  g_pred / g_actual
}

calc_metrics <- function(actual, pred) {
  pred <- pmax(pred, 1e-6)
  rmse <- sqrt(mean((actual - pred)^2))
  mae  <- mean(abs(actual - pred))
  gini <- normalized_gini(actual, pred)
  ae   <- sum(actual) / sum(pred)
  c(RMSE = rmse, MAE = mae, Gini_Norm = gini, AE_Ratio = ae)
}

# ---- 4. Model Wrappers -------------------------------------------

fit_glm2 <- function(train_x, train_y, test_x) {
  df <- as.data.frame(train_x)
  df$ClaimAmount <- train_y
  
  const <- sapply(df, function(x) length(unique(x)) == 1)
  const["ClaimAmount"] <- FALSE
  if (any(const)) {
    df <- df[, !const, drop = FALSE]
  }
  
  pnames <- setdiff(names(df), "ClaimAmount")
  if (length(pnames) == 0) return(rep(mean(train_y), nrow(test_x)))
  
  test_df <- as.data.frame(test_x)[, pnames, drop = FALSE]
  
  preds <- tryCatch({
    form <- as.formula(paste("ClaimAmount ~", paste(pnames, collapse = " + ")))
    fit  <- glm2(form, data = df, family = Gamma(link = "log"), control = glm.control(maxit = 100))
    p    <- predict(fit, newdata = test_df, type = "response")
    ifelse(is.na(p) | p <= 0, mean(train_y), p)
  }, error = function(e) {
    message("GLM2 error: ", e$message)
    rep(mean(train_y), nrow(test_df))
  })
  preds
}

fit_ridge <- function(train_x, train_y, test_x) {
  x <- as.matrix(train_x)
  y <- train_y
  tryCatch({
    cvf <- cv.glmnet(x, y, family = "gaussian", alpha = 0, nfolds = 5)
    as.vector(predict(cvf, newx = as.matrix(test_x), s = "lambda.min"))
  }, error = function(e) rep(mean(train_y), nrow(test_x)))
}

fit_elnet <- function(train_x, train_y, test_x) {
  x <- as.matrix(train_x)
  y <- train_y
  tryCatch({
    cvf <- cv.glmnet(x, y, family = "gaussian", alpha = 0.5, nfolds = 5)
    as.vector(predict(cvf, newx = as.matrix(test_x), s = "lambda.min"))
  }, error = function(e) rep(mean(train_y), nrow(test_x)))
}

if (HAS_RF) {
  fit_rf <- function(train_x, train_y, test_x) {
    df <- as.data.frame(train_x)
    df$ClaimAmount <- train_y
    tryCatch({
      fit <- randomForest(ClaimAmount ~ ., data = df, ntree = 500)
      p <- predict(fit, newdata = as.data.frame(test_x))
      pmax(p, 1e-6)
    }, error = function(e) rep(mean(train_y), nrow(test_x)))
  }
}

if (HAS_XGB) {
  fit_xgb <- function(train_x, train_y, test_x) {
    dtrain <- xgb.DMatrix(data = as.matrix(train_x), label = train_y)
    dtest  <- xgb.DMatrix(data = as.matrix(test_x))
    tryCatch({
      fit <- xgb.train(
        params   = list(objective = "reg:squarederror", eta = 0.05,
                        max_depth = 4, subsample = 0.8, colsample_bytree = 0.8),
        data     = dtrain,
        nrounds  = 500,
        verbose  = 0,
        nthread  = 2
      )
      p <- predict(fit, newdata = dtest)
      pmax(p, 1e-6)
    }, error = function(e) rep(mean(train_y), nrow(test_x)))
  }
}

# ---- 5. CV Loop (Repeated 5-Fold, 5 repeats) ---------------------
n_total   <- nrow(sampled)
y_vec     <- sampled[[target_var]]
repeats   <- 5
k_folds   <- 5

seeds     <- sample.int(1e6, repeats)
fold_res  <- list()

for (r in seq_len(repeats)) {
  set.seed(seeds[r])
  flds <- createFolds(y_vec, k = k_folds, list = TRUE, returnTrain = FALSE)
  
  for (f in seq_len(k_folds)) {
    test_idx  <- flds[[f]]
    train_idx <- setdiff(seq_len(n_total), test_idx)
    
    train_raw <- sampled[train_idx, , drop = FALSE]
    test_raw  <- sampled[test_idx, , drop = FALSE]
    
    proc      <- apply_feature_engineering(train_raw, test_raw, target_var)
    train_proc <- proc$train
    test_proc  <- proc$test
    
    train_y <- train_proc[[target_var]]
    test_y  <- test_proc[[target_var]]
    train_x <- train_proc[, !names(train_proc) %in% target_var, drop = FALSE]
    test_x  <- test_proc[, !names(test_proc) %in% target_var, drop = FALSE]
    
    # Align columns
    all_cols <- union(names(train_x), names(test_x))
    for (col in setdiff(all_cols, names(train_x))) train_x[[col]] <- 0
    for (col in setdiff(all_cols, names(test_x))) test_x[[col]] <- 0
    train_x <- train_x[, all_cols, drop = FALSE]
    test_x  <- test_x[, all_cols, drop = FALSE]
    
    # Drop zero-variance predictors
    zv <- sapply(train_x, function(x) is.numeric(x) && (sd(x, na.rm = TRUE) == 0 || all(is.na(x))))
    if (any(zv)) {
      train_x <- train_x[, !zv, drop = FALSE]
      test_x  <- test_x[, names(train_x), drop = FALSE]
    }
    
    preds <- list(
      Gamma_GLM2 = fit_glm2(train_x, train_y, test_x),
      Ridge      = fit_ridge(train_x, train_y, test_x),
      ElasticNet = fit_elnet(train_x, train_y, test_x)
    )
    
    if (HAS_RF)  preds[["RandomForest"]] <- fit_rf(train_x, train_y, test_x)
    if (HAS_XGB) preds[["XGBoost"]]     <- fit_xgb(train_x, train_y, test_x)
    
    for (m in names(preds)) {
      met <- calc_metrics(test_y, preds[[m]])
      fold_res[[length(fold_res) + 1]] <- data.frame(
        Repeat = r,
        Fold   = f,
        Model  = m,
        t(met),
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      )
    }
  }
}

results_df <- bind_rows(fold_res)

# ---- 6. Summaries ------------------------------------------------
abs_summary <- results_df %>%
  group_by(Model) %>%
  summarise(
    RMSE      = mean(RMSE),
    MAE       = mean(MAE),
    Gini_Norm = mean(Gini_Norm),
    AE_Ratio  = mean(AE_Ratio),
    .groups   = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(RMSE)

glm2_ref <- abs_summary %>% filter(Model == "Gamma_GLM2")

rel_summary <- abs_summary %>%
  mutate(
    RMSE_Ratio       = RMSE / glm2_ref$RMSE,
    MAE_Ratio        = MAE / glm2_ref$MAE,
    Gini_Norm_Ratio  = Gini_Norm / glm2_ref$Gini_Norm,
    AE_Ratio_Ratio   = AE_Ratio / glm2_ref$AE_Ratio
  ) %>%
  select(Model, RMSE_Ratio, MAE_Ratio, Gini_Norm_Ratio, AE_Ratio, AE_Ratio_Ratio) %>%
  arrange(RMSE_Ratio)

best_model <- rel_summary %>% slice(1)

cat("\n=== Absolute Metrics ===\n")
print(as.data.frame(abs_summary))
cat("\n=== Relative Metrics (vs Gamma GLM2) ===\n")
print(as.data.frame(rel_summary))
cat("\n=== Best Model ===\n")
print(as.data.frame(best_model))

# ---- 7. Save JSON Artifacts --------------------------------------
if (HAS_JSONLITE) {
  write_json(abs_summary,  path = file.path(art_dir, "abs_metrics.json"), pretty = TRUE, auto_unbox = TRUE)
  write_json(rel_summary,  path = file.path(art_dir, "rel_metrics.json"), pretty = TRUE, auto_unbox = TRUE)
  write_json(best_model,   path = file.path(art_dir, "best_model.json"), pretty = TRUE, auto_unbox = TRUE)
  write_json(results_df,   path = file.path(art_dir, "cv_fold_results.json"), pretty = TRUE, auto_unbox = TRUE)
  
  defs <- list(
    RMSE            = list(Definition = "Root Mean Squared Error",
                           Interpretation = "Error scale in original currency units; lower is better."),

                           Interpretation = "Median-like prediction error robust to large outliers; lower is better."),

                           Interpretation = "Ranking power scaled 0–1; 1.0 implies perfect ordering of observed claim amounts. Higher is better."),

    AE_Ratio_Ratio  = list(Definition = "AE Ratio relative to GLM2 baseline",

  )
  write_json(defs, path = file.path(art_dir, "metrics_definitions.json"), pretty = TRUE, auto_unbox = TRUE)

} else {

}

--- FILE: bayes/T7/experiments/research_log.md ---

# Research Log: Actuarial Severity Benchmarking Pipeline

## Objective
Implement an actuarial severity benchmarking pipeline in R for the French MTPL datasets (`freMTPL2freq.csv`, `freMTPL2sev.csv`).

## Tasks
1. **Data Preparation**: Join on `IDpol`, filter for exactly 2 claims, and sample 500 rows.
2. **Feature Engineering**: Apply log‑transforms, smoothed LOO target encoding, natural splines, and standardization.
3. **Benchmarking Loop**: Repeated 5‑fold cross‑validation with 5 repeats, using a 20 %/80 % train‑test split.
4. **Modeling Suite**: Compare baseline Gamma GLM (glm2) against Ridge, Elastic Net, and additional models.
5. **Reporting**: Generate `Actuarial_Severity_Report.pdf` with methodology, parameters, tables, and model selection discussion.

## Hypothesis

Shrinkage estimators (Ridge, Elastic Net) and flexible non-parametric learners (Random Forest, XGBoost) are expected to outperform the baseline Gamma GLM2 on the French MTPL severity task. Insurance claim amounts are highly right-skewed and contain extreme, heterogeneous noise; regularization via shrinkage reduces variance introduced by tail events, while LOO target encoding and natural splines capture latent geographical and age effects without overfitting. We therefore hypothesize that the lowest RMSE_Ratio will be achieved by a shrinkage estimator due to its superior bias-variance trade-off under skewed noise.

## Expected Artifacts

Running `experiments/experiment_1.R` will produce the following artifacts in `experiments/artifacts/`:

| Artifact | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `abs_metrics.json` | JSON | **Table 1** – Average absolute out-of-sample performance metrics per model (RMSE, MAE, Gini_Norm, AE_Ratio). |
| `rel_metrics.json` | JSON | **Table 2** – Average out-of-sample relative ratios vs Gamma GLM2 (RMSE_Ratio, MAE_Ratio, Gini_Norm_Ratio, AE_Ratio_Ratio). |
| `metrics_definitions.json` | JSON | Column definitions and actuarial interpretations for report inclusion. |
| `best_model.json` | JSON | The winning model identifier and its relative metrics. |
| `cv_fold_results.json` | JSON | Granular per-fold, per-repeat results for auditability. |
| `model_comparison.png` | PNG | Horizontal bar chart of out-of-sample RMSE by model. |
| `ae_ratio_plot.png` | PNG | Dot plot of AE_Ratio by model with unbiasedness reference line at 1.0. |
| `gini_comparison.png` | PNG | Horizontal bar chart of normalized Gini by model. |

#!/usr/bin/env Rscript
# experiments/sidecar_task.R
# Sidecar: Rebuild summary tables & plots from Experiment 1 raw fold results.
# No model retraining performed.

library(jsonlite)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

art_dir <- "experiments/artifacts"
cv_path <- file.path(art_dir, "cv_fold_results.json")

if (!file.exists(cv_path)) {
  stop("Experiment 1 artifact 'cv_fold_results.json' not found at: ", cv_path)
}

# 1. Load raw per-fold, per-repeat results produced by experiment_1.R
results_df <- fromJSON(cv_path)

# Ensure data-frame form (handles nested JSON arrays)
if (!is.data.frame(results_df)) {
  results_df <- bind_rows(results_df)
}

# 2. Compute absolute out-of-sample metrics per model
abs_summary <- results_df %>%
  group_by(Model) %>%
  summarise(
    RMSE      = mean(RMSE, na.rm = TRUE),
    MAE       = mean(MAE, na.rm = TRUE),
    Gini_Norm = mean(Gini_Norm, na.rm = TRUE),
    AE_Ratio  = mean(AE_Ratio, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups   = "drop"
  )

# 3. Compute relative metrics vs Gamma GLM2 baseline
baseline <- abs_summary %>% filter(Model == "Gamma_GLM2")
if (nrow(baseline) == 0) {
  stop("Baseline 'Gamma_GLM2' not found in results.")
}

rel_summary <- abs_summary %>%
  mutate(
    RMSE_Ratio      = RMSE / baseline$RMSE,
    MAE_Ratio       = MAE / baseline$MAE,
    Gini_Norm_Ratio = Gini_Norm / baseline$Gini_Norm,
    AE_Ratio_Ratio  = AE_Ratio / baseline$AE_Ratio
  ) %>%
  select(Model, RMSE_Ratio, MAE_Ratio, Gini_Norm_Ratio, AE_Ratio_Ratio)

# 4. Identify winning model (lowest average RMSE)
best_row <- abs_summary %>% slice_min(RMSE, n = 1)
best_rel <- rel_summary %>% filter(Model == best_row$Model)
best_json <- list(
  best_model = best_row$Model,
  metrics    = as.list(best_rel %>% select(-Model))
)

# 5. Write JSON artifacts required by report.Rmd
write_json(abs_summary, file.path(art_dir, "abs_metrics.json"),
           pretty = TRUE, auto_unbox = TRUE)
write_json(rel_summary, file.path(art_dir, "rel_metrics.json"),
           pretty = TRUE, auto_unbox = TRUE)
write_json(best_json, file.path(art_dir, "best_model.json"),
           pretty = TRUE, auto_unbox = TRUE)

# 6. Regenerate PNG visualizations
p_rmse <- ggplot(abs_summary, aes(x = reorder(Model, RMSE), y = RMSE, fill = Model)) +
  geom_col(show.legend = FALSE) +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(title = "Average Out-of-Sample RMSE by Model", x = "Model", y = "RMSE") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12)

p_ae <- ggplot(abs_summary, aes(x = reorder(Model, AE_Ratio), y = AE_Ratio)) +
  geom_point(size = 4, color = "steelblue") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 1.0, linetype = "dashed", color = "firebrick") +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(title = "Actual-to-Expected Ratio by Model", x = "Model", y = "AE Ratio") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12)

p_gini <- ggplot(abs_summary, aes(x = reorder(Model, Gini_Norm), y = Gini_Norm, fill = Model)) +
  geom_col(show.legend = FALSE) +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(title = "Normalized Gini by Model", x = "Model", y = "Gini_Norm") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12)

ggsave(file.path(art_dir, "model_comparison.png"), p_rmse, width = 8, height = 5, dpi = 150)
ggsave(file.path(art_dir, "ae_ratio_plot.png"),   p_ae,   width = 8, height = 5, dpi = 150)
ggsave(file.path(art_dir, "gini_comparison.png"), p_gini, width = 8, height = 5, dpi = 150)

cat("Sidecar complete. Artifacts updated in", normalizePath(art_dir), "\n")

--- FILE: bayes/checklist/glm_test.R ---

# Load the claims data
claims <- read.csv("data.csv")

# Fit Poisson GLM for claim frequency
# log(exposure) offset converts the count model into a rate/frequency model
glm_freq <- glm(
  claim_count ~ age + zone + offset(log(exposure)),
  family = poisson(link = "log"),
  data = claims
)

# Full model summary (coefficients, standard errors, deviance)
summary(glm_freq)

# Exponentiate coefficients to obtain incident-rate ratios (multiplicative effects)
cat("\n--- Incident Rate Ratios ---\n")
print(exp(coef(glm_freq)))

# Compare observed vs predicted frequencies
claims$observed_freq  <- claims$claim_count / claims$exposure
claims$predicted_freq <- predict(glm_freq, type = "response") / claims$exposure

cat("\n--- Observed vs Predicted Frequencies ---\n")
print(data.frame(
  policy_id      = claims$policy_id,
  zone           = claims$zone,
  age            = claims$age,
  observed_freq  = round(claims$observed_freq, 3),
  predicted_freq = round(claims$predicted_freq, 3)
))

--- FILE: utils/data_loader.py ---

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np


def clean_price(series):
    return pd.to_numeric(series.astype(str).str.replace(r'[^\d.]', '', regex=True), errors='coerce')


def clean_pct(series):
    return pd.to_numeric(series.astype(str).str.replace('%', '', regex=True), errors='coerce')


def clean_count(series):
    return pd.to_numeric(series.astype(str).str.replace(',', '', regex=True), errors='coerce')


def load_and_clean(file_path):
    df = pd.read_csv(file_path)
    
    df['discounted_price_num'] = clean_price(df['discounted_price'])
    df['actual_price_num'] = clean_price(df['actual_price'])
    df['discount_pct_num'] = clean_pct(df['discount_percentage'])
    df['rating_count_num'] = clean_count(df['rating_count'])
    df['rating_num'] = pd.to_numeric(df['rating'], errors='coerce')
    df['revenue_proxy'] = df['discounted_price_num'] * df['rating_count_num']
    
    date_candidates = ['date', 'Date', 'timestamp', 'Timestamp', 'sales_date']
    for col in date_candidates:
        if col in df.columns:
            df['parsed_date'] = pd.to_datetime(df[col], errors='coerce')
            break
    else:
        df['parsed_date'] = pd.NaT
    
    if 'country' not in df.columns:
        df['country'] = 'Unknown'
    if 'latitude' not in df.columns:
        df['latitude'] = np.nan
    if 'longitude' not in df.columns:
        df['longitude'] = np.nan
    
    return df

--- FILE: utils/ui_helpers.py ---

import streamlit as st
import plotly.express as px
import pandas as pd


def render_sidebar_filters(df):
    st.sidebar.header("Options")
    cats = st.sidebar.multiselect("Category", options=df['category'].unique(), default=list(df['category'].unique()[:5]))
    rat_min, rat_max = st.sidebar.slider("Rating", 0.0, 5.0, (0.0, 5.0), 0.1)
    p_min = float(df['discounted_price_num'].min())
    p_max = float(df['discounted_price_num'].max())
    pri_min, pri_max = st.sidebar.slider("Discounted Price", p_min, p_max, (p_min, p_max))
    return cats, rat_min, rat_max, pri_min, pri_max


def filter_data(df, cats, rat_min, rat_max, pri_min, pri_max):
    return df[
        df['category'].isin(cats) &
        (df['rating_num'] >= rat_min) &
        (df['rating_num'] <= rat_max) &
        (df['discounted_price_num'] >= pri_min) &
        (df['discounted_price_num'] <= pri_max)
    ].copy()


def render_metrics(data):
    k1, k2, k3, k4, k5, k6 = st.columns(6)
    k1.metric("Products", len(data))
    k2.metric("Avg Rating", round(data['rating_num'].mean(), 2) if len(data) > 0 else 0.0)
    k3.metric("Avg Discount %", round(data['discount_pct_num'].mean(), 2) if len(data) > 0 else 0.0)
    k4.metric("Categories", data['category'].nunique())
    k5.metric("Total Rev Proxy", f"{data['revenue_proxy'].sum():,.0f}" if len(data) > 0 and 'revenue_proxy' in data.columns else "0")
    k6.metric("Sales Volume Proxy", f"{data['rating_count_num'].sum():,.0f}" if len(data) > 0 and 'rating_count_num' in data.columns else "0")


def render_top_categories(data):
    top_cats = data['category'].value_counts().head(10).reset_index()
    top_cats.columns = ['category', 'count']
    fig = px.bar(top_cats, x='category', y='count', title="Top 10 Categories")
    return fig


def render_revenue_chart(data):
    if 'parsed_date' in data.columns and pd.api.types.is_datetime64_any_dtype(data['parsed_date']) and data['parsed_date'].notna().any():
        ts = data.groupby(data['parsed_date'].dt.to_period('M').astype(str))['revenue_proxy'].sum().reset_index()
        ts.columns = ['month', 'revenue']
        fig = px.line(ts, x='month', y='revenue', title="Revenue Trend Over Time")
    else:
        cat_rev = data.groupby('category')['revenue_proxy'].sum().reset_index().sort_values('revenue_proxy', ascending=False).head(10)
        fig = px.bar(cat_rev, x='category', y='revenue_proxy', title="Revenue by Category (Top 10)")
    return fig


def render_rating_distribution(data):
    fig = px.histogram(data, x='rating_num', nbins=10, title="Rating Distribution")
    return fig


def render_price_scatter(data):
    fig = px.scatter(data, x='actual_price_num', y='discounted_price_num', color='rating_num', title="Actual vs Discounted Price", opacity=0.6)
    return fig


def render_correlation_heatmap(data):
    nums = ['actual_price_num', 'discounted_price_num', 'discount_pct_num', 'rating_num', 'rating_count_num']
    available_nums = [n for n in nums if n in data.columns]
    fig = px.imshow(data[available_nums].corr(), text_auto=True, aspect="auto", title="Correlation Matrix")
    return fig


def render_geo_distribution(data):
    map_data = data.dropna(subset=['latitude', 'longitude'])
    if not map_data.empty:
        fig = px.scatter_geo(map_data, lat='latitude', lon='longitude', color='rating_num', title="Geographic Distribution")
    else:
        geo = data['country'].value_counts().head(10).reset_index()
        geo.columns = ['country', 'count']
        fig = px.bar(geo, x='country', y='count', title="Geographic Distribution (Top Countries)")
    return fig


def render_data_preview(data):
    st.subheader("Data Preview")
    st.dataframe(data)


def render_footer():
    st.sidebar.markdown("---")
    st.sidebar.caption("Data Source: Amazon Dataset")
    if st.sidebar.button("Refresh"):
        st.rerun()
    st.markdown("---")
    st.caption("Data Source: Amazon Dataset | Built with Streamlit")

--- FILE: webtest14/Blood/src/utils/auth.ts ---

import { signToken, verifyToken } from './jwt'

const TOKEN_KEY = 'blood_bank_auth_token'

export interface AuthUser {
  userId: string
  email: string
  role: 'admin' | 'patient'
  name: string
}

const mockUsers = new Map<string, { password: string; name: string; role: 'admin' | 'patient' }>([
  ['admin@bloodbank.com', { password: 'admin123', name: 'System Administrator', role: 'admin' }],
  ['patient@bloodbank.com', { password: 'patient123', name: 'Alex Johnson', role: 'patient' }],
])

export function login(email: string, password: string): { token: string; user: AuthUser } {
  const normalizedEmail = email.trim().toLowerCase()
  const record = mockUsers.get(normalizedEmail)
  if (!record || record.password !== password) {
    throw new Error('Invalid email or password')
  }
  const user: AuthUser = {
    userId: normalizedEmail.replace(/[@.]/g, '-'),
    email: normalizedEmail,
    role: record.role,
    name: record.name,
  }
  const token = signToken({ ...user })
  localStorage.setItem(TOKEN_KEY, token)
  return { token, user }
}

export function signUp(email: string, password: string, name: string, role: 'admin' | 'patient' = 'patient'): { token: string; user: AuthUser } {
  const normalizedEmail = email.trim().toLowerCase()
  if (mockUsers.has(normalizedEmail)) {
    throw new Error('Account already exists')
  }
  mockUsers.set(normalizedEmail, { password, name, role })
  const user: AuthUser = {
    userId: normalizedEmail.replace(/[@.]/g, '-'),
    email: normalizedEmail,
    role,
    name,
  }
  const token = signToken({ ...user })
  localStorage.setItem(TOKEN_KEY, token)
  return { token, user }
}

export function logout(): void {
  localStorage.removeItem(TOKEN_KEY)
}

export function getToken(): string | null {
  return localStorage.getItem(TOKEN_KEY)
}

export function isAuthenticated(): boolean {
  const token = getToken()
  if (!token) return false
  return verifyToken(token) !== null
}

export function getCurrentUser(): AuthUser | null {
  const token = getToken()
  if (!token) return null
  const payload = verifyToken(token)
  if (!payload) return null
  return payload as unknown as AuthUser
}

export function getUserRole(): 'admin' | 'patient' | null {
  const user = getCurrentUser()
  return user?.role ?? null
}

export function hasRole(role: 'admin' | 'patient'): boolean {
  return getUserRole() === role
}

--- FILE: webtest14/Blood/src/utils/csvParser.ts ---

import Papa from 'papaparse'
import type { BloodInventoryItem } from '../api/mockApi'

export type InventoryCsvRow = Omit<BloodInventoryItem, 'id'>

export function parseInventoryCsv(file: File): Promise<InventoryCsvRow[]> {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    Papa.parse<Record<string, string>>(file, {
      header: true,
      skipEmptyLines: true,
      complete: (results) => {
        const items: InventoryCsvRow[] = results.data.map((row) => ({
          hospital: String(row.hospital || '').trim(),
          region: String(row.region || '').trim(),
          bloodType: String(row.bloodType || '').trim(),
          units: Number(row.units) || 0,
          lastUpdated: row.lastUpdated
            ? new Date(row.lastUpdated).toISOString()
            : new Date().toISOString(),
        }))
        resolve(items)
      },
      error: (error) => reject(error),
    })
  })
}

export function inventoryToCsv(items: BloodInventoryItem[]): string {
  return Papa.unparse(items)
}

export function downloadCsv(filename: string, csvContent: string): void {
  const blob = new Blob([csvContent], { type: 'text/csv;charset=utf-8;' })
  const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob)
  const link = document.createElement('a')
  link.href = url
  link.download = filename
  link.style.visibility = 'hidden'
  document.body.appendChild(link)
  link.click()
  document.body.removeChild(link)
  URL.revokeObjectURL(url)
}

--- FILE: webtest14/Blood/src/utils/jwt.ts ---

const SECRET = 'blood-bank-mock-secret-2026'

const toBase64Url = (input: string): string =>
  btoa(input).replace(/\+/g, '-').replace(/\//g, '_').replace(/=+$/, '')

const fromBase64Url = (input: string): string => {
  const pad = '='.repeat((4 - (input.length % 4)) % 4)
  return atob(input.replace(/-/g, '+').replace(/_/g, '/') + pad)
}

export function signToken(payload: Record<string, unknown>): string {
  const header = toBase64Url(JSON.stringify({ alg: 'HS256', typ: 'JWT' }))
  const body = toBase64Url(JSON.stringify(payload))
  const signature = toBase64Url(SECRET + header + '.' + body)
  return `${header}.${body}.${signature}`
}

export function verifyToken(token: string): Record<string, unknown> | null {
  try {
    const [header, body, signature] = token.split('.')
    if (!header || !body || !signature) return null
    const expected = toBase64Url(SECRET + header + '.' + body)
    if (signature !== expected) return null
    return JSON.parse(fromBase64Url(body))
  } catch {
    return null
  }
}

import { useEffect } from 'react'
import type { ReactNode } from 'react'
import { motion, AnimatePresence } from 'framer-motion'
import { X } from 'lucide-react'
import { fadeUp } from '../../animations'
import { cn } from '../core/utils'

interface AnimatedDialogProps {
  isOpen: boolean
  onClose: () => void
  title?: string
  children: ReactNode
  className?: string
}

const backdropVariants = {
  hidden: { opacity: 0 },
  visible: { opacity: 1, transition: { duration: 0.35, ease: 'easeOut' as const } },
  exit: { opacity: 0, transition: { duration: 0.25, ease: 'easeOut' as const } },
}

export default function AnimatedDialog({
  isOpen,
  onClose,
  title,
  children,
  className,
}: AnimatedDialogProps): ReactNode {
  useEffect(() => {
    if (isOpen) {
      document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden'
    } else {
      document.body.style.overflow = ''
    }
    return () => {
      document.body.style.overflow = ''
    }
  }, [isOpen])

  return (
    <AnimatePresence>
      {isOpen && (
        <div
          className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4 md:p-6"
          role="dialog"
          aria-modal="true"
        >
          <motion.div
            className="absolute inset-0 bg-black/20 backdrop-blur-sm"
            variants={backdropVariants}
            initial="hidden"
            animate="visible"
            exit="exit"
            onClick={onClose}
          />
          <motion.div
            className={cn(
              'relative w-full max-w-lg rounded-xl border border-[var(--color-border)] bg-[var(--color-surface)] p-6 md:p-8',
              className
            )}
            variants={fadeUp}
            initial="hidden"
            animate="visible"
            exit="hidden"
          >
            {title && (
              <div className="mb-6 flex items-center justify-between gap-4">
                <h2
                  className="text-xl font-light tracking-tight text-[var(--color-text)]"
                  style={{ fontFamily: 'var(--font-heading)' }}
                >
                  {title}
                </h2>
                <button
                  onClick={onClose}
                  className="inline-flex h-8 w-8 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full border border-[var(--color-border)] text-[var(--color-text)] transition-colors hover:border-[var(--color-primary)] hover:text-[var(--color-primary)]"
                  aria-label="Close dialog"
                >
                  <X className="h-4 w-4" />
                </button>
              </div>
            )}
            {!title && (
              <button
                onClick={onClose}
                className="absolute right-4 top-4 inline-flex h-8 w-8 items-center justify-center rounded-full border border-[var(--color-border)] text-[var(--color-text)] transition-colors hover:border-[var(--color-primary)] hover:text-[var(--color-primary)]"
                aria-label="Close dialog"
              >
                <X className="h-4 w-4" />
              </button>
            )}
            <div className="text-sm font-light leading-relaxed text-[var(--color-text)]/80">
              {children}
            </div>
          </motion.div>
        </div>
      )}
    </AnimatePresence>
  )
}

import type { ReactNode } from 'react'
import { Link } from 'react-router-dom'
import { motion } from 'framer-motion'
import { cn } from '../core/utils'

interface AnimatedLinkProps {
  to: string
  children: ReactNode
  className?: string
}

const containerVariants = {
  rest: {},
  hover: {},
}

const labelVariants = {
  rest: { y: 0 },
  hover: { y: -1, transition: { duration: 0.3, ease: 'easeOut' as const } },
}

const underlineVariants = {
  rest: { scaleX: 0, originX: 0 },
  hover: { scaleX: 1, transition: { duration: 0.35, ease: 'easeOut' as const } },
}

export default function AnimatedLink({ to, children, className }: AnimatedLinkProps) {
  return (
    <motion.span
      className={cn('relative inline-block', className)}
      variants={containerVariants}
      initial="rest"
      whileHover="hover"
      animate="rest"
    >
      <Link to={to} className="block font-light tracking-wide">
        <motion.span className="block" variants={labelVariants}>
          {children}
        </motion.span>
      </Link>
      <motion.span
        className="absolute bottom-0 left-0 h-[1px] w-full origin-left bg-[var(--color-primary)]"
        variants={underlineVariants}
      />
    </motion.span>
  )
}

--- FILE: webtest14/Blood/src/components/ui/FloatingHeader.tsx ---

import { useState, useEffect } from 'react'
import type { ReactNode } from 'react'
import { Link, useLocation } from 'react-router-dom'
import { motion, AnimatePresence } from 'framer-motion'
import { Menu, X } from 'lucide-react'
import { cn } from '../core/utils'

interface FloatingHeaderProps {
  variant?: 'centered' | 'default'
  brandName: string
  logo?: ReactNode
  links?: { label: string; href: string }[]
  actions?: ReactNode
  className?: string
}

export default function FloatingHeader({
  variant = 'default',
  brandName,
  logo,
  links,
  actions,
  className,
}: FloatingHeaderProps): ReactNode {
  const location = useLocation()
  const [scrolled, setScrolled] = useState(false)
  const [mobileOpen, setMobileOpen] = useState(false)

  useEffect(() => {
    const onScroll = () => setScrolled(window.scrollY > 8)
    window.addEventListener('scroll', onScroll, { passive: true })
    return () => window.removeEventListener('scroll', onScroll)
  }, [])

  useEffect(() => {
    setMobileOpen(false)
  }, [location.pathname])

  return (
    <motion.header
      initial={{ opacity: 0, y: -8 }}
      animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
      transition={{ duration: 0.65, ease: 'easeOut' }}
      className={cn(
        'sticky top-0 z-50 transition-all duration-300',
        scrolled ? 'py-3' : 'py-5',
        className
      )}
    >
      <div
        className={cn(
          'mx-auto flex items-center justify-between gap-4 border px-6 py-3 transition-all duration-300',
          variant === 'centered' ? 'max-w-7xl' : '',
          scrolled
            ? 'rounded-xl border-[var(--color-border)] bg-[var(--color-surface)]/80 shadow-sm backdrop-blur-md'
            : 'rounded-none border-transparent bg-transparent'
        )}
      >
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
          {logo && (
            <span className="inline-flex items-center justify-center text-[var(--color-primary)]">
              {logo}
            </span>
          )}
          <Link
            to="/home"
            className="text-lg font-light tracking-tight text-[var(--color-text)]"
            style={{ fontFamily: 'var(--font-heading)' }}
          >
            {brandName}
          </Link>
        </div>

        {links && links.length > 0 && (
          <nav className="hidden md:flex items-center gap-6">
            {links.map((link) => (
              <Link
                key={link.href}
                to={link.href}
                className={cn(
                  'relative text-sm font-light tracking-wide transition-colors',
                  location.pathname === link.href
                    ? 'text-[var(--color-primary)]'
                    : 'text-[var(--color-text)]/70 hover:text-[var(--color-text)]'
                )}
              >
                {link.label}
                {location.pathname === link.href && (
                  <motion.span
                    layoutId="active-nav-indicator"
                    className="absolute -bottom-1 left-0 right-0 h-px bg-[var(--color-primary)]"
                  />
                )}
              </Link>
            ))}
          </nav>
        )}

        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
          {actions}

          {links && links.length > 0 && (
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setMobileOpen((prev) => !prev)}
              className="inline-flex h-9 w-9 items-center justify-center rounded-lg border border-[var(--color-border)] text-[var(--color-text)] transition-colors hover:border-[var(--color-primary)] hover:text-[var(--color-primary)] md:hidden"
              aria-label="Toggle menu"
            >
              {mobileOpen ? (
                <X className="h-4 w-4" />
              ) : (
                <Menu className="h-4 w-4" />
              )}
            </button>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>

      <AnimatePresence>
        {mobileOpen && links && links.length > 0 && (
          <motion.div
            initial={{ opacity: 0, height: 0 }}
            animate={{ opacity: 1, height: 'auto' }}
            exit={{ opacity: 0, height: 0 }}
            transition={{ duration: 0.3, ease: 'easeOut' }}
            className={cn(
              'overflow-hidden border-x border-b border-[var(--color-border)] bg-[var(--color-surface)]/95 backdrop-blur-md md:hidden',
              variant === 'centered' ? 'mx-auto max-w-7xl rounded-b-xl' : ''
            )}
          >
            <nav className="flex flex-col gap-2 px-6 py-4">
              {links.map((link) => (
                <Link
                  key={link.href}
                  to={link.href}
                  className={cn(
                    'py-2 text-sm font-light tracking-wide transition-colors',
                    location.pathname === link.href
                      ? 'text-[var(--color-primary)]'
                      : 'text-[var(--color-text)]/70 hover:text-[var(--color-text)]'
                  )}
                >
                  {link.label}
                </Link>
              ))}
            </nav>
          </motion.div>
        )}
      </AnimatePresence>
    </motion.header>
  )
}

--- FILE: webtest14/Blood/src/components/ui/TopBanner.tsx ---

import { useState, useCallback } from 'react'
import type { ReactNode } from 'react'
import { motion, AnimatePresence } from 'framer-motion'
import { X } from 'lucide-react'
import { cn } from '../core/utils'

interface TopBannerProps {
  children: ReactNode
  variant?: 'default' | 'primary'
  dismissible?: boolean
  onDismiss?: () => void
  className?: string
}

export default function TopBanner({
  children,
  variant = 'default',
  dismissible = false,
  onDismiss,
  className,
}: TopBannerProps) {
  const [dismissed, setDismissed] = useState(false)

  const handleDismiss = useCallback(() => {
    setDismissed(true)
    onDismiss?.()
  }, [onDismiss])

  if (dismissed) {
    return null
  }

  return (
    <AnimatePresence>
      {!dismissed && (
        <motion.div
          initial={{ opacity: 0, y: -8 }}
          animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
          exit={{ opacity: 0, y: -8 }}
          transition={{ duration: 0.65, ease: 'easeOut' }}
          className={cn(
            'relative border-b px-6 py-3 text-sm font-light tracking-wide',
            variant === 'primary'
              ? 'border-[var(--color-border)] bg-[#099296]/5 text-[#099296]'
              : 'border-[var(--color-border)] bg-[var(--color-muted)] text-[var(--color-text)]',
            className
          )}
        >
          <div className="mx-auto flex max-w-7xl items-center justify-between gap-4">
            <div className="flex-1 text-center">{children}</div>
            {dismissible && (
              <button
                onClick={handleDismiss}
                className="inline-flex shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-md p-1 text-current transition-opacity hover:opacity-70"
                aria-label="Dismiss banner"
              >
                <X className="h-4 w-4" />
              </button>
            )}
          </div>
        </motion.div>
      )}
    </AnimatePresence>
  )
}

--- FILE: webtest14/Blood/src/components/ui/navigation/FloatingHeader.tsx ---

import { useState } from 'react'
import type { ReactNode } from 'react'
import { Link, useLocation } from 'react-router-dom'
import { motion, AnimatePresence } from 'framer-motion'
import { Menu, X } from 'lucide-react'
import { cn } from '../../core/utils'
import { stagger, fadeDown } from '../../../animations'

interface FloatingHeaderProps {
  variant?: string
  brandName?: string
  logo?: ReactNode
  links?: Array<{ label: string; href: string }>
  actions?: ReactNode
  className?: string
}

export default function FloatingHeader({
  variant = 'default',
  brandName,
  logo,
  links = [],
  actions,
  className,
}: FloatingHeaderProps): ReactNode {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false)
  const location = useLocation()

  return (
    <motion.header
      className={cn(
        'fixed left-0 right-0 top-0 z-50 border-b border-[var(--color-border)] bg-[var(--color-surface)]/80 backdrop-blur-md',
        className
      )}
      variants={stagger}
      initial="hidden"
      animate="visible"
    >
      <div className="relative mx-auto flex h-16 max-w-7xl items-center justify-between px-6 md:px-8">
        <motion.div variants={fadeDown} className="flex items-center gap-3">
          {logo && (
            <span className="inline-flex items-center justify-center text-[var(--color-primary)]">
              {logo}
            </span>
          )}
          {brandName && (
            <Link
              to="/"
              className="text-lg font-light tracking-tight text-[var(--color-text)]"
              style={{ fontFamily: 'var(--font-heading)' }}
            >
              {brandName}
            </Link>
          )}
        </motion.div>

        {variant === 'centered' ? (
          <motion.nav
            variants={fadeDown}
            className="absolute left-1/2 hidden -translate-x-1/2 items-center gap-8 md:flex"
          >
            {links.map((link) => (
              <Link
                key={link.href}
                to={link.href}
                className={cn(
                  'text-sm font-light tracking-wide transition-colors hover:text-[var(--color-primary)]',
                  location.pathname === link.href
                    ? 'text-[var(--color-primary)]'
                    : 'text-[var(--color-text)]'
                )}
              >
                {link.label}
              </Link>
            ))}
          </motion.nav>
        ) : (
          links.length > 0 && (
            <motion.nav variants={fadeDown} className="hidden items-center gap-8 md:flex">
              {links.map((link) => (
                <Link
                  key={link.href}
                  to={link.href}
                  className={cn(
                    'text-sm font-light tracking-wide transition-colors hover:text-[var(--color-primary)]',
                    location.pathname === link.href
                      ? 'text-[var(--color-primary)]'
                      : 'text-[var(--color-text)]'
                  )}
                >
                  {link.label}
                </Link>
              ))}
            </motion.nav>
          )
        )}

        <motion.div variants={fadeDown} className="hidden items-center gap-4 md:flex">
          {actions}
        </motion.div>

        <motion.button
          variants={fadeDown}
          className="inline-flex h-9 w-9 items-center justify-center rounded-lg border border-[var(--color-border)] text-[var(--color-text)] transition-colors hover:border-[var(--color-primary)] hover:text-[var(--color-primary)] md:hidden"
          onClick={() => setOpen(!open)}
          aria-label="Toggle menu"
        >
          {open ? <X className="h-4 w-4" /> : <Menu className="h-4 w-4" />}
        </motion.button>
      </div>

      <AnimatePresence>
        {open && (
          <motion.div
            initial={{ opacity: 0, height: 0 }}
            animate={{ opacity: 1, height: 'auto' }}
            exit={{ opacity: 0, height: 0 }}
            transition={{ duration: 0.35, ease: 'easeOut' }}
            className="overflow-hidden border-t border-[var(--color-border)] bg-[var(--color-surface)]/95 backdrop-blur-md md:hidden"
          >
            <nav className="flex flex-col gap-4 px-6 py-6">
              {links.map((link) => (
                <Link
                  key={link.href}
                  to={link.href}
                  onClick={() => setOpen(false)}
                  className={cn(
                    'text-base font-light tracking-wide transition-colors hover:text-[var(--color-primary)]',
                    location.pathname === link.href
                      ? 'text-[var(--color-primary)]'
                      : 'text-[var(--color-text)]'
                  )}
                >
                  {link.label}
                </Link>
              ))}
              {actions && <div className="pt-2">{actions}</div>}
            </nav>
          </motion.div>
        )}
      </AnimatePresence>
    </motion.header>
  )
}

--- FILE: webtest14/Blood/src/components/ui/backgrounds/GridPattern.tsx ---

import { useId } from 'react'
import type { ReactNode } from 'react'

interface GridPatternProps {
  children?: ReactNode
  className?: string
  width?: number
  height?: number
  x?: number
  y?: number
}

export default function GridPattern({
  children,
  className = '',
  width = 32,
  height = 32,
  x = -1,
  y = -1,
}: GridPatternProps) {
  const baseId = useId().replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9]/g, '')
  const patternId = `${baseId}-grid`

  return (
    <div className={`relative isolate ${className}`}>
      <svg
        className="absolute inset-0 -z-10 h-full w-full opacity-[0.05]"
        aria-hidden="true"
      >
        <defs>
          <pattern
            id={patternId}
            width={width}
            height={height}
            patternUnits="userSpaceOnUse"
            x={x}
            y={y}
          >
            <path
              d={`M ${width} 0 L 0 0 0 ${height}`}
              fill="none"
              stroke="var(--color-primary)"
              strokeWidth="0.5"
            />
          </pattern>
        </defs>
        <rect width="100%" height="100%" fill={`url(#${patternId})`} />
      </svg>
      {children}
    </div>
  )
}
