import { motion } from 'framer-motion'
import { Pencil, Trash2, ArrowUpDown, ArrowUp, ArrowDown } from 'lucide-react'
import type { BloodInventoryItem } from '../../api/mockApi'
import { updateInventoryItem, deleteInventoryItem } from '../../api/mockApi'
import { getToken } from '../../utils/auth'
import { fadeUp, hoverLift } from '../../animations'
import { tokens } from '../../tokens'
import { cn } from '../core/utils'
import AnimatedDialog from '../ui/AnimatedDialog'
import ShineBorder from '../ui/ShineBorder'

interface InventoryTableProps {
  items: BloodInventoryItem[]
  showActions?: boolean
  onRefresh?: () => void
  className?: string
}

type SortKey = keyof BloodInventoryItem

export default function InventoryTable({
  items,
  showActions = false,
  onRefresh,
  className,
}: InventoryTableProps): ReactNode {
  const [sortKey, setSortKey] = useState<SortKey | null>(null)
  const [sortDir, setSortDir] = useState<'asc' | 'desc'>('asc')
  const [editingItem, setEditingItem] = useState<BloodInventoryItem | null>(null)
  const [isEditOpen, setIsEditOpen] = useState(false)
  const [deletingId, setDeletingId] = useState<string | null>(null)
  const [isDeleteOpen, setIsDeleteOpen] = useState(false)
  const [formLoading, setFormLoading] = useState(false)
  const [formError, setFormError] = useState<string | null>(null)

  const handleSort = useCallback((key: SortKey) => {
    setSortKey((prev) => {
      if (prev === key) {
        setSortDir((d) => (d === 'asc' ? 'desc' : 'asc'))
        return key
      }
      setSortDir('asc')
      return key
    })
  }, [])

  const sortedItems = useMemo(() => {
    if (!sortKey) return items
    const dir = sortDir === 'asc' ? 1 : -1
    return [...items].sort((a, b) => {
      const aVal = a[sortKey]
      const bVal = b[sortKey]
      if (typeof aVal === 'number' && typeof bVal === 'number') {
        return (aVal - bVal) * dir
      }
      return String(aVal).localeCompare(String(bVal)) * dir
    })
  }, [items, sortKey, sortDir])

  const openEdit = useCallback((item: BloodInventoryItem) => {
    setEditingItem({ ...item })
    setFormError(null)
    setIsEditOpen(true)
  }, [])

  const closeEdit = useCallback(() => {
    setIsEditOpen(false)
    setEditingItem(null)
    setFormError(null)
  }, [])

  const handleEditSubmit = useCallback(async (e: FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault()
    if (!editingItem) return
    setFormLoading(true)
    setFormError(null)
    try {
      const token = getToken()
      if (!token) throw new Error('Authentication required')
      await updateInventoryItem(editingItem.id, {
        hospital: editingItem.hospital,
        region: editingItem.region,
        bloodType: editingItem.bloodType,
        units: editingItem.units,
      }, `Bearer ${token}`)
      closeEdit()
      onRefresh?.()
    } catch (err) {
      setFormError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Update failed')
    } finally {
      setFormLoading(false)
    }
  }, [editingItem, onRefresh, closeEdit])

  const openDelete = useCallback((id: string) => {
    setDeletingId(id)
    setFormError(null)
    setIsDeleteOpen(true)
  }, [])

  const closeDelete = useCallback(() => {
    setIsDeleteOpen(false)
    setDeletingId(null)
    setFormError(null)
  }, [])

  const handleDeleteConfirm = useCallback(async () => {
    if (!deletingId) return
    setFormLoading(true)
    setFormError(null)
    try {
      const token = getToken()
      if (!token) throw new Error('Authentication required')
      await deleteInventoryItem(deletingId, `Bearer ${token}`)
      closeDelete()
      onRefresh?.()
    } catch (err) {
      setFormError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Delete failed')
    } finally {
      setFormLoading(false)
    }
  }, [deletingId, onRefresh, closeDelete])

  const sortColumns: { key: SortKey; label: string; align?: 'left' | 'right' }[] = [
    { key: 'hospital', label: 'Hospital' },
    { key: 'region', label: 'Region' },
    { key: 'bloodType', label: 'Blood Type' },
    { key: 'units', label: 'Units', align: 'right' },
    { key: 'lastUpdated', label: 'Last Updated' },
  ]

  return (
    <div className={cn('flex flex-col gap-6', className)}>
      <ShineBorder className="overflow-hidden rounded-xl">
        <div className="overflow-x-auto">
          <table className="w-full text-left text-sm font-light">
            <thead>
              <tr className="border-b border-[var(--color-border)] text-[var(--color-text)]/60">
                {sortColumns.map((col) => (
                  <th
                    key={col.key}
                    className={cn(
                      'cursor-pointer px-6 py-4 text-xs font-light uppercase tracking-widest transition-colors hover:text-[var(--color-primary)]',
                      col.align === 'right' ? 'text-right' : 'text-left'
                    )}
                    onClick={() => handleSort(col.key)}
                  >
                    <span className="inline-flex items-center">
                      {col.label}
                      {sortKey !== col.key && <ArrowUpDown className="ml-1 inline h-3 w-3 opacity-40" />}
                      {sortKey === col.key && sortDir === 'asc' && <ArrowUp className="ml-1 inline h-3 w-3" />}
                      {sortKey === col.key && sortDir === 'desc' && <ArrowDown className="ml-1 inline h-3 w-3" />}
                    </span>
                  </th>
                ))}
                {showActions && (
                  <th className="px-6 py-4 text-right text-xs font-light uppercase tracking-widest">
                    Actions
                  </th>
                )}
              </tr>
            </thead>
            <tbody>
              {sortedItems.map((item, index) => (
                <motion.tr
                  key={item.id}
                  variants={fadeUp}
                  initial="hidden"
                  animate="visible"
                  transition={{ delay: Math.min(index * 0.05, 0.6) }}
                  className="border-b border-[var(--color-border)] transition-colors hover:bg-[var(--color-muted)]"
                >
                  <td className="px-6 py-4 text-[var(--color-text)]">{item.hospital}</td>
                  <td className="px-6 py-4 text-[var(--color-text)]/80">{item.region}</td>
                  <td className="px-6 py-4">
                    <span className="inline-flex rounded-md border border-[var(--color-border)] bg-[var(--color-muted)] px-2 py-1 text-xs font-light tracking-wide text-[var(--color-primary)]">
                      {item.bloodType}
                    </span>
                  </td>
                  <td className="px-6 py-4 text-right text-[var(--color-text)]">{item.units}</td>
                  <td className="whitespace-nowrap px-6 py-4 text-[var(--color-text)]/60">
                    {new Date(item.lastUpdated).toLocaleDateString()}
                  </td>
                  {showActions && (
                    <td className="px-6 py-4 text-right">
                      <div className="flex items-center justify-end gap-3">
                        <motion.button
                          whileHover={hoverLift}
                          onClick={() => openEdit(item)}
                          className="inline-flex h-8 w-8 items-center justify-center rounded-lg border border-[var(--color-border)] text-[var(--color-text)] transition-colors hover:border-[var(--color-primary)] hover:text-[var(--color-primary)]"
                          aria-label="Edit"
                        >
                          <Pencil className="h-4 w-4" />
                        </motion.button>
                        <motion.button
                          whileHover={{ ...hoverLift, borderColor: tokens.color.error, color: tokens.color.error }}
                          onClick={() => openDelete(item.id)}
                          className="inline-flex h-8 w-8 items-center justify-center rounded-lg border border-[var(--color-border)] text-[var(--color-text)]"
                          aria-label="Delete"
                        >
                          <Trash2 className="h-4 w-4" />
                        </motion.button>
                      </div>
                    </td>
                  )}
                </motion.tr>
              ))}
              {sortedItems.length === 0 && (
                <tr>
                  <td
                    colSpan={showActions ? 6 : 5}
                    className="px-6 py-12 text-center text-[var(--color-text)]/40"
                  >
                    No inventory records found.
                  </td>
                </tr>
              )}
            </tbody>
          </table>
        </div>
      </ShineBorder>

      <AnimatedDialog isOpen={isEditOpen} onClose={closeEdit} title="Edit Inventory Record">
        {editingItem && (
          <form onSubmit={handleEditSubmit} className="flex flex-col gap-5">
            <div className="flex flex-col gap-2">
              <label htmlFor="hospital" className="text-sm font-light tracking-wide text-[var(--color-text)]/70">Hospital</label>
              <input
                id="hospital"
                type="text"
                value={editingItem.hospital}
                onChange={(e) => setEditingItem((prev) => prev ? { ...prev, hospital: e.target.value } : prev)}
                required
                className="w-full rounded-lg border border-[var(--color-border)] bg-[var(--color-surface)] px-4 py-2.5 text-sm font-light text-[var(--color-text)] focus:border-[var(--color-primary)] focus:outline-none"
              />
            </div>
            <div className="flex flex-col gap-2">
              <label htmlFor="region" className="text-sm font-light tracking-wide text-[var(--color-text)]/70">Region</label>
              <input
                id="region"
                type="text"
                value={editingItem.region}
                onChange={(e) => setEditingItem((prev) => prev ? { ...prev, region: e.target.value } : prev)}
                required
                className="w-full rounded-lg border border-[var(--color-border)] bg-[var(--color-surface)] px-4 py-2.5 text-sm font-light text-[var(--color-text)] focus:border-[var(--color-primary)] focus:outline-none"
              />
            </div>
            <div className="flex flex-col gap-2">
              <label htmlFor="bloodType" className="text-sm font-light tracking-wide text-[var(--color-text)]/70">Blood Type</label>
              <input
                id="bloodType"
                type="text"
                value={editingItem.bloodType}
                onChange={(e) => setEditingItem((prev) => prev ? { ...prev, bloodType: e.target.value } : prev)}
                required
                className="w-full rounded-lg border border-[var(--color-border)] bg-[var(--color-surface)] px-4 py-2.5 text-sm font-light text-[var(--color-text)] focus:border-[var(--color-primary)] focus:outline-none"
              />
            </div>
            <div className="flex flex-col gap-2">
              <label htmlFor="units" className="text-sm font-light tracking-wide text-[var(--color-text)]/70">Units</label>
              <input
                id="units"
                type="number"
                min={0}
                value={editingItem.units}
                onChange={(e) => setEditingItem((prev) => prev ? { ...prev, units: Number(e.target.value) } : prev)}
                required
                className="w-full rounded-lg border border-[var(--color-border)] bg-[var(--color-surface)] px-4 py-2.5 text-sm font-light text-[var(--color-text)] focus:border-[var(--color-primary)] focus:outline-none"
              />
            </div>
            {formError && <p className="text-sm font-light text-red-500">{formError}</p>}
            <div className="flex justify-end gap-3 pt-2">
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={closeEdit}
                className="rounded-lg border border-[var(--color-border)] px-4 py-2 text-sm font-light transition-colors hover:border-[var(--color-primary)] hover:text-[var(--color-primary)]"
              >
                Cancel
              </button>
              <button
                type="submit"
                disabled={formLoading}
                className="rounded-lg bg-[var(--color-primary)] px-4 py-2 text-sm font-light text-white transition-opacity hover:opacity-90 disabled:opacity-40"
              >
                {formLoading ? 'Saving...' : 'Save Changes'}
              </button>
            </div>
          </form>
        )}
      </AnimatedDialog>

      <AnimatedDialog isOpen={isDeleteOpen} onClose={closeDelete} title="Delete Record">
        <div className="flex flex-col gap-6">
          <p className="text-sm font-light leading-relaxed text-[var(--color-text)]/70">
            Are you sure you want to delete this inventory record? This action cannot be undone.
          </p>
          {formError && <p className="text-sm font-light text-red-500">{formError}</p>}
          <div className="flex justify-end gap-3">
            <button
              onClick={closeDelete}
              className="rounded-lg border border-[var(--color-border)] px-4 py-2 text-sm font-light transition-colors hover:border-[var(--color-primary)] hover:text-[var(--color-primary)]"
            >
              Cancel
            </button>
            <button
              onClick={handleDeleteConfirm}
              disabled={formLoading}
              style={{ backgroundColor: tokens.color.error }}
              className="rounded-lg px-4 py-2 text-sm font-light text-white transition-opacity hover:opacity-90 disabled:opacity-40"
            >
              {formLoading ? 'Deleting...' : 'Delete'}
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </AnimatedDialog>
    </div>
  )
}

import type { ReactNode } from 'react'
import { useState, useCallback, useMemo } from 'react'
import { motion } from 'framer-motion'
import { ArrowUpDown, ArrowUp, ArrowDown } from 'lucide-react'
import type { BloodInventoryItem } from '../../api/mockApi'
import { stagger, fadeUp } from '../../animations'
import { cn } from '../core/utils'
import ShineBorder from '../ui/ShineBorder'

interface PatientTableProps {
  items: BloodInventoryItem[]
  className?: string
}

type SortKey = keyof BloodInventoryItem

export default function PatientTable({ items, className }: PatientTableProps): ReactNode {
  const [sortKey, setSortKey] = useState<SortKey | null>(null)
  const [sortDir, setSortDir] = useState<'asc' | 'desc'>('asc')

  return (

      <ShineBorder className="overflow-hidden rounded-xl">
        <div className="overflow-x-auto">

              <tr className="border-b border-[var(--color-border)] text-[var(--color-text)]/60">
                {sortColumns.map((col) => (
                  <th
                    key={col.key}
                    className={cn(
                      'cursor-pointer px-6 py-4 text-xs font-light uppercase tracking-widest transition-colors hover:text-[var(--color-primary)]',
                      col.align === 'right' ? 'text-right' : 'text-left'
                    )}
                    onClick={() => handleSort(col.key)}
                  >
                    <span className="inline-flex items-center">
                      {col.label}
                      {sortKey !== col.key && <ArrowUpDown className="ml-1 inline h-3 w-3 opacity-40" />}

                      {sortKey === col.key && sortDir === 'desc' && <ArrowDown className="ml-1 inline h-3 w-3" />}
                    </span>
                  </th>
                ))}
              </tr>
            </thead>
            <motion.tbody
              variants={stagger}
              initial="hidden"
              animate="visible"
            >
              {sortedItems.map((item) => (
                <motion.tr
                  key={item.id}
                  variants={fadeUp}
                  className="border-b border-[var(--color-border)] transition-colors hover:bg-[var(--color-muted)]"
                >
                  <td className="px-6 py-4 text-[var(--color-text)]">{item.hospital}</td>
                  <td className="px-6 py-4 text-[var(--color-text)]/80">{item.region}</td>
                  <td className="px-6 py-4">
                    <span className="inline-flex rounded-md border border-[var(--color-border)] bg-[var(--color-muted)] px-2 py-1 text-xs font-light tracking-wide text-[var(--color-primary)]">
                      {item.bloodType}
                    </span>
                  </td>
                  <td className="px-6 py-4 text-right text-[var(--color-text)]">{item.units}</td>

              ))}

                    No matching records found.
                  </td>
                </tr>
              )}
            </motion.tbody>
          </table>
        </div>
      </ShineBorder>
    </div>
  )
}

--- FILE: webtest14/Blood/src/components/forms/InventoryImportExportForm.tsx ---

import type { ReactNode, ChangeEvent } from 'react'
import { useState, useRef, useCallback } from 'react'
import { motion } from 'framer-motion'
import { Upload, Download } from 'lucide-react'
import { parseInventoryCsv, inventoryToCsv, downloadCsv } from '../../utils/csvParser'
import { importInventoryBatch } from '../../api/mockApi'
import { getToken } from '../../utils/auth'
import { useInventoryStore } from '../../store/inventoryStore'
import { fadeUp, stagger, hoverScale } from '../../animations'
import { cn } from '../core/utils'
import AnimatedDialog from '../ui/AnimatedDialog'

export default function InventoryImportExportForm({ className }: { className?: string }): ReactNode {
  const [isImportOpen, setIsImportOpen] = useState(false)
  const [file, setFile] = useState<File | null>(null)
  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(false)
  const [feedback, setFeedback] = useState<string | null>(null)
  const fileInputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null)
  const items = useInventoryStore((state) => state.items)

  const handleExport = useCallback(() => {
    const csv = inventoryToCsv(items)
    downloadCsv(`blood-bank-inventory-${new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10)}.csv`, csv)
    setFeedback('Inventory exported successfully')
    setTimeout(() => setFeedback(null), 3000)
  }, [items])

  const handleFileChange = useCallback((e: ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    const selected = e.target.files?.[0] ?? null
    setFile(selected)
  }, [])

  const handleImport = useCallback(async () => {
    if (!file) return
    setIsLoading(true)
    try {
      const rows = await parseInventoryCsv(file)
      const token = getToken()
      if (!token) throw new Error('Authentication required')
      const result = await importInventoryBatch(rows, `Bearer ${token}`)
      setFeedback(`Imported ${result.imported} records successfully`)
      setFile(null)
      setIsImportOpen(false)
      setTimeout(() => setFeedback(null), 4000)
    } catch (err) {
      setFeedback(err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Import failed')
    } finally {
      setIsLoading(false)
    }
  }, [file])

  return (
    <motion.div
      variants={stagger}
      initial="hidden"
      animate="visible"
      className={cn('flex flex-col gap-6', className)}
    >
      <div className="flex flex-col gap-4 sm:flex-row">
        <motion.button
          variants={fadeUp}
          whileHover={hoverScale}
          onClick={() => setIsImportOpen(true)}
          className="inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-lg border border-[var(--color-border)] px-6 py-3 text-sm font-light transition-colors hover:border-[var(--color-primary)] hover:text-[var(--color-primary)]"
        >
          <Upload className="h-4 w-4" />
          Import CSV
        </motion.button>
        <motion.button
          variants={fadeUp}
          whileHover={hoverScale}
          onClick={handleExport}
          className="inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-lg bg-[var(--color-primary)] px-6 py-3 text-sm font-light text-white transition-opacity hover:opacity-90"
        >
          <Download className="h-4 w-4" />
          Export CSV
        </motion.button>
      </div>

      {feedback && (
        <motion.p
          variants={fadeUp}
          initial="hidden"
          animate="visible"
          className="text-sm font-light text-[var(--color-primary)]"
        >
          {feedback}
        </motion.p>
      )}

      <AnimatedDialog
        isOpen={isImportOpen}
        onClose={() => {
          setIsImportOpen(false)
          setFile(null)
          setFeedback(null)
        }}
        title="Import Inventory"
      >
        <div className="flex flex-col gap-6">
          <p className="text-sm font-light leading-relaxed text-[var(--color-text)]/60">
            Upload a CSV file containing columns: hospital, region, bloodType, units, lastUpdated
          </p>
          <input
            ref={fileInputRef}
            type="file"
            accept=".csv"
            onChange={handleFileChange}
            className="block w-full cursor-pointer text-sm font-light file:mr-4 file:rounded-lg file:border-0 file:bg-[var(--color-primary)] file:px-4 file:py-2 file:text-sm file:font-light file:text-white hover:file:opacity-90"
          />
          {file && (
            <p className="text-sm font-light text-[var(--color-text)]/70">{file.name}</p>
          )}
          <div className="flex justify-end gap-3 pt-2">
            <button
              onClick={() => {
                setIsImportOpen(false)
                setFile(null)
                setFeedback(null)
              }}
              className="rounded-lg border border-[var(--color-border)] px-4 py-2 text-sm font-light transition-colors hover:border-[var(--color-primary)] hover:text-[var(--color-primary)]"
            >
              Cancel
            </button>
            <button
              onClick={handleImport}
              disabled={!file || isLoading}
              className="rounded-lg bg-[var(--color-primary)] px-4 py-2 text-sm font-light text-white transition-opacity hover:opacity-90 disabled:opacity-40"
            >
              {isLoading ? 'Importing...' : 'Import'}
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </AnimatedDialog>
    </motion.div>
  )
}

--- FILE: webtest14/Blood/src/components/forms/LoginForm.tsx ---

import type { ReactNode } from 'react'
import { useState, useCallback } from 'react'
import { motion } from 'framer-motion'
import { Link, useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom'
import { fadeUp, stagger, hoverScale } from '../../animations'
import { cn } from '../core/utils'
import { useAuthStore } from '../../store/authStore'

interface LoginFormProps {
  className?: string
}

export default function LoginForm({ className }: LoginFormProps): ReactNode {
  const [email, setEmail] = useState('')
  const [password, setPassword] = useState('')
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null)
  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(false)
  const navigate = useNavigate()
  const { login } = useAuthStore()

  const handleSubmit = useCallback((e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault()
    setError(null)
    setIsLoading(true)
    try {
      const result = login(email, password)
      if (result.user.role === 'admin') {
        navigate('/admin')
      } else {
        navigate('/home')
      }
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Login failed')
    } finally {
      setIsLoading(false)
    }
  }, [email, password, login, navigate])

  return (
    <motion.form
      onSubmit={handleSubmit}
      variants={stagger}
      initial="hidden"
      animate="visible"
      className={cn('flex flex-col gap-6', className)}
    >
      <motion.div variants={fadeUp} className="flex flex-col gap-2">
        <label htmlFor="email" className="text-sm font-light tracking-wide text-[var(--color-text)]/70">
          Email
        </label>
        <input
          id="email"
          type="email"
          autoComplete="email"
          value={email}
          onChange={(e) => setEmail(e.target.value)}
          required
          className="w-full rounded-lg border border-[var(--color-border)] bg-[var(--color-surface)] px-4 py-3 text-sm font-light text-[var(--color-text)] placeholder:text-[var(--color-text)]/30 focus:border-[var(--color-primary)] focus:outline-none"
          placeholder="you@example.com"
        />
      </motion.div>

      <motion.div variants={fadeUp} className="flex flex-col gap-2">
        <label htmlFor="password" className="text-sm font-light tracking-wide text-[var(--color-text)]/70">
          Password
        </label>
        <input
          id="password"
          type="password"
          autoComplete="current-password"
          value={password}

--- FILE: webtest14/Blood/src/components/core/ProtectedRoute.tsx ---

import type { ReactNode } from 'react'
import { Navigate } from 'react-router-dom'
import { useAuthStore } from '../../store/authStore'

interface ProtectedRouteProps {
  children: ReactNode
  allowedRoles?: string[]
}

export default function ProtectedRoute({ children, allowedRoles }: ProtectedRouteProps): ReactNode {
  const { isAuthenticated, role } = useAuthStore()

  if (!isAuthenticated) {
    return <Navigate to="/login" replace />
  }

  if (allowedRoles && (!role || !allowedRoles.includes(role))) {
    return <Navigate to="/home" replace />
  }

  return children
}

--- FILE: webtest14/Blood/src/components/core/utils.ts ---

export function cn(...inputs: Array<string | undefined | null | false | Record<string, boolean | undefined | null>>): string {
  const classes: string[] = []
  for (const input of inputs) {
    if (!input) continue
    if (typeof input === 'string') {
      classes.push(input)
    } else if (typeof input === 'object' && !Array.isArray(input)) {
      for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(input)) {
        if (value) classes.push(key)
      }
    }
  }
  return classes.join(' ')
}

import { useState, useEffect, useRef, useMemo } from 'react'
import type { ReactNode } from 'react'
import { motion, useInView } from 'framer-motion'
import { getInventoryStats } from '../../api/mockApi'
import { fadeUp, stagger } from '../../animations'
import { cn } from '../core/utils'

interface BloodStatsChartProps {
  className?: string
}

interface StatItem {
  bloodType: string
  totalUnits: number
  count: number
}

export default function BloodStatsChart({ className }: BloodStatsChartProps): ReactNode {
  const ref = useRef(null)
  const isInView = useInView(ref, { once: true, margin: '-80px' })
  const [stats, setStats] = useState<StatItem[]>([])

  useEffect(() => {
    getInventoryStats()
      .then((res) => {
        const order = ['O+', 'O-', 'A+', 'A-', 'B+', 'B-', 'AB+', 'AB-']
        const sorted = [...res.data].sort((a, b) => {
          const ia = order.indexOf(a.bloodType)
          const ib = order.indexOf(b.bloodType)
          if (ia !== -1 && ib !== -1) return ia - ib
          if (ia !== -1) return -1
          if (ib !== -1) return 1
          return a.bloodType.localeCompare(b.bloodType)
        })
        setStats(sorted)
      })
      .catch(() => setStats([]))
  }, [])

  const { width, height, margin, yMax } = useMemo(() => {
    const margin = { top: 30, right: 20, bottom: 50, left: 50 }
    const width = 800 - margin.left - margin.right
    const height = 400 - margin.top - margin.bottom
    const maxUnits = Math.max(...stats.map((s) => s.totalUnits), 1)
    const yMax = Math.ceil(maxUnits / 10) * 10
    return { width, height, margin, yMax }
  }, [stats])

  const barCount = stats.length
  const barSpacing = barCount > 0 ? width / barCount : 0
  const barWidth = barCount > 0 ? barSpacing * 0.5 : 0
  const ticks = [0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1]

  return (
    <motion.section
      ref={ref}
      variants={stagger}
      initial="hidden"
      animate={isInView ? 'visible' : 'hidden'}
      className={cn('mx-auto max-w-7xl px-6 py-20 md:px-8 lg:py-24', className)}
    >
      <motion.div variants={fadeUp} className="mb-12 flex flex-col gap-4">
        <h2
          className="text-3xl font-light tracking-tight text-[var(--color-text)] lg:text-4xl"
          style={{ fontFamily: 'var(--font-heading)' }}
        >
          Blood Type Distribution
        </h2>
        <p className="max-w-xl text-sm font-light leading-relaxed text-[var(--color-text)]/60">
          Aggregated availability of blood units grouped by type across all registered hospitals and regions.
        </p>
      </motion.div>

      <motion.div
        variants={fadeUp}
        className="relative rounded-xl border border-[var(--color-border)] bg-[var(--color-surface)] p-6 md:p-8"
      >
        <svg viewBox="0 0 800 400" className="h-auto w-full overflow-visible">
          <g transform={`translate(${margin.left},${margin.top})`}>
            {ticks.map((t, i) => {
              const y = height - t * height
              return (
                <g key={`grid-${i}`}>
                  <line
                    x1={0}
                    x2={width}
                    y1={y}
                    y2={y}
                    stroke="var(--color-border)"
                    strokeWidth="0.5"
                  />
                  <text
                    x={-12}
                    y={y + 4}
                    textAnchor="end"
                    className="text-xs font-light"
                    fill="var(--color-text)"
                    fillOpacity={0.5}
                  >
                    {Math.round(t * yMax)}
                  </text>
                </g>
              )
            })}

            <motion.g variants={stagger}>
              {stats.map((stat) => {
                const barHeight = yMax > 0 ? (stat.totalUnits / yMax) * height : 0
                const x = stats.indexOf(stat) * barSpacing + (barSpacing - barWidth) / 2
                const y = height - barHeight

                return (
                  <motion.g key={stat.bloodType} variants={fadeUp}>
                    <motion.rect
                      x={x}
                      y={y}
                      width={barWidth}
                      height={barHeight}
                      rx={6}
                      fill="var(--color-primary)"
                      fillOpacity={0.85}
                      whileHover={{ fillOpacity: 1 }}
                      transition={{ duration: 0.3 }}
                    />
                    {barHeight > 12 && (
                      <text
                        x={x + barWidth / 2}
                        y={y - 8}
                        textAnchor="middle"
                        className="text-xs font-light"
                        fill="var(--color-text)"
                        fillOpacity={0.9}
                      >
                        {stat.totalUnits}
                      </text>
                    )}
                    <text
                      x={x + barWidth / 2}
                      y={height + 24}
                      textAnchor="middle"
                      className="text-xs font-light"
                      fill="var(--color-text)"
                      fillOpacity={0.7}
                    >
                      {stat.bloodType}
                    </text>
                  </motion.g>
                )
              })}
            </motion.g>

            <line
              x1={0}
              x2={width}
              y1={height}
              y2={height}
              stroke="var(--color-border)"
              strokeWidth="1"
            />
            <line
              x1={0}
              x2={0}
              y1={0}
              y2={height}
              stroke="var(--color-border)"
              strokeWidth="1"
            />
          </g>
        </svg>
      </motion.div>
    </motion.section>
  )
}

--- FILE: webtest14/Blood/src/api/mockApi.ts ---

import { verifyToken } from '../utils/jwt'
import { useInventoryStore } from '../store/inventoryStore'

export interface BloodInventoryItem {
  id: string
  hospital: string
  region: string
  bloodType: string
  units: number
  lastUpdated: string
}

export interface InventorySearchParams {
  bloodType?: string
  region?: string
  hospital?: string
  query?: string
}

const delay = (ms: number = 300) => new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, ms))

const generateId = () => `${Date.now().toString(36)}-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 8)}`

const getAuthPayload = (authHeader?: string): { userId: string; role: string } => {
  if (!authHeader) throw new Error('Unauthorized')
  const token = authHeader.replace('Bearer ', '')
  const payload = verifyToken(token)
  if (!payload) throw new Error('Unauthorized')
  return payload as { userId: string; role: string }
}

const assertAdmin = (authHeader?: string) => {
  const user = getAuthPayload(authHeader)
  if (user.role !== 'admin') throw new Error('Forbidden')
}

export const getInventory = async (
  params?: InventorySearchParams,
  _authHeader?: string
): Promise<{ data: BloodInventoryItem[] }> => {
  await delay()
  const state = useInventoryStore.getState()
  let results = state.items ?? []

  if (params?.bloodType) {
    results = results.filter((i) =>
      i.bloodType.toLowerCase().includes(params.bloodType!.toLowerCase())
    )
  }
  if (params?.region) {
    results = results.filter((i) =>
      i.region.toLowerCase().includes(params.region!.toLowerCase())
    )
  }
  if (params?.hospital) {
    results = results.filter((i) =>
      i.hospital.toLowerCase().includes(params.hospital!.toLowerCase())
    )
  }
  if (params?.query) {
    const q = params.query.toLowerCase()
    results = results.filter(
      (i) =>
        i.hospital.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
        i.region.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
        i.bloodType.toLowerCase().includes(q)
    )
  }

  return { data: results }
}

export const getInventoryItem = async (
  id: string
): Promise<{ data: BloodInventoryItem }> => {
  await delay()
  const state = useInventoryStore.getState()
  const item = state.items.find((i: BloodInventoryItem) => i.id === id)
  if (!item) throw new Error('Not found')
  return { data: item }
}

export const createInventoryItem = async (
  payload: Omit<BloodInventoryItem, 'id'>,
  authHeader: string
): Promise<{ data: BloodInventoryItem }> => {
  await delay()
  assertAdmin(authHeader)
  const state = useInventoryStore.getState()
  const item: BloodInventoryItem = {
    ...payload,
    id: generateId(),
    lastUpdated: new Date().toISOString(),
  }
  state.addItem(item)
  return { data: item }
}

export const updateInventoryItem = async (
  id: string,
  payload: Partial<Omit<BloodInventoryItem, 'id'>>,
  authHeader: string
): Promise<{ data: BloodInventoryItem }> => {
  await delay()
  assertAdmin(authHeader)
  const state = useInventoryStore.getState()
  const existing = state.items.find((i: BloodInventoryItem) => i.id === id)
  if (!existing) throw new Error('Not found')
  const item: BloodInventoryItem = {
    ...existing,
    ...payload,
    id,
    lastUpdated: new Date().toISOString(),
  }
  state.updateItem(id, item)
  return { data: item }
}

export const deleteInventoryItem = async (
  id: string,
  authHeader: string
): Promise<{ success: boolean }> => {
  await delay()
  assertAdmin(authHeader)
  const state = useInventoryStore.getState()
  const existing = state.items.find((i: BloodInventoryItem) => i.id === id)
  if (!existing) throw new Error('Not found')
  state.removeItem(id)
  return { success: true }
}

export const getInventoryStats = async (): Promise<{
  data: { bloodType: string; totalUnits: number; count: number }[]
}> => {
  await delay()
  const state = useInventoryStore.getState()
  const items = state.items ?? []
  const map = new Map<string, { totalUnits: number; count: number }>()

  for (const item of items) {
    const curr = map.get(item.bloodType) || { totalUnits: 0, count: 0 }
    curr.totalUnits += item.units
    curr.count += 1
    map.set(item.bloodType, curr)
  }

  const data = Array.from(map.entries()).map(([bloodType, val]) => ({
    bloodType,
    totalUnits: val.totalUnits,
    count: val.count,
  }))

  return { data }
}

export const importInventoryBatch = async (
  items: Omit<BloodInventoryItem, 'id'>[],
  authHeader: string
): Promise<{ imported: number }> => {
  await delay(600)
  assertAdmin(authHeader)
  const state = useInventoryStore.getState()
  let imported = 0
  for (const entry of items) {
    const item: BloodInventoryItem = {
      ...entry,
      id: generateId(),
      lastUpdated: new Date().toISOString(),
    }
    state.addItem(item)
    imported++
  }
  return { imported }
}

interface Endpoint {
  method: string
  path: string
  auth: string
  description: string
  params: string[]
  response: string
}

const endpoints: Endpoint[] = [
  {
    method: 'GET',
    path: '/api/inventory',
    auth: 'Optional',
    description: 'List all inventory records with optional filtering by blood type, region, hospital, or free-text query.',
    params: ['bloodType', 'region', 'hospital', 'query'],
    response: '{ data: BloodInventoryItem[] }',
  },
  {
    method: 'GET',
    path: '/api/inventory/:id',
    auth: 'Optional',
    description: 'Retrieve a single inventory record by its unique identifier.',
    params: [],
    response: '{ data: BloodInventoryItem }',
  },
  {
    method: 'POST',
    path: '/api/inventory',
    auth: 'Bearer Token (Admin)',
    description: 'Create a new inventory record. Requires an admin role.',
    params: ['hospital', 'region', 'bloodType', 'units'],
    response: '{ data: BloodInventoryItem }',
  },
  {
    method: 'PUT',
    path: '/api/inventory/:id',
    auth: 'Bearer Token (Admin)',
    description: 'Update an existing inventory record. Requires an admin role.',
    params: ['hospital?', 'region?', 'bloodType?', 'units?'],
    response: '{ data: BloodInventoryItem }',
  },
  {
    method: 'DELETE',
    path: '/api/inventory/:id',
    auth: 'Bearer Token (Admin)',
    description: 'Delete an inventory record permanently. Requires an admin role.',
    params: [],
    response: '{ success: boolean }',
  },
  {
    method: 'GET',
    path: '/api/inventory/stats',
    auth: 'Optional',
    description: 'Return aggregated blood type distribution across all registered hospitals.',
    params: [],
    response: '{ data: { bloodType, totalUnits, count }[] }',
  },
  {
    method: 'POST',
    path: '/api/inventory/batch',
    auth: 'Bearer Token (Admin)',
    description: 'Import multiple inventory records in a single request. Requires an admin role.',
    params: ['items[]'],
    response: '{ imported: number }',
  },
]

--- FILE: webtest14/Blood/src/pages/PatientSearch.tsx ---

import type { ReactNode, FormEvent } from 'react'
import { useState, useCallback, useEffect, useRef } from 'react'
import { motion, useInView } from 'framer-motion'
import { Search } from 'lucide-react'
import { fadeUp, scaleIn, stagger, hoverScale } from '../animations'
import { getInventory } from '../api/mockApi'
import type { BloodInventoryItem } from '../api/mockApi'
import PatientTable from '../components/tables/PatientTable'
import BGPattern from '../components/ui/backgrounds/BGPattern'
import AnimatedLink from '../components/ui/AnimatedLink'

export default function PatientSearch(): ReactNode {
  const [items, setItems] = useState<BloodInventoryItem[]>([])
  const [query, setQuery] = useState('')
  const [bloodType, setBloodType] = useState('')
  const [region, setRegion] = useState('')
  const [hospital, setHospital] = useState('')
  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(false)

  const heroRef = useRef(null)
  const heroInView = useInView(heroRef, { once: true, margin: '-80px' })

  const tableRef = useRef(null)
  const tableInView = useInView(tableRef, { once: true, margin: '-80px' })

  const loadInventory = useCallback(async () => {
    setIsLoading(true)
    try {
      const res = await getInventory()
      setItems(res.data)
    } catch {
      setItems([])
    } finally {
      setIsLoading(false)
    }
  }, [])

  useEffect(() => {
    loadInventory()
  }, [loadInventory])

  const handleSearch = useCallback(
    async (e?: FormEvent) => {
      e?.preventDefault()
      setIsLoading(true)
      try {
        const res = await getInventory({
          query: query || undefined,
          bloodType: bloodType || undefined,
          region: region || undefined,
          hospital: hospital || undefined,
        })
        setItems(res.data)
      } catch {
        setItems([])
      } finally {
        setIsLoading(false)
      }
    },
    [query, bloodType, region, hospital]
  )

  return (
    <BGPattern className="flex flex-col gap-20 py-20 md:py-24 lg:py-32">
      <motion.section
        ref={heroRef}
        variants={stagger}
        initial="hidden"
        animate={heroInView ? 'visible' : 'hidden'}
        className="mx-auto max-w-7xl px-6 md:px-8"
      >
        <motion.p
          variants={fadeUp}
          className="text-sm font-light uppercase tracking-widest text-[var(--color-primary)]"
        >
          Find Blood
        </motion.p>
        <motion.h1
          variants={fadeUp}
          className="mt-4 text-4xl font-light tracking-tight text-[var(--color-text)] lg:text-5xl"
          style={{ fontFamily: 'var(--font-heading)' }}
        >
          Search Inventory
        </motion.h1>
        <motion.p
          variants={fadeUp}
          className="mt-4 max-w-xl text-base font-light leading-relaxed text-[var(--color-text)]/60"
        >
          Locate available blood units across hospitals and regions in real time. Filter by blood type, location, or hospital name.
        </motion.p>
      </motion.section>

      <motion.section
        ref={tableRef}
        variants={stagger}
        initial="hidden"
        animate={tableInView ? 'visible' : 'hidden'}
        className="mx-auto w-full max-w-7xl px-6 md:px-8"
      >
        <motion.form
          variants={fadeUp}
          onSubmit={(e) => handleSearch(e)}
          className="mb-8 flex flex-col gap-4 lg:flex-row lg:items-end"
        >
          <div className="flex flex-1 flex-col gap-2">
            <label
              htmlFor="search-query"
              className="text-sm font-light tracking-wide text-[var(--color-text)]/70"
            >
              Keywords
            </label>
            <input
              id="search-query"
              type="text"
              value={query}
              onChange={(e) => setQuery(e.target.value)}
              placeholder="Search across all fields"
              className="w-full rounded-lg border border-[var(--color-border)] bg-[var(--color-surface)] px-4 py-3 text-sm font-light text-[var(--color-text)] placeholder:text-[var(--color-text)]/30 focus:border-[var(--color-primary)] focus:outline-none"
            />
          </div>
          <div className="flex flex-1 flex-col gap-2">
            <label
              htmlFor="search-bloodType"
              className="text-sm font-light tracking-wide text-[var(--color-text)]/70"
            >
              Blood Type
            </label>
            <input
              id="search-bloodType"
              type="text"
              value={bloodType}
              onChange={(e) => setBloodType(e.target.value)}
              placeholder="e.g. O+"
              className="w-full rounded-lg border border-[var(--color-border)] bg-[var(--color-surface)] px-4 py-3 text-sm font-light text-[var(--color-text)] placeholder:text-[var(--color-text)]/30 focus:border-[var(--color-primary)] focus:outline-none"
            />
          </div>
          <div className="flex flex-1 flex-col gap-2">
            <label
              htmlFor="search-region"
              className="text-sm font-light tracking-wide text-[var(--color-text)]/70"
            >
              Region
            </label>
            <input
              id="search-region"
              type="text"
              value={region}
              onChange={(e) => setRegion(e.target.value)}
              placeholder="e.g. North District"
              className="w-full rounded-lg border border-[var(--color-border)] bg-[var(--color-surface)] px-4 py-3 text-sm font-light text-[var(--color-text)] placeholder:text-[var(--color-text)]/30 focus:border-[var(--color-primary)] focus:outline-none"
            />
          </div>
          <div className="flex flex-1 flex-col gap-2">
            <label
              htmlFor="search-hospital"
              className="text-sm font-light tracking-wide text-[var(--color-text)]/70"
            >
              Hospital
            </label>
            <input
              id="search-hospital"
              type="text"
              value={hospital}
              onChange={(e) => setHospital(e.target.value)}
              placeholder="Hospital name"
              className="w-full rounded-lg border border-[var(--color-border)] bg-[var(--color-surface)] px-4 py-3 text-sm font-light text-[var(--color-text)] placeholder:text-[var(--color-text)]/30 focus:border-[var(--color-primary)] focus:outline-none"
            />
          </div>
          <motion.button
            variants={fadeUp}
            whileHover={hoverScale}
            type="submit"
            disabled={isLoading}
            className="inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-lg bg-[var(--color-primary)] px-6 py-3 text-sm font-light text-white transition-opacity hover:opacity-90 disabled:opacity-40"
          >
            <Search className="h-4 w-4" />
            {isLoading ? 'Searching...' : 'Search'}
          </motion.button>
        </motion.form>

        <motion.div
          variants={scaleIn}
          className="mb-4 flex items-center justify-between"
        >
          <p className="text-sm font-light text-[var(--color-text)]/60">
            {items.length} result{items.length !== 1 ? 's' : ''} found
          </p>
          <AnimatedLink to="/home">Back to Home</AnimatedLink>
        </motion.div>

        <motion.div variants={fadeUp}>
          <PatientTable items={items} />
        </motion.div>
      </motion.section>
    </BGPattern>
  )
}

--- FILE: webtest14/Blood/src/store/authStore.tsx ---

import { create } from 'zustand'
import type { AuthUser } from '../utils/auth'
import { login as authLogin, signUp as authSignUp, logout as authLogout, getToken, getCurrentUser, getUserRole } from '../utils/auth'

interface AuthState {
  user: AuthUser | null
  token: string | null
  isAuthenticated: boolean
  role: 'admin' | 'patient' | null
  login: (email: string, password: string) => { token: string; user: AuthUser }
  signUp: (email: string, password: string, name: string, role?: 'admin' | 'patient') => { token: string; user: AuthUser }
  logout: () => void
}

const initialToken = getToken()
const initialUser = getCurrentUser()
const initialRole = getUserRole()

export const useAuthStore = create<AuthState>((set) => ({
  user: initialUser,
  token: initialToken,
  isAuthenticated: !!initialUser,
  role: initialRole,
  login: (email: string, password: string) => {
    const result = authLogin(email, password)
    set({ user: result.user, token: result.token, isAuthenticated: true, role: result.user.role })
    return result
  },
  signUp: (email: string, password: string, name: string, userRole: 'admin' | 'patient' = 'patient') => {
    const result = authSignUp(email, password, name, userRole)
    set({ user: result.user, token: result.token, isAuthenticated: true, role: result.user.role })
    return result
  },
  logout: () => {
    authLogout()
    set({ user: null, token: null, isAuthenticated: false, role: null })
  },
}))

export const useInventoryStore = create<InventoryState>()(
  persist(
    (set) => ({
      items: initialInventory,
      addItem: (item) => set((state) => ({ items: [...state.items, item] })),
      updateItem: (id, item) => set((state) => ({
        items: state.items.map((i) => (i.id === id ? item : i)),
      })),
      removeItem: (id) => set((state) => ({
        items: state.items.filter((i) => i.id !== id),
      })),
    }),
    {
      name: 'blood-bank-inventory',
    }
  )
)

# React + TypeScript + Vite

This template provides a minimal setup to get React working in Vite with HMR and some ESLint rules.

Currently, two official plugins are available:

- [@vitejs/plugin-react](https://github.com/vitejs/vite-plugin-react/blob/main/packages/plugin-react) uses [Oxc](https://oxc.rs)
- [@vitejs/plugin-react-swc](https://github.com/vitejs/vite-plugin-react/blob/main/packages/plugin-react-swc) uses [SWC](https://swc.rs/)

## React Compiler

The React Compiler is not enabled on this template because of its impact on dev & build performances. To add it, see [this documentation](https://react.dev/learn/react-compiler/installation).

## Expanding the ESLint configuration

If you are developing a production application, we recommend updating the configuration to enable type-aware lint rules:

```js
export default defineConfig([
  globalIgnores(['dist']),
  {
    files: ['**/*.{ts,tsx}'],
    extends: [
      // Other configs...

      // Remove tseslint.configs.recommended and replace with this
      tseslint.configs.recommendedTypeChecked,
      // Alternatively, use this for stricter rules
      tseslint.configs.strictTypeChecked,
      // Optionally, add this for stylistic rules
      tseslint.configs.stylisticTypeChecked,

      // Other configs...
    ],
    languageOptions: {
      parserOptions: {
        project: ['./tsconfig.node.json', './tsconfig.app.json'],
        tsconfigRootDir: import.meta.dirname,
      },
      // other options...
    },
  },
])
```

You can also install [eslint-plugin-react-x](https://github.com/Rel1cx/eslint-react/tree/main/packages/plugins/eslint-plugin-react-x) and [eslint-plugin-react-dom](https://github.com/Rel1cx/eslint-react/tree/main/packages/plugins/eslint-plugin-react-dom) for React-specific lint rules:

```js
// eslint.config.js
import reactX from 'eslint-plugin-react-x'
import reactDom from 'eslint-plugin-react-dom'

export default defineConfig([
  globalIgnores(['dist']),
  {
    files: ['**/*.{ts,tsx}'],
    extends: [
      // Other configs...
      // Enable lint rules for React
      reactX.configs['recommended-typescript'],
      // Enable lint rules for React DOM
      reactDom.configs.recommended,
    ],
    languageOptions: {
      parserOptions: {
        project: ['./tsconfig.node.json', './tsconfig.app.json'],
        tsconfigRootDir: import.meta.dirname,
      },
      // other options...
    },
  },
])
```

export default function App() {
  const [sidebarOpen, setSidebarOpen] = useState(false)
  const [isDark, setIsDark] = useState(() => {
    const stored = localStorage.getItem('theme')
    if (stored) return stored === 'dark'
    return window.matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)').matches
  })

  useEffect(() => {
    if (isDark) {
      document.documentElement.classList.add('dark')
      localStorage.setItem('theme', 'dark')
    } else {
      document.documentElement.classList.remove('dark')
      localStorage.setItem('theme', 'light')
    }
  }, [isDark])

  const location = useLocation()

  const navItems = [
    { path: '/', label: 'Dashboard', icon: <DashboardIcon /> },
    { path: '/transactions', label: 'Transactions', icon: <TransactionsIcon /> },
    { path: '/categories', label: 'Categories', icon: <CategoriesIcon /> },
    { path: '/settings', label: 'Settings', icon: <SettingsIcon /> },
  ]

  return (
    <div style={{ display: 'flex', height: '100vh', overflow: 'hidden' }}>
      {sidebarOpen && (
        <div
          style={{
            position: 'fixed',
            inset: 0,
            background: 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3)',
            backdropFilter: 'blur(2px)',
            zIndex: 30,
          }}
          onClick={() => setSidebarOpen(false)}
          aria-hidden="true"
        />
      )}

      <aside className={`sidebar ${sidebarOpen ? 'open' : ''}`}>
        <div style={{ padding: '0 1.5rem 1.5rem', display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'space-between' }}>
          <span style={{ fontSize: '1.25rem', fontWeight: 700, background: 'linear-gradient(135deg, var(--accent), var(--accent-light))', WebkitBackgroundClip: 'text', WebkitTextFillColor: 'transparent' }}>💎 Budget</span>
        </div>

        <nav style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: '0.25rem', padding: '0 0.75rem', flex: 1 }}>
          {navItems.map((item) => (
            <Link
              key={item.path}
              to={item.path}
              className={`nav-item ${location.pathname === item.path ? 'active' : ''}`}
              onClick={() => setSidebarOpen(false)}
            >
              {item.icon}
              {item.label}
            </Link>
          ))}
        </nav>
      </aside>

      <div className="main-content" style={{ flex: 1, display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', minHeight: '100vh', overflow: 'hidden' }}>
        <header className="header">
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: '1rem' }}>
            <button
              type="button"
              className="btn-icon"
              onClick={() => setSidebarOpen(true)}
              aria-label="Open sidebar"
            >
              <MenuIcon />
            </button>
            <h1 style={{ fontSize: '1.125rem', fontWeight: 600, margin: 0, lineHeight: 1.2 }}>Budget Tracker</h1>
          </div>

          <button
            type="button"
            className="btn-icon"
            onClick={() => setIsDark((d) => !d)}
            aria-label="Toggle theme"
            title="Toggle theme"
          >
            {isDark ? <SunIcon /> : <MoonIcon />}
          </button>
        </header>

        <main style={{ flex: 1, overflowY: 'auto' }}>
          <Outlet />
        </main>
      </div>
    </div>
  )
}

--- FILE: webtest13/Budget/src/utils/format.ts ---

export const formatCurrency = (
  amount: number,
  currency = 'USD',
  locale = 'en-US'
): string => {
  return new Intl.NumberFormat(locale, {
    style: 'currency',
    currency,
    minimumFractionDigits: 2,
    maximumFractionDigits: 2,
  }).format(amount)
}

export const formatDate = (
  date: string | Date,
  options: Intl.DateTimeFormatOptions = {
    year: 'numeric',
    month: 'short',
    day: 'numeric',
  },
  locale = 'en-US'
): string => {
  const d = typeof date === 'string' ? new Date(date) : date
  return new Intl.DateTimeFormat(locale, options).format(d)
}

export const formatShortDate = (date: string | Date, locale = 'en-US'): string => {
  const d = typeof date === 'string' ? new Date(date) : date
  return new Intl.DateTimeFormat(locale, {
    month: 'short',
    day: 'numeric',
  }).format(d)
}

export const formatMonthYear = (date: string | Date, locale = 'en-US'): string => {
  const d = typeof date === 'string' ? new Date(date) : date
  return new Intl.DateTimeFormat(locale, {
    month: 'short',
    year: 'numeric',
  }).format(d)
}

export const toDateInputValue = (date: string | Date): string => {
  const d = typeof date === 'string' ? new Date(date) : date
  const year = d.getFullYear()
  const month = String(d.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0')
  const day = String(d.getDate()).padStart(2, '0')
  return `${year}-${month}-${day}`
}

export const formatNumber = (value: number, locale = 'en-US'): string => {
  return new Intl.NumberFormat(locale, {
    minimumFractionDigits: 2,
    maximumFractionDigits: 2,
  }).format(value)
}

--- FILE: webtest13/Budget/src/utils/storage.ts ---

export interface Transaction {
  id: string
  date: string
  amount: number
  categoryId: string
  type: 'income' | 'expense'
  note?: string
}

export interface Category {
  id: string
  name: string
  color?: string
}

export interface PersistedState {
  transactions: Transaction[]
  categories: Category[]
}

const STORAGE_KEY = 'budget-data'

export const load = (): PersistedState => {
  try {
    const raw = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY)
    if (raw) {
      return JSON.parse(raw) as PersistedState
    }
  } catch {}
  return { transactions: [], categories: [] }
}

export const save = (state: PersistedState): void => {
  try {
    localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(state))
  } catch {}
}

export const exportToJSON = (state: PersistedState): void => {
  const blob = new Blob([JSON.stringify(state, null, 2)], { type: 'application/json' })
  const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob)
  const a = document.createElement('a')
  a.href = url
  a.download = `budget-backup-${new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0]}.json`
  a.click()
  URL.revokeObjectURL(url)
}

export const importFromJSON = (file: File): Promise<PersistedState> => {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const reader = new FileReader()
    reader.onload = (e) => {
      try {
        const result = JSON.parse(e.target?.result as string) as PersistedState
        resolve(result)
      } catch {
        reject(new Error('Invalid JSON file'))
      }
    }
    reader.onerror = () => reject(new Error('Failed to read file'))
    reader.readAsText(file)
  })
}

--- FILE: webtest13/Budget/src/components/ui/Button.tsx ---

import { ButtonHTMLAttributes, ReactNode } from 'react'

interface ButtonProps extends ButtonHTMLAttributes<HTMLButtonElement> {
  children?: ReactNode
  variant?: 'primary' | 'danger' | 'ghost' | 'icon'
}

export default function Button({
  children,
  variant = 'primary',
  className = '',
  ...props
}: ButtonProps) {
  const base =
    variant === 'icon'
      ? 'btn-icon'
      : variant === 'primary'
      ? 'btn btn-primary'
      : variant === 'danger'
      ? 'btn btn-danger'
      : 'btn btn-ghost'

  return (
    <button type="button" className={`${base} ${className}`.trim()} {...props}>
      {children}
    </button>
  )
}

--- FILE: webtest13/Budget/src/components/ui/Input.tsx ---

import { InputHTMLAttributes, useState, forwardRef } from 'react'

interface InputProps extends InputHTMLAttributes<HTMLInputElement> {
  label: string
}

const Input = forwardRef<HTMLInputElement, InputProps>(
  ({ label, className = '', style, value, defaultValue, onFocus, onBlur, ...props }, ref) => {
    const [isFocused, setIsFocused] = useState(false)
    const hasValue = String(value ?? defaultValue ?? '').length > 0
    const isFloating = isFocused || hasValue

    return (
      <div
        className={className}
        style={{
          position: 'relative',
          width: '100%',
          ...style,
        }}
      >
        <label
          style={{
            position: 'absolute',
            left: '1rem',
            top: isFloating ? '0.5rem' : '50%',
            transform: isFloating ? 'translateY(0)' : 'translateY(-50%)',
            fontSize: isFloating ? '0.75rem' : '0.9375rem',
            fontWeight: isFloating ? 600 : 400,
            color: isFocused ? 'var(--accent)' : 'var(--text-muted)',
            transition: 'all 0.2s ease',
            pointerEvents: 'none',
            lineHeight: 1,
          }}
        >
          {label}
        </label>
        <input
          ref={ref}
          value={value}
          defaultValue={defaultValue}
          onFocus={(e) => {
            setIsFocused(true)
            onFocus?.(e)
          }}
          onBlur={(e) => {
            setIsFocused(false)
            onBlur?.(e)
          }}
          style={{
            width: '100%',
            padding: isFloating ? '1.375rem 1rem 0.5rem' : '0.875rem 1rem',
            fontSize: '0.9375rem',
            fontFamily: 'inherit',
            color: 'var(--text-main)',
            background: 'var(--glass-bg)',
            backdropFilter: 'blur(12px)',
            WebkitBackdropFilter: 'blur(12px)',
            border: `1px solid ${isFocused ? 'var(--accent)' : 'var(--glass-border)'}`,
            borderRadius: 'var(--radius-md)',
            outline: 'none',
            boxShadow: isFocused ? '0 0 0 3px var(--accent-bg)' : 'none',
            transition: 'all 0.2s ease',
            boxSizing: 'border-box',
          }}
          {...props}
        />
      </div>
    )
  }
)

Input.displayName = 'Input'

export default Input

import { Transaction, useBudgetStore } from '../../store/budgetStore'
import { formatCurrency, formatDate } from '../../utils/format'

interface TransactionTableProps {
  transactions: Transaction[]
  onEdit: (transaction: Transaction) => void
  onDelete: (id: string) => void
}

const EditIcon = () => (
  <svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2" strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round">
    <path d="M11 4H4a2 2 0 0 0-2 2v14a2 2 0 0 0 2 2h14a2 2 0 0 0 2-2v-7" />
    <path d="M18.5 2.5a2.121 2.121 0 0 1 3 3L12 15l-4 1 1-4 9.5-9.5z" />
  </svg>
)

const DeleteIcon = () => (
  <svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2" strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round">
    <polyline points="3 6 5 6 21 6" />
    <path d="M19 6v14a2 2 0 0 1-2 2H7a2 2 0 0 1-2-2V6m3 0V4a2 2 0 0 1 2-2h4a2 2 0 0 1 2 2v2" />
    <line x1="10" y1="11" x2="10" y2="17" />
    <line x1="14" y1="11" x2="14" y2="17" />
  </svg>
)

export default function TransactionTable({ transactions, onEdit, onDelete }: TransactionTableProps) {
  const categories = useBudgetStore((state) => state.categories)

  const getCategory = (categoryId: string) =>
    categories.find((c) => c.id === categoryId)

  if (transactions.length === 0) {
    return (
      <div style={{ textAlign: 'center', padding: '3rem 1rem', color: 'var(--text-muted)', fontSize: '0.9375rem' }}>
        No transactions yet.
      </div>
    )
  }

  return (
    <div style={{ overflowX: 'auto' }}>
      <table>
        <thead>
          <tr>
            <th>Date</th>
            <th>Category</th>
            <th>Note</th>
            <th>Type</th>
            <th style={{ textAlign: 'right' }}>Amount</th>
            <th style={{ textAlign: 'right', width: '100px' }}>Actions</th>
          </tr>
        </thead>
        <tbody>
          {transactions.map((t) => {
            const category = getCategory(t.categoryId)
            return (
              <tr key={t.id}>
                <td>{formatDate(t.date)}</td>
                <td>
                  <span style={{ display: 'inline-flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: '0.5rem' }}>
                    {category?.color && (
                      <span
                        style={{
                          width: '8px',
                          height: '8px',
                          borderRadius: '50%',
                          background: category.color,
                          display: 'inline-block',
                        }}
                      />
                    )}
                    {category?.name ?? 'Uncategorized'}
                  </span>
                </td>
                <td style={{ color: 'var(--text-muted)' }}>{t.note || '—'}</td>
                <td>
                  <span
                    style={{
                      display: 'inline-block',
                      padding: '0.25rem 0.5rem',
                      borderRadius: 'var(--radius-sm)',
                      fontSize: '0.75rem',
                      fontWeight: 600,
                      textTransform: 'capitalize',
                      background: t.type === 'income' ? 'var(--success-bg)' : 'var(--danger-bg)',
                      color: t.type === 'income' ? 'var(--success)' : 'var(--danger)',
                    }}
                  >
                    {t.type}
                  </span>
                </td>
                <td
                  style={{
                    textAlign: 'right',
                    fontWeight: 600,
                    color: t.type === 'income' ? 'var(--success)' : 'var(--danger)',
                  }}
                >
                  {t.type === 'income' ? '+' : '-'}
                  {formatCurrency(Math.abs(t.amount))}
                </td>
                <td style={{ textAlign: 'right' }}>
                  <div style={{ display: 'inline-flex', gap: '0.5rem' }}>
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      className="btn-icon"
                      onClick={() => onEdit(t)}
                      aria-label="Edit transaction"
                      title="Edit"
                    >
                      <EditIcon />
                    </button>
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      className="btn-icon"
                      onClick={() => onDelete(t.id)}
                      aria-label="Delete transaction"
                      title="Delete"
                      style={{ color: 'var(--danger)' }}
                    >
                      <DeleteIcon />
                    </button>
                  </div>
                </td>
              </tr>
            )
          })}
        </tbody>
      </table>

  )
}

--- FILE: webtest13/Budget/src/components/forms/CategoryForm.tsx ---

import { useState, useEffect } from 'react'
import { Category } from '../../store/budgetStore'
import Input from '../ui/Input'
import Button from '../ui/Button'

interface CategoryFormProps {
  initialData?: Partial<Category>
  onSubmit: (data: Omit<Category, 'id'>) => void
  onCancel?: () => void
}

type FormData = Omit<Category, 'id'>

const defaultFormData: FormData = {
  name: '',
  color: '',
}

export default function CategoryForm({ initialData, onSubmit, onCancel }: CategoryFormProps) {
  const [formData, setFormData] = useState<FormData>(defaultFormData)

  useEffect(() => {
    if (initialData) {
      setFormData({
        name: initialData.name ?? '',
        color: initialData.color ?? '',
      })
    } else {
      setFormData(defaultFormData)
    }
  }, [initialData])

  const updateField = <K extends keyof FormData>(key: K, value: FormData[K]) => {
    setFormData((prev) => ({ ...prev, [key]: value } as FormData))
  }

  const handleSubmit = (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault()
    if (!formData.name.trim()) return
    onSubmit({
      name: formData.name.trim(),
      color: formData.color?.trim() || undefined,
    })
  }

  return (
    <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: '0.75rem' }}>
      <Input
        label="Category Name"
        type="text"
        value={formData.name}
        onChange={(e) => updateField('name', e.target.value)}
        required
      />
      <Input
        label="Color"
        type="text"
        value={formData.color}
        onChange={(e) => updateField('color', e.target.value)}
      />
      <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: '0.75rem', justifyContent: 'flex-end', marginTop: '0.5rem' }}>
        {onCancel && (
          <Button type="button" variant="ghost" onClick={onCancel}>
            Cancel
          </Button>
        )}
        <Button type="submit" variant="primary">
          {initialData ? 'Update' : 'Add'} Category
        </Button>
      </div>
    </form>
  )
}

import { useState, useEffect } from 'react'
import { useBudgetStore, Transaction } from '../../store/budgetStore'
import Input from '../ui/Input'
import Button from '../ui/Button'
import { toDateInputValue } from '../../utils/format'

interface TransactionFormProps {
  initialData?: Partial<Transaction>
  onSubmit: (data: Omit<Transaction, 'id'>) => void
  onCancel?: () => void
}

type FormData = Omit<Transaction, 'id'>

const defaultFormData: FormData = {
  date: toDateInputValue(new Date()),
  amount: 0,
  categoryId: '',
  type: 'expense',
  note: '',
}

export default function TransactionForm({ initialData, onSubmit, onCancel }: TransactionFormProps) {
  const categories = useBudgetStore((state) => state.categories)
  const [formData, setFormData] = useState<FormData>(defaultFormData)

  useEffect(() => {
    if (initialData) {
      setFormData({
        date: initialData.date ? toDateInputValue(initialData.date) : defaultFormData.date,
        amount: initialData.amount ?? 0,
        categoryId: initialData.categoryId ?? '',
        type: initialData.type ?? 'expense',
        note: initialData.note ?? '',
      })
    } else {
      setFormData(defaultFormData)
    }
  }, [initialData])

  const updateField = <K extends keyof FormData>(key: K, value: FormData[K]) => {
    setFormData((prev) => ({ ...prev, [key]: value } as FormData))
  }

  const handleSubmit = (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault()
    if (!formData.categoryId || formData.amount <= 0) return
    onSubmit(formData)
    if (!initialData) {
      setFormData(defaultFormData)
    }
  }

  return (
    <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: '1rem', width: '100%' }}>
      <div style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: '1fr 1fr', gap: '1rem' }}>
        <Input
          label="Date"
          type="date"
          value={formData.date}
          onChange={(e) => updateField('date', e.target.value)}
          required
        />
        <Input
          label="Amount"
          type="number"
          step="0.01"
          min="0.01"
          value={formData.amount}
          onChange={(e) => {
            const val = parseFloat(e.target.value)
            updateField('amount', isNaN(val) ? 0 : val)
          }}
          required
        />
      </div>

      <div style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: '1fr 1fr', gap: '1rem' }}>
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: '0.5rem' }}>
          <span style={{ fontSize: '0.75rem', fontWeight: 600, color: 'var(--text-muted)', textTransform: 'uppercase', letterSpacing: '0.05em' }}>
            Type
          </span>
          <div style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: '1fr 1fr', gap: '0.5rem' }}>
            <Button
              type="button"
              variant={formData.type === 'expense' ? 'primary' : 'ghost'}
              onClick={() => updateField('type', 'expense')}
            >
              Expense
            </Button>
            <Button
              type="button"
              variant={formData.type === 'income' ? 'primary' : 'ghost'}
              onClick={() => updateField('type', 'income')}
            >
              Income
            </Button>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div style={{ position: 'relative', width: '100%' }}>
          <label
            style={{
              position: 'absolute',
              left: '1rem',
              top: '0.5rem',
              fontSize: '0.75rem',
              fontWeight: 600,
              color: 'var(--text-muted)',
              pointerEvents: 'none',
              lineHeight: 1,
              textTransform: 'uppercase',
              letterSpacing: '0.05em',
            }}
          >
            Category
          </label>
          <select
            value={formData.categoryId}
            onChange={(e) => updateField('categoryId', e.target.value)}
            required
            style={{
              width: '100%',
              padding: '1.375rem 1rem 0.5rem',
              fontSize: '0.9375rem',
              fontFamily: 'inherit',
              color: formData.categoryId ? 'var(--text-main)' : 'var(--text-muted)',
              background: 'var(--glass-bg)',
              backdropFilter: 'blur(12px)',
              WebkitBackdropFilter: 'blur(12px)',
              border: '1px solid var(--glass-border)',
              borderRadius: 'var(--radius-md)',
              outline: 'none',
              boxShadow: 'none',
              transition: 'all 0.2s ease',
              boxSizing: 'border-box',
              appearance: 'none',
              cursor: 'pointer',
            }}
          >
            <option value="" disabled>
              Select category
            </option>
            {categories.map((cat) => (
              <option key={cat.id} value={cat.id}>
                {cat.name}
              </option>
            ))}
          </select>
          <svg
            width="12"
            height="12"
            viewBox="0 0 24 24"
            fill="none"
            stroke="currentColor"
            strokeWidth="3"
            strokeLinecap="round"
            strokeLinejoin="round"
            style={{
              position: 'absolute',
              right: '1rem',
              top: '50%',
              transform: 'translateY(-50%)',
              pointerEvents: 'none',
              color: 'var(--text-muted)',
              marginTop: '0.25rem',
            }}
          >
            <polyline points="6 9 12 15 18 9" />
          </svg>
        </div>
      </div>

      <Input
        label="Note"
        type="text"
        value={formData.note}
        onChange={(e) => updateField('note', e.target.value)}
      />

      <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: '0.75rem', justifyContent: 'flex-end', marginTop: '0.5rem' }}>
        {onCancel && (
          <Button type="button" variant="ghost" onClick={onCancel}>
            Cancel
          </Button>
        )}
        <Button type="submit" variant="primary">
          {initialData ? 'Update' : 'Add'} Transaction
        </Button>
      </div>
    </form>
  )
}
