--- FILE: webtest13/Budget/src/components/charts/ExpenseChart.tsx ---

import { useState, useMemo } from 'react'
import { useBudgetStore } from '../../store/budgetStore'
import { formatCurrency } from '../../utils/format'
import Card from '../ui/Card'

interface TooltipState {
  visible: boolean
  x: number
  y: number
  name: string
  value: number
  percentage: number
}

function polarToCartesian(cx: number, cy: number, radius: number, angleInDegrees: number) {
  const angleInRadians = ((angleInDegrees - 90) * Math.PI) / 180.0
  return {
    x: cx + radius * Math.cos(angleInRadians),
    y: cy + radius * Math.sin(angleInRadians),
  }
}

function describeArc(
  cx: number,
  cy: number,
  radius: number,
  innerRadius: number,
  startAngle: number,
  endAngle: number
) {
  const start = polarToCartesian(cx, cy, radius, endAngle)
  const end = polarToCartesian(cx, cy, radius, startAngle)
  const startInner = polarToCartesian(cx, cy, innerRadius, endAngle)
  const endInner = polarToCartesian(cx, cy, innerRadius, startAngle)

  const largeArcFlag = endAngle - startAngle <= 180 ? 0 : 1

  return [
    'M', start.x, start.y,
    'A', radius, radius, 0, largeArcFlag, 0, end.x, end.y,
    'L', endInner.x, endInner.y,
    'A', innerRadius, innerRadius, 0, largeArcFlag, 1, startInner.x, startInner.y,
    'Z',
  ].join(' ')
}

const FALLBACK_COLORS = [
  'var(--chart-1)',
  'var(--chart-2)',
  'var(--chart-3)',
  'var(--chart-4)',
  'var(--chart-5)',
  'var(--chart-6)',
]

export default function ExpenseChart() {
  const transactions = useBudgetStore((state) => state.transactions)
  const categories = useBudgetStore((state) => state.categories)
  const [tooltip, setTooltip] = useState<TooltipState>({
    visible: false,
    x: 0,
    y: 0,
    name: '',
    value: 0,
    percentage: 0,
  })
  const [activeIndex, setActiveIndex] = useState<number | null>(null)

  const data = useMemo(() => {
    const expenseTransactions = transactions.filter((t) => t.type === 'expense')
    const totalExpenses = expenseTransactions.reduce((sum, t) => sum + t.amount, 0)

    if (totalExpenses === 0) return { items: [] as Array<{ categoryId: string; name: string; color: string; value: number; percentage: number }>, total: 0 }

    const categoryTotals = new Map<string, number>()
    expenseTransactions.forEach((t) => {
      categoryTotals.set(t.categoryId, (categoryTotals.get(t.categoryId) || 0) + t.amount)
    })

    const items = Array.from(categoryTotals.entries()).map(([categoryId, value], index) => {
      const category = categories.find((c) => c.id === categoryId)
      return {
        categoryId,
        name: category?.name || 'Uncategorized',
        color: category?.color || FALLBACK_COLORS[index % FALLBACK_COLORS.length],
        value,
        percentage: (value / totalExpenses) * 100,
      }
    })

    items.sort((a, b) => b.value - a.value)
    return { items, total: totalExpenses }
  }, [transactions, categories])

  const chartPaths = useMemo(() => {
    if (data.items.length === 0) return []
    let currentAngle = 0
    return data.items.map((item) => {
      const angle = (item.value / data.total) * 360
      const startAngle = currentAngle
      const endAngle = currentAngle + angle
      currentAngle = endAngle
      return {
        ...item,
        startAngle,
        endAngle,
        d: describeArc(100, 100, 85, 65, startAngle, endAngle),
      }
    })
  }, [data])

  const handleMouseEnter = (
    e: React.MouseEvent,
    item: (typeof chartPaths)[number],
    index: number
  ) => {
    setActiveIndex(index)
    setTooltip({
      visible: true,
      x: e.clientX,
      y: e.clientY,
      name: item.name,
      value: item.value,
      percentage: item.percentage,
    })
  }

  const handleMouseMove = (e: React.MouseEvent) => {
    setTooltip((prev) => ({ ...prev, x: e.clientX, y: e.clientY + 12 }))
  }

  const handleMouseLeave = () => {
    setActiveIndex(null)
    setTooltip((prev) => ({ ...prev, visible: false }))
  }

  return (
    <Card>
      <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'space-between', marginBottom: '1.25rem' }}>
        <h3 style={{ margin: 0, fontSize: '1rem', fontWeight: 600, color: 'var(--text-main)' }}>
          Expense Breakdown
        </h3>
      </div>

      <div style={{ position: 'relative', display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center' }}>
        <svg
          viewBox="0 0 200 200"
          style={{ width: '100%', maxWidth: 280, height: 'auto', transform: 'rotate(-90deg)', transformOrigin: 'center' }}
        >
          {chartPaths.length === 0 && (
            <circle cx="100" cy="100" r="75" fill="none" stroke="var(--glass-border)" strokeWidth="20" />
          )}
          {chartPaths.map((item, index) => (
            <path
              key={item.categoryId}
              d={item.d}
              fill={item.color}
              stroke="var(--bg-raised)"
              strokeWidth="2"
              style={{
                cursor: 'pointer',
                opacity: activeIndex === null || activeIndex === index ? 1 : 0.4,
                transition: 'opacity 0.2s ease',
              }}
              onMouseEnter={(e) => handleMouseEnter(e, item, index)}
              onMouseMove={handleMouseMove}
              onMouseLeave={handleMouseLeave}
            />
          ))}
        </svg>

        <div
          style={{
            position: 'absolute',
            inset: 0,
            display: 'flex',
            flexDirection: 'column',
            alignItems: 'center',
            justifyContent: 'center',
            pointerEvents: 'none',
          }}
        >
          <span style={{ fontSize: '0.875rem', color: 'var(--text-muted)' }}>Total Expenses</span>
          <span style={{ fontSize: '1.5rem', fontWeight: 700, color: 'var(--text-main)' }}>
            {formatCurrency(data.total)}
          </span>
        </div>
      </div>

      {data.items.length > 0 && (
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: '0.75rem', marginTop: '1.5rem' }}>
          {data.items.map((item) => (
            <div
              key={item.categoryId}
              style={{
                display: 'flex',
                alignItems: 'center',
                justifyContent: 'space-between',
                fontSize: '0.9375rem',
              }}
            >
              <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: '0.5rem' }}>
                <span
                  style={{
                    width: 10,
                    height: 10,
                    borderRadius: '50%',
                    background: item.color,
                    flexShrink: 0,
                  }}
                />
                <span style={{ color: 'var(--text-main)' }}>{item.name}</span>
              </div>
              <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: '0.75rem' }}>
                <span style={{ color: 'var(--text-muted)', fontSize: '0.875rem' }}>
                  {item.percentage.toFixed(1)}%
                </span>
                <span style={{ fontWeight: 600, color: 'var(--text-main)', minWidth: 80, textAlign: 'right' }}>
                  {formatCurrency(item.value)}
                </span>
              </div>
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
      )}

      {tooltip.visible && (
        <div
          style={{
            position: 'fixed',
            left: tooltip.x,
            top: tooltip.y,
            background: 'var(--bg-raised)',
            border: '1px solid var(--glass-border)',
            borderRadius: 'var(--radius-md)',
            padding: '0.5rem 0.75rem',
            boxShadow: 'var(--shadow-lg)',
            pointerEvents: 'none',
            zIndex: 9999,
            fontSize: '0.875rem',
          }}
        >
          <div style={{ fontWeight: 600, color: 'var(--text-main)', marginBottom: '0.25rem' }}>
            {tooltip.name}
          </div>
          <div style={{ color: 'var(--text-muted)' }}>
            {formatCurrency(tooltip.value)} ({tooltip.percentage.toFixed(1)}%)
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </Card>
  )
}

import { useBudgetStore } from '../../store/budgetStore'

import Card from '../ui/Card'

interface TooltipState {
  visible: boolean
  x: number
  y: number
  name: string
  value: number
  percentage: number
}

function polarToCartesian(cx: number, cy: number, radius: number, angleInDegrees: number) {
  const angleInRadians = ((angleInDegrees - 90) * Math.PI) / 180.0
  return {
    x: cx + radius * Math.cos(angleInRadians),
    y: cy + radius * Math.sin(angleInRadians),
  }
}

function describeArc(
  cx: number,
  cy: number,
  radius: number,
  innerRadius: number,
  startAngle: number,
  endAngle: number
) {
  const start = polarToCartesian(cx, cy, radius, endAngle)
  const end = polarToCartesian(cx, cy, radius, startAngle)
  const startInner = polarToCartesian(cx, cy, innerRadius, endAngle)
  const endInner = polarToCartesian(cx, cy, innerRadius, startAngle)

  const largeArcFlag = endAngle - startAngle <= 180 ? 0 : 1

  return [
    'M', start.x, start.y,
    'A', radius, radius, 0, largeArcFlag, 0, end.x, end.y,
    'L', endInner.x, endInner.y,
    'A', innerRadius, innerRadius, 0, largeArcFlag, 1, startInner.x, startInner.y,
    'Z',
  ].join(' ')
}

const FALLBACK_COLORS = [
  'var(--chart-1)',
  'var(--chart-2)',
  'var(--chart-3)',
  'var(--chart-4)',
  'var(--chart-5)',
  'var(--chart-6)',
]

export default function IncomeChart() {
  const transactions = useBudgetStore((state) => state.transactions)
  const categories = useBudgetStore((state) => state.categories)
  const [tooltip, setTooltip] = useState<TooltipState>({
    visible: false,
    x: 0,
    y: 0,
    name: '',
    value: 0,
    percentage: 0,
  })

  const incomeTransactions = useMemo(
    () => transactions.filter((t) => t.type === 'income'),
    [transactions]
  )

  const data = useMemo(() => {
    const map = new Map<string, number>()
    incomeTransactions.forEach((t) => {
      map.set(t.categoryId, (map.get(t.categoryId) ?? 0) + t.amount)
    })
    return Array.from(map.entries())
      .map(([categoryId, value]) => {
        const cat = categories.find((c) => c.id === categoryId)
        return {
          name: cat?.name ?? 'Uncategorized',
          color: cat?.color,
          value,
        }
      })
      .sort((a, b) => b.value - a.value)
  }, [incomeTransactions, categories])

  const total = useMemo(
    () => data.reduce((sum, item) => sum + item.value, 0),
    [data]
  )

  const segments = useMemo(() => {
    if (total === 0) return []
    let currentAngle = 0
    return data.map((item) => {
      const angle = (item.value / total) * 360
      const segment = {
        ...item,
        startAngle: currentAngle,
        endAngle: currentAngle + angle,
      }
      currentAngle += angle
      return segment
    })
  }, [data, total])

  const handleMouseMove = (
    e: React.MouseEvent,
    item: { name: string; value: number }
  ) => {
    const percentage = total > 0 ? (item.value / total) * 100 : 0
    setTooltip({
      visible: true,
      x: e.clientX + 12,
      y: e.clientY - 12,
      name: item.name,
      value: item.value,
      percentage,
    })
  }

  const handleMouseLeave = () => {
    setTooltip((prev) => ({ ...prev, visible: false }))
  }

  if (total === 0) {
    return (
      <Card>
        <h3 style={{ margin: '0 0 1rem', fontSize: '1rem', fontWeight: 600, color: 'var(--text-main)' }}>
          Income by Category
        </h3>

          No income data available.
        </div>
      </Card>
    )
  }

  return (
    <Card>
      <h3 style={{ margin: '0 0 1rem', fontSize: '1rem', fontWeight: 600, color: 'var(--text-main)' }}>
        Income by Category
      </h3>

          {segments.map((seg, i) => (
            <path
              key={i}
              d={describeArc(100, 100, 80, 55, seg.startAngle, seg.endAngle)}
              fill={seg.color ?? FALLBACK_COLORS[i % FALLBACK_COLORS.length]}
              stroke="var(--bg-raised)"
              strokeWidth={2}
              style={{ cursor: 'pointer' }}
              onMouseMove={(e) => handleMouseMove(e, seg)}
              onMouseLeave={handleMouseLeave}
            />
          ))}
          <text
            x="100"
            y="96"
            textAnchor="middle"
            dominantBaseline="middle"
            style={{ fontSize: '0.875rem', fontWeight: 600, fill: 'var(--text-muted)' }}
          >
            Total

          <text
            x="100"
            y="114"

            style={{ fontSize: '1rem', fontWeight: 700, fill: 'var(--text-main)' }}
          >

            return (

--- FILE: webtest13/Budget/src/components/charts/NetChart.tsx ---

import { useState, useMemo } from 'react'
import { useBudgetStore } from '../../store/budgetStore'
import { formatCurrency, formatMonthYear } from '../../utils/format'
import Card from '../ui/Card'

export default function NetChart() {
  const transactions = useBudgetStore((state) => state.transactions)

  const data = useMemo(() => {
    const monthMap = new Map<string, { income: number; expense: number }>()
    transactions.forEach((t) => {
      const month = t.date.slice(0, 7)
      const curr = monthMap.get(month) ?? { income: 0, expense: 0 }
      if (t.type === 'income') {
        curr.income += t.amount
      } else {
        curr.expense += t.amount
      }
      monthMap.set(month, curr)
    })
    const months = Array.from(monthMap.keys()).sort()
    let running = 0
    return months.map((month) => {
      const val = monthMap.get(month)!
      running += val.income - val.expense
      const [y, m] = month.split('-')
      return {
        month,
        value: running,
        label: formatMonthYear(new Date(Number(y), Number(m) - 1, 1)),
      }
    })
  }, [transactions])

  const [tooltip, setTooltip] = useState<{
    x: number
    y: number
    label: string
    value: number
  } | null>(null)

  const width = 600
  const height = 300
  const margin = { top: 20, right: 30, bottom: 40, left: 70 }
  const innerWidth = width - margin.left - margin.right
  const innerHeight = height - margin.top - margin.bottom

  if (data.length === 0) {
    return (
      <Card>
        <h3 style={{ fontSize: '1.125rem', fontWeight: 600, margin: '0 0 1rem', color: 'var(--text-main)' }}>
          Net Balance Over Time
        </h3>
        <div style={{ textAlign: 'center', padding: '3rem 1rem', color: 'var(--text-muted)', fontSize: '0.9375rem' }}>
          No data available.
        </div>
      </Card>
    )
  }

  const getX = (i: number) => {
    if (data.length <= 1) return innerWidth / 2
    return (i / (data.length - 1)) * innerWidth
  }

  const values = data.map((d) => d.value)
  const minValue = Math.min(0, ...values)
  const maxValue = Math.max(0, ...values)
  const range = maxValue - minValue || 1

  const yScale = (v: number) => innerHeight - ((v - minValue) / range) * innerHeight

  const yTicks = 5
  const yTickValues = Array.from({ length: yTicks + 1 }, (_, i) => minValue + (range * i) / yTicks)

  const areaPath = [
    `M ${getX(0)} ${yScale(data[0].value)}`,
    ...data.map((d, i) => `L ${getX(i)} ${yScale(d.value)}`),
    `L ${getX(data.length - 1)} ${innerHeight}`,
    `L ${getX(0)} ${innerHeight}`,
    'Z',
  ].join(' ')

  const linePath = [
    `M ${getX(0)} ${yScale(data[0].value)}`,
    ...data.map((d, i) => `L ${getX(i)} ${yScale(d.value)}`),
  ].join(' ')

  const handleMouseMove = (e: React.MouseEvent<SVGSVGElement>) => {
    const rect = e.currentTarget.getBoundingClientRect()
    const svgX = e.clientX - rect.left - margin.left
    let index = 0
    if (data.length > 1) {
      const step = innerWidth / (data.length - 1)
      index = Math.round(svgX / step)
    }
    index = Math.max(0, Math.min(index, data.length - 1))
    const d = data[index]
    setTooltip({
      x: e.clientX + 12,
      y: e.clientY - 12,
      label: d.label,
      value: d.value,
    })
  }

  const handleMouseLeave = () => setTooltip(null)

  return (
    <Card>
      <h3 style={{ fontSize: '1.125rem', fontWeight: 600, margin: '0 0 1rem', color: 'var(--text-main)' }}>
        Net Balance Over Time
      </h3>
      <svg
        width="100%"
        height={height}
        viewBox={`0 0 ${width} ${height}`}
        onMouseMove={handleMouseMove}
        onMouseLeave={handleMouseLeave}
        style={{ overflow: 'visible' }}
      >
        <g transform={`translate(${margin.left},${margin.top})`}>
          {yTickValues.map((v, i) => (
            <line
              key={i}
              x1={0}
              y1={yScale(v)}
              x2={innerWidth}
              y2={yScale(v)}
              stroke="var(--glass-border)"
              strokeDasharray="4 4"
            />
          ))}
          <line x1={0} y1={innerHeight} x2={innerWidth} y2={innerHeight} stroke="var(--glass-border)" />
          <line x1={0} y1={0} x2={0} y2={innerHeight} stroke="var(--glass-border)" />

          {yTickValues.map((v, i) => (
            <text
              key={`yl-${i}`}
              x={-10}
              y={yScale(v)}
              textAnchor="end"
              dominantBaseline="middle"
              fill="var(--text-muted)"
              fontSize={10}
            >
              {formatCurrency(v)}
            </text>
          ))}

          {data.map((d, i) => (
            <text
              key={`xl-${i}`}
              x={getX(i)}
              y={innerHeight + 20}
              textAnchor="middle"
              fill="var(--text-muted)"
              fontSize={10}
            >
              {d.label}
            </text>
          ))}

          <path d={areaPath} fill="var(--accent-bg)" opacity={0.5} />
          <path
            d={linePath}
            fill="none"
            stroke="var(--accent)"
            strokeWidth={2.5}
            strokeLinejoin="round"
            strokeLinecap="round"
          />

          {data.map((d, i) => (
            <circle
              key={`dot-${i}`}
              cx={getX(i)}
              cy={yScale(d.value)}
              r={4}
              fill="var(--accent)"
              stroke="var(--bg-raised)"
              strokeWidth={2}
            />
          ))}
        </g>
      </svg>

      {tooltip && (
        <div
          style={{
            position: 'fixed',
            left: tooltip.x,
            top: tooltip.y,
            background: 'var(--bg-raised)',
            border: '1px solid var(--glass-border)',
            borderRadius: 'var(--radius-md)',
            padding: '0.5rem 0.75rem',
            boxShadow: 'var(--shadow-lg)',
            pointerEvents: 'none',
            zIndex: 9999,
            fontSize: '0.875rem',
          }}
        >
          <div style={{ fontWeight: 600, color: 'var(--text-main)', marginBottom: '0.25rem' }}>
            {tooltip.label}
          </div>
          <div style={{ color: 'var(--text-muted)' }}>
            {formatCurrency(tooltip.value)}
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </Card>
  )
}

--- FILE: webtest13/Budget/src/pages/Dashboard.tsx ---

import { useMemo } from 'react'
import { useBudgetStore } from '../store/budgetStore'
import { formatCurrency, formatDate } from '../utils/format'
import Card from '../components/ui/Card'
import ExpenseChart from '../components/charts/ExpenseChart'
import IncomeChart from '../components/charts/IncomeChart'
import NetChart from '../components/charts/NetChart'

export default function Dashboard() {
  const transactions = useBudgetStore((state) => state.transactions)
  const categories = useBudgetStore((state) => state.categories)

  const { totalIncome, totalExpense, netBalance } = useMemo(() => {
    let income = 0
    let expense = 0
    transactions.forEach((t) => {
      if (t.type === 'income') income += t.amount
      else expense += t.amount
    })
    return {
      totalIncome: income,
      totalExpense: expense,
      netBalance: income - expense,
    }
  }, [transactions])

  const recentTransactions = useMemo(() => {
    return [...transactions]
      .sort((a, b) => new Date(b.date).getTime() - new Date(a.date).getTime())
      .slice(0, 5)
  }, [transactions])

  const getCategoryName = (categoryId: string) => {
    return categories.find((c) => c.id === categoryId)?.name ?? 'Uncategorized'
  }

  return (
    <div style={{ padding: '1.5rem', display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: '1.5rem' }}>
      <div style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: 'repeat(auto-fit, minmax(200px, 1fr))', gap: '1rem' }}>
        <Card>
          <div style={{ fontSize: '0.875rem', color: 'var(--text-muted)', marginBottom: '0.5rem', fontWeight: 500 }}>Total Income</div>
          <div style={{ fontSize: '1.5rem', fontWeight: 700, color: 'var(--success)' }}>{formatCurrency(totalIncome)}</div>
        </Card>
        <Card>
          <div style={{ fontSize: '0.875rem', color: 'var(--text-muted)', marginBottom: '0.5rem', fontWeight: 500 }}>Total Expenses</div>
          <div style={{ fontSize: '1.5rem', fontWeight: 700, color: 'var(--danger)' }}>{formatCurrency(totalExpense)}</div>
        </Card>
        <Card>
          <div style={{ fontSize: '0.875rem', color: 'var(--text-muted)', marginBottom: '0.5rem', fontWeight: 500 }}>Net Balance</div>
          <div style={{ fontSize: '1.5rem', fontWeight: 700, color: netBalance >= 0 ? 'var(--success)' : 'var(--danger)' }}>{formatCurrency(netBalance)}</div>
        </Card>
        <Card>
          <div style={{ fontSize: '0.875rem', color: 'var(--text-muted)', marginBottom: '0.5rem', fontWeight: 500 }}>Transactions</div>
          <div style={{ fontSize: '1.5rem', fontWeight: 700, color: 'var(--text-main)' }}>{transactions.length}</div>
        </Card>
      </div>

      <div style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: 'repeat(auto-fit, minmax(300px, 1fr))', gap: '1.5rem' }}>
        <ExpenseChart />
        <IncomeChart />
      </div>

      <NetChart />

      <Card>
        <h2 style={{ margin: '0 0 1rem', fontSize: '1.125rem', fontWeight: 600, color: 'var(--text-main)' }}>Recent Transactions</h2>
        {recentTransactions.length === 0 ? (
          <div style={{ textAlign: 'center', padding: '2rem', color: 'var(--text-muted)' }}>No transactions yet.</div>
        ) : (
          <div style={{ overflowX: 'auto' }}>
            <table>
              <thead>
                <tr>
                  <th>Date</th>
                  <th>Category</th>
                  <th>Note</th>
                  <th style={{ textAlign: 'right' }}>Amount</th>
                </tr>
              </thead>
              <tbody>
                {recentTransactions.map((t) => (
                  <tr key={t.id}>
                    <td>{formatDate(t.date)}</td>
                    <td>{getCategoryName(t.categoryId)}</td>
                    <td>{t.note || '—'}</td>
                    <td style={{ textAlign: 'right', fontWeight: 600, color: t.type === 'income' ? 'var(--success)' : 'var(--danger)' }}>
                      {t.type === 'income' ? '+' : '-'}{formatCurrency(Math.abs(t.amount))}
                    </td>
                  </tr>
                ))}
              </tbody>
            </table>
          </div>
        )}
      </Card>
    </div>
  )
}

--- FILE: webtest13/Budget/src/pages/Settings.tsx ---

import { useState, useRef } from 'react'
import { useBudgetStore } from '../store/budgetStore'
import Card from '../components/ui/Card'
import Button from '../components/ui/Button'
import { exportToJSON, importFromJSON, save } from '../utils/storage'

export default function Settings() {
  const transactions = useBudgetStore((state) => state.transactions)
  const categories = useBudgetStore((state) => state.categories)
  const [currency, setCurrency] = useState(() => localStorage.getItem('currency') || 'USD')
  const [isDark, setIsDark] = useState(() => document.documentElement.classList.contains('dark'))
  const fileRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null)

  const handleThemeToggle = () => {
    const next = !isDark
    setIsDark(next)
    if (next) {
      document.documentElement.classList.add('dark')
    } else {
      document.documentElement.classList.remove('dark')
    }
    localStorage.setItem('theme', next ? 'dark' : 'light')
  }

  const handleExport = () => {
    exportToJSON({ transactions, categories })
  }

  const handleImportClick = () => {
    fileRef.current?.click()
  }

  const handleFileChange = async (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    const file = e.target.files?.[0]
    if (!file) return
    try {
      const data = await importFromJSON(file)
      save(data)
      window.location.reload()
    } catch {
      alert('Invalid JSON file')
    }
    if (fileRef.current) {
      fileRef.current.value = ''
    }
  }

  const handleClear = () => {
    if (window.confirm('Are you sure you want to clear all data? This cannot be undone.')) {
      save({ transactions: [], categories: [] })
      window.location.reload()
    }
  }

  const handleCurrencyChange = (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLSelectElement>) => {
    const val = e.target.value
    setCurrency(val)
    localStorage.setItem('currency', val)
  }

  return (
    <div style={{ padding: '1.5rem', display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: '1.5rem' }}>
      <h1 style={{ margin: 0, fontSize: '1.5rem', fontWeight: 700, color: 'var(--text-main)' }}>
        Settings
      </h1>

      <div style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: 'repeat(auto-fit, minmax(300px, 1fr))', gap: '1.5rem' }}>
        <Card>
          <h2 style={{ margin: '0 0 1rem', fontSize: '1.125rem', fontWeight: 600, color: 'var(--text-main)' }}>
            Appearance
          </h2>
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'space-between' }}>
            <span style={{ color: 'var(--text-muted)' }}>Dark Mode</span>
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={handleThemeToggle}
              style={{
                width: 48,
                height: 26,
                borderRadius: 13,
                background: isDark ? 'var(--accent)' : 'var(--glass-bg)',
                border: '1px solid var(--glass-border)',
                position: 'relative',
                cursor: 'pointer',
                transition: 'background 0.3s',
              }}
              aria-label="Toggle dark mode"
            >
              <span
                style={{
                  position: 'absolute',
                  top: 2,
                  left: isDark ? 26 : 2,
                  width: 20,
                  height: 20,
                  borderRadius: '50%',
                  background: 'var(--text-inverse)',
                  transition: 'left 0.3s',
                }}
              />
            </button>
          </div>
        </Card>

        <Card>
          <h2 style={{ margin: '0 0 1rem', fontSize: '1.125rem', fontWeight: 600, color: 'var(--text-main)' }}>
            Regional
          </h2>
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: '0.75rem' }}>
            <label style={{ fontSize: '0.875rem', color: 'var(--text-muted)', fontWeight: 500 }}>
              Currency
            </label>
            <select
              value={currency}
              onChange={handleCurrencyChange}
              style={{
                padding: '0.5rem 0.75rem',
                fontSize: '0.9375rem',
                fontFamily: 'inherit',
                color: 'var(--text-main)',
                background: 'var(--glass-bg)',
                border: '1px solid var(--glass-border)',
                borderRadius: 'var(--radius-md)',
                outline: 'none',
                cursor: 'pointer',
              }}
            >
              <option value="USD">USD — US Dollar</option>
              <option value="EUR">EUR — Euro</option>
              <option value="GBP">GBP — British Pound</option>
              <option value="JPY">JPY — Japanese Yen</option>
              <option value="CAD">CAD — Canadian Dollar</option>
              <option value="AUD">AUD — Australian Dollar</option>
            </select>
          </div>
        </Card>

        <Card>
          <h2 style={{ margin: '0 0 1rem', fontSize: '1.125rem', fontWeight: 600, color: 'var(--text-main)' }}>
            Data
          </h2>
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: '0.75rem' }}>
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: '0.75rem' }}>
              <Button variant="primary" onClick={handleExport}>
                Export JSON
              </Button>
              <Button variant="ghost" onClick={handleImportClick}>
                Import JSON
              </Button>
              <input
                ref={fileRef}
                type="file"
                accept=".json,application/json"
                onChange={handleFileChange}
                style={{ display: 'none' }}
              />
            </div>
            <div style={{ paddingTop: '0.5rem', borderTop: '1px solid var(--glass-border)' }}>
              <Button variant="danger" onClick={handleClear}>
                Clear All Data
              </Button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </Card>
      </div>
    </div>
  )
}

--- FILE: webtest13/Budget/src/store/budgetStore.ts ---

import { create } from 'zustand'

export interface Transaction {
  id: string
  date: string
  amount: number
  categoryId: string
  type: 'income' | 'expense'
  note?: string
}

export interface Category {
  id: string
  name: string
  color?: string
}

interface PersistedState {
  transactions: Transaction[]
  categories: Category[]
}

interface BudgetState extends PersistedState {
  addTransaction: (t: Omit<Transaction, 'id'>) => void
  updateTransaction: (id: string, t: Partial<Transaction>) => void
  deleteTransaction: (id: string) => void
  addCategory: (c: Omit<Category, 'id'>) => void
  updateCategory: (id: string, c: Partial<Category>) => void
  deleteCategory: (id: string) => void
}

const STORAGE_KEY = 'budget-data'

const load = (): Partial<PersistedState> => {
  try {
    const raw = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY)
    if (raw) {
      return JSON.parse(raw)
    }
  } catch {}
  return {}
}

const save = (state: PersistedState) => {
  try {
    localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(state))
  } catch {}
}

const initial = load()

export const useBudgetStore = create<BudgetState>((set) => ({
  transactions: initial.transactions ?? [],
  categories: initial.categories ?? [],
  addTransaction: (t) =>
    set((state) => {
      const transaction: Transaction = { ...t, id: crypto.randomUUID() }
      const next = { ...state, transactions: [...state.transactions, transaction] }
      save(next)
      return next
    }),
  updateTransaction: (id, t) =>
    set((state) => {
      const next = {
        ...state,
        transactions: state.transactions.map((tr) => (tr.id === id ? { ...tr, ...t } : tr)),
      }
      save(next)
      return next
    }),
  deleteTransaction: (id) =>
    set((state) => {
      const next = { ...state, transactions: state.transactions.filter((tr) => tr.id !== id) }
      save(next)
      return next
    }),
  addCategory: (c) =>
    set((state) => {
      const category: Category = { ...c, id: crypto.randomUUID() }
      const next = { ...state, categories: [...state.categories, category] }
      save(next)
      return next
    }),
  updateCategory: (id, c) =>
    set((state) => {
      const next = {
        ...state,
        categories: state.categories.map((cat) => (cat.id === id ? { ...cat, ...c } : cat)),
      }
      save(next)
      return next
    }),
  deleteCategory: (id) =>
    set((state) => {
      const next = { ...state, categories: state.categories.filter((cat) => cat.id !== id) }
      save(next)
      return next
    }),
}))

  <script>
    // === STATE ===
    let DATA = [];
    let filteredData = [];
    let charts = {};
    let sortCol = 'Create Date';
    let sortAsc = false;
    let currentPage = 0;
    const pageSize = 25;

    const AUDIT_ALERTS = [
      "225 records (6.9%) are flagged 'Contact unworked' — stagnant leads requiring immediate sales action",
      "Critical enrichment gaps: Email missing on 35.9% of records; Job Title missing on 78.8%, crippling persona-based routing",
      "Disqualification/Lost reason is blank for 42.5% of records, preventing loss-cohort analysis and feedback loops",
      "Systemic poor lead quality: Lead Fit Score mean is -9.05 with 75th percentile at -4.0; 98 outliers detected — review targeting and scoring model",
      "Deactivated user 'Niranjan Kumar (Deactivated User)' still assigned as owner on active records — reassign immediately",
      "Constant / zero-variance columns detected (Average Pageviews, Event Revenue, HubSpot Team, Prospecting Agent counts) — deprecate from analytics",
      "Phone Number field contains malformed, concatenated, and corrupted entries (e.g., mixed symbols and excessive digits) — data hygiene risk",
      "High multicollinearity redundancy: Number of Form Submissions, Sessions, and Unique Forms Submitted are nearly perfectly correlated (r > 0.97)"
    ];

    // === UTILS ===
    function isEmpty(v) {
      return v === null || v === undefined || v === '' || (typeof v === 'string' && v.trim() === '') || v === 'NaN';
    }
    function toNum(v) {
      if (isEmpty(v)) return null;
      const n = Number(v);
      return isNaN(n) ? null : n;
    }
    function toStr(v) {
      return isEmpty(v) ? '' : String(v).trim();
    }
    function parseDate(d) {
      if (isEmpty(d)) return null;
      const date = new Date(d);
      return isNaN(date.getTime()) ? null : date;
    }
    function fmtNum(n, digits = 0) {
      if (n === null || n === undefined || isNaN(n)) return '-';
      return Number(n).toLocaleString(undefined, { minimumFractionDigits: digits, maximumFractionDigits: digits });
    }
    function fmtPct(n) {
      if (n === null || n === undefined || isNaN(n)) return '-%';
      return (n * 100).toFixed(1) + '%';
    }
    function currentThemeMode() {
      return document.documentElement.classList.contains('dark') ? 'dark' : 'light';
    }
    function baseChartOptions() {
      return {
        theme: { mode: currentThemeMode() },
        chart: {
          background: 'transparent',
          toolbar: { show: false },
          animations: { enabled: true, easing: 'easeinout', speed: 600 }
        },
        dataLabels: { style: { colors: ['currentColor'] } },
        legend: { labels: { colors: 'currentColor' } }
      };
    }

    // === UPLOAD HANDLERS ===
    const dropZone = document.getElementById('dropZone');
    const fileInput = document.getElementById('fileInput');

    dropZone.addEventListener('click', () => fileInput.click());
    dropZone.addEventListener('dragover', e => { e.preventDefault(); dropZone.classList.add('drag-active'); });
    dropZone.addEventListener('dragleave', () => dropZone.classList.remove('drag-active'));
    dropZone.addEventListener('drop', e => { e.preventDefault(); dropZone.classList.remove('drag-active'); handleFiles(e.dataTransfer.files); });
    fileInput.addEventListener('change', e => handleFiles(e.target.files));

    async function handleFiles(files) {
      if (!files.length) return;
      DATA = [];
      const fileNames = [];
      let totalRows = 0;

      for (const file of files) {
        fileNames.push(file.name);
        const ext = file.name.split('.').pop().toLowerCase();
        if (ext === 'csv') {
          const text = await file.text();
          const parsed = Papa.parse(text, { header: true, skipEmptyLines: true });
          if (parsed.data && parsed.data.length) {
            DATA = DATA.concat(parsed.data);
            totalRows += parsed.data.length;
          }
        } else if (ext === 'xlsx' || ext === 'xls') {
          const buffer = await file.arrayBuffer();
          const workbook = XLSX.read(buffer, { type: 'array' });
          const firstSheet = workbook.SheetNames[0];
          if (firstSheet) {
            const json = XLSX.utils.sheet_to_json(workbook.Sheets[firstSheet]);
            DATA = DATA.concat(json);
            totalRows += json.length;
          }
        }
      }

      const statusEl = document.getElementById('uploadStatus');
      statusEl.classList.remove('hidden');
      statusEl.textContent = `✓ Loaded ${DATA.length} rows from ${fileNames.length} file(s): ${fileNames.join(', ')}`;

      setTimeout(() => {
        document.getElementById('uploadPhase').classList.add('hidden');
        document.getElementById('dashboardPhase').classList.remove('hidden');
        initDashboard();
      }, 700);
    }

    function resetData() {
      DATA = [];
      filteredData = [];
      Object.values(charts).forEach(c => c.destroy());
      charts = {};
      document.getElementById('dashboardPhase').classList.add('hidden');
      document.getElementById('uploadPhase').classList.remove('hidden');
      document.getElementById('uploadStatus').classList.add('hidden');
      document.getElementById('fileInput').value = '';
    }

    // === INIT ===
    function initDashboard() {
      renderAuditAlerts();
      buildFilters();
      applyFilters();
    }

    function renderAuditAlerts() {
      const container = document.getElementById('auditAlerts');
      container.innerHTML = AUDIT_ALERTS.map((text, i) => {
        const isCritical = i < 3;
        const border = isCritical ? 'border-red-500 dark:border-nova-danger' : 'border-amber-500 dark:border-nova-warning';
        return `<div class="glass p-3 border-l-4 ${border} text-xs leading-relaxed">
          <div class="flex items-center gap-2 mb-1">
            <span class="font-bold uppercase tracking-wider ${isCritical ? 'text-red-600 dark:text-red-400' : 'text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400'}">Alert ${i+1}</span>
          </div>
          <p class="opacity-90">${text}</p>
        </div>`;
      }).join('');
    }

    // === FILTERS ===
    function buildFilters() {
      const makeOpts = (col, id) => {
        const vals = [...new Set(DATA.map(d => toStr(d[col])).filter(Boolean))].sort();
        const sel = document.getElementById(id);
        // keep first option
        sel.innerHTML = `<option value="">${sel.options[0]?.text || 'All'}</option>`;
        vals.forEach(v => {
          const opt = document.createElement('option');
          opt.value = v;
          opt.textContent = v;
          sel.appendChild(opt);
        });
      };
      makeOpts('Contact owner', 'filterOwner');
      makeOpts('Original Traffic Source', 'filterChannel');
      makeOpts('Lead Qualification Status', 'filterStatus');
      makeOpts('Account Segment', 'filterSegment');

      // Date bounds
      const dates = DATA.map(d => parseDate(d['Create Date'])).filter(Boolean).sort((a,b) => a-b);
      if (dates.length) {
        const min = dates[0];
        const max = dates[dates.length-1];
        document.getElementById('filterDateFrom').valueAsDate = min;
        document.getElementById('filterDateTo').valueAsDate = max;
      }
    }

    function resetFilters() {
      buildFilters();
      applyFilters();
    }

    function applyFilters() {
      const fromVal = document.getElementById('filterDateFrom').value;
      const toVal = document.getElementById('filterDateTo').value;
      const owner = document.getElementById('filterOwner').value;
      const channel = document.getElementById('filterChannel').value;
      const status = document.getElementById('filterStatus').value;
      const segment = document.getElementById('filterSegment').value;

      const from = fromVal ? new Date(fromVal) : null;
      const to = toVal ? new Date(toVal) : null;
      if (to) to.setHours(23,59,59,999);

      filteredData = DATA.filter(rec => {
        const d = parseDate(rec['Create Date']);
        if (from && (!d || d < from)) return false;
        if (to && (!d || d > to)) return false;
        if (owner && toStr(rec['Contact owner']) !== owner) return false;
        if (channel && toStr(rec['Original Traffic Source']) !== channel) return false;
        if (status && toStr(rec['Lead Qualification Status']) !== status) return false;
        if (segment && toStr(rec['Account Segment']) !== segment) return false;
        return true;
      });

      currentPage = 0;
      renderKPIs();
      renderCharts();
      renderTable();
    }

    // === KPIs ===
    function renderKPIs() {
      const total = filteredData.length;
      const connected = filteredData.filter(r => toNum(r['Number of times contacted']) > 0 || !isEmpty(r['Notes Last Contacted'])).length;
      const qualified = filteredData.filter(r => toStr(r['Lead Qualification Status']).toLowerCase().includes('qualif')).length;
      const unworked = filteredData.filter(r => toNum(r['Number of times contacted']) === 0 && isEmpty(r['Notes Last Contacted'])).length;
      const emailOk = filteredData.filter(r => !isEmpty(r['Email'])).length;
      const sumFit = filteredData.reduce((acc, r) => acc + (toNum(r['Lead Fit Score']) ?? 0), 0);
      const fitCount = filteredData.reduce((acc, r) => acc + (toNum(r['Lead Fit Score']) !== null ? 1 : 0), 0);
      const avgFit = fitCount ? sumFit / fitCount : null;
      const sumContacted = filteredData.reduce((acc, r) => acc + (toNum(r['Number of times contacted']) ?? 0), 0);
      const contactedCount = filteredData.filter(r => toNum(r['Number of times contacted']) !== null).length;
      const avgTimes = contactedCount ? sumContacted / contactedCount : null;

      const channelCounts = {};
      filteredData.forEach(r => {
        const s = toStr(r['Original Traffic Source']) || 'Unknown';
        channelCounts[s] = (channelCounts[s] || 0) + 1;
      });
      const topChannel = Object.entries(channelCounts).sort((a,b) => b[1]-a[1])[0];

      const kpiData = [
        { label: 'Total Leads', value: fmtNum(total), sub: 'from selected cohort', accent: 'text-cyan-600 dark:text-cyan-400', icon: 'M15 19.128a9.38 9.38 0 002.625.372 9.337 9.337 0 004.121-.952 4.125 4.125 0 00-7.533-2.493M15 19.128v-.003c0-1.113-.285-2.16-.786-3.07M15 19.128v.106A12.318 12.318 0 018.624 21c-2.331 0-4.512-.645-6.374-1.766l-.001-.109a6.375 6.375 0 0111.964-3.07M12 6.375a3.375 3.375 0 11-6.75 0 3.375 3.375 0 016.75 0zm8.25 2.25a2.625 2.625 0 11-5.25 0 2.625 2.625 0 015.25 0z' },
        { label: 'Contact Connection Rate', value: fmtPct(total ? connected / total : 0), sub: `${fmtNum(connected)} reached`, accent: 'text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400', icon: 'M2.25 6.75c0 8.284 6.716 15 15 15h2.25a2.25 2.25 0 002.25-2.25v-1.372c0-.516-.351-.966-.852-1.091l-4.423-1.106c-.44-.11-.902.055-1.173.417l-.97 1.293c-.282.376-.769.542-1.21.38a12.035 12.035 0 01-7.143-7.143c-.162-.441.004-.928.38-1.21l1.293-.97c.363-.271.527-.734.417-1.173L6.963 3.102a1.125 1.125 0 00-1.091-.852H4.5A2.25 2.25 0 002.25 4.5v2.25z' },
        { label: 'Qualification Rate', value: fmtPct(total ? qualified / total : 0), sub: `${fmtNum(qualified)} qualified`, accent: 'text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400', icon: 'M9 12.75L11.25 15 15 9.75M21 12c0 1.268-.63 2.39-1.593 3.068a3.745 3.745 0 01-1.043 3.296 3.745 3.745 0 01-3.296 1.043A3.745 3.745 0 0112 21c-1.268 0-2.39-.63-3.068-1.593a3.746 3.746 0 01-3.296-1.043 3.745 3.745 0 01-1.043-3.296A3.745 3.745 0 013 12c0-1.268.63-2.39 1.593-3.068a3.745 3.745 0 011.043-3.296 3.746 3.746 0 013.296-1.043A3.746 3.746 0 0112 3c1.268 0 2.39.63 3.068 1.593a3.746 3.746 0 013.296 1.043 3.746 3.746 0 011.043 3.296A3.745 3.745 0 0121 12z' },

    // === CHARTS ===
    function renderCharts() {
      // destroy old
      Object.values(charts).forEach(c => { try { c.destroy(); } catch(e){} });
      charts = {};
      const mode = currentThemeMode();

      // 1) Timeline
      const monthCounts = {};
      filteredData.forEach(r => {
        const d = parseDate(r['Create Date']);
        if (!d) return;
        const k = `${d.getFullYear()}-${String(d.getMonth()+1).padStart(2,'0')}`;
        monthCounts[k] = (monthCounts[k]||0)+1;
      });
      const tKeys = Object.keys(monthCounts).sort();
      const tSeries = [{ name: 'Leads', data: tKeys.map(k => monthCounts[k]) }];
      charts.timeline = new ApexCharts(document.querySelector('#timelineChart'), {
        ...baseChartOptions(),
        chart: { ...baseChartOptions().chart, type: 'area', height: 288 },
        series: tSeries,
        xaxis: { categories: tKeys, labels: { style: { colors: 'currentColor' } } },
        yaxis: { labels: { style: { colors: 'currentColor' } } },
        colors: ['#22d3ee'],
        stroke: { curve: 'smooth', width: 2 },
        fill: { type: 'gradient', gradient: { shadeIntensity: 1, opacityFrom: 0.5, opacityTo: 0.05, stops: [0, 100] } },
        grid: { borderColor: 'rgba(128,128,128,0.2)' }
      });
      charts.timeline.render();

      // 2) Sources (Donut)
      const sCounts = {};
      filteredData.forEach(r => {
        const s = toStr(r['Original Traffic Source']) || 'Unknown';
        sCounts[s] = (sCounts[s]||0)+1;
      });
      const sSorted = Object.entries(sCounts).sort((a,b)=>b[1]-a[1]);
      const sTop = sSorted.slice(0,7);
      const sOther = sSorted.slice(7).reduce((a,[,c])=>a+c,0);
      const sLabels = sTop.map(x=>x[0]); if (sOther>0) sLabels.push('Others');
      const sVals = sTop.map(x=>x[1]); if (sOther>0) sVals.push(sOther);
      charts.source = new ApexCharts(document.querySelector('#sourceChart'), {
        ...baseChartOptions(),
        chart: { ...baseChartOptions().chart, type: 'donut', height: 288 },
        series: sVals,
        labels: sLabels,
        plotOptions: { pie: { donut: { labels: { show: true, total: { show: true, label: 'Total', formatter: () => fmtNum(filteredData.length) } } } } },
        colors: ['#22d3ee', '#34d399', '#818cf8', '#f472b6', '#fbbf24', '#f87171', '#a78bfa', '#94a3b8'],
        legend: { position: 'bottom', labels: { colors: 'currentColor' } }
      });
      charts.source.render();

      // 3) Owners
      const oCounts = {};
      filteredData.forEach(r => {
        const s = toStr(r['Contact owner']) || 'Unassigned';
        oCounts[s] = (oCounts[s]||0)+1;
      });
      const oSorted = Object.entries(oCounts).sort((a,b)=>b[1]-a[1]).slice(0,10);
      charts.owner = new ApexCharts(document.querySelector('#ownerChart'), {
        ...baseChartOptions(),
        chart: { ...baseChartOptions().chart, type: 'bar', height: 288 },
        series: [{ name: 'Leads', data: oSorted.map(x=>x[1]) }],
        xaxis: { categories: oSorted.map(x=>x[0]), labels: { style: { colors: 'currentColor' } } },
        yaxis: { labels: { style: { colors: 'currentColor' } } },
        colors: ['#34d399'],
        plotOptions: { bar: { borderRadius: 4, columnWidth: '55%' } },
        grid: { borderColor: 'rgba(128,128,128,0.2)' }
      });
      charts.owner.render();

      // 4) Funnel (horizontal bar)
      const qCounts = {};
      filteredData.forEach(r => {
        const s = toStr(r['Lead Qualification Status']) || 'Unspecified';
        qCounts[s] = (qCounts[s]||0)+1;
      });
      const qSorted = Object.entries(qCounts).sort((a,b)=>b[1]-a[1]);
      charts.funnel = new ApexCharts(document.querySelector('#funnelChart'), {
        ...baseChartOptions(),
        chart: { ...baseChartOptions().chart, type: 'bar', height: 288 },
        series: [{ name: 'Count', data: qSorted.map(x=>x[1]) }],
        xaxis: { categories: qSorted.map(x=>x[0]), labels: { style: { colors: 'currentColor' } } },
        yaxis: { labels: { style: { colors: 'currentColor' } } },
        plotOptions: { bar: { horizontal: true, distributed: true, borderRadius: 4, barHeight: '60%' } },
        colors: ['#22d3ee', '#818cf8', '#f472b6', '#34d399', '#fbbf24', '#f87171', '#a78bfa'],
        dataLabels: { enabled: true, style: { colors: ['#fff'] } },
        grid: { borderColor: 'rgba(128,128,128,0.2)' }
      });
      charts.funnel.render();

      // 5) Fit Score by Owner
      const fsMap = {}; const fsN = {};
      filteredData.forEach(r => {
        const owner = toStr(r['Contact owner']);
        const score = toNum(r['Lead Fit Score']);
        if (!owner || score === null) return;
        fsMap[owner] = (fsMap[owner]||0)+score;
        fsN[owner] = (fsN[owner]||0)+1;
      });
      const fsArr = Object.entries(fsMap).map(([o,t]) => ({ o, avg: t/fsN[o], n: fsN[o] })).filter(x=>x.n>=3).sort((a,b)=>b.n-a.n).slice(0,10);
      charts.fitScore = new ApexCharts(document.querySelector('#fitScoreChart'), {
        ...baseChartOptions(),
        chart: { ...baseChartOptions().chart, type: 'bar', height: 320 },
        series: [{ name: 'Avg Fit Score', data: fsArr.map(x=> parseFloat(x.avg.toFixed(2))) }],
        xaxis: { categories: fsArr.map(x=>x.o), labels: { style: { colors: 'currentColor' } } },
        yaxis: { labels: { style: { colors: 'currentColor' } } },
        colors: ['#fbbf24'],
        plotOptions: { bar: { borderRadius: 4, columnWidth: '50%' } },
        grid: { borderColor: 'rgba(128,128,128,0.2)' }
      });
      charts.fitScore.render();
    }

    // === TABLE ===
    function valForSort(rec, col) {
      const v = rec[col];
      const n = toNum(v);
      if (n !== null) return n;
      const d = parseDate(v);
      if (d) return d.getTime();
      return toStr(v).toLowerCase();
    }
    function setSort(col) {
      if (sortCol === col) sortAsc = !sortAsc;
      else { sortCol = col; sortAsc = true; }
      currentPage = 0;
      renderTable();
    }
    function renderTable() {
      let rows = [...filteredData];
      rows.sort((a,b) => {
        const av = valForSort(a, sortCol);
        const bv = valForSort(b, sortCol);
        if (av < bv) return sortAsc ? -1 : 1;
        if (av > bv) return sortAsc ? 1 : -1;
        return 0;
      });

      const total = rows.length;
      const pages = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(total / pageSize));
      if (currentPage >= pages) currentPage = pages - 1;
      const start = currentPage * pageSize;
      const slice = rows.slice(start, start + pageSize);

      const tbody = document.getElementById('tableBody');
      tbody.innerHTML = slice.map(rec => `
        <tr class="hover:bg-black/5 dark:hover:bg-white/5 transition-colors">
          <td class="py-2 px-3 whitespace-nowrap kpi-value">${rec['Record ID'] ?? '-'}</td>
          <td class="py-2 px-3 whitespace-nowrap">${toStr(rec['First Name'])} ${toStr(rec['Last Name'])}</td>
          <td class="py-2 px-3 whitespace-nowrap">${toStr(rec['Contact owner']) || 'Unassigned'}</td>
          <td class="py-2 px-3 whitespace-nowrap">
            <span class="inline-block px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-[10px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide bg-slate-200 dark:bg-slate-700 text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-200">${toStr(rec['Lead Qualification Status']) || 'N/A'}</span>
          </td>
          <td class="py-2 px-3 whitespace-nowrap opacity-90">${toStr(rec['Original Traffic Source']) || 'N/A'}</td>
          <td class="py-2 px-3 whitespace-nowrap kpi-value">${toNum(rec['Lead Fit Score']) !== null ? toNum(rec['Lead Fit Score']).toFixed(0) : '-'}</td>
          <td class="py-2 px-3 whitespace-nowrap opacity-90">${toStr(rec['Create Date']).split(' ')[0] || '-'}</td>
        </tr>
      `).join('');

      document.getElementById('pageInfo').textContent = `Page ${currentPage + 1} / ${pages}`;
      document.getElementById('tableMeta').textContent = `Showing ${fmtNum(slice.length)} of ${fmtNum(total)} records`;
    }
    function nextPage() { currentPage++; renderTable(); }
    function prevPage() { if (currentPage > 0) { currentPage--; renderTable(); } }

    // === THEME ===
    function toggleTheme() {
      document.documentElement.classList.toggle('dark');
      const mode = currentThemeMode();
      Object.values(charts).forEach(chart => {
        try { chart.updateOptions({ theme: { mode }, chart: { background: 'transparent' } }); } catch(e){}
      });
    }

    // === ACTION BUTTONS ===
    function exportCommand() {
      const from = document.getElementById('filterDateFrom').value;
      const to = document.getElementById('filterDateTo').value;
      const owner = document.getElementById('filterOwner').value;
      const status = document.getElementById('filterStatus').value;
      const cmd = `python export_leads.py --from "${from}" --to "${to}" --owner "${owner}" --status "${status}" --outfile leads_export_${new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10)}.csv`;
      console.log('[ACTION] Execute export command:', cmd);
      console.log('[ACTION] Filtered row count:', filteredData.length);
    }
    function hygieneCommand() {
      const malformed = DATA.filter(r => /[^0-9+\-\s]/.test(toStr(r['Phone Number']))).length;
      console.log('[ACTION] Execute data hygiene script: python data_hygiene.py --fix --columns "Phone Number,Email,Job Title"');
      console.log('[ACTION] Malformed phone estimate:', malformed);
    }
    function reassignCommand() {
      const affected = DATA.filter(r => toStr(r['Contact owner']).includes('Niranjan')).length;
      console.log('[ACTION] Execute reassignment: python reassign.py --from "Niranjan Kumar (Deactivated User)" --to "Unassigned"');
      console.log('[ACTION] Affected records:', affected);
    }
  </script>
</body>

  <script>
    /*  STATE & CONFIG  */
    const CHART_COLORS = ['#06b6d4', '#8b5cf6', '#10b981', '#f59e0b', '#f43f5e', '#6366f1', '#84cc16', '#d946ef', '#f97316', '#14b8a6'];
    let DATA = [];
    let charts = {};
    let currentTab = 'executive';
    let filtersVisible = true;

    /*  UTILS  */
    const $ = (sel) => document.querySelector(sel);
    const $$ = (sel) => document.querySelectorAll(sel);

    function isNull(v) {
      return v === null || v === undefined || v === '' || v === 'NaN' || v === 'null' || v === 'undefined';
    }

    function fmtNum(n) {
      if (n === null || n === undefined || (typeof n === 'number' && isNaN(n))) return '-';
      return new Intl.NumberFormat('en-US', { maximumFractionDigits: 1 }).format(n);
    }

    function fmtPct(n) {
      if (n === null || n === undefined || (typeof n === 'number' && isNaN(n))) return '-';
      const v = n * 100;
      if (v === 0) return '0%';
      return v.toFixed(1) + '%';
    }

    function parseDate(d) {
      if (!d) return null;
      if (d instanceof Date) return isNaN(d) ? null : d;
      if (typeof d !== 'string') return null;
      const p = new Date(d);
      return isNaN(p) ? null : p;
    }

    function getISOWeek(date) {
      const d = new Date(Date.UTC(date.getFullYear(), date.getMonth(), date.getDate()));
      const dayNum = d.getUTCDay() || 7;
      d.setUTCDate(d.getUTCDate() + 4 - dayNum);
      const yearStart = new Date(Date.UTC(d.getUTCFullYear(), 0, 1));
      const weekNo = Math.ceil((((d - yearStart) / 86400000) + 1) / 7);
      return d.getUTCFullYear() + '-W' + String(weekNo).padStart(2, '0');
    }

    function groupBy(arr, key) {
      return arr.reduce((acc, row) => {
        const v = row[key];
        if (isNull(v)) return acc;
        const k = String(v);
        if (!acc[k]) acc[k] = [];
        acc[k].push(row);
        return acc;
      }, {});
    }

    function getForeColor() {
      return document.documentElement.getAttribute('data-theme') === 'dark' ? '#e5e7eb' : '#374151';
    }

    function getGridColor() {
      return document.documentElement.getAttribute('data-theme') === 'dark' ? '#334155' : '#e2e8f0';
    }

    /*  THEME  */
    function initTheme() {
      const saved = localStorage.getItem('theme');
      if (saved === 'dark' || (!saved && window.matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)').matches)) {
        document.documentElement.setAttribute('data-theme', 'dark');
      } else {
        document.documentElement.setAttribute('data-theme', 'light');
      }
      updateThemeIcon();
    }

    function toggleTheme() {
      const isDark = document.documentElement.getAttribute('data-theme') === 'dark';
      document.documentElement.setAttribute('data-theme', isDark ? 'light' : 'dark');
      localStorage.setItem('theme', isDark ? 'light' : 'dark');
      updateThemeIcon();
      renderTabCharts(getFilteredData());
    }

    function updateThemeIcon() {
      const isDark = document.documentElement.getAttribute('data-theme') === 'dark';
      $('#btn-theme').innerHTML = isDark ? '<i class="fa-solid fa-sun"></i>' : '<i class="fa-solid fa-moon"></i>';
    }

    /*  UPLOAD  */
    function initUpload() {
      const zone = $('#upload-zone');
      zone.addEventListener('click', () => $('#file-input').click());
      zone.addEventListener('dragover', (e) => { e.preventDefault(); zone.classList.add('border-accent'); });
      zone.addEventListener('dragleave', () => zone.classList.remove('border-accent'));
      zone.addEventListener('drop', (e) => {
        e.preventDefault();
        zone.classList.remove('border-accent');
        handleFiles(e.dataTransfer.files);
      });
      $('#file-input').addEventListener('change', (e) => handleFiles(e.target.files));
    }

    function handleFiles(files) {
      const file = files[0];
      if (!file) return;
      if (file.name.toLowerCase().endsWith('.csv')) {
        Papa.parse(file, {
          header: true,
          skipEmptyLines: true,
          complete: (res) => processData(res.data, file.name)
        });
      } else if (file.name.match(/\.xlsx?$/i)) {
        const reader = new FileReader();
        reader.onload = (e) => {
          const data = new Uint8Array(e.target.result);
          const workbook = XLSX.read(data, { type: 'array' });
          const firstSheet = workbook.Sheets[workbook.SheetNames[0]];
          const json = XLSX.utils.sheet_to_json(firstSheet, { defval: null });
          processData(json, file.name);
        };
        reader.readAsArrayBuffer(file);
      } else {
        alert('Please upload a CSV or Excel file.');
      }
    }

    /*  DATA PROCESSING  */
    function processData(raw, filename) {
      DATA = raw.map(row => {
        const obj = {};
        Object.keys(row).forEach(k => {
          let v = row[k];
          if (v instanceof Date) {
            v = v.toISOString();
          }
          if (typeof v === 'string') {
            v = v.trim();
            if (v === '' || v.toLowerCase() === 'nan' || v.toLowerCase() === 'null' || v.toLowerCase() === 'undefined') {
              v = null;
            } else if (v.toLowerCase() === 'true') {
              v = true;
            } else if (v.toLowerCase() === 'false') {
              v = false;
            } else if (!isNaN(Number(v)) && String(Number(v)) === v) {
              v = Number(v);
            }
          }
          obj[k.trim()] = v;
        });
        return obj;
      }).filter(row => Object.values(row).some(v => !isNull(v)));

      // Derive title
      let base = filename.replace(/\.[^/.]+$/, '').replace(/[_-]/g, ' ');
      base = base.split(' ').map(w => w.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + w.slice(1)).join(' ');
      let title = base;
      if (/^(Cleaned|Data|Export|Sheet|Book)/i.test(base)) {
        title = 'Healthcare Inside Sales Command Center';
      } else {
        title = base + ' — Healthcare CRM';
      }
      $('#dashboard-title').textContent = title;

      // Subtitle
      const dates = DATA.map(r => parseDate(r['Create Date'])).filter(d => d);
      let rangeStr = '';
      if (dates.length) {
        const minD = new Date(Math.min(...dates));
        const maxD = new Date(Math.max(...dates));
        rangeStr = `${minD.toLocaleDateString()} – ${maxD.toLocaleDateString()}`;
      }
      $('#dashboard-subtitle').textContent = `${DATA.length.toLocaleString()} records • ${rangeStr || 'Date range unavailable'}`;

      populateFilters();
      $('#upload-screen').classList.add('hidden');
      $('#app').classList.remove('hidden');
      renderDashboard(DATA);
    }

    function populateFilters() {
      const fill = (id, col) => {
        const sel = $(id);
        const vals = [...new Set(DATA.map(r => r[col]).filter(v => !isNull(v)))].sort();
        // keep first disabled option
        const first = sel.options[0];
        sel.innerHTML = '';
        sel.appendChild(first);
        vals.forEach(v => {
          const opt = document.createElement('option');
          opt.value = v;
          opt.textContent = v;
          sel.appendChild(opt);
        });
      };
      fill('#filter-segment', 'Account Segment');
      fill('#filter-owner', 'Contact owner');
      fill('#filter-source', 'Original Traffic Source');
      fill('#filter-stage', 'Lifecycle Stage');

      const dates = DATA.map(r => parseDate(r['Create Date'])).filter(d => d);
      if (dates.length) {
        const minD = new Date(Math.min(...dates));
        const maxD = new Date(Math.max(...dates));
        $('#date-from').value = minD.toISOString().split('T')[0];
        $('#date-to').value = maxD.toISOString().split('T')[0];
      }
    }

    /*  FILTERS  */
    function getFilteredData() {
      const seg = Array.from($('#filter-segment').selectedOptions).map(o => o.value);
      const own = Array.from($('#filter-owner').selectedOptions).map(o => o.value);
      const src = Array.from($('#filter-source').selectedOptions).map(o => o.value);
      const stg = Array.from($('#filter-stage').selectedOptions).map(o => o.value);
      const dFrom = parseDate($('#date-from').value);
      const dTo = parseDate($('#date-to').value);

      const fd = DATA.filter(r => {
        if (seg.length && !seg.includes(r['Account Segment'])) return false;
        if (own.length && !own.includes(r['Contact owner'])) return false;
        if (src.length && !src.includes(r['Original Traffic Source'])) return false;
        if (stg.length && !stg.includes(r['Lifecycle Stage'])) return false;
        const cDate = parseDate(r['Create Date']);
        if (dFrom && cDate && cDate < dFrom) return false;
        if (dTo && cDate && cDate > dTo) return false;
        return true;
      });

      const active = (seg.length ? 1 : 0) + (own.length ? 1 : 0) + (src.length ? 1 : 0) + (stg.length ? 1 : 0) + ((dFrom || dTo) ? 1 : 0);
      $('#filter-badge').textContent = active + ' active';
      return fd;
    }

    function onFilterChange() {
      const fd = getFilteredData();
      renderDashboard(fd);
    }

    function resetFilters() {
      $$('select[multiple]').forEach(sel => {
        Array.from(sel.options).forEach(o => o.selected = false);
      });
      const dates = DATA.map(r => parseDate(r['Create Date'])).filter(d => d);
      if (dates.length) {
        const minD = new Date(Math.min(...dates));
        const maxD = new Date(Math.max(...dates));
        $('#date-from').value = minD.toISOString().split('T')[0];
        $('#date-to').value = maxD.toISOString().split('T')[0];
      } else {
        $('#date-from').value = '';
        $('#date-to').value = '';
      }
      onFilterChange();
    }

    /*  RENDER DASHBOARD  */
    function renderDashboard(data) {
      if (!data.length) {
        $('#zero-state').classList.remove('hidden');
        $('#zero-state').classList.add('flex');
        // Hide chart containers so empty guards don't compete
        Object.values(charts).forEach(c => { if (c && typeof c.destroy === 'function') c.destroy(); });
        charts = {};
        return;
      } else {
        $('#zero-state').classList.add('hidden');
        $('#zero-state').classList.remove('flex');
      }
      updateKPIs(data);
      updateNarrative(data);
      renderTabCharts(data);
    }

    function updateKPIs(data) {
      const total = data.length;
      const unworked = data.filter(r => r['Contact unworked'] === true).length;
      const fitScores = data.map(r => r['Lead score (Fit score)']).filter(v => typeof v === 'number' && !isNaN(v));
      const avgFit = fitScores.length ? fitScores.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / fitScores.length : null;
      const acts = data.map(r => r['Number of Sales Activities']).filter(v => typeof v === 'number' && !isNaN(v));
      const avgAct = acts.length ? acts.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / acts.length : null;
      const touches = data.map(r => r['Number of times contacted']).filter(v => typeof v === 'number' && !isNaN(v));
      const avgTouch = touches.length ? touches.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / touches.length : null;
      const emailMissing = data.filter(r => isNull(r['Email'])).length;
      const contactable = total ? (total - emailMissing) / total : null;

      const set = (id, val) => {
        const el = $(id);
        if (!el) return;
        el.querySelector('.kpi-value').textContent = val;
      };
      set('#kpi-total', total.toLocaleString());
      set('#kpi-unworked', fmtPct(unworked / total));
      set('#kpi-fit', fmtNum(avgFit));
      set('#kpi-act', fmtNum(avgAct));
      set('#kpi-touch', fmtNum(avgTouch));
      set('#kpi-contactable', fmtPct(contactable));
    }

    function updateNarrative(data) {
      const total = data.length;
      const unworked = data.filter(r => r['Contact unworked'] === true).length;
      const unworkedPct = total ? (unworked / total) : 0;
      const fitScores = data.map(r => r['Lead score (Fit score)']).filter(v => typeof v === 'number' && !isNaN(v));
      const avgFit = fitScores.length ? fitScores.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / fitScores.length : 0;

      const srcGrp = groupBy(data, 'Original Traffic Source');
      const topSrc = Object.entries(srcGrp).sort((a, b) => b[1].length - a[1].length)[0];
      const ownGrp = groupBy(data, 'Contact owner');
      const topOwn = Object.entries(ownGrp).sort((a, b) => b[1].length - a[1].length)[0];

      let worstOwn = null, worstPct = 0;
      Object.entries(ownGrp).forEach(([owner, rows]) => {
        if (rows.length < 5) return;
        const uw = rows.filter(r => r['Contact unworked'] === true).length;
        const pct = uw / rows.length;
        if (pct > worstPct) { worstPct = pct; worstOwn = owner; }
      });

      const emailNullPct = total ? data.filter(r => isNull(r['Email'])).length / total : 0;

      $('#narrative-content').innerHTML = `
        <p class="mb-2">Pipeline contains <strong>${total.toLocaleString()}</strong> leads. 
        <span style="color:var(--rose)" class="font-semibold">${fmtPct(unworkedPct)}</span> are stagnant (unworked), posing an immediate follow-up risk. 
        Lead quality is depressed with an average fit score of <strong>${fmtNum(avgFit)}</strong>.</p>
        <p class="mb-2"><strong>${topSrc ? topSrc[0] : 'N/A'}</strong> is the dominant traffic source, contributing <strong>${topSrc ? fmtPct(topSrc[1].length / total) : '0%'}</strong> of volume. 
        <strong>${topOwn ? topOwn[0] : 'N/A'}</strong> carries the largest book (${topOwn ? topOwn[1].length.toLocaleString() : 0} leads). 
        ${worstOwn ? `<strong>${worstOwn}</strong> has the highest unworked ratio at <span style="color:var(--rose)" class="font-semibold">${fmtPct(worstPct)}</span>.` : ''}</p>
        <p>Data hygiene is compromised: <strong>${fmtPct(emailNullPct)}</strong> of records lack email addresses, breaking nurture sequences.</p>
      `;
    }

    /*  CHARTS  */
    function renderTabCharts(data) {
      // Destroy existing charts
      Object.values(charts).forEach(c => { if (c && typeof c.destroy === 'function') c.destroy(); });
      charts = {};
      const foreColor = getForeColor();
      const gridColor = getGridColor();

      if (currentTab === 'executive') {
        renderChartLifecycle(data, foreColor, gridColor);
        renderChartInflow(data, foreColor, gridColor);
        renderChartTraffic(data, foreColor, gridColor);
        renderChartFitDist(data, foreColor, gridColor);
      } else if (currentTab === 'pipeline') {
        renderChartContactStage(data, foreColor, gridColor);
        renderChartLeadStatus(data, foreColor, gridColor);
        renderChartDisqReasons(data, foreColor, gridColor);
        renderChartUnworkedOwners(data, foreColor, gridColor);
        renderChartFitBySegment(data, foreColor, gridColor);
        renderChartEngagementType(data, foreColor, gridColor);
      } else if (currentTab === 'team') {
        renderChartOwnerVolume(data, foreColor, gridColor);
        renderChartOwnerActivities(data, foreColor, gridColor);
        renderChartOwnerBubble(data, foreColor, gridColor);
        renderChartFormDist(data, foreColor, gridColor);
      }
    }

    function showEmpty(id, show) {
      const el = $(id).parentElement.querySelector('.empty-guard');
      if (!el) return;
      if (show) el.classList.remove('hidden');
      else el.classList.add('hidden');
    }

    function commonOptions(titleText, foreColor, gridColor) {
      return {
        chart: { fontFamily: 'Inter, sans-serif', toolbar: { show: false }, animations: { enabled: false } },
        title: { text: titleText, align: 'left', style: { color: foreColor, fontFamily: 'Sora, sans-serif', fontSize: '14px', fontWeight: 600 } },
        grid: { borderColor: gridColor, strokeDashArray: 4 },
        legend: { labels: { colors: foreColor } }
      };
    }

    function renderChartLifecycle(data, foreColor, gridColor) {
      const id = '#chart-lifecycle';
      if (!data.length) { showEmpty(id, true); return; }
      showEmpty(id, false);
      const grp = groupBy(data, 'Lifecycle Stage');
      const entries = Object.entries(grp).map(([k, v]) => [k, v.length]).sort((a, b) => b[1] - a[1]);
      const cats = entries.map(([k]) => k);
      const vals = entries.map(([, v]) => v);
      const opts = {
        ...commonOptions('Lifecycle Stage Distribution', foreColor, gridColor),
        series: [{ name: 'Leads', data: vals }],
        chart: { type: 'bar', height: 320 },
        colors: [CHART_COLORS[0]],
        plotOptions: { bar: { horizontal: true, borderRadius: 4 } },
        dataLabels: { enabled: false },
        xaxis: { categories: cats, labels: { style: { colors: foreColor } } },
        yaxis: { labels: { style: { colors: foreColor } } }
      };
      charts['lifecycle'] = new ApexCharts($(id), opts);
      charts['lifecycle'].render();
    }

    function renderChartInflow(data, foreColor, gridColor) {
      const id = '#chart-inflow';
      if (!data.length) { showEmpty(id, true); return; }
      const dates = data.map(r => parseDate(r['Create Date'])).filter(d => d);
      if (!dates.length) { showEmpty(id, true); return; }
      showEmpty(id, false);
      const minD = new Date(Math.min(...dates));
      const maxD = new Date(Math.max(...dates));
      const dayDiff = (maxD - minD) / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24);
      const isWeekly = dayDiff > 60;

      const grp = {};
      dates.forEach(d => {
        const key = isWeekly ? getISOWeek(d) : d.toISOString().split('T')[0];
        grp[key] = (grp[key] || 0) + 1;
      });
      const cats = Object.keys(grp).sort();
      const vals = cats.map(c => grp[c]);

      const opts = {
        ...commonOptions(isWeekly ? 'Weekly Lead Inflow' : 'Daily Lead Inflow', foreColor, gridColor),
        series: [{ name: 'New Leads', data: vals }],
        chart: { type: 'area', height: 320 },
        colors: [CHART_COLORS[3]],
        fill: { type: 'gradient', gradient: { shadeIntensity: 1, opacityFrom: 0.4, opacityTo: 0.05, stops: [0, 100] } },
        stroke: { curve: 'smooth', width: 2 },
        dataLabels: { enabled: false },
        xaxis: { categories: cats, labels: { style: { colors: foreColor }, rotate: isWeekly ? 0 : 45 }, tooltip: { enabled: false } },
        yaxis: { labels: { style: { colors: foreColor } } }
      };
      charts['inflow'] = new ApexCharts($(id), opts);
      charts['inflow'].render();
    }

    function renderChartTraffic(data, foreColor, gridColor) {
      const id = '#chart-traffic';
      if (!data.length) { showEmpty(id, true); return; }
      showEmpty(id, false);
      const grp = groupBy(data, 'Original Traffic Source');
      let entries = Object.entries(grp).map(([k, v]) => [k, v.length]).sort((a, b) => b[1] - a[1]);
      let others = 0;
      if (entries.length > 7) {
        const top = entries.slice(0, 7);
        others = entries.slice(7).reduce((s, [, c]) => s + c, 0);
        entries = top;
        if (others > 0) entries.push(['Other', others]);
      }
      const labels = entries.map(([k]) => k);
      const series = entries.map(([, v]) => v);

      const opts = {
        ...commonOptions('Traffic Source Mix', foreColor, gridColor),
        series: series,
        chart: { type: 'donut', height: 320 },
        labels: labels,
        colors: CHART_COLORS,
        plotOptions: { pie: { donut: { labels: { show: true, total: { show: true, label: 'Total Leads', color: foreColor } } } } },
        legend: { position: 'bottom', labels: { colors: foreColor } }
      };
      charts['traffic'] = new ApexCharts($(id), opts);
      charts['traffic'].render();
    }

    function renderChartFitDist(data, foreColor, gridColor) {
      const id = '#chart-fit-dist';
      if (!data.length) { showEmpty(id, true); return; }
      showEmpty(id, false);
      const bins = { '< -20': 0, '-20 to -10': 0, '-10 to 0': 0, '0 to 10': 0, '10 to 20': 0, '> 20': 0 };
      data.forEach(r => {
        const v = r['Lead score (Fit score)'];
        if (typeof v !== 'number' || isNaN(v)) return;
        if (v < -20) bins['< -20']++;
        else if (v < -10) bins['-20 to -10']++;
        else if (v < 0) bins['-10 to 0']++;
        else if (v < 10) bins['0 to 10']++;
        else if (v < 20) bins['10 to 20']++;
        else bins['> 20']++;
      });
      const cats = Object.keys(bins);
      const vals = Object.values(bins);
      const opts = {
        ...commonOptions('Lead Score Distribution', foreColor, gridColor),
        series: [{ name: 'Leads', data: vals }],
        chart: { type: 'bar', height: 320 },
        colors: [CHART_COLORS[2]],
        plotOptions: { bar: { borderRadius: 4, columnWidth: '60%' } },
        dataLabels: { enabled: false },
        xaxis: { categories: cats, labels: { style: { colors: foreColor } }, title: { text: 'Fit Score Bucket', style: { color: foreColor } } },
        yaxis: { labels: { style: { colors: foreColor } } }
      };
      charts['fitDist'] = new ApexCharts($(id), opts);
      charts['fitDist'].render();
    }

    function renderChartLeadStatus(data, foreColor, gridColor) {
      const id = '#chart-lead-status';

      const segments = [...new Set(data.map(r => r['Account Segment']).filter(v => !isNull(v)))].sort();
      const series = segments.map(seg => ({
        name: seg,

    function renderChartUnworkedOwners(data, foreColor, gridColor) {
      const id = '#chart-unworked-owners';
      if (!data.length) { showEmpty(id, true); return; }
      const ownGrp = groupBy(data, 'Contact owner');
      let owners = Object.entries(ownGrp)
        .map(([o, rows]) => ({ o, rows, total: rows.length }))
        .filter(x => x.total >= 3)
        .sort((a, b) => b.total - a.total)
        .slice(0, 10);
      if (!owners.length) { showEmpty(id, true); return; }
      showEmpty(id, false);
      const cats = owners.map(x => x.o);
      const unworked = owners.map(x => x.rows.filter(r => r['Contact unworked'] === true).length);
      const worked = owners.map((x, i) => x.total - unworked[i]);
      const opts = {
        ...commonOptions('Unworked vs Worked by Owner (Top 10)', foreColor, gridColor),
        series: [{ name: 'Worked', data: worked }, { name: 'Unworked', data: unworked }],
        chart: { type: 'bar', height: 320, stacked: true },
        colors: [CHART_COLORS[2], CHART_COLORS[4]],
        plotOptions: { bar: { horizontal: true, borderRadius: 2 } },
        xaxis: { categories: cats, labels: { style: { colors: foreColor } } },
        yaxis: { labels: { style: { colors: foreColor } } }
      };
      charts['unworkedOwners'] = new ApexCharts($(id), opts);
      charts['unworkedOwners'].render();
    }

    function renderChartFitBySegment(data, foreColor, gridColor) {
      const id = '#chart-fit-segment';
      if (!data.length) { showEmpty(id, true); return; }
      const grp = groupBy(data, 'Account Segment');
      const entries = Object.entries(grp)
        .map(([k, rows]) => {
          const scores = rows.map(r => r['Lead score (Fit score)']).filter(v => typeof v === 'number' && !isNaN(v));
          return [k, scores.length ? scores.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / scores.length : 0, rows.length];
        })
        .sort((a, b) => b[1] - a[1]);
      if (!entries.length) { showEmpty(id, true); return; }
      showEmpty(id, false);
      const cats = entries.map(([k]) => k);
      const vals = entries.map(([, v]) => parseFloat(v.toFixed(2)));
      const opts = {
        ...commonOptions('Avg Fit Score by Account Segment', foreColor, gridColor),
        series: [{ name: 'Avg Fit Score', data: vals }],
        chart: { type: 'bar', height: 320 },
        colors: [CHART_COLORS[6]],
        plotOptions: { bar: { borderRadius: 4 } },
        xaxis: { categories: cats, labels: { style: { colors: foreColor } } },
        yaxis: { labels: { style: { colors: foreColor } } }
      };
      charts['fitSegment'] = new ApexCharts($(id), opts);
      charts['fitSegment'].render();
    }

    function renderChartOwnerBubble(data, foreColor, gridColor) {
      const id = '#chart-owner-bubble';
      if (!data.length) { showEmpty(id, true); return; }
      const grp = groupBy(data, 'Contact owner');
      const bubbles = Object.entries(grp)
        .map(([owner, rows]) => {
          const touches = rows.map(r => r['Number of times contacted']).filter(v => typeof v === 'number' && !isNaN(v));
          const fits = rows.map(r => r['Lead score (Fit score)']).filter(v => typeof v === 'number' && !isNaN(v));
          const avgTouch = touches.length ? touches.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / touches.length : 0;
          const avgFit = fits.length ? fits.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / fits.length : 0;
          return { x: parseFloat(avgTouch.toFixed(2)), y: parseFloat(avgFit.toFixed(2)), z: rows.length, name: owner };
        })
        .filter(d => d.z >= 3)
        .slice(0, 20);
      if (!bubbles.length) { showEmpty(id, true); return; }
      showEmpty(id, false);
      const seriesData = bubbles.map(d => ({ x: d.x, y: d.y, z: d.z, name: d.name }));
      const opts = {
        ...commonOptions('Owner Performance Bubble', foreColor, gridColor),
        series: [{ name: 'Owners', data: seriesData }],
        chart: { type: 'bubble', height: 320, toolbar: { show: false } },
        dataLabels: { enabled: false },
        fill: { opacity: 0.7, type: 'solid' },
        colors: [CHART_COLORS[7]],
        xaxis: {
          title: { text: 'Avg Times Contacted', style: { color: foreColor } },
          labels: { style: { colors: foreColor } },
          tickAmount: 5
        },
        yaxis: {
          title: { text: 'Avg Fit Score', style: { color: foreColor } },
          labels: { style: { colors: foreColor } }
        },
        tooltip: {
          custom: function({ seriesIndex, dataPointIndex, w }) {
            const d = w.config.series[seriesIndex].data[dataPointIndex];
            return '<div class="px-3 py-2 text-sm"><strong>' + d.name + '</strong><br/>Leads: ' + d.z + '<br/>Avg Contacted: ' + d.x + '<br/>Avg Fit: ' + d.y + '</div>';
          }
        }
      };
      charts['ownerBubble'] = new ApexCharts($(id), opts);
      charts['ownerBubble'].render();
    }
