    function toggleFilters() {
      filtersVisible = !filtersVisible;
      $('#filter-bar').classList.toggle('hidden', !filtersVisible);
    }

    function switchTab(tab) {
      currentTab = tab;
      $$('.tab-btn').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
      $$('.tab-panel').forEach(p => p.classList.add('hidden'));
      $('#tab-btn-' + tab).classList.add('active');
      $('#tab-panel-' + tab).classList.remove('hidden');
      renderTabCharts(getFilteredData());
    }

    function exportData() {
      const fd = getFilteredData();
      if (!fd.length) return alert('No data to export');
      const csv = Papa.unparse(fd);
      const blob = new Blob([csv], { type: 'text/csv;charset=utf-8;' });
      const link = document.createElement('a');
      link.href = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
      link.download = 'filtered_data.csv';
      link.click();
    }

    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
      initTheme();
      initUpload();

      $('#btn-filters').addEventListener('click', toggleFilters);
      $('#btn-theme').addEventListener('click', toggleTheme);
      $('#btn-export').addEventListener('click', exportData);
      $('#btn-new').addEventListener('click', () => location.reload());
      $('#btn-reset').addEventListener('click', resetFilters);
      $('#zero-reset').addEventListener('click', resetFilters);

      $$('.tab-btn').forEach(btn => {
        btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
          const tab = btn.id.replace('tab-btn-', '');
          switchTab(tab);
        });
      });

      $$('select[multiple]').forEach(sel => sel.addEventListener('change', onFilterChange));
      $('#date-from').addEventListener('change', onFilterChange);
      $('#date-to').addEventListener('change', onFilterChange);
    });
  </script>
</body>
</html>

    function escapeHtml(str) {
      return String(str ?? '').replace(/&/g,'&amp;').replace(/</g,'&lt;').replace(/>/g,'&gt;').replace(/"/g,'&quot;');
    }
    function fmtNum(n) {
      if (n == null || isNaN(n)) return '—';
      return new Intl.NumberFormat('en-US', {maximumFractionDigits:0}).format(n);
    }
    function fmtDec(n, d=1) {
      if (n == null || isNaN(n)) return '—';
      return n.toFixed(d);
    }
    function fmtPct(n) {
      if (n == null || isNaN(n)) return '—';
      return (n*100).toFixed(1) + '%';
    }
    function fmtDuration(minutes) {
      if (!minutes || isNaN(minutes)) return '—';
      const d = Math.floor(minutes/1440);
      const h = Math.floor((minutes%1440)/60);
      const m = Math.floor(minutes%60);
      if (d > 0) return `${d}d ${h}h ${m}m`;
      if (h > 0) return `${h}h ${m}m`;
      return `${m}m`;
    }
    function safeMean(arr) {
      const nums = arr.filter(v => v != null && !isNaN(v));
      return nums.length ? nums.reduce((a,b)=>a+b,0)/nums.length : 0;
    }
    function median(arr) {
      const nums = arr.slice().sort((a,b)=>a-b);
      const mid = Math.floor(nums.length/2);
      return nums.length % 2 ? nums[mid] : (nums[mid-1]+nums[mid])/2;
    }
    function groupBy(arr, key) {
      return arr.reduce((o,r)=>{ const v=r[key]; if (v==null) return o; (o[v]=o[v]||[]).push(r); return o; },{});
    }
    function formatYM(d) {
      if (!d) return '';
      const y = d.getFullYear();
      const m = String(d.getMonth()+1).padStart(2,'0');
      return `${y}-${m}`;
    }
    function getThemeColors() {
      const isDark = document.documentElement.getAttribute('data-theme') === 'dark';
      return {
        textColor: isDark ? '#e2e8f0' : '#0f172a',
        axisColor: isDark ? '#475569' : '#cbd5e1',
        gridColor: isDark ? '#334155' : '#e2e8f0'
      };
    }

    // =
    // PARSING
    // =
    function findHeader(rawHeaders, aliases) {
      const candidates = rawHeaders.map(h => h.trim());
      for (const a of aliases) {
        const exact = candidates.find(h => h === a);
        if (exact) return exact;
      }
      for (const a of aliases) {
        const lower = a.toLowerCase();
        const match = candidates.find(h => h.toLowerCase() === lower);
        if (match) return match;
      }
      for (const a of aliases) {
        const normA = a.toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]/g, '');
        const match = candidates.find(h => h.toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]/g, '') === normA);
        if (match) return match;
      }
      return null;
    }
    function normalizeValue(val, type) {
      if (val === null || val === undefined || val === '') return null;
      if (type === 'boolean') {
        if (typeof val === 'boolean') return val;
        const s = String(val).toLowerCase().trim();
        return s === 'true' || s === '1' || s === 'yes';
      }
      if (type === 'number') {
        const n = Number(val);
        return isNaN(n) ? null : n;
      }
      if (type === 'date') {
        if (val instanceof Date) return isNaN(val.getTime()) ? null : val;
        const d = new Date(val);
        return isNaN(d.getTime()) ? null : d;
      }
      if (type === 'string') return String(val).trim();
      return val;
    }
    function parseHMS(val) {
      if (val == null || val === '') return null;
      const s = String(val).trim();
      const m = s.match(/^(\d+):(\d+):(\d+)$/);
      if (!m) return null;
      const h = parseInt(m[1],10), mn = parseInt(m[2],10), sec = parseInt(m[3],10);
      if (isNaN(h)||isNaN(mn)||isNaN(sec)) return null;
      return h*60 + mn + sec/60;
    }
    function normalizeRows(rawRows) {
      if (!rawRows.length) return [];
      const headers = Object.keys(rawRows[0]);
      const hmap = {};
      for (const key of Object.keys(COL_MAP)) {
        const found = findHeader(headers, COL_MAP[key]);
        if (found) hmap[key] = found;
      }
      return rawRows.map((r, i) => {
        const get = k => r[hmap[k]];
        const out = {};
        out._raw = r;
        out._idx = i;
        out.recordId = normalizeValue(get('recordId'), 'string');
        out.firstName = normalizeValue(get('firstName'), 'string');
        out.lastName = normalizeValue(get('lastName'), 'string');
        out.accountSegment = normalizeValue(get('accountSegment'), 'string');
        out.contactOwner = normalizeValue(get('contactOwner'), 'string');
        out.originalContactOwner = normalizeValue(get('originalContactOwner'), 'string');
        out.contactUnworked = normalizeValue(get('contactUnworked'), 'boolean');
        out.createDate = normalizeValue(get('createDate'), 'date');
        out.dateEnteredCurrentStage = normalizeValue(get('dateEnteredCurrentStage'), 'date');
        out.lastActivityDate = normalizeValue(get('lastActivityDate'), 'date');
        out.lastContacted = normalizeValue(get('lastContacted'), 'date');
        out.lastModifiedDate = normalizeValue(get('lastModifiedDate'), 'date');
        out.lifecycleStage = normalizeValue(get('lifecycleStage'), 'string');
        out.timeInStage = parseHMS(get('timeInStage'));
        out.numSalesActivities = normalizeValue(get('numSalesActivities'), 'number') ?? 0;
        out.numFormSubmissions = normalizeValue(get('numFormSubmissions'), 'number') ?? 0;
        out.numSessions = normalizeValue(get('numSessions'), 'number') ?? 0;
        out.numPageviews = normalizeValue(get('numPageviews'), 'number') ?? 0;
        out.numTimesContacted = normalizeValue(get('numTimesContacted'), 'number') ?? 0;
        out.numUniqueForms = normalizeValue(get('numUniqueForms'), 'number') ?? 0;
        out.originalTrafficSource = normalizeValue(get('originalTrafficSource'), 'string');
        out.originalTrafficSourceDrillDown1 = normalizeValue(get('originalTrafficSourceDrillDown1'), 'string');
        out.latestTrafficSource = normalizeValue(get('latestTrafficSource'), 'string');
        out.latestTrafficSourceDrillDown1 = normalizeValue(get('latestTrafficSourceDrillDown1'), 'string');
        out.recordSource = normalizeValue(get('recordSource'), 'string');
        out.recordSourceDetail1 = normalizeValue(get('recordSourceDetail1'), 'string');
        out.typeOfFirstEngagement = normalizeValue(get('typeOfFirstEngagement'), 'string');
        out.callResponseStatus = normalizeValue(get('callResponseStatus'), 'string');
        out.state = normalizeValue(get('state'), 'string');
        out.city = normalizeValue(get('city'), 'string');
        out.email = normalizeValue(get('email'), 'string');
        out.phone = normalizeValue(get('phone'), 'string');
        out.jobTitle = normalizeValue(get('jobTitle'), 'string');
        out.persona = normalizeValue(get('persona'), 'string');
        out.leadFitScore = normalizeValue(get('leadFitScore'), 'number');
        out.disqualificationReason = normalizeValue(get('disqualificationReason'), 'string');
        out.sendsSinceLastEngagement = normalizeValue(get('sendsSinceLastEngagement'), 'number');
        out.recentConversion = normalizeValue(get('recentConversion'), 'string');
        out.recentConversionDate = normalizeValue(get('recentConversionDate'), 'date');
        out.timeFirstSeen = normalizeValue(get('timeFirstSeen'), 'date');
        out.timeLastSeen = normalizeValue(get('timeLastSeen'), 'date');
        out.hubspotTeam = normalizeValue(get('hubspotTeam'), 'string');
        out.marketingContactStatus = normalizeValue(get('marketingContactStatus'), 'string');
        return out;
      });
    }

    const uploadZone = document.getElementById('upload-zone');
    const fileInput = document.getElementById('file-input');
    uploadZone.addEventListener('click', () => fileInput.click());
    uploadZone.addEventListener('dragover', e => { e.preventDefault(); uploadZone.classList.add('dragover'); });
    uploadZone.addEventListener('dragleave', () => uploadZone.classList.remove('dragover'));
    uploadZone.addEventListener('drop', e => {
      e.preventDefault(); uploadZone.classList.remove('dragover');
      if (e.dataTransfer.files.length) handleFile(e.dataTransfer.files[0]);
    });
    fileInput.addEventListener('change', e => { if (e.target.files.length) handleFile(e.target.files[0]); });

    function handleFile(file) {
      const name = file.name.toLowerCase();
      if (name.endsWith('.csv')) {
        Papa.parse(file, { header: true, skipEmptyLines: true, complete: results => finalize(results.data, file.name) });
      } else if (name.endsWith('.xlsx') || name.endsWith('.xls')) {
        const reader = new FileReader();
        reader.onload = e => {
          const data = new Uint8Array(e.target.result);
          const workbook = XLSX.read(data, { type: 'array', cellDates: true });
          const first = workbook.SheetNames[0];
          const rows = XLSX.utils.sheet_to_json(workbook.Sheets[first], { raw: false, defval: '' });
          finalize(rows, file.name);
        };
        reader.readAsArrayBuffer(file);
      } else {
        alert('Please upload a CSV or Excel file.');
      }
    }
    function finalize(rawRows, filename) {
      if (!rawRows || rawRows.length === 0) { alert('No data found in file.'); return; }
      DATA = normalizeRows(rawRows);
      DASHBOARD_TITLE = deriveTitle(filename);
      document.getElementById('dash-title').textContent = DASHBOARD_TITLE;
      document.getElementById('upload-screen').style.display = 'none';
      document.getElementById('app').style.display = 'block';
      populateFilters();
      applyFilters();
    }
    function deriveTitle(filename) {
      const base = filename.replace(/\.[^/.]+$/, '').replace(/[_-]+/g, ' ');
      const clean = base.split(' ').map(w => w.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + w.slice(1).toLowerCase()).join(' ');
      return `${clean} — Healthcare & MedTech Inside Sales Command Center`;
    }

    // =
    // FILTERS
    // =
    let msOwner = null;
    function populateFilters() {
      const segments = [...new Set(DATA.map(r => r.accountSegment).filter(Boolean))].sort();
      const owners = [...new Set(DATA.map(r => r.contactOwner).filter(Boolean))].sort();
      const stages = [...new Set(DATA.map(r => r.lifecycleStage).filter(Boolean))].sort();
      const sources = [...new Set(DATA.map(r => r.originalTrafficSource).filter(Boolean))].sort();

      fillSelect('filter-segment', segments);
      fillSelect('filter-stage', stages);
      fillSelect('filter-traffic', sources);

      const msContainer = document.getElementById('ms-owner');
      msContainer.querySelector('.ms-list').innerHTML = '';
      owners.forEach(opt => {
        const label = document.createElement('label');
        label.innerHTML = `<input type="checkbox" value="${escapeHtml(opt)}" checked> <span>${escapeHtml(opt)}</span>`;
        msContainer.querySelector('.ms-list').appendChild(label);
      });
      if (!msOwner) {
        msOwner = createMultiSelect('ms-owner', () => applyFilters());
      } else {
        msOwner.updateTrigger();
      }

      const dates = DATA.map(r => r.createDate).filter(Boolean);
      if (dates.length) {
        document.getElementById('filter-date-from').valueAsDate = new Date(Math.min(...dates));
        document.getElementById('filter-date-to').valueAsDate = new Date(Math.max(...dates));
      }
    }
    function fillSelect(id, opts) {
      const sel = document.getElementById(id);
      sel.innerHTML = '<option value="">All</option>' + opts.map(o => `<option value="${escapeHtml(o)}">${escapeHtml(o)}</option>`).join('');
    }
    function createMultiSelect(id, onChange) {
      const container = document.getElementById(id);
      const trigger = container.querySelector('.ms-trigger');
      const list = container.querySelector('.ms-list');
      const btnAll = container.querySelector('.ms-all');
      const btnNone = container.querySelector('.ms-none');

      function updateTrigger() {
        const checked = list.querySelectorAll('input:checked');
        const total = list.querySelectorAll('input').length;
        trigger.textContent = checked.length === total ? 'All Owners' : `${checked.length} selected`;
        if (onChange) onChange();
      }
      list.addEventListener('change', updateTrigger);
      btnAll.addEventListener('click', e => { e.stopPropagation(); list.querySelectorAll('input').forEach(i => i.checked = true); updateTrigger(); if (onChange) onChange(); });
      btnNone.addEventListener('click', e => { e.stopPropagation(); list.querySelectorAll('input').forEach(i => i.checked = false); updateTrigger(); if (onChange) onChange(); });
      trigger.addEventListener('click', e => { e.stopPropagation(); document.querySelectorAll('.multi-select').forEach(m => { if (m !== container) m.classList.remove('open'); }); container.classList.toggle('open'); });
      updateTrigger();
      return {
        getSelected: () => Array.from(list.querySelectorAll('input:checked')).map(c => c.value),
        updateTrigger
      };
    }
    document.addEventListener('click', () => document.querySelectorAll('.multi-select').forEach(m => m.classList.remove('open')));

    function applyFilters() {
      const seg = document.getElementById('filter-segment').value;
      const stage = document.getElementById('filter-stage').value;
      const traffic = document.getElementById('filter-traffic').value;
      const owners = msOwner ? msOwner.getSelected() : [];
      const dateFrom = document.getElementById('filter-date-from').valueAsDate;
      const dateTo = document.getElementById('filter-date-to').valueAsDate;

      FILTERS = { seg, stage, traffic, owners, dateFrom, dateTo };
      FILTERED = DATA.filter(r => {
        if (seg && r.accountSegment !== seg) return false;
        if (stage && r.lifecycleStage !== stage) return false;
        if (traffic && r.originalTrafficSource !== traffic) return false;
        if (owners.length > 0 && !owners.includes(r.contactOwner)) return false;
        if (dateFrom && r.createDate && r.createDate < dateFrom) return false;
        if (dateTo && r.createDate && r.createDate > dateTo) return false;
        return true;
      });
      updateFilterBadge();
      renderDashboard();
    }
    function updateFilterBadge() {
      let c = 0;
      if (FILTERS.seg) c++;
      if (FILTERS.stage) c++;
      if (FILTERS.traffic) c++;
      const allOwners = [...new Set(DATA.map(r=>r.contactOwner).filter(Boolean))].length;
      if (FILTERS.owners.length !== allOwners) c++;
      if (FILTERS.dateFrom || FILTERS.dateTo) c++;
      const badge = document.getElementById('filter-badge');
      badge.textContent = c ? `${c} active` : 'Filters';
    }
    document.getElementById('reset-filters').addEventListener('click', () => {
      document.getElementById('filter-segment').value = '';
      document.getElementById('filter-stage').value = '';
      document.getElementById('filter-traffic').value = '';
      if (msOwner) { document.querySelectorAll('#ms-owner .ms-list input').forEach(i => i.checked = true); msOwner.updateTrigger(); }
      const dates = DATA.map(r => r.createDate).filter(Boolean);
      if (dates.length) {
        document.getElementById('filter-date-from').valueAsDate = new Date(Math.min(...dates));
        document.getElementById('filter-date-to').valueAsDate = new Date(Math.max(...dates));
      }
      applyFilters();
    });

      if (!FILTERED.length) return;
      const cols = ['recordId','firstName','lastName','contactOwner','accountSegment','lifecycleStage','createDate','lastActivityDate','numSalesActivities','numFormSubmissions','originalTrafficSource'];
      const rows = FILTERED.map(r => {
        const o = {};
        cols.forEach(c => { o[c] = r[c] instanceof Date ? r[c].toISOString() : (r[c] ?? ''); });
        return o;
      });
      const csv = Papa.unparse(rows);
      const blob = new Blob([csv], {type:'text/csv'});
      const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
      const a = document.createElement('a');
      a.href = url;
      a.download = DASHBOARD_TITLE.replace(/[^a-z0-9]/gi,'_') + '_export.csv';
      a.click();
      URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
    });

      document.getElementById('tab-' + tabId).classList.add('active');
      document.querySelectorAll('.tab-btn').forEach(b => b.classList.toggle('active', b.dataset.tab === tabId));

    }

    function updateHeaderInfo() {
      document.getElementById('record-count').textContent = `${fmtNum(FILTERED.length)} records`;
      const dates = FILTERED.map(r => r.createDate).filter(Boolean);
      if (dates.length) {
        const min = new Date(Math.min(...dates));
        const max = new Date(Math.max(...dates));
        document.getElementById('date-range').textContent = `${min.toLocaleDateString()} – ${max.toLocaleDateString()}`;
      } else {
        document.getElementById('date-range').textContent = 'No date range';
      }
    }

    // =
    // KPIs
    // =
    function isQualifiedStage(stage) {
      if (!stage) return false;
      const s = stage.toLowerCase();
      if (s.includes('qualif') || s.includes('opportunit') || s.includes('customer') || s.includes('won') || s.includes('closed') || s.includes('sqo') || s.includes('sales qualified')) return true;
      if (s.includes('subscriber') || s.includes('lead') || s.includes('new') || s.includes('raw') || s.includes('prospect')) return false;
      return false;
    }
    function computeMetrics(data) {
      const total = data.length;
      if (!total) return { total:0, unworked:0, stale:0, avgSales:0, avgForms:0, avgSessions:0, qualifiedCount:0, medianTime:0, topSource:'—', topSourceCount:0, agentCount:0, agentsWithUnworked:0 };
      const unworked = data.filter(r => r.contactUnworked).length;
      const stale = data.filter(r => !r.lastActivityDate).length;
      const avgSales = safeMean(data.map(r => r.numSalesActivities));
      const avgForms = safeMean(data.map(r => r.numFormSubmissions));
      const avgSessions = safeMean(data.map(r => r.numSessions));
      const qualifiedCount = data.filter(r => isQualifiedStage(r.lifecycleStage)).length;
      const times = data.map(r => r.timeInStage).filter(v => v != null);
      const medianTime = times.length ? median(times) : 0;
      const traffic = groupBy(data, 'originalTrafficSource');
      const trafficSorted = Object.entries(traffic).sort((a,b) => b[1].length - a[1].length);
      const topSource = trafficSorted[0]?.[0] || '—';
      const topSourceCount = trafficSorted[0]?.[1].length || 0;
      const agents = groupBy(data, 'contactOwner');
      const agentCount = Object.keys(agents).length;
      const agentsWithUnworked = Object.values(agents).filter(list => list.some(r => r.contactUnworked)).length;
      return { total, unworked, stale, avgSales, avgForms, avgSessions, qualifiedCount, medianTime, topSource, topSourceCount, agentCount, agentsWithUnworked };
    }
    function renderKPIs() {
      const m = computeMetrics(FILTERED);
      const set = (id, val, sub) => {
        const el = document.getElementById(id);
        if (!el) return;
        el.querySelector('.kpi-value').textContent = val;
        const subEl = el.querySelector('.kpi-sub');
        if (sub && subEl) subEl.textContent = sub;
      };
      set('kpi-total', fmtNum(m.total), `${fmtNum(m.agentCount)} agents`);
      set('kpi-unworked', fmtPct(m.unworked/m.total), `${fmtNum(m.unworked)} leads`);
      set('kpi-qualified', fmtPct(m.qualifiedCount/m.total), `${fmtNum(m.qualifiedCount)} leads`);
      set('kpi-stale', fmtPct(m.stale/m.total), `${fmtNum(m.stale)} leads`);
      set('kpi-avg-sales', fmtDec(m.avgSales), 'per lead');
      set('kpi-avg-forms', fmtDec(m.avgForms), 'per lead');
      set('kpi-avg-sessions', fmtDec(m.avgSessions), 'per lead');
      set('kpi-top-source', m.topSource, `${fmtPct((m.topSourceCount||0)/m.total)} of volume`);
      set('kpi-median-time', fmtDuration(m.medianTime), 'in current stage');
      set('kpi-agents-unworked', fmtNum(m.agentsWithUnworked), 'agents');
    }

    // =
    // NARRATIVE
    // =
    function renderNarrative() {
      const m = computeMetrics(FILTERED);
      const ul = document.getElementById('narrative-list');
      if (!ul) return;
      const items = [];
      items.push(`Total pipeline comprises <strong>${fmtNum(m.total)}</strong> leads.`);
      if (m.unworked > 0) items.push(`<strong>${fmtPct(m.unworked/m.total)}</strong> are unworked (${fmtNum(m.unworked)} records), posing immediate follow-up risk.`);
      items.push(`Top acquisition channel is <strong>${escapeHtml(m.topSource)}</strong>, driving ${fmtPct((m.topSourceCount||0)/m.total)} of volume.`);
      items.push(`Average engagement depth is <strong>${fmtDec(m.avgSales)}</strong> sales activities per lead.`);
      if (m.stale > 0) items.push(`<strong>${fmtNum(m.stale)}</strong> leads lack a last activity date, indicating stale inventory.`);
      items.push(`Pipeline spans <strong>${fmtNum(m.agentCount)}</strong> agents with varying performance.`);
      ul.innerHTML = items.map(s => `<li>${s}</li>`).join('');
    }

    // =
    // CHART ENGINE
    // =
    function renderChart(id, optionFn, hasData) {
      const dom = document.getElementById(id);
      if (!dom) return;
      const box = dom.closest('.chart-box');
      const overlay = box ? box.querySelector('.chart-overlay') : null;
      if (!hasData) {
        if (overlay) overlay.style.display = 'flex';
        if (charts[id]) { charts[id].dispose(); delete charts[id]; }
        return;
      }
      if (overlay) overlay.style.display = 'none';
      const theme = getThemeColors();
      if (!charts[id]) charts[id] = echarts.init(dom);
      const opt = optionFn(FILTERED, theme);
      opt.backgroundColor = 'transparent';
      if (!opt.textStyle) opt.textStyle = {};
      opt.textStyle.fontFamily = 'Sora, sans-serif';
      charts[id].setOption(opt, true);
    }
    window.addEventListener('resize', () => { Object.values(charts).forEach(c => c.resize()); });

    // =
    // OVERVIEW TAB
    // =
    function renderOverviewTab(data) {
      renderChart('chart-lifecycle', (d, t) => {
        const g = groupBy(d, 'lifecycleStage');
        const items = Object.entries(g).sort((a,b) => a[1].length - b[1].length);
        return {
          color: PALETTE,
          tooltip: { trigger:'axis' },
          grid: { left:'3%', right:'6%', bottom:'3%', containLabel:true },
          xAxis: { type:'value', axisLine:{lineStyle:{color:t.axisColor}}, axisLabel:{color:t.textColor}, splitLine:{lineStyle:{color:t.gridColor}} },
          yAxis: { type:'category', data: items.map(i=>i[0]), axisLine:{lineStyle:{color:t.axisColor}}, axisLabel:{color:t.textColor} },
          series: [{ type:'bar', data: items.map(i=>i[1].length), itemStyle:{borderRadius:[0,4,4,0]}, label:{show:true, position:'right', color:t.textColor} }]
        };
      }, data.length > 0);

      renderChart('chart-segment', (d, t) => {
        const g = groupBy(d, 'accountSegment');
        const entries = Object.entries(g).sort((a,b) => b[1].length - a[1].length);
        return {
          color: PALETTE,
          tooltip: { trigger:'item' },
          legend: { orient:'vertical', left:'left', textStyle:{color:t.textColor} },
          series: [{ type:'pie', radius:['40%','70%'], center:['60%','50%'], data: entries.map(e=>({value:e[1].length, name:e[0]||'Unknown'})), label:{color:t.textColor} }]
        };
      }, data.length > 0);

      renderChart('chart-traffic', (d, t) => {
        const g = groupBy(d, 'originalTrafficSource');
        const items = Object.entries(g).sort((a,b) => a[1].length - b[1].length).slice(-10);
        return {
          color: [PALETTE[0]],
          tooltip: { trigger:'axis' },
          grid: { left:'3%', right:'6%', bottom:'3%', containLabel:true },
          xAxis: { type:'value', axisLine:{lineStyle:{color:t.axisColor}}, axisLabel:{color:t.textColor}, splitLine:{lineStyle:{color:t.gridColor}} },
          yAxis: { type:'category', data: items.map(i=>i[0]), axisLine:{lineStyle:{color:t.axisColor}}, axisLabel:{color:t.textColor} },
          series: [{ type:'bar', data: items.map(i=>i[1].length), itemStyle:{borderRadius:[0,4,4,0]}, label:{show:true, position:'right', color:t.textColor} }]
        };
      }, data.length > 0);

      renderChart('chart-creation-trend', (d, t) => {
        const g = {};
        d.forEach(r => { if (!r.createDate) return; const k = formatYM(r.createDate); g[k] = (g[k]||0)+1; });
        const keys = Object.keys(g).sort();
        return {
          color: [PALETTE[1]],
          tooltip: { trigger:'axis' },
          grid: { left:'3%', right:'4%', bottom:'3%', containLabel:true },
          xAxis: { type:'category', data:keys, axisLine:{lineStyle:{color:t.axisColor}}, axisLabel:{color:t.textColor} },
          yAxis: { type:'value', splitLine:{lineStyle:{color:t.gridColor}}, axisLabel:{color:t.textColor} },
          series: [{ type:'line', data:keys.map(k=>g[k]), smooth:true, areaStyle:{opacity:0.2}, symbol:'circle' }]
        };
      }, data.length > 0);
    }

    // =
    // TRENDS TAB
    // =
    function renderTrendsTab(data) {
      renderChart('chart-activity-trend', (d, t) => {
        const months = {};
        d.forEach(r => {
          if (!r.createDate) return;
          const k = formatYM(r.createDate);
          if (!months[k]) months[k] = { sales:[], forms:[] };
          months[k].sales.push(r.numSalesActivities);
          months[k].forms.push(r.numFormSubmissions);
        });
        const keys = Object.keys(months).sort();
        const avg = arr => arr.length ? arr.reduce((a,b)=>a+b,0)/arr.length : 0;
        return {
          color: [PALETTE[0], PALETTE[2]],
          tooltip: { trigger:'axis' },
          legend: { textStyle:{color:t.textColor} },
          grid: { left:'3%', right:'4%', bottom:'3%', containLabel:true },
          xAxis: { type:'category', data:keys, axisLine:{lineStyle:{color:t.axisColor}}, axisLabel:{color:t.textColor} },
          yAxis: { type:'value', splitLine:{lineStyle:{color:t.gridColor}}, axisLabel:{color:t.textColor} },
          series: [
            { name:'Avg Sales Activities', type:'line', data:keys.map(k=> +avg(months[k].sales).toFixed(2)), smooth:true },
            { name:'Avg Form Submissions', type:'line', data:keys.map(k=> +avg(months[k].forms).toFixed(2)), smooth:true }
          ]
        };
      }, data.length > 0);

      renderChart('chart-cumulative', (d, t) => {
        const g = {};
        d.forEach(r => { if (!r.createDate) return; const k = formatYM(r.createDate); g[k] = (g[k]||0)+1; });
        const keys = Object.keys(g).sort();
        let cum = 0;
        const vals = keys.map(k => { cum += g[k]; return cum; });
        return {
          color: [PALETTE[3]],
          tooltip: { trigger:'axis' },
          grid: { left:'3%', right:'4%', bottom:'3%', containLabel:true },
          xAxis: { type:'category', data:keys, axisLine:{lineStyle:{color:t.axisColor}}, axisLabel:{color:t.textColor} },
          yAxis: { type:'value', splitLine:{lineStyle:{color:t.gridColor}}, axisLabel:{color:t.textColor} },
          series: [{ type:'line', data:vals, smooth:true, areaStyle:{opacity:0.3}, symbol:'circle' }]
        };
      }, data.length > 0);

      renderChart('chart-traffic-drill', (d, t) => {
        const src = groupBy(d, 'originalTrafficSource');
        const topSources = Object.entries(src).sort((a,b) => b[1].length - a[1].length).slice(0,7).map(e => e[0]);
        const g = {};
        d.forEach(r => {
          if (!topSources.includes(r.originalTrafficSource)) return;
          const dd = r.originalTrafficSourceDrillDown1 || '(Blank)';
          g[dd] = (g[dd]||0) + 1;
        });
        const items = Object.entries(g).sort((a,b) => a[1] - b[1]).slice(-10);
        return {
          color: [PALETTE[4]],
          tooltip: { trigger:'axis' },
          grid: { left:'3%', right:'6%', bottom:'3%', containLabel:true },
          xAxis: { type:'value', axisLine:{lineStyle:{color:t.axisColor}}, axisLabel:{color:t.textColor}, splitLine:{lineStyle:{color:t.gridColor}} },
          yAxis: { type:'category', data: items.map(i=>i[0]), axisLine:{lineStyle:{color:t.axisColor}}, axisLabel:{color:t.textColor} },
          series: [{ type:'bar', data: items.map(i=>i[1]), itemStyle:{borderRadius:[0,4,4,0]}, label:{show:true, position:'right', color:t.textColor} }]
        };
      }, data.length > 0);

      renderChart('chart-stage-trend', (d, t) => {
        const months = {};
        const stages = new Set();
        d.forEach(r => {
          if (!r.createDate || !r.lifecycleStage) return;
          const k = formatYM(r.createDate);
          stages.add(r.lifecycleStage);
          if (!months[k]) months[k] = {};
          months[k][r.lifecycleStage] = (months[k][r.lifecycleStage]||0) + 1;
        });
        const keys = Object.keys(months).sort();
        const stageArr = Array.from(stages);
        return {
          color: PALETTE,
          tooltip: { trigger:'axis' },
          legend: { textStyle:{color:t.textColor} },
          grid: { left:'3%', right:'4%', bottom:'3%', containLabel:true },
          xAxis: { type:'category', data:keys, axisLine:{lineStyle:{color:t.axisColor}}, axisLabel:{color:t.textColor} },
          yAxis: { type:'value', splitLine:{lineStyle:{color:t.gridColor}}, axisLabel:{color:t.textColor} },
          series: stageArr.map((s,i) => ({
            name: s, type:'bar', stack:'total',
            data: keys.map(k => months[k][s] || 0),
            itemStyle: { color: PALETTE[i % PALETTE.length] }
          }))
        };
      }, data.length > 0);
    }

    // =
    // AGENTS TAB
    // =
    function computeAgentMetrics(data) {
      const byOwner = groupBy(data, 'contactOwner');
      const agents = Object.keys(byOwner).map(name => {
        const rows = byOwner[name];
        const total = rows.length;
        const unworked = rows.filter(r => r.contactUnworked).length;
        const unworkedPct = total ? unworked/total : 0;
        const avgSales = safeMean(rows.map(r => r.numSalesActivities));
        const avgForms = safeMean(rows.map(r => r.numFormSubmissions));
        const avgSessions = safeMean(rows.map(r => r.numSessions));
        const qualified = rows.filter(r => isQualifiedStage(r.lifecycleStage)).length;
        const qualRate = total ? qualified/total : 0;
        const times = rows.map(r => r.timeInStage).filter(v => v != null);
        const medianTime = times.length ? median(times) : 0;
        return { name, total, unworked, unworkedPct, avgSales, avgForms, avgSessions, qualRate, medianTime };
      });
      const maxTotal = Math.max(...agents.map(a=>a.total),1);
      const minUnworkedPct = Math.min(...agents.map(a=>a.unworkedPct),0);
      const maxUnworkedPct = Math.max(...agents.map(a=>a.unworkedPct),1);
      const maxAvgSales = Math.max(...agents.map(a=>a.avgSales),1);
      const maxQualRate = Math.max(...agents.map(a=>a.qualRate),1);
      agents.forEach(a => {
        const nLeads = a.total / maxTotal;
        const nUnworked = maxUnworkedPct === minUnworkedPct ? 0.5 : 1 - ((a.unworkedPct - minUnworkedPct) / (maxUnworkedPct - minUnworkedPct));
        const nSales = a.avgSales / maxAvgSales;
        const nQual = maxQualRate === 0 ? 0 : a.qualRate / maxQualRate;
        a.score = (nLeads*0.25 + nUnworked*0.25 + nSales*0.25 + nQual*0.25) * 100;
      });
      agents.sort((a,b) => b.score - a.score);
      const n = agents.length;
      agents.forEach((a,i) => {
        const pct = i / (n || 1);
        if (pct < 0.2) a.tier = 'Top Performer';
        else if (pct > 0.8) a.tier = 'Underperforming';
        else a.tier = 'Average';
      });
      return agents;
    }
    function renderAgentsTab(data) {
      const agents = computeAgentMetrics(data);
      renderChart('chart-agent-score', (d, t) => {
        const items = agents.slice(0,15);
        return {
          color: [PALETTE[0]],
          tooltip: { trigger:'axis', formatter: p => `${p[0].name}: ${p[0].value.toFixed(1)}` },
          grid: { left:'3%', right:'6%', bottom:'3%', containLabel:true },
          xAxis: { type:'value', max:100, axisLine:{lineStyle:{color:t.axisColor}}, axisLabel:{color:t.textColor}, splitLine:{lineStyle:{color:t.gridColor}} },
          yAxis: { type:'category', data: items.map(a=>a.name).reverse(), axisLine:{lineStyle:{color:t.axisColor}}, axisLabel:{color:t.textColor} },
          series: [{ type:'bar', data: items.map(a=> +a.score.toFixed(1)).reverse(), itemStyle:{borderRadius:[0,4,4,0]}, label:{show:true, position:'right', color:t.textColor} }]
        };
      }, agents.length > 0);

      renderChart('chart-agent-unworked', (d, t) => {
        const items = agents.filter(a=>a.unworked>0).sort((a,b)=>b.unworked - a.unworked).slice(0,15);
        return {
          color: [PALETTE[3]],
          tooltip: { trigger:'axis' },
          grid: { left:'3%', right:'6%', bottom:'3%', containLabel:true },
          xAxis: { type:'value', axisLine:{lineStyle:{color:t.axisColor}}, axisLabel:{color:t.textColor}, splitLine:{lineStyle:{color:t.gridColor}} },
          yAxis: { type:'category', data: items.map(a=>a.name).reverse(), axisLine:{lineStyle:{color:t.axisColor}}, axisLabel:{color:t.textColor} },
          series: [{ type:'bar', data: items.map(a=>a.unworked).reverse(), itemStyle:{borderRadius:[0,4,4,0]}, label:{show:true, position:'right', color:t.textColor} }]
        };
      }, agents.some(a=>a.unworked>0));

      const sort = document.getElementById('agent-sort').value;
      const sorted = agents.slice().sort((a,b) => {
        if (sort === 'leads') return b.total - a.total;
        if (sort === 'unworked') return b.unworkedPct - a.unworkedPct;
        if (sort === 'activities') return b.avgSales - a.avgSales;
        return b.score - a.score;
      });
      const maxScore = Math.max(...agents.map(a=>a.score),1);
      const grid = document.getElementById('agent-cards-grid');
      grid.innerHTML = sorted.map(a => `
        <div class="agent-card">
          <div class="agent-header">
            <div class="agent-name">${escapeHtml(a.name)}</div>
            <span class="agent-badge ${a.tier==='Top Performer'?'badge-top':a.tier==='Underperforming'?'badge-under':'badge-average'}">${a.tier}</span>
          </div>
          <div class="agent-metrics">
            <div class="agent-metric"><span>Total Leads</span><strong>${fmtNum(a.total)}</strong></div>
            <div class="agent-metric"><span>Unworked</span><strong>${fmtNum(a.unworked)} <span style="color:var(--text-muted);font-size:11px">(${fmtPct(a.unworkedPct)})</span></strong></div>
            <div class="agent-metric"><span>Avg Activities</span><strong>${fmtDec(a.avgSales)}</strong></div>
            <div class="agent-metric"><span>Qualification Rate</span><strong>${fmtPct(a.qualRate)}</strong></div>
            <div class="agent-metric"><span>Avg Sessions</span><strong>${fmtDec(a.avgSessions)}</strong></div>
            <div class="agent-metric"><span>Med. Time in Stage</span><strong>${fmtDuration(a.medianTime)}</strong></div>
          </div>
          <div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;font-size:12px;color:var(--text-muted)">
            <span>Score</span>
            <div class="agent-bar-bg"><div class="agent-bar-fill" style="width:${(a.score/maxScore*100).toFixed(1)}%"></div></div>
            <span style="font-weight:700;color:var(--text)">${a.score.toFixed(0)}</span>
          </div>
        </div>
      `).join('');
    }
    document.getElementById('agent-sort').addEventListener('change', () => renderAgentsTab(FILTERED));

    function renderQualityTab() {
      const target = DATA.length ? DATA : [];
      renderChart('chart-missing', (d, t) => {
        const cols = [
          {k:'email',l:'Email'},{k:'phone',l:'Phone'},{k:'jobTitle',l:'Job Title'},{k:'persona',l:'Persona'},
          {k:'state',l:'State'},{k:'city',l:'City'},{k:'lastActivityDate',l:'Last Activity'},{k:'callResponseStatus',l:'Call Response'},
          {k:'leadFitScore',l:'Lead Fit Score'},{k:'disqualificationReason',l:'Lost Reason'}
        ];
        const computed = cols.map(c => {
          const missing = target.filter(r => r[c.k]==null).length;
          return { label: c.l, pct: target.length ? (missing/target.length)*100 : 0 };
        }).sort((a,b)=>b.pct - a.pct);
        return {
          color: [PALETTE[3]],
          tooltip: { trigger:'axis', formatter: p => `${p[0].name}: ${p[0].value.toFixed(1)}% missing` },
          grid: { left:'3%', right:'8%', bottom:'3%', containLabel:true },
          xAxis: { type:'value', max:100, axisLine:{lineStyle:{color:t.axisColor}}, axisLabel:{formatter:'{value}%', color:t.textColor}, splitLine:{lineStyle:{color:t.gridColor}} },
          yAxis: { type:'category', data: computed.map(c=>c.label), axisLine:{lineStyle:{color:t.axisColor}}, axisLabel:{color:t.textColor} },
          series: [{ type:'bar', data: computed.map(c=> +c.pct.toFixed(1)), itemStyle:{borderRadius:[0,4,4,0]}, label:{show:true, position:'right', formatter:'{c}%', color:t.textColor} }]
        };
      }, target.length > 0);

      renderChart('chart-constants', (d, t) => {
        const consts = [];
        Object.keys(COL_MAP).forEach(key => {
          const vals = target.map(r => r[key]).filter(v => v != null);
          const uniq = [...new Set(vals.map(v => String(v)))];
          if (uniq.length <= 1) consts.push({ col: key, count: vals.length });
        });
        const items = consts.slice(0, 12);
        return {
          color: [PALETTE[4]],
          tooltip: { trigger:'axis' },
          grid: { left:'3%', right:'6%', bottom:'3%', containLabel:true },
          xAxis: { type:'value', axisLine:{lineStyle:{color:t.axisColor}}, axisLabel:{color:t.textColor}, splitLine:{lineStyle:{color:t.gridColor}} },
          yAxis: { type:'category', data: items.map(i=>i.col), axisLine:{lineStyle:{color:t.axisColor}}, axisLabel:{color:t.textColor} },
          series: [{ type:'bar', data: items.map(i=>i.count), itemStyle:{borderRadius:[0,4,4,0]}, label:{show:true, position:'right', color:t.textColor} }]
        };
      }, target.length > 0);

      renderChart('chart-completeness', (d, t) => {
        const buckets = { '0-20%':0, '21-40%':0, '41-60%':0, '61-80%':0, '81-100%':0 };
        const qkeys = ['email','phone','jobTitle','persona','state','city','lastActivityDate','callResponseStatus','leadFitScore','disqualificationReason'];
        target.forEach(r => {
          let present = 0;
          qkeys.forEach(k => { if (r[k] != null) present++; });
          const p = present / qkeys.length * 100;
          if (p <= 20) buckets['0-20%']++;
          else if (p <= 40) buckets['21-40%']++;
          else if (p <= 60) buckets['41-60%']++;
          else if (p <= 80) buckets['61-80%']++;
          else buckets['81-100%']++;
        });
        const cats = Object.keys(buckets);
        return {
          color: [PALETTE[1]],
          tooltip: { trigger:'axis' },
          grid: { left:'3%', right:'4%', bottom:'3%', containLabel:true },
          xAxis: { type:'category', data:cats, axisLine:{lineStyle:{color:t.axisColor}}, axisLabel:{color:t.textColor} },
          yAxis: { type:'value', axisLabel:{color:t.textColor}, splitLine:{lineStyle:{color:t.gridColor}} },
          series: [{ type:'bar', data:cats.map(c=>buckets[c]), itemStyle:{borderRadius:[4,4,0,0]}, label:{show:true, position:'top', color:t.textColor} }]
        };
      }, target.length > 0);
    }

  <script>
    const AUDIT = {
      totalRows: 3282,
      stagnantCount: 225,
      stagnantPct: 6.85,
      missingEmailPct: 35.86,
      missingLastNamePct: 10.51,
      missingJobTitlePct: 78.79,
      missingDisqualifyPct: 42.5,
      avgLeadScore: -9.05,
      orphanedOwner: 'Niranjan Kumar'
    };

    const SAMPLE_DATA = [
      {
        "Record ID": 1,
        "First Name": null,
        "Last Name": null,
        "Account Segment": null,
        "Average Pageviews": 0,
        "Contact Stage": "Contact unworked",
        "Contact owner": "Shreya Sawant",
        "Create Date": "2026-05-14 15:27:00",
        "Email": null,
        "HubSpot Team": "Inside Sales",
        "Lead Score": -10,
        "Number of Sales Activities": 2,
        "Number of times contacted": 1,
        "Original Traffic Source": "Paid Social",
        "Phone Number": " +918974210663",
        "State.": "Odisha",
        "Time in current stage (HH:mm:ss)": "03:13:09",
        "What best describes you?": "doctor_/_cardiologist",
        "Zigment stage": "Zigment Not Connected",
        "Disqualification/Lost reason": null,
        "Job Title": null,
        "City": null,
        "Number of event completions": 0,
        "Recent Conversion": "Facebook Lead Ads: SME 2026 April"
      }
    ];

    const appState = {
      rawData: [],
      filteredData: [],
      filters: { owner:'All', segment:'All', source:'All', stage:'All' },
      theme: 'dark',
      pagination: { page:1, rowsPerPage:15 }
    };

    const charts = {};

    function normalize(v) {
      if (v === undefined || v === null) return null;
      if (typeof v === 'string') {
        const t = v.trim();
        if (t === '' || t.toLowerCase()==='nan' || t.toLowerCase()==='null' || t.toLowerCase()==='undefined') return null;
        if (/^-?\d+$/.test(t)) return parseInt(t,10);
        if (/^-?\d+\.\d+$/.test(t)) return parseFloat(t);
        return t;
      }
      return v;
    }

    function normalizeRows(rows) {
      return rows.map(r => {
        const out = {};
        for (const k in r) out[k] = normalize(r[k]);
        return out;
      });
    }

    function isQualified(row) {
      const s = (row['Contact Stage']||'').toLowerCase();
      const z = (row['Zigment stage']||'').toLowerCase();
      return s.includes('qualif') || (s.includes('connected') && !s.includes('not')) || (z.includes('connected') && !z.includes('not connected'));
    }

    function isStagnant(row) {
      const acts = parseFloat(row['Number of Sales Activities'])||0;
      const s = (row['Contact Stage']||'').toLowerCase();
      const z = (row['Zigment stage']||'').toLowerCase();
      return acts===0 && (s==='contact unworked' || z.includes('not connected'));
    }

    function isOrphaned(row) { return row['Contact owner'] === AUDIT.orphanedOwner; }
    function isMissingCore(row) { return !row['Email'] || !row['Last Name'] || !row['Job Title']; }
    function isMissingDisqualify(row) {
      const s = (row['Contact Stage']||'').toLowerCase();
      return (s.includes('lost') || s.includes('disqualified')) && !row['Disqualification/Lost reason'];
    }
    function isMalformedPhone(row) {
      const p = (row['Phone Number']||'').trim();
      if (!p) return false;
      return /[a-zA-Z]/.test(p) || (p.match(/\+/g)||[]).length > 1 || (p.match(/\d/g)||[]).length < 7;
    }
    function isZeroEngagement(row) {
      const pv = parseFloat(row['Average Pageviews'])||0;
      const ec = parseFloat(row['Number of event completions'])||0;
      return pv===0 && ec===0;
    }
    function isNegativeCritical(row) {
      const s = parseFloat(row['Lead Score']);
      return !isNaN(s) && s < -25;
    }

    function handleDragOver(e) { e.preventDefault(); e.currentTarget.classList.add('border-cyan-500','dark:border-cyan-400','bg-cyan-50','dark:bg-cyan-900/20'); }
    function handleDragLeave(e) { e.preventDefault(); e.currentTarget.classList.remove('border-cyan-500','dark:border-cyan-400','bg-cyan-50','dark:bg-cyan-900/20'); }
    function handleDrop(e) { e.preventDefault(); handleDragLeave(e); const f = e.dataTransfer.files; if (f.length) processCSVFile(f[0]); }
    function handleFileSelect(e) { const f = e.target.files; if (f.length) processCSVFile(f[0]); }
    function processCSVFile(file) {
      if (!file.name.toLowerCase().endsWith('.csv')) { alert('Please upload a CSV file.'); return; }
      Papa.parse(file, { header:true, skipEmptyLines:true, complete:function(res){
        const rows = normalizeRows(res.data||[]);
        if (rows.length>0) {
          appState.rawData = rows;
          document.getElementById('csvStatus').className = 'mt-6 p-3 rounded-lg bg-emerald-50 dark:bg-emerald-900/20 border border-emerald-200 dark:border-emerald-800 text-[11px] text-emerald-800 dark:text-emerald-300 leading-snug';
          document.getElementById('csvStatus').textContent = `Loaded ${rows.length.toLocaleString()} rows from ${file.name}`;
          initApp();
        } else { alert('CSV file appears empty or invalid.'); }
      }, error:function(){ alert('Failed to parse CSV.'); }});
    }

    function loadCSV() {
      Papa.parse('cleaned_data.csv', {
        download: true,
        header: true,
        skipEmptyLines: true,
        complete: function(res) {
          const rows = normalizeRows(res.data||[]);
          if (rows.length > 0) {
            appState.rawData = rows;
            document.getElementById('csvStatus').className = 'mt-6 p-3 rounded-lg bg-emerald-50 dark:bg-emerald-900/20 border border-emerald-200 dark:border-emerald-800 text-[11px] text-emerald-800 dark:text-emerald-300 leading-snug';
            document.getElementById('csvStatus').textContent = `Loaded ${rows.length.toLocaleString()} rows from cleaned_data.csv`;
          } else {
            useSample();
          }
          initApp();
        },
        error: function() {
          useSample();
          initApp();
        }
      });
    }

    function useSample() {
      appState.rawData = normalizeRows(SAMPLE_DATA);
      document.getElementById('csvStatus').className = 'mt-6 p-3 rounded-lg bg-amber-50 dark:bg-amber-900/20 border border-amber-200 dark:border-amber-800 text-[11px] text-amber-800 dark:text-amber-300 leading-snug';
      document.getElementById('csvStatus').textContent = 'Previewing from pipeline metadata. Place cleaned_data.csv alongside this file and refresh for full metrics.';
    }

    function initApp() {
      populateFilters();
      applyFilters();
    }

    function populateFilters() {
      const owners = [...new Set(appState.rawData.map(r=>r['Contact owner']).filter(Boolean))].sort();
      const segments = [...new Set(appState.rawData.map(r=>r['Account Segment']).filter(Boolean))].sort();
      const sources = [...new Set(appState.rawData.map(r=>r['Original Traffic Source']).filter(Boolean))].sort();
      const stages = [...new Set(appState.rawData.map(r=>r['Contact Stage']||r['Zigment stage']).filter(Boolean))].sort();

      const setOpts = (id, vals) => {
        const el = document.getElementById(id);
        el.innerHTML = '<option>All</option>' + vals.map(v=>`<option value="${v}">${v}</option>`).join('');
      };
      setOpts('filter-owner', owners);
      setOpts('filter-segment', segments);
      setOpts('filter-source', sources);
      setOpts('filter-stage', stages);
    }

    function applyFilters() {
      appState.filters.owner = document.getElementById('filter-owner').value;
      appState.filters.segment = document.getElementById('filter-segment').value;
      appState.filters.source = document.getElementById('filter-source').value;
      appState.filters.stage = document.getElementById('filter-stage').value;

      appState.filteredData = appState.rawData.filter(r => {
        if (appState.filters.owner !== 'All' && r['Contact owner'] !== appState.filters.owner) return false;
        if (appState.filters.segment !== 'All' && r['Account Segment'] !== appState.filters.segment) return false;
        if (appState.filters.source !== 'All' && r['Original Traffic Source'] !== appState.filters.source) return false;
        if (appState.filters.stage !== 'All') {
          const stage = r['Contact Stage'] || r['Zigment stage'] || 'Unknown';
          if (stage !== appState.filters.stage) return false;
        }
        return true;
      });

      appState.pagination.page = 1;
      renderKPIs();
      renderCharts();
      renderLeaderboards();
      renderAlerts();
      renderExplorer();
    }

    function resetFilters() {
      document.getElementById('filter-owner').value='All';
      document.getElementById('filter-segment').value='All';
      document.getElementById('filter-source').value='All';
      document.getElementById('filter-stage').value='All';
      applyFilters();
    }

    function renderKPIs() {
      const d = appState.filteredData;
      const n = d.length || 1;
      const safeAvg = (key) => {
        const vals = d.map(r=>parseFloat(r[key])).filter(v=>!isNaN(v));
        return vals.length ? (vals.reduce((a,b)=>a+b,0)/vals.length).toFixed(1) : '0.0';
      };

      const total = d.length;
      const qual = d.filter(isQualified).length;
      const qualRate = total ? ((qual/total)*100).toFixed(1) : '0.0';
      const avgScore = safeAvg('Lead Score');
      const stagnant = d.filter(isStagnant).length;
      const missingCore = d.filter(r => !r['Email']).length;
      const missingCorePct = total ? ((missingCore/total)*100).toFixed(1) : '0.0';
      const orphaned = d.filter(isOrphaned).length;
      const avgTouch = safeAvg('Number of times contacted');
      const avgActs = safeAvg('Number of Sales Activities');

      const sourceCounts = {};
      d.forEach(r=>{ const s=r['Original Traffic Source']||'Unknown'; sourceCounts[s]=(sourceCounts[s]||0)+1; });
      const topSource = Object.entries(sourceCounts).sort((a,b)=>b[1]-a[1])[0]?.[0] || '-';

      const kpiDefs = [
        { id:'kpi-total', label:'Total Leads', value: total.toLocaleString(), sub: 'Active pipeline' },
        { id:'kpi-qual', label:'Qualification Rate', value: qualRate+'%', sub: 'North Star', color: qualRate>20?'text-emerald-500':qualRate>10?'text-amber-500':'text-red-500' },
        { id:'kpi-score', label:'Avg Lead Score', value: avgScore, sub: 'Fit model', color: parseFloat(avgScore)>0?'text-emerald-500':'text-red-500' },
        { id:'kpi-stag', label:'Stagnant Leads', value: stagnant.toLocaleString(), sub: 'Unworked / zero engagement', color: stagnant>50?'text-red-500':'text-amber-500' },
        { id:'kpi-miss', label:'Missing Email', value: missingCorePct+'%', sub: 'Blocking routing & outreach', color: parseFloat(missingCorePct)>30?'text-red-500':'text-amber-500' },
        { id:'kpi-orph', label:'Orphaned Records', value: orphaned.toLocaleString(), sub: 'Deactivated owner', color: orphaned>0?'text-red-500':'text-emerald-500' },
        { id:'kpi-top', label:'Top Channel', value: topSource, sub: 'By lead volume', color: 'text-cyan-500' },
        { id:'kpi-touch', label:'Avg Activities', value: avgActs, sub: 'Sales touches per lead', color: 'text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300' }
      ];

      const container = document.getElementById('kpiGrid');
      container.innerHTML = kpiDefs.map(k=>`
        <div class="glass rounded-xl p-4 flex flex-col justify-between h-28 hover:-translate-y-0.5 transition-transform duration-200">
          <div class="flex justify-between items-start">
            <span class="text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">${k.label}</span>
            <span class="px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800 text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400 text-[9px] font-bold">LIVE</span>
          </div>
          <div>
            <div class="text-2xl md:text-3xl font-bold tracking-tight ${k.color||''}">${k.value}</div>
            <div class="text-[11px] text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 mt-0.5">${k.sub}</div>
          </div>
        </div>
      `).join('');
    }

    function initChartOptions(type, height=320) {
      const isDark = appState.theme==='dark';
      const grid = isDark?'#334155':'#e2e8f0';
      const labels = isDark?'#94a3b8':'#64748b';
      const base = {
        chart: { type, height, toolbar:{show:false}, background:'transparent', animations:{enabled:true} },
        theme:{mode:appState.theme},
        grid:{borderColor:grid, strokeDashArray:4},
        xaxis:{labels:{style:{colors:labels, fontSize:'11px'}}, axisBorder:{color:grid}, axisTicks:{color:grid}},
        yaxis:{labels:{style:{colors:labels, fontSize:'11px'}}},
        legend:{labels:{colors:labels}},
        dataLabels:{enabled:false}
      };
      if (type==='bar'||type==='column') {
        base.plotOptions = { bar: { borderRadius: 4, columnWidth: '55%' } };
        base.colors = ['#22d3ee','#34d399','#fbbf24','#f87171','#a78bfa'];
      }
      return base;
    }

    function renderCharts() {
      const d = appState.filteredData;

      const months = {};
      d.forEach(r=>{
        const raw = r['Create Date']||r['Owner assigned date'];
        if (!raw) return;
        const dt = new Date(raw);
        if (isNaN(dt)) return;
        const key = `${dt.getFullYear()}-${String(dt.getMonth()+1).padStart(2,'0')}`;
        if (!months[key]) months[key] = {total:0, qual:0};
        months[key].total++;
        if (isQualified(r)) months[key].qual++;
      });
      const mKeys = Object.keys(months).sort();
      const northCategories = mKeys.map(k=>{const [y,m]=k.split('-'); return `${m}/${y.slice(2)}`;});
      const northSeries = mKeys.map(k=> months[k].total ? (months[k].qual/months[k].total*100) : 0);

      if (!charts.north) {
        charts.north = new ApexCharts(document.getElementById('northStarChart'), {
          ...initChartOptions('area', 340),
          series: [{name:'Qualification Rate %', data:northSeries}],
          xaxis: { ...initChartOptions('area').xaxis, categories: northCategories },
          colors: ['#22d3ee'],
          fill: { type:'gradient', gradient: { shadeIntensity:1, opacityFrom:0.5, opacityTo:0.05 } },
          stroke: { curve:'smooth', width:3 },
          yaxis: { ...initChartOptions('area').yaxis, labels:{formatter:v=>v.toFixed(0)+'%'} }
        });
        charts.north.render();
      } else {
        charts.north.updateOptions({ xaxis:{categories:northCategories} });
        charts.north.updateSeries([{name:'Qualification Rate %', data:northSeries}]);
      }

      const stageCounts = {};
      d.forEach(r=>{ const s=r['Contact Stage']||r['Zigment stage']||'Unknown'; stageCounts[s]=(stageCounts[s]||0)+1; });
      const donutLabels = Object.keys(stageCounts);
      const donutSeries = Object.values(stageCounts);

      if (!charts.donut) {
        charts.donut = new ApexCharts(document.getElementById('donutChart'), {
          ...initChartOptions('donut', 300),
          series: donutSeries,
          labels: donutLabels,
          plotOptions: { pie: { donut: { labels: { show:true, total: { show:true, label:'Total', formatter:()=>d.length.toLocaleString() } } } } },
          colors: ['#22d3ee','#34d399','#fbbf24','#f87171','#a78bfa','#64748b']
        });
        charts.donut.render();
      } else {
        charts.donut.updateOptions({
          labels: donutLabels,
          plotOptions: {
            pie: {
              donut: {
                labels: {
                  total: {
                    formatter: ()=>d.length.toLocaleString()
                  }
                }
              }
            }
          }
        });
        charts.donut.updateSeries(donutSeries);
      }

      const reps = {};
      d.forEach(r=>{
        const rep = r['Contact owner']||'Unassigned';
        if (!reps[rep]) reps[rep] = {total:0, qual:0};
        reps[rep].total++;
        if (isQualified(r)) reps[rep].qual++;
      });
      const repNames = Object.keys(reps).sort((a,b)=>reps[b].total-reps[a].total).slice(0,12);
      const repTotals = repNames.map(n=>reps[n].total);
      const repQuals = repNames.map(n=> reps[n].total ? (reps[n].qual/reps[n].total*100) : 0);

      if (!charts.rep) {
        charts.rep = new ApexCharts(document.getElementById('repChart'), {
          ...initChartOptions('line', 320),
          chart: { type:'line', height:320, toolbar:{show:false} },
          series: [
            {name:'Lead Count', type:'column', data:repTotals},
            {name:'Qualification %', type:'line', data:repQuals}
          ],
          labels: repNames,
          stroke: { width:[0,3], curve:'smooth' },
          plotOptions: { bar:{columnWidth:'45%', borderRadius:3} },
          colors: ['#34d399','#22d3ee'],
          yaxis: [
            { title:{text:'Leads'}, labels:{style:{colors:'#94a3b8'}} },
            { opposite:true, title:{text:'Rate %'}, labels:{formatter:v=>v.toFixed(0)+'%', style:{colors:'#94a3b8'}} }
          ]
        });
        charts.rep.render();
      } else {
        charts.rep.updateOptions({ labels: repNames, yaxis:[{},{opposite:true, labels:{formatter:v=>v.toFixed(0)+'%'}}] });
        charts.rep.updateSeries([
          {name:'Lead Count', type:'column', data:repTotals},
          {name:'Qualification %', type:'line', data:repQuals}
        ]);
      }

      const srcs = {};
      d.forEach(r=>{
        const s = r['Original Traffic Source']||'Unknown';
        if (!srcs[s]) srcs[s] = {total:0, score:0, nScore:0};
        srcs[s].total++;
        const sc = parseFloat(r['Lead Score']);
        if (!isNaN(sc)) { srcs[s].score+=sc; srcs[s].nScore++; }
      });
      const srcNames = Object.keys(srcs).sort((a,b)=>srcs[b].total-srcs[a].total).slice(0,8);
      const srcAvgScore = srcNames.map(n=> srcs[n].nScore ? (srcs[n].score/srcs[n].nScore) : 0);

      if (!charts.source) {
        charts.source = new ApexCharts(document.getElementById('sourceChart'), {
          ...initChartOptions('bar', 300),
          series: [{name:'Avg Lead Score', data:srcAvgScore}],
          xaxis: { categories: srcNames },
          yaxis: { labels:{formatter:v=>v.toFixed(1)} },
          colors: ['#fbbf24']
        });
        charts.source.render();
      } else {
        charts.source.updateOptions({ xaxis:{categories:srcNames} });
        charts.source.updateSeries([{name:'Avg Lead Score', data:srcAvgScore}]);
      }

      const scatter = d.filter(r=>{
        const x = parseFloat(r['Lead Score']);
        const y = parseFloat(r['Number of Sales Activities']);
        return !isNaN(x) && !isNaN(y);
      }).map(r=>({x: parseFloat(r['Lead Score']), y: parseFloat(r['Number of Sales Activities'])}));

      if (!charts.scatter) {
        charts.scatter = new ApexCharts(document.getElementById('scatterChart'), {
          ...initChartOptions('scatter', 300),
          series: [{name:'Leads', data:scatter}],
          xaxis: { title:{text:'Lead Score'}, labels:{formatter:v=>v.toFixed(0)} },
          yaxis: { title:{text:'Sales Activities'}, labels:{formatter:v=>v.toFixed(0)} },
          colors: ['#a78bfa'],
          markers: { size:5, stroke:{width:0} },
          tooltip: {
            custom: function({seriesIndex, dataPointIndex, w}) {
              const p = w.config.series[seriesIndex].data[dataPointIndex];
              return `<div class="px-2 py-1 text-xs"><strong>Score:</strong> ${p.x}<br/><strong>Activities:</strong> ${p.y}</div>`;
            }
          }
        });
        charts.scatter.render();
      } else {
        charts.scatter.updateSeries([{name:'Leads', data:scatter}]);
      }
    }

    function renderLeaderboards() {
      const d = appState.filteredData;
      const build = (key, extraFn, tbodyId, colsFn) => {
        const map = {};
        d.forEach(r=>{
          const k = r[key]||'Unassigned';
          if (!map[k]) map[k] = {total:0, qual:0, score:0, nScore:0, stagnant:0, touch:0, nTouch:0};
          map[k].total++;
          if (isQualified(r)) map[k].qual++;
          const sc = parseFloat(r['Lead Score']); if (!isNaN(sc)) { map[k].score+=sc; map[k].nScore++; }
          if (isStagnant(r)) map[k].stagnant++;
          const t = parseFloat(r['Number of times contacted']); if (!isNaN(t)) { map[k].touch+=t; map[k].nTouch++; }
        });
        const rows = Object.entries(map).sort((a,b)=>b[1].total-a[1].total).slice(0,10);
        const html = rows.map(([name, v], idx)=>{
          const rankColor = idx===0?'bg-amber-100 text-amber-700 dark:bg-amber-900/30 dark:text-amber-300':idx===1?'bg-slate-200 text-slate-700 dark:bg-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300':idx===2?'bg-orange-100 text-orange-700 dark:bg-orange-900/30 dark:text-orange-300':'bg-slate-100 text-slate-600 dark:bg-slate-800 dark:text-slate-400';
          const qual = v.total ? ((v.qual/v.total)*100).toFixed(1)+'%' : '0.0%';
          const avgScore = v.nScore ? (v.score/v.nScore).toFixed(1) : '-';
          const avgTouch = v.nTouch ? (v.touch/v.nTouch).toFixed(1) : '-';
          return colsFn(idx+1, name, v, qual, avgScore, avgTouch, rankColor);
        }).join('');
        document.getElementById(tbodyId).innerHTML = html || '<tr><td class="px-3 py-3 text-slate-500" colspan="5">No data</td></tr>';
      };

      build('Contact owner', null, 'lb-reps', (rank,name,v,qual,avgScore,avgTouch,color)=>`
        <tr class="hover:bg-slate-50 dark:hover:bg-slate-800/50 transition">
          <td class="px-3 py-2.5"><span class="inline-flex items-center justify-center w-6 h-6 rounded-full text-[10px] font-bold ${color}">${rank}</span></td>
          <td class="px-3 py-2.5 font-medium">${name}</td>
          <td class="px-3 py-2.5 text-right">${v.total}</td>
          <td class="px-3 py-2.5 text-right">${qual}</td>
          <td class="px-3 py-2.5 text-right">${avgScore}</td>
        </tr>
      `);

      build('Account Segment', null, 'lb-segments', (rank,name,v,qual,avgScore,avgTouch,color)=>`
        <tr class="hover:bg-slate-50 dark:hover:bg-slate-800/50 transition">
          <td class="px-3 py-2.5"><span class="inline-flex items-center justify-center w-6 h-6 rounded-full text-[10px] font-bold ${color}">${rank}</span></td>
          <td class="px-3 py-2.5 font-medium">${name}</td>
          <td class="px-3 py-2.5 text-right">${v.total}</td>
          <td class="px-3 py-2.5 text-right">${qual}</td>
          <td class="px-3 py-2.5 text-right">${v.stagnant}</td>
        </tr>
      `);

      build('Original Traffic Source', null, 'lb-sources', (rank,name,v,qual,avgScore,avgTouch,color)=>`
        <tr class="hover:bg-slate-50 dark:hover:bg-slate-800/50 transition">
          <td class="px-3 py-2.5"><span class="inline-flex items-center justify-center w-6 h-6 rounded-full text-[10px] font-bold ${color}">${rank}</span></td>
          <td class="px-3 py-2.5 font-medium">${name}</td>
          <td class="px-3 py-2.5 text-right">${v.total}</td>
          <td class="px-3 py-2.5 text-right">${avgTouch}</td>
          <td class="px-3 py-2.5 text-right">${avgScore}</td>
        </tr>
      `);
    }

    function renderAlerts() {
      const d = appState.filteredData;
      const issues = [];
      d.forEach(r=>{
        const sev = [];
        if (isOrphaned(r)) sev.push({level:'Critical', text:'Orphaned owner (deactivated user)', action:'Reassign immediately'});
        if (isNegativeCritical(r)) sev.push({level:'Critical', text:'Severely negative lead score (< -25)', action:'Review scoring model'});
        if (isStagnant(r)) sev.push({level:'Warning', text:'Stagnant: zero sales activities', action:'Revive or disqualify'});
        if (isMissingDisqualify(r)) sev.push({level:'Warning', text:'Disqualification reason missing', action:'Capture reason'});
        if (isMissingCore(r)) sev.push({level:'Warning', text:'Missing Email, Last Name, or Job Title', action:'Enrich data'});
        if (isMalformedPhone(r)) sev.push({level:'Warning', text:'Malformed phone number', action:'Validate & clean'});
        if (isZeroEngagement(r)) sev.push({level:'Warning', text:'Zero web engagement tracking', action:'Fix tracking'});
        sev.forEach(s=>issues.push({...s, id:r['Record ID'], owner:r['Contact owner']||'-'}));
      });

      const counts = {Critical:0, Warning:0};
      issues.forEach(i=>counts[i.level] = (counts[i.level]||0)+1);
      const sumHtml = [
        {label:'Critical', count:counts.Critical, color:'bg-red-100 text-red-700 dark:bg-red-900/20 dark:text-red-300 border-red-200 dark:border-red-800'},
        {label:'Warning', count:counts.Warning, color:'bg-amber-100 text-amber-700 dark:bg-amber-900/20 dark:text-amber-300 border-amber-200 dark:border-amber-800'},
        {label:'Data Gap Leads', count: d.filter(r=>!r['Email']||!r['Last Name']||!r['Job Title']).length, color:'bg-rose-100 text-rose-700 dark:bg-rose-900/20 dark:text-rose-300 border-rose-200 dark:border-rose-800'},
        {label:'Stagnant', count: d.filter(isStagnant).length, color:'bg-orange-100 text-orange-700 dark:bg-orange-900/20 dark:text-orange-300 border-orange-200 dark:border-orange-800'}
      ].map(s=>`
        <div class="p-3 rounded-lg border ${s.color}">
          <div class="text-2xl font-bold">${s.count}</div>
          <div class="text-[10px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider mt-0.5">${s.label}</div>
        </div>
      `).join('');
      document.getElementById('alertSummary').innerHTML = sumHtml;

      const rows = issues.slice(0,100).map(i=>`
        <tr class="hover:bg-slate-50 dark:hover:bg-slate-800/50 transition">
          <td class="px-4 py-3 whitespace-nowrap">
            <span class="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider ${i.level==='Critical'?'bg-red-100 text-red-700 dark:bg-red-900/30 dark:text-red-300':'bg-amber-100 text-amber-700 dark:bg-amber-900/30 dark:text-amber-300'}">
              <span class="w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full ${i.level==='Critical'?'bg-red-500':'bg-amber-500'}"></span>${i.level}
            </span>
          </td>
          <td class="px-4 py-3 font-medium">${i.id}</td>
          <td class="px-4 py-3">${i.owner}</td>
          <td class="px-4 py-3">${i.text}</td>
          <td class="px-4 py-3 text-[11px] text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">${i.action}</td>
        </tr>
      `).join('');
      document.getElementById('alertBody').innerHTML = rows || '<tr><td colspan="5" class="px-4 py-6 text-center text-slate-500">No actionable alerts for current filters.</td></tr>';
    }

    function renderExplorer() {
      const search = document.getElementById('searchExplorer').value.toLowerCase().trim();
      let rows = appState.filteredData;
      if (search) {
        rows = rows.filter(r => Object.values(r).some(v => String(v).toLowerCase().includes(search)));
      }
      const total = rows.length;
      const pages = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(total / appState.pagination.rowsPerPage));
      const page = Math.min(appState.pagination.page, pages);
      appState.pagination.page = page;
      const start = (page-1)*appState.pagination.rowsPerPage;
      const pageRows = rows.slice(start, start+appState.pagination.rowsPerPage);

      const preferredCols = ['Record ID','Create Date','Contact owner','Account Segment','Original Traffic Source','Contact Stage','Zigment stage','Lead Score','Number of Sales Activities','Email','Phone Number','State.','What best describes you?'];
      const keys = preferredCols.filter(k => appState.rawData.length && (appState.rawData[0][k]!==undefined || pageRows[0]?.[k]!==undefined));

      const head = keys.map(k=>`<th class="px-3 py-2 whitespace-nowrap">${k}</th>`).join('');
      const body = pageRows.map(r=>{
        return `<tr class="hover:bg-slate-50 dark:hover:bg-slate-800/50 transition">` + keys.map(k=>{
          let v = r[k];
          if (v===null || v===undefined) v = '<span class="text-slate-400">—</span>';
          const s = String(v).toLowerCase();
          const isStage = (k==='Contact Stage'||k==='Zigment stage');
          let badge = '';
          if (isStage) {
            if (s.includes('connected') && !s.includes('not')) badge = 'bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-700 dark:bg-emerald-900/30 dark:text-emerald-300';
            else if (s.includes('not connected')||s.includes('unworked')) badge = 'bg-slate-100 text-slate-700 dark:bg-slate-800 dark:text-slate-300';
            else if (s.includes('lost')||s.includes('disqualified')) badge = 'bg-red-100 text-red-700 dark:bg-red-900/30 dark:text-red-300';
            else badge = 'bg-blue-100 text-blue-700 dark:bg-blue-900/30 dark:text-blue-300';
          }
          if (k==='Lead Score') {
            const n = parseFloat(v);
            if (!isNaN(n)) {
              if (n>0) badge = 'bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-700 dark:bg-emerald-900/30 dark:text-emerald-300';
              else if (n>=-15) badge = 'bg-amber-100 text-amber-700 dark:bg-amber-900/30 dark:text-amber-300';
              else badge = 'bg-red-100 text-red-700 dark:bg-red-900/30 dark:text-red-300';
            }
          }
          if (badge) v = `<span class="px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-[10px] font-semibold ${badge}">${r[k]}</span>`;
          return `<td class="px-3 py-2 whitespace-nowrap">${v}</td>`;
        }).join('') + '</tr>';
      }).join('');

      document.getElementById('explorerHead').innerHTML = head;
      document.getElementById('explorerBody').innerHTML = body || '<tr><td colspan="'+keys.length+'" class="px-3 py-6 text-center text-slate-500">No records</td></tr>';
      document.getElementById('explorerCount').textContent = `${total} rows`;
      document.getElementById('explorerInfo').textContent = `Showing ${Math.min(total,start+1)}–${Math.min(total,start+appState.pagination.rowsPerPage)} of ${total}`;

      let pHtml = '';
      for (let i=1;i<=pages;i++) {
        if (i===1 || i===pages || Math.abs(i-page)<=1) {
          pHtml += `<button onclick="appState.pagination.page=${i};renderExplorer()" class="px-2.5 py-1 rounded text-xs font-medium transition ${i===page?'bg-cyan-600 text-white':'bg-slate-200 dark:bg-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-300 dark:hover:bg-slate-600'}">${i}</button>`;
        } else if (Math.abs(i-page)===2) {
          pHtml += `<span class="px-1 text-xs text-slate-400">...</span>`;
        }
      }
      document.getElementById('explorerPagination').innerHTML = `
        <button onclick="if(appState.pagination.page>1){appState.pagination.page--;renderExplorer()}" class="px-2 py-1 rounded text-xs bg-slate-200 dark:bg-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-300 dark:hover:bg-slate-600 transition">Prev</button>
        ${pHtml}
        <button onclick="if(appState.pagination.page<${pages}){appState.pagination.page++;renderExplorer()}" class="px-2 py-1 rounded text-xs bg-slate-200 dark:bg-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-300 dark:hover:bg-slate-600 transition">Next</button>
      `;
    }

    function switchTab(tab) {
      document.querySelectorAll('.tab-panel').forEach(p=>p.classList.add('hidden'));
      document.getElementById('panel-'+tab).classList.remove('hidden');
      document.querySelectorAll('.tab-btn').forEach(b=>{
        const isActive = b.dataset.tab===tab;
        b.classList.toggle('active', isActive);
        b.classList.toggle('bg-slate-200', isActive);
        b.classList.toggle('dark:bg-slate-800', isActive);
        b.classList.toggle('text-slate-900', isActive);
        b.classList.toggle('dark:text-slate-100', isActive);
        b.classList.toggle('bg-transparent', !isActive);
        b.classList.toggle('text-slate-600', !isActive);
        b.classList.toggle('dark:text-slate-400', !isActive);
      });
      if (tab==='performance') setTimeout(()=>{ charts.rep?.updateOptions({}); charts.source?.updateOptions({}); charts.scatter?.updateOptions({}); }, 50);
    }

    function toggleTheme() {
      const html = document.documentElement;
      const isDark = html.classList.toggle('dark');
      appState.theme = isDark ? 'dark' : 'light';
      document.getElementById('themeBtn').textContent = isDark ? '🌙' : '☀️';
      const grid = isDark?'#334155':'#e2e8f0';
      const color = isDark?'#94a3b8':'#64748b';
      Object.values(charts).forEach(c=>{
        c.updateOptions({
          theme:{mode:appState.theme},
          grid:{borderColor:grid},
          xaxis:{labels:{style:{colors:color}}, axisBorder:{color:grid}, axisTicks:{color:grid}},
          yaxis:{labels:{style:{colors:color}}},
          legend:{labels:{colors:color}}
        });
      });
    }

      console.log('%c[NOVA COMMAND]','color:#22d3ee;font-weight:bold;font-size:12px', cmd);
    }

    function runReassignCmd() {
      console.log('%c[NOVA COMMAND]','color:#34d399;font-weight:bold;font-size:12px', `BULK_REASSIGN --from "Niranjan Kumar" --to "Inside Sales Queue" --file cleaned_data.csv --reason "Deactivated user cleanup"`);
    }

Original script:

  <script>
    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", () => {
      const symbols = [
        "NASDAQ:AAPL","NASDAQ:MSFT","NASDAQ:GOOGL","NASDAQ:AMZN","NASDAQ:FB",
        "NASDAQ:TSLA","NASDAQ:NFLX","NASDAQ:NVDA","NASDAQ:INTC","NASDAQ:AMD",
        "NYSE:JPM","NYSE:BAC","NYSE:WFC","NYSE:V","NYSE:MA","NYSE:DIS",
        "NASDAQ:CRM","NASDAQ:PYPL","NASDAQ:SQ","NASDAQ:UBER"
      ];

      const datalist = document.getElementById("symbol-datalist");
      symbols.forEach(sym => {
        const opt = document.createElement("option");
        opt.value = sym;
        datalist.appendChild(opt);
      });

      const watchlist = document.getElementById("watchlist");
      symbols.slice(0,8).forEach(sym => {
        const li = document.createElement("li");
        li.textContent = sym;
        li.dataset.symbol = sym;
        li.setAttribute("tabindex", "0");
        li.setAttribute("role", "button");
        watchlist.appendChild(li);
      });

      const chart = new TradingView.widget({
        container_id: "chart-container",
        symbol: "NASDAQ:AAPL",
        interval: "D",
        datafeed: new Datafeeds.UDFCompatibleDatafeed("https://demo_feed.tradingview.com"),
        library_path: "https://s3.tradingview.com/",
        locale: "en",
        disabled_features: ["header_widget", "timeframes_toolbar"],
        enabled_features: ["chart_scroll_zoom"],
        theme: "dark",
        autosize: true
      });

      const setSymbol = (sym) => {
        try {
          chart.chart().setSymbol(sym, () => {
            document.getElementById("status-bar").textContent = "Symbol: " + sym;
          });
        } catch (e) {
          document.getElementById("status-bar").textContent = "Error loading symbol";
        }
      };

      const symbolInput = document.getElementById("symbol-input");
      document.getElementById("symbol-go").addEventListener("click", () => {
        const sym = symbolInput.value.trim();
        if (sym) setSymbol(sym);
      });
      symbolInput.addEventListener("keypress", (e) => {
        if (e.key === "Enter") {
          const sym = symbolInput.value.trim();
          if (sym) setSymbol(sym);
        }
      });

      document.querySelectorAll(".tf-btn").forEach(btn => {
        btn.addEventListener("click", () => {
          const tf = btn.dataset.tf;
          try { chart.chart().setResolution(tf); } catch (_) {}
          document.querySelectorAll(".tf-btn").forEach(b => b.classList.remove("active"));
          btn.classList.add("active");
        });
      });

      watchlist.addEventListener("click", (e) => {
        if (e.target && e.target.matches("li")) {
          setSymbol(e.target.dataset.symbol);
        }
      });
      watchlist.addEventListener("keypress", (e) => {
        if (e.target && e.target.matches("li") && (e.key === "Enter" || e.key === " ")) {
          e.preventDefault();
          setSymbol(e.target.dataset.symbol);
        }
      });

      const toggleWatch = document.getElementById("toggle-watchlist");
      if (toggleWatch) {
        toggleWatch.addEventListener("click", () => {
          document.getElementById("watchlist-panel").classList.toggle("collapsed");
        });
      }

      const handleResize = () => {
        if (window.innerWidth < 800) {
          document.getElementById("watchlist-panel").classList.add("collapsed");
          document.getElementById("depth-panel").classList.add("collapsed");
        } else {
          document.getElementById("watchlist-panel").classList.remove("collapsed");
          document.getElementById("depth-panel").classList.remove("collapsed");
        }
      };
      window.addEventListener("resize", handleResize);
      handleResize();
    });
  </script>
</body>
</html>


Replace with:

  <script>
    (function() {
      const container = document.getElementById("tv-wrap");
      const symbols = ["NASDAQ:AAPL","NASDAQ:MSFT","NASDAQ:GOOGL","NASDAQ:AMZN","NASDAQ:TSLA","NASDAQ:NVDA","NYSE:JPM","NYSE:V","FX:EURUSD","BINANCE:BTCUSDT"];

      function buildWidget(sym) {
        container.innerHTML = "";
        return new TradingView.widget({
          autosize: true,
          symbol: sym || "NASDAQ:AAPL",
          interval: "D",
          timezone: "exchange",
          theme: "dark",
          style: "1",
          locale: "en",
          toolbar_bg: "#131722",

          hide_side_toolbar: false,
          allow_symbol_change: true,

          container_id: "tv-wrap",
          enable_publishing: false,
          watchlist: symbols,
          details: true,
          hotlist: true,
          calendar: false,
          news: ["headlines"],
          studies: ["MASimple@tv-basicstudies","Volume@tv-basicstudies"],
          show_popup_button: true,
          popup_width: "1000",
          popup_height: "650"
        });
      }

      buildWidget("NASDAQ:AAPL");

      const input = document.getElementById("symbol-input");
      const goBtn = document.getElementById("symbol-go");

      function setSymbol(sym) {
        if (!sym) return;
        buildWidget(sym);
        document.getElementById("status-left").textContent = "Symbol: " + sym;
      }

      goBtn.addEventListener("click", () => setSymbol(input.value.trim()));
      input.addEventListener("keypress", (e) => { if (e.key === "Enter") setSymbol(input.value.trim()); });

      function updateTime() {
        const now = new Date();
        document.getElementById("status-right").textContent = now.toISOString().replace("T"," ").slice(0,19) + " UTC";
      }
      setInterval(updateTime, 1000);
      updateTime();
    })();
  </script>
