  <script>
    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", () => {
      const symbols = [
        "NASDAQ:AAPL","NASDAQ:MSFT","NASDAQ:GOOGL","NASDAQ:AMZN","NASDAQ:FB",
        "NASDAQ:TSLA","NASDAQ:NFLX","NASDAQ:NVDA","NASDAQ:INTC","NASDAQ:AMD",
        "NYSE:JPM","NYSE:BAC","NYSE:WFC","NYSE:V","NYSE:MA","NYSE:DIS",
        "NASDAQ:CRM","NASDAQ:PYPL","NASDAQ:SQ","NASDAQ:UBER"
      ];

      const datalist = document.getElementById("symbol-datalist");
      symbols.forEach(sym => {
        const opt = document.createElement("option");
        opt.value = sym;
        datalist.appendChild(opt);
      });

      const watchlist = document.getElementById("watchlist");
      symbols.slice(0,8).forEach(sym => {
        const li = document.createElement("li");
        li.textContent = sym;
        li.dataset.symbol = sym;
        li.setAttribute("tabindex", "0");
        li.setAttribute("role", "button");
        watchlist.appendChild(li);
      });

      const chart = new TradingView.widget({
        container_id: "chart-container",
        symbol: "NASDAQ:AAPL",
        interval: "D",
        datafeed: new Datafeeds.UDFCompatibleDatafeed("https://demo_feed.tradingview.com"),
        library_path: "https://s3.tradingview.com/",
        locale: "en",
        disabled_features: ["header_widget", "timeframes_toolbar"],
        enabled_features: ["chart_scroll_zoom"],
        theme: "dark",
        autosize: true
      });

      const setSymbol = (sym) => {
        try {
          chart.chart().setSymbol(sym, () => {
            document.getElementById("status-bar").textContent = "Symbol: " + sym;
          });
        } catch (e) {
          document.getElementById("status-bar").textContent = "Error loading symbol";
        }
      };

      const symbolInput = document.getElementById("symbol-input");
      document.getElementById("symbol-go").addEventListener("click", () => {
        const sym = symbolInput.value.trim();
        if (sym) setSymbol(sym);
      });
      symbolInput.addEventListener("keypress", (e) => {
        if (e.key === "Enter") {
          const sym = symbolInput.value.trim();
          if (sym) setSymbol(sym);
        }
      });

      document.querySelectorAll(".tf-btn").forEach(btn => {
        btn.addEventListener("click", () => {
          const tf = btn.dataset.tf;
          try { chart.chart().setResolution(tf); } catch (_) {}
          document.querySelectorAll(".tf-btn").forEach(b => b.classList.remove("active"));
          btn.classList.add("active");
        });
      });

      watchlist.addEventListener("click", (e) => {
        if (e.target && e.target.matches("li")) {
          setSymbol(e.target.dataset.symbol);
        }
      });
      watchlist.addEventListener("keypress", (e) => {
        if (e.target && e.target.matches("li") && (e.key === "Enter" || e.key === " ")) {
          e.preventDefault();
          setSymbol(e.target.dataset.symbol);
        }
      });

      const toggleWatch = document.getElementById("toggle-watchlist");
      if (toggleWatch) {
        toggleWatch.addEventListener("click", () => {
          document.getElementById("watchlist-panel").classList.toggle("collapsed");
        });
      }

      const handleResize = () => {
        if (window.innerWidth < 800) {
          document.getElementById("watchlist-panel").classList.add("collapsed");
          document.getElementById("depth-panel").classList.add("collapsed");
        } else {
          document.getElementById("watchlist-panel").classList.remove("collapsed");
          document.getElementById("depth-panel").classList.remove("collapsed");
        }
      };
      window.addEventListener("resize", handleResize);
      handleResize();
    });
  </script>
</body>
</html>

    // TRADINGVIEW CHART INITIALIZATION
    let tvWidget = null;
    function loadChart(symbol) {
      document.getElementById("tv-chart-container").innerHTML = "";
      
      try {
        tvWidget = new TradingView.widget({
          "autosize": true,
          "symbol": symbol,
          "interval": "D",

          "theme": "dark",

          "toolbar_bg": "#1c2030",
          "enable_publishing": false,
          "hide_side_toolbar": false,
          "allow_symbol_change": true,
          "container_id": "tv-chart-container"
        });
      } catch (err) {
        console.error("Failed to initialize TradingView widget, tv.js script might be blocked:", err);
        document.getElementById("tv-chart-container").innerHTML = `
          <div style="height:100%; display:flex; flex-direction:column; align-items:center; justify-content:center; padding: 20px; color:var(--text-muted);">
            <i data-lucide="alert-triangle" style="width:48px;height:48px;color:var(--color-red);margin-bottom:12px;"></i>
            <h3>TradingView Widget Connection Delayed</h3>
            <p style="margin-top:8px;font-size:12px;text-align:center;max-width:320px;">
              Loading interactive chart canvas... Please verify internet connection or check browser extension filters.
            </p>
          </div>
        `;
        lucide.createIcons();
      }
    }

    function initChartWidget() {
      if (typeof TradingView !== 'undefined') {
        let stock = getOrCreateStock(state.activeTicker);
        loadChart(stock.symbol);
      } else {
        setTimeout(initChartWidget, 300);
      }
    }

    // STATE CONTROLLER
    function getOrCreateStock(ticker) {
      let cleanTicker = ticker.toUpperCase().trim();
      let parts = cleanTicker.split(":");
      let tName = parts[parts.length - 1];
      let tExchange = parts.length > 1 ? parts[0] : "NASDAQ";

      if (stocks[tName]) {
        return stocks[tName];
      }

      // Check if stock is in screener and copy it
      let screenerStock = screenerStocks.find(s => s.ticker === tName);
      if (screenerStock) {
        stocks[tName] = {
          symbol: screenerStock.symbol,
          name: screenerStock.name,
          price: screenerStock.price,
          prevPrice: screenerStock.price,
          open: screenerStock.price * 0.99,
          high: screenerStock.price * 1.02,
          low: screenerStock.price * 0.98,
          volume: "12.4M",
          marketCap: screenerStock.cap,
          pe: screenerStock.pe,
          logo: "📈"
        };
        return stocks[tName];
      }

      // Create new mock stock profile
      let mockPrice = parseFloat((Math.random() * 500 + 10).toFixed(2));
      stocks[tName] = {
        symbol: `${tExchange}:${tName}`,
        name: `${tName} Inc.`,
        price: mockPrice,
        prevPrice: mockPrice,
        open: parseFloat((mockPrice * 0.99).toFixed(2)),
        high: parseFloat((mockPrice * 1.01).toFixed(2)),
        low: parseFloat((mockPrice * 0.985).toFixed(2)),
        volume: (Math.random() * 80 + 2).toFixed(1) + "M",
        marketCap: (Math.random() * 1.5 + 0.05).toFixed(2) + "T",
        pe: (Math.random() * 40 + 10).toFixed(1),
        logo: "💼"
      };

      return stocks[tName];
    }

    // LOCAL STORAGE PERSISTENCE
    function saveState() {
      localStorage.setItem("tv_terminal_state", JSON.stringify(state));
      localStorage.setItem("tv_terminal_stocks", JSON.stringify(stocks));
    }

    function loadState() {
      let savedState = localStorage.getItem("tv_terminal_state");
      let savedStocks = localStorage.getItem("tv_terminal_stocks");
      
      if (savedState) {
        try {
          state = JSON.parse(savedState);
        } catch (e) {
          console.error("Error parsing saved state", e);
        }
      }
      
      if (savedStocks) {
        try {
          stocks = JSON.parse(savedStocks);
        } catch (e) {
          console.error("Error parsing saved stocks", e);
        }
      }
      
      // Ensure arrays exist
      if (!state.positions) state.positions = [];
      if (!state.orders) state.orders = [];
      if (!state.history) state.history = [];
      if (!state.logs) state.logs = [];
      if (!state.watchlist) state.watchlist = ["AAPL", "MSFT", "NVDA", "TSLA", "AMZN"];
      if (!state.startingCapital) state.startingCapital = 100000.00;
      if (!state.simulationSpeed) state.simulationSpeed = 1.5;
    }

    // REAL-TIME PRICE FLUCUATOR SIMULATION
    let simIntervalId = null;
    function startPriceSimulation() {
      if (simIntervalId) clearInterval(simIntervalId);
      
      simIntervalId = setInterval(() => {
        let activeStockUpdated = false;
        
        // Loop through all stocks in active memory
        for (let ticker in stocks) {
          let stock = stocks[ticker];
          let changePercent = (Math.random() * 0.12 - 0.06); // -0.06% to +0.06% tick change
          stock.prevPrice = stock.price;
          
          let oldPrice = stock.price;
          stock.price = parseFloat((stock.price * (1 + changePercent / 100)).toFixed(2));
          
          // Record highs/lows
          if (stock.price > stock.high) stock.high = stock.price;
          if (stock.price < stock.low) stock.low = stock.price;
          
          // Update Watchlist DOM Elements
          let row = document.querySelector(`.watchlist-row[data-ticker="${ticker}"]`);
          if (row) {
            let pCell = row.querySelector('.stock-price');
            let cCell = row.querySelector('.stock-change');
            
            pCell.innerText = stock.price.toFixed(2);
            
            let absChange = stock.price - stock.open;
            let percentChange = (absChange / stock.open) * 100;
            cCell.innerText = (absChange >= 0 ? "+" : "") + percentChange.toFixed(2) + "%";
            
            // Flashing animations based on price ticks
            pCell.classList.remove('up', 'down', 'flash-green', 'flash-red');
            cCell.classList.remove('up', 'down');
            
            if (stock.price > oldPrice) {
              pCell.classList.add('flash-green', 'up');
              cCell.classList.add('up');
            } else if (stock.price < oldPrice) {
              pCell.classList.add('flash-red', 'down');
              cCell.classList.add('down');
            } else {
              if (absChange >= 0) {
                pCell.classList.add('up');
                cCell.classList.add('up');
              } else {
                pCell.classList.add('down');
                cCell.classList.add('down');
              }
            }
          }
          
          if (ticker === state.activeTicker) {
            activeStockUpdated = true;
          }
        }
        
        // Update header values and details pane
        if (activeStockUpdated) {
          updateHeaderBlock(state.activeTicker);
          updateDetailsPane(state.activeTicker);
        }
        
        // Render Ticker Tape
        updateTickerTape();
        
        // Run broker matching logic (checking orders, SL/TP triggers, updating P&L)
        runBrokerPipeline();
        
      }, state.simulationSpeed * 1000);
    }

    // BROKER MATCHING PIPELINE
    function runBrokerPipeline() {
      let now = Date.now();
      let filledOrdersCount = 0;
      let triggerExitsCount = 0;
      
      // 1. Process Limit Orders
      for (let i = state.orders.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
        let ord = state.orders[i];
        let stock = stocks[ord.ticker];
        if (!stock) continue;
        
        let match = false;
        if (ord.type === "BUY" && stock.price <= ord.limitPrice) {
          match = true;
        } else if (ord.type === "SELL" && stock.price >= ord.limitPrice) {
          match = true;
        }
        
        if (match) {
          // Fill order
          let executionCost = ord.qty * stock.price;
          let executionFee = executionCost * 0.0001;
          let totalExecutionCost = ord.type === "BUY" ? (executionCost + executionFee) : (executionCost - executionFee);
          
          if (ord.type === "BUY" && totalExecutionCost > state.balance) {
            // Cancel due to margin
            addLog(`Order cancelled: Insufficient cash balance to execute Buy Limit of ${ord.qty} ${ord.ticker} at limit price $${ord.limitPrice.toFixed(2)} (Required: $${totalExecutionCost.toFixed(2)}).`, "error");
            showToast("Order Cancelled", `Limit buy for ${ord.ticker} failed.`, "error");
            state.orders.splice(i, 1);
          } else {
            // Deduct / add cash balance
            if (ord.type === "BUY") {
              state.balance -= totalExecutionCost;
            } else {
              state.balance += totalExecutionCost; // Short sale proceeds
            }
            
            // Push to active positions
            let newPos = {
              id: "pos_" + now + "_" + i,
              symbol: ord.symbol,
              ticker: ord.ticker,
              type: ord.type,
              qty: ord.qty,
              entryPrice: stock.price,
              currentPrice: stock.price,
              sl: ord.sl,
              tp: ord.tp,
              timestamp: now
            };
            
            state.positions.push(newPos);
            state.orders.splice(i, 1);
            filledOrdersCount++;
            
            addLog(`Limit Order Filled: ${ord.type} ${ord.qty} ${ord.ticker} at $${stock.price.toFixed(2)}. Broker Fee: $${executionFee.toFixed(2)}.`, "success");
            showToast("Order Filled", `Limit ${ord.type} ${ord.qty} ${ord.ticker} filled at $${stock.price.toFixed(2)}`, "success");
          }
        }
      }
      
      // 2. Process active positions PnL updates + Stop Loss / Take Profit triggers
      for (let i = state.positions.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
        let pos = state.positions[i];
        let stock = stocks[pos.ticker];
        if (!stock) continue;
        
        pos.currentPrice = stock.price;
        let pnl = 0;
        if (pos.type === "BUY") {
          pnl = pos.qty * (stock.price - pos.entryPrice);
        } else {
          pnl = pos.qty * (pos.entryPrice - stock.price);
        }
        pos.unrealizedPnL = pnl;
        
        // Check SL / TP
        let triggerExit = false;
        let exitReason = "";
        
        if (pos.type === "BUY") {
          if (pos.sl && stock.price <= pos.sl) {
            triggerExit = true;
            exitReason = "Stop Loss";
          } else if (pos.tp && stock.price >= pos.tp) {
            triggerExit = true;
            exitReason = "Take Profit";
          }
        } else { // SHORT positions
          if (pos.sl && stock.price >= pos.sl) {
            triggerExit = true;
            exitReason = "Stop Loss";
          } else if (pos.tp && stock.price <= pos.tp) {
            triggerExit = true;
            exitReason = "Take Profit";
          }
        }
        
        if (triggerExit) {
          // Liquidate position at current price
          let exitPrice = stock.price;
          let realizedPnL = 0;
          
          if (pos.type === "BUY") {
            realizedPnL = pos.qty * (exitPrice - pos.entryPrice);
            state.balance += pos.qty * exitPrice;
          } else {
            realizedPnL = pos.qty * (pos.entryPrice - exitPrice);
            state.balance += pos.qty * pos.entryPrice + realizedPnL;
          }
          
          let closingFee = pos.qty * exitPrice * 0.0001;
          state.balance -= closingFee;
          realizedPnL -= closingFee;
          
          let histItem = {
            id: "hist_" + now + "_" + i,
            symbol: pos.symbol,
            ticker: pos.ticker,
            type: pos.type,
            qty: pos.qty,
            entryPrice: pos.entryPrice,
            exitPrice: exitPrice,
            realizedPnL: realizedPnL,
            fee: closingFee,
            timestamp: pos.timestamp,
            closeTimestamp: now
          };
          
          state.history.push(histItem);
          state.positions.splice(i, 1);
          triggerExitsCount++;
          
          addLog(`${exitReason} Triggered: ${pos.type} position in ${pos.ticker} (qty ${pos.qty}) closed at market $${exitPrice.toFixed(2)}. Net P&L: $${realizedPnL.toFixed(2)}.`, realizedPnL >= 0 ? "success" : "error");
          showToast(`${exitReason} hit`, `${pos.ticker} position liquidated at $${exitPrice.toFixed(2)}`, realizedPnL >= 0 ? "success" : "error");
        }
      }
      
      // 3. Save changes & Redraw tables
      if (filledOrdersCount > 0 || triggerExitsCount > 0) {
        saveState();
        renderPositions();
        renderOrders();
        renderHistory();
      } else {
        // Just update values of positions table rather than replacing DOM completely to avoid selection flickering
        updateLivePositionsValues();
      }
      
      updateSummary();
    }

    // DYNAMIC UPDATERS
    function updateLivePositionsValues() {
      state.positions.forEach(pos => {
        let row = document.getElementById(`pos-row-${pos.id}`);
        if (row) {
          let stock = stocks[pos.ticker];
          let lastPriceCell = row.querySelector('.pos-last-price');
          let mValueCell = row.querySelector('.pos-market-value');
          let pnlCell = row.querySelector('.pos-pnl');
          
          if (stock && lastPriceCell && mValueCell && pnlCell) {
            lastPriceCell.innerText = stock.price.toFixed(2);
            
            let mValue = pos.qty * stock.price;
            mValueCell.innerText = "$" + mValue.toLocaleString('en-US', { minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2 });
            
            let pnlPercent = (pos.unrealizedPnL / (pos.qty * pos.entryPrice)) * 100;
            pnlCell.innerText = (pos.unrealizedPnL >= 0 ? "+" : "") + pos.unrealizedPnL.toLocaleString('en-US', { minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2 }) + " (" + (pos.unrealizedPnL >= 0 ? "+" : "") + pnlPercent.toFixed(2) + "%)";
            
            pnlCell.className = "pos-pnl font-mono " + (pos.unrealizedPnL >= 0 ? "text-up" : "text-down");
          }
        }
      });
    }

    // UPDATE TOP HEADER TEXTS
    function updateHeaderBlock(ticker) {
      let stock = stocks[ticker];
      if (!stock) return;
      
      let absChange = stock.price - stock.open;
      let percentChange = (absChange / stock.open) * 100;
      
      document.getElementById("hdr-symbol").innerText = ticker;
      document.getElementById("hdr-name").innerText = stock.name;
      
      let pElem = document.getElementById("hdr-price");
      pElem.innerText = stock.price.toFixed(2);
      
      let cElem = document.getElementById("hdr-change");
      cElem.innerText = `${absChange >= 0 ? "+" : ""}${absChange.toFixed(2)} (${absChange >= 0 ? "+" : ""}${percentChange.toFixed(2)}%)`;
      
      cElem.className = "active-ticker-change " + (absChange >= 0 ? "up" : "down");
    }

    // UPDATE DETAILS BAR
    function updateDetailsPane(ticker) {
      let stock = stocks[ticker];
      if (!stock) return;
      
      let absChange = stock.price - stock.open;
      let percentChange = (absChange / stock.open) * 100;
      
      document.getElementById("det-symbol").innerText = ticker;
      document.getElementById("det-name").innerText = stock.name;
      
      let priceElem = document.getElementById("det-price");
      priceElem.innerText = stock.price.toFixed(2);
      
      let changeElem = document.getElementById("det-change");
      changeElem.innerText = `${absChange >= 0 ? "+" : ""}${absChange.toFixed(2)} (${absChange >= 0 ? "+" : ""}${percentChange.toFixed(2)}%)`;
      changeElem.className = "details-change " + (absChange >= 0 ? "up" : "down");
      
      // Update statistics
      document.getElementById("det-open").innerText = stock.open.toFixed(2);
      document.getElementById("det-high").innerText = stock.high.toFixed(2);
      document.getElementById("det-low").innerText = stock.low.toFixed(2);
      document.getElementById("det-volume").innerText = stock.volume;
      document.getElementById("det-mcap").innerText = stock.marketCap;
      document.getElementById("det-pe").innerText = stock.pe;
      
      // Update Technical Gauge
      let needle = document.getElementById("gauge-needle");
      let ratingText = document.getElementById("gauge-rating");
      let buyVal = document.getElementById("gauge-buy-val");
      let neutVal = document.getElementById("gauge-neutral-val");
      let sellVal = document.getElementById("gauge-sell-val");
      
      // Determine rating based on price deviation from open
      let rating = "Neutral";
      let deg = 0;
      let bCount = 9, nCount = 11, sCount = 6;
      
      if (percentChange > 1.8) {
        rating = "Strong Buy";
        deg = 70;
        bCount = 18; nCount = 6; sCount = 2;
        ratingText.className = "gauge-rating up";
      } else if (percentChange > 0.4) {
        rating = "Buy";
        deg = 35;
        bCount = 15; nCount = 8; sCount = 3;
        ratingText.className = "gauge-rating up";
      } else if (percentChange < -1.8) {
        rating = "Strong Sell";
        deg = -70;
        bCount = 2; nCount = 7; sCount = 17;
        ratingText.className = "gauge-rating down";
      } else if (percentChange < -0.4) {
        rating = "Sell";
        deg = -35;
        bCount = 4; nCount = 9; sCount = 13;
        ratingText.className = "gauge-rating down";
      } else {
        rating = "Neutral";
        deg = 0;
        bCount = 9; nCount = 11; sCount = 6;
        ratingText.className = "gauge-rating neutral";
      }
      
      needle.style.transform = `rotate(${deg}deg)`;
      ratingText.innerText = rating;
      buyVal.innerText = bCount;
      neutVal.innerText = nCount;
      sellVal.innerText = sCount;
    }

    // UPDATE TICKER TAPE
    function updateTickerTape() {
      let container = document.getElementById("ticker-tape-container");
      container.innerHTML = "";
      
      state.watchlist.forEach(ticker => {
        let stock = stocks[ticker];
        if (!stock) return;
        
        let absChange = stock.price - stock.open;
        let percentChange = (absChange / stock.open) * 100;
        
        let item = document.createElement("div");
        item.className = "ticker-tape-item";
        item.innerHTML = `
          <span class="tape-symbol">${ticker}</span>
          <span class="tape-price">${stock.price.toFixed(2)}</span>
          <span class="tape-change ${absChange >= 0 ? "up" : "down"}">${absChange >= 0 ? "+" : ""}${percentChange.toFixed(2)}%</span>
        `;
        
        item.addEventListener("click", () => {
          selectTicker(ticker);
        });
        
        container.appendChild(item);
      });
    }

    // SYNC ACTIVE CODES TABS
    function selectTicker(ticker) {
      state.activeTicker = ticker;
      let stock = getOrCreateStock(ticker);
      
      // Update Watchlist Active State
      document.querySelectorAll(".watchlist-row").forEach(row => {
        row.classList.remove("active");
        if (row.dataset.ticker === ticker) {
          row.classList.add("active");
        }
      });
      
      // Load New Chart Canvas
      loadChart(stock.symbol);
      
      // Sync Sidebar views
      updateHeaderBlock(ticker);
      updateDetailsPane(ticker);
      
      // Setup limits placeholders based on ticker price
      document.getElementById("order-limit-price").value = stock.price.toFixed(2);
      document.getElementById("order-sl-price").value = (stock.price * 0.95).toFixed(2);
      document.getElementById("order-tp-price").value = (stock.price * 1.05).toFixed(2);
      
      updateOrderSummary();
      renderNews();
      saveState();
    }

    // ACCOUNT SUMMARY BALANCES
    function updateSummary() {
      let totalUnrealizedPnL = state.positions.reduce((acc, pos) => acc + pos.unrealizedPnL, 0);
      let equity = state.balance + totalUnrealizedPnL;
      
      // Format to strings
      document.getElementById("val-balance").innerText = "$" + state.balance.toLocaleString('en-US', { minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2 });
      document.getElementById("val-equity").innerText = "$" + equity.toLocaleString('en-US', { minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2 });
      
      let pnlElem = document.getElementById("val-unrealized-pnl");
      let percentage = state.startingCapital > 0 ? (totalUnrealizedPnL / state.startingCapital) * 100 : 0;
      pnlElem.innerText = (totalUnrealizedPnL >= 0 ? "+" : "") + totalUnrealizedPnL.toLocaleString('en-US', { minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2 }) + " (" + (totalUnrealizedPnL >= 0 ? "+" : "") + percentage.toFixed(2) + "%)";
      
      pnlElem.className = "summary-value " + (totalUnrealizedPnL >= 0 ? "up" : "down");
      
      // Calculate Win Rate
      let totalWins = state.history.filter(h => h.realizedPnL > 0).length;
      let totalTrades = state.history.length;
      let winRate = totalTrades > 0 ? Math.round((totalWins / totalTrades) * 100) : 0;
      document.getElementById("val-winrate").innerText = winRate + "%";
      
      // Tab badges count
      document.getElementById("badge-positions").innerText = state.positions.length;
      document.getElementById("badge-orders").innerText = state.orders.length;
    }

    // RENDERING CORE DOM PANELS

    // R1: WATCHLIST TABLE
    function renderWatchlist() {
      let tbody = document.getElementById("watchlist-body");
      tbody.innerHTML = "";
      
      state.watchlist.forEach(ticker => {
        let stock = stocks[ticker];
        if (!stock) return;
        
        let absChange = stock.price - stock.open;
        let percentChange = (absChange / stock.open) * 100;
        
        let row = document.createElement("tr");
        row.className = "watchlist-row" + (ticker === state.activeTicker ? " active" : "");
        row.dataset.ticker = ticker;
        
        row.innerHTML = `
          <td class="stock-symbol">${ticker}</td>
          <td class="stock-price">${stock.price.toFixed(2)}</td>
          <td class="stock-change ${absChange >= 0 ? "up" : "down"}">${absChange >= 0 ? "+" : ""}${percentChange.toFixed(2)}%</td>
        `;
        
        row.addEventListener("click", () => {
          selectTicker(ticker);
        });
        
        tbody.appendChild(row);
      });
    }

    // R2: POSITIONS TABLE
    function renderPositions() {
      let tbody = document.getElementById("positions-table-body");
      tbody.innerHTML = "";
      
      if (state.positions.length === 0) {
        tbody.innerHTML = `
          <tr>
            <td colspan="10">
              <div class="empty-state">
                <i data-lucide="briefcase"></i>
                <span>No active paper trade positions open. Place an order on the right.</span>
              </div>
            </td>
          </tr>
        `;
        lucide.createIcons();
        return;
      }
      
      state.positions.forEach(pos => {
        let row = document.createElement("tr");
        row.id = `pos-row-${pos.id}`;
        
        let entryPrice = pos.entryPrice;
        let currentPrice = pos.currentPrice;
        let mValue = pos.qty * currentPrice;
        let pnl = pos.unrealizedPnL;
        let pnlPercent = (pnl / (pos.qty * entryPrice)) * 100;
        
        row.innerHTML = `
          <td style="font-weight:700;color:var(--text-bright);">${pos.ticker}</td>
          <td><span class="badge-type ${pos.type.toLowerCase()}">${pos.type}</span></td>
          <td class="font-mono">${pos.qty}</td>
          <td class="font-mono">$${entryPrice.toFixed(2)}</td>
          <td class="font-mono pos-last-price">$${currentPrice.toFixed(2)}</td>
          <td class="font-mono pos-market-value">$${mValue.toLocaleString('en-US', { minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2 })}</td>
          <td class="font-mono text-down">${pos.sl ? "$" + pos.sl.toFixed(2) : "—"}</td>
          <td class="font-mono text-up">${pos.tp ? "$" + pos.tp.toFixed(2) : "—"}</td>
          <td class="pos-pnl font-mono ${pnl >= 0 ? "text-up" : "text-down"}">
            ${pnl >= 0 ? "+" : ""}${pnl.toLocaleString('en-US', { minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2 })} (${pnl >= 0 ? "+" : ""}${pnlPercent.toFixed(2)}%)
          </td>
          <td>
            <button class="close-trade-btn" onclick="closePosition('${pos.id}')">Close Position</button>
          </td>
        `;
        tbody.appendChild(row);
      });
    }

          </td>

      });
    }

    // R4: TRADING HISTORY TABLE
    function renderHistory() {
      let tbody = document.getElementById("history-table-body");
      tbody.innerHTML = "";
      
      if (state.history.length === 0) {
        tbody.innerHTML = `
          <tr>
            <td colspan="8">
              <div class="empty-state">
                <i data-lucide="history"></i>
                <span>Account history is empty. Close open positions to record logs.</span>
              </div>
            </td>
          </tr>
        `;
        lucide.createIcons();
        return;
      }
      
      // Render in reverse chronological order
      let sortedHistory = [...state.history].reverse();
      
      sortedHistory.forEach(item => {
        let row = document.createElement("tr");
        let closeTimeStr = new Date(item.closeTimestamp).toLocaleTimeString();
        
        row.innerHTML = `
          <td class="font-mono">${closeTimeStr}</td>
          <td style="font-weight:700;color:var(--text-bright);">${item.ticker}</td>
          <td><span class="badge-type ${item.type.toLowerCase()}">${item.type}</span></td>
          <td class="font-mono">${item.qty}</td>
          <td class="font-mono">$${item.entryPrice.toFixed(2)}</td>
          <td class="font-mono">$${item.exitPrice.toFixed(2)}</td>
          <td class="font-mono" style="color:var(--text-muted);">$${item.fee.toFixed(2)}</td>
          <td class="font-mono ${item.realizedPnL >= 0 ? "text-up" : "text-down"}">
            ${item.realizedPnL >= 0 ? "+" : ""}$${item.realizedPnL.toFixed(2)}
          </td>
        `;
        tbody.appendChild(row);
      });
    }

    // R5: MARKET SCREENER TABLE
    function renderScreener() {
      let tbody = document.getElementById("screener-table-body");
      tbody.innerHTML = "";
      
      // Render screener stocks
      screenerStocks.forEach(item => {
        let row = document.createElement("tr");
        
        // Sync price if it is in stocks active memory
        let currentPrice = item.price;
        let ratingText = item.rating;
        let absChange = 0;
        let percentChange = 0;
        
        if (stocks[item.ticker]) {
          currentPrice = stocks[item.ticker].price;
          absChange = currentPrice - stocks[item.ticker].open;
          percentChange = (absChange / stocks[item.ticker].open) * 100;
        } else {
          percentChange = item.change;
        }
        
        // Dynamic recommendation based on price
        if (percentChange > 1) ratingText = "Strong Buy";
        else if (percentChange > 0.2) ratingText = "Buy";
        else if (percentChange < -1) ratingText = "Strong Sell";
        else if (percentChange < -0.2) ratingText = "Sell";
        else ratingText = "Neutral";
        
        row.innerHTML = `
          <td style="font-weight:700;color:var(--text-bright);">${item.ticker}</td>
          <td style="color:var(--text-muted);">${item.name}</td>
          <td class="font-mono">$${currentPrice.toFixed(2)}</td>
          <td class="font-mono ${percentChange >= 0 ? "text-up" : "text-down"}">${percentChange >= 0 ? "+" : ""}${percentChange.toFixed(2)}%</td>
          <td style="color:var(--text-muted);">${item.ticker === 'AAPL' || item.ticker === 'MSFT' ? stocks[item.ticker].volume : '15.4M'}</td>
          <td class="font-mono">${item.pe}</td>
          <td class="font-mono">${item.cap}</td>
          <td>
            <span class="badge-type ${ratingText.toLowerCase().replace(" ", "-")}" 
              style="background-color:${ratingText.includes("Buy") ? "var(--color-green-bg)" : ratingText.includes("Sell") ? "var(--color-red-bg)" : "var(--border)"}; 
                     color:${ratingText.includes("Buy") ? "var(--color-green)" : ratingText.includes("Sell") ? "var(--color-red)" : "var(--text-active)"}">
              ${ratingText}
            </span>
          </td>
          <td>
            <button class="close-trade-btn" style="border-color:var(--color-blue);color:var(--color-blue);" onclick="addScreenerToWatchlist('${item.ticker}')">
              + Watchlist
            </button>
          </td>
        `;
        
        row.addEventListener("dblclick", () => {
          addScreenerToWatchlist(item.ticker);
          selectTicker(item.ticker);
        });
        
        tbody.appendChild(row);
      });
    }

    function addScreenerToWatchlist(ticker) {
      if (!state.watchlist.includes(ticker)) {
        state.watchlist.push(ticker);
        getOrCreateStock(ticker);
        renderWatchlist();
        updateTickerTape();
        saveState();
        showToast("Watchlist Updated", `${ticker} added to watchlist.`, "success");
      } else {
        showToast("Info", `${ticker} is already in the watchlist.`, "info");
      }
    }

    // R6: MARKET NEWS STREAM
    function renderNews() {
      let container = document.getElementById("news-container");
      container.innerHTML = "";
      
      // Filter news: global news + selected ticker news
      let filteredNews = staticNews.filter(n => n.ticker === "GLOBAL" || n.ticker === state.activeTicker);
      
      filteredNews.forEach(item => {
        let card = document.createElement("div");
        card.className = "news-card";
        
        card.innerHTML = `
          <div class="news-meta">
            <span class="news-ticker">${item.ticker}</span>
            <span>${item.source} &bull; ${item.time}</span>
          </div>
          <h4 class="news-headline">${item.headline}</h4>
          <p class="news-summary">${item.summary}</p>
        `;
        
        card.addEventListener("click", () => {
          showToast("News Summary", `Reading full report from ${item.source} regarding ${item.ticker}...`, "info");
        });
        
        container.appendChild(card);
      });
    }

    // R7: SYSTEM CONSOLE LOGS
    function renderLogs() {
      let container = document.getElementById("log-console-container");
      container.innerHTML = "";
      
      state.logs.forEach(log => {
        let line = document.createElement("div");
        line.className = "log-line";
        
        let timeStr = new Date(log.timestamp).toLocaleTimeString();
        let colorClass = "info";
        if (log.message.includes("Filled") || log.message.includes("Profit")) colorClass = "success";
        else if (log.message.includes("cancelled") || log.message.includes("Loss") || log.message.includes("Error")) colorClass = "error";
        
        line.innerHTML = `
          <span class="log-time">[${timeStr}]</span>
          <span class="log-msg ${colorClass}">${log.message}</span>
        `;
        container.appendChild(line);
      });
      
      // Scroll console to bottom
      container.scrollTop = container.scrollHeight;
    }

    function addLog(msg, type = "info") {
      state.logs.push({
        timestamp: Date.now(),
        message: msg,
        type: type
      });
      // Cap log array
      if (state.logs.length > 100) state.logs.shift();
      saveState();
      renderLogs();
    }

    // BROKER TRANSACTION INTERFACE & OPERATIONS

    // 1. PLACE AN ORDER
    function submitActiveOrder() {
      let qtyInput = document.getElementById("order-qty");
      let qty = parseInt(qtyInput.value) || 0;
      
      if (qty <= 0) {
        showToast("Order Error", "Order quantity must be 1 share or more.", "error");
        return;
      }
      
      let stock = stocks[state.activeTicker];
      if (!stock) return;
      
      let entryPrice = stock.price;
      if (state.orderType === "limit") {
        entryPrice = parseFloat(document.getElementById("order-limit-price").value) || 0;
        if (entryPrice <= 0) {
          showToast("Order Error", "Please specify a valid Limit Price.", "error");
          return;
        }
      }
      
      // Validate Stop Loss
      let slPrice = null;
      if (document.getElementById("order-sl-check").checked) {
        slPrice = parseFloat(document.getElementById("order-sl-price").value) || 0;
        if (slPrice <= 0) {
          showToast("Order Error", "Please enter a valid Stop Loss price threshold.", "error");
          return;
        }
        if (state.orderAction === "buy" && slPrice >= entryPrice) {
          showToast("Order Error", "Long Stop Loss must be lower than Buy price.", "error");
          return;
        }
        if (state.orderAction === "sell" && slPrice <= entryPrice) {
          showToast("Order Error", "Short Stop Loss must be higher than Sell price.", "error");
          return;
        }
      }

      // Validate Take Profit
      let tpPrice = null;
      if (document.getElementById("order-tp-check").checked) {
        tpPrice = parseFloat(document.getElementById("order-tp-price").value) || 0;
        if (tpPrice <= 0) {
          showToast("Order Error", "Please enter a valid Take Profit price target.", "error");
          return;
        }
        if (state.orderAction === "buy" && tpPrice <= entryPrice) {
          showToast("Order Error", "Long Take Profit must be higher than Buy price.", "error");
          return;
        }
        if (state.orderAction === "sell" && tpPrice >= entryPrice) {
          showToast("Order Error", "Short Take Profit must be lower than Sell price.", "error");
          return;
        }
      }

      let orderValue = qty * entryPrice;
      let orderFee = orderValue * 0.0001; // 0.01% fee
      let totalCost = state.orderAction === "buy" ? (orderValue + orderFee) : (orderValue - orderFee);
      
      // Double check balance limits
      if (state.orderAction === "buy" && totalCost > state.balance) {
        showToast("Margin Error", `Insufficient balance. Required: $${totalCost.toFixed(2)}, Available: $${state.balance.toFixed(2)}`, "error");
        return;
      }
      
      let now = Date.now();
      
      if (state.orderType === "market") {
        // Market execution immediately
        if (state.orderAction === "buy") {
          state.balance -= totalCost;
        } else {
          state.balance += totalCost; // Cash from selling short
        }
        
        let newPos = {
          id: "pos_" + now,
          symbol: stock.symbol,
          ticker: state.activeTicker,
          type: state.orderAction.toUpperCase(), // "BUY" or "SELL"
          qty: qty,
          entryPrice: entryPrice,
          currentPrice: entryPrice,
          unrealizedPnL: 0,
          sl: slPrice,
          tp: tpPrice,
          timestamp: now
        };
        
        state.positions.push(newPos);
        addLog(`Market Filled: ${state.orderAction.toUpperCase()} ${qty} ${state.activeTicker} at $${entryPrice.toFixed(2)}. Broker Fee: $${orderFee.toFixed(2)}.`, "success");
        showToast("Order Executed", `Filled ${state.orderAction.toUpperCase()} ${qty} ${state.activeTicker} at $${entryPrice.toFixed(2)}`, "success");
        
      } else {
        // Limit order added to book
        let newOrder = {
          id: "ord_" + now,
          symbol: stock.symbol,
          ticker: state.activeTicker,
          type: state.orderAction.toUpperCase(),
          qty: qty,
          limitPrice: entryPrice,
          sl: slPrice,
          tp: tpPrice,
          timestamp: now
        };
        
        state.orders.push(newOrder);
        addLog(`Limit Order Placed: ${state.orderAction.toUpperCase()} ${qty} ${state.activeTicker} at limit $${entryPrice.toFixed(2)}.`, "info");
        showToast("Order Placed", `Pending Limit Order for ${qty} ${state.activeTicker} at $${entryPrice.toFixed(2)}`, "info");
      }
      
      saveState();
      renderPositions();
      renderOrders();
      updateSummary();
      
      // Clear inputs
      qtyInput.value = "10";
      document.getElementById("order-sl-check").checked = false;
      document.getElementById("order-sl-price").disabled = true;
      document.getElementById("order-sl-price").value = "";
      document.getElementById("order-tp-check").checked = false;
      document.getElementById("order-tp-price").disabled = true;
      document.getElementById("order-tp-price").value = "";
      
      updateOrderSummary();
    }

    // 2. CLOSE OPEN POSITION
    window.closePosition = function(id) {
      let index = state.positions.findIndex(p => p.id === id);
      if (index === -1) return;
      
      let pos = state.positions[index];
      let stock = stocks[pos.ticker];
      if (!stock) return;
      
      let exitPrice = stock.price;
      let realizedPnL = 0;
      
      if (pos.type === "BUY") {
        realizedPnL = pos.qty * (exitPrice - pos.entryPrice);
        state.balance += pos.qty * exitPrice;
      } else { // SHORT position closing: buy back shares
        realizedPnL = pos.qty * (pos.entryPrice - exitPrice);
        state.balance += pos.qty * pos.entryPrice + realizedPnL;
      }
      
      let closingFee = pos.qty * exitPrice * 0.0001;
      state.balance -= closingFee;
      realizedPnL -= closingFee;
      
      let now = Date.now();
      let histItem = {
        id: "hist_" + now,
        symbol: pos.symbol,
        ticker: pos.ticker,
        type: pos.type,
        qty: pos.qty,
        entryPrice: pos.entryPrice,
        exitPrice: exitPrice,
        realizedPnL: realizedPnL,
        fee: closingFee,
        timestamp: pos.timestamp,
        closeTimestamp: now
      };
      
      state.history.push(histItem);
      state.positions.splice(index, 1);
      
      addLog(`Closed Position: ${pos.type} ${pos.qty} ${pos.ticker} at $${exitPrice.toFixed(2)}. Net P&L: $${realizedPnL.toFixed(2)}. Closing Fee: $${closingFee.toFixed(2)}`, realizedPnL >= 0 ? "success" : "error");
      showToast("Position Closed", `${pos.ticker} closed. P&L: $${realizedPnL.toFixed(2)}`, realizedPnL >= 0 ? "success" : "error");
      
      saveState();
      renderPositions();
      renderHistory();
      updateSummary();
    };

    // 3. CANCEL PENDING ORDER
    window.cancelOrder = function(id) {
      let index = state.orders.findIndex(o => o.id === id);
      if (index === -1) return;
      
      let ord = state.orders[index];
      state.orders.splice(index, 1);
      
      addLog(`Limit Order Cancelled: ${ord.type} ${ord.qty} ${ord.ticker} at $${ord.limitPrice.toFixed(2)}.`);
      showToast("Order Cancelled", `Limit order for ${ord.ticker} cancelled.`, "info");
      
      saveState();
      renderOrders();
      updateSummary();
    };

    // ORDER PRICE VALUATION TAPE CALCULATOR
    function updateOrderSummary() {
      let qty = parseInt(document.getElementById("order-qty").value) || 0;
      let stock = stocks[state.activeTicker];
      if (!stock) return;
      
      let price = stock.price;
      if (state.orderType === "limit") {
        price = parseFloat(document.getElementById("order-limit-price").value) || price;
      }
      
      let estVal = qty * price;
      let estFee = estVal * 0.0001;
      let estTotal = state.orderAction === "buy" ? (estVal + estFee) : (estVal - estFee);
      
      document.getElementById("est-val").innerText = "$" + estVal.toLocaleString('en-US', { minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2 });
      document.getElementById("est-fee").innerText = "$" + estFee.toLocaleString('en-US', { minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2 });
      document.getElementById("est-total").innerText = "$" + estTotal.toLocaleString('en-US', { minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2 });
      
      // Update Button Text and color styles
      let submitBtn = document.getElementById("submit-order-btn");
      let icon = state.orderAction === "buy" ? '<i data-lucide="shopping-cart"></i>' : '<i data-lucide="trending-down"></i>';
      let actionText = state.orderAction === "buy" ? "Buy" : "Sell Short";
      
      submitBtn.innerHTML = `${icon} ${actionText} ${qty} ${state.activeTicker}`;
      
      // Insufficient funds bounds check
      let warningElem = document.getElementById("order-bal-warning");
      if (state.orderAction === "buy" && estTotal > state.balance) {
        warningElem.style.display = "block";
        submitBtn.style.opacity = "0.5";
      } else {
        warningElem.style.display = "none";
        submitBtn.style.opacity = "1";
      }
      lucide.createIcons();
    }

    // TOAST SYSTEM
    function showToast(title, message, type = "info") {
      let container = document.getElementById("toast-container");
      let toast = document.createElement("div");
      toast.className = `toast ${type}`;
      
      toast.innerHTML = `
        <div class="toast-header">
          <span class="toast-title">${title}</span>
          <span class="toast-close">&times;</span>
        </div>
        <div class="toast-body">${message}</div>
      `;
      
      container.appendChild(toast);
      
      toast.querySelector(".toast-close").addEventListener("click", () => {
        toast.remove();
      });
      
      // Auto dismiss
      setTimeout(() => {
        toast.style.opacity = "0";
        toast.style.transform = "translateY(-10px)";
        setTimeout(() => { toast.remove(); }, 500);
      }, 4000);
    }

    // SYSTEM RESET ACCOUNT CAPITAL
    function resetAccountCapital() {
      if (confirm(`Are you sure you want to reset your paper trading account to initial balance of $${state.startingCapital.toLocaleString()}? All current positions, orders, and logs will be deleted.`)) {
        state.balance = state.startingCapital;
        state.positions = [];
        state.orders = [];
        state.history = [];
        state.logs = [];
        
        addLog(`Account Capital Reset. Initialized simulation balance to $${state.balance.toLocaleString('en-US', { minimumFractionDigits: 2 })}.`, "info");
        
        saveState();
        renderPositions();
        renderOrders();
        renderHistory();
        renderLogs();
        updateSummary();
        showToast("Account Reset", "Simulated portfolio reset successfully.", "success");
      }
    }

    // EVENT BINDINGS & LIFECYCLE
    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", () => {
      // 1. Load data
      loadState();
      
      // Initialize news and logs
      if (state.logs.length === 0) {
        addLog(`System Initialization Complete. Paper Trading balance funded with $${state.balance.toLocaleString('en-US', { minimumFractionDigits: 2 })}.`, "info");
      }
      
      // 2. Render initial static DOMs
      renderWatchlist();
      updateTickerTape();
      updateHeaderBlock(state.activeTicker);
      updateDetailsPane(state.activeTicker);
      updateSummary();
      renderPositions();
      renderOrders();
      renderHistory();
      renderScreener();
      renderNews();
      renderLogs();
      
      // 3. Mount interactive chart canvas
      initChartWidget();
      
      // 4. Start ticker price ticking
      startPriceSimulation();
      
      // 5. Binding DOM events
      
      // Watchlist Ticker Search Text Event
      document.getElementById("ticker-search").addEventListener("keypress", function(e) {
        if (e.key === "Enter") {
          let query = this.value.toUpperCase().trim();
          if (query) {
            let stock = getOrCreateStock(query);
            let name = stock.symbol.split(":")[1];
            
            if (!state.watchlist.includes(name)) {
              state.watchlist.push(name);
              renderWatchlist();
              updateTickerTape();
            }
            selectTicker(name);
            this.value = "";
            showToast("Search Success", `Loaded chart ticker details for ${stock.symbol}`, "success");
          }
        }
      });
      
      // Collapsing Panel
      let togglePanelBtn = document.getElementById("btn-toggle-panel");
      let bottomPanel = document.getElementById("bottom-panel");
      let chartParent = document.getElementById("chart-parent");
      
      togglePanelBtn.addEventListener("click", () => {
        let isCollapsed = bottomPanel.classList.toggle("collapsed");
        chartParent.classList.toggle("maximized", isCollapsed);
        
        let iconName = isCollapsed ? "chevron-up" : "chevron-down";
        let tooltipText = isCollapsed ? "Expand Dashboard" : "Collapse Dashboard";
        
        togglePanelBtn.innerHTML = `<i data-lucide="${iconName}"></i>`;
        togglePanelBtn.setAttribute("data-tooltip", tooltipText);
        lucide.createIcons();
        
        // Let widget resize to fit screen sizes
        setTimeout(() => {
          if (tvWidget && typeof tvWidget.resize === 'function') {
            tvWidget.resize();
          }
        }, 320);
      });
      
      // Bottom Panel Switch Tab Views
      document.querySelectorAll(".bottom-tab").forEach(tab => {
        tab.addEventListener("click", () => {
          document.querySelectorAll(".bottom-tab").forEach(t => t.classList.remove("active"));
          document.querySelectorAll(".tab-content").forEach(c => c.classList.remove("active"));
          
          tab.classList.add("active");
          let tabId = tab.dataset.tab;
          document.getElementById(`tab-${tabId}`).classList.add("active");
          
          state.activeTab = tabId;
          saveState();
          
          // Re-trigger layout paints if needed
          if (tabId === "logs") {
            let logConsole = document.getElementById("log-console-container");
            logConsole.scrollTop = logConsole.scrollHeight;
          }
          if (tabId === "screener") {
            renderScreener();
          }
        });
      });
      
      // Order tabs BUY / SELL switch
      let buyTab = document.getElementById("tab-order-buy");
      let sellTab = document.getElementById("tab-order-sell");
      
      buyTab.addEventListener("click", () => {
        buyTab.classList.add("active");
        sellTab.classList.remove("active");
        state.orderAction = "buy";
        updateOrderSummary();
      });
      
      sellTab.addEventListener("click", () => {
        sellTab.classList.add("active");
        buyTab.classList.remove("active");
        state.orderAction = "sell";
        updateOrderSummary();
      });
      
      // Order type buttons MARKET / LIMIT switch
      let mktBtn = document.getElementById("btn-type-market");
      let limitBtn = document.getElementById("btn-type-limit");
      let limitGroup = document.getElementById("grp-limit-price");
      
      mktBtn.addEventListener("click", () => {
        mktBtn.classList.add("active");
        limitBtn.classList.remove("active");
        limitGroup.style.display = "none";
        state.orderType = "market";
        updateOrderSummary();
      });
      
      limitBtn.addEventListener("click", () => {
        limitBtn.classList.add("active");
        mktBtn.classList.remove("active");
        limitGroup.style.display = "flex";
        state.orderType = "limit";
        
        let stock = stocks[state.activeTicker];
        if (stock) {
          document.getElementById("order-limit-price").value = stock.price.toFixed(2);
        }
        updateOrderSummary();
      });
      
      // Input listeners for order form recalculation
      document.getElementById("order-qty").addEventListener("input", updateOrderSummary);
      document.getElementById("order-limit-price").addEventListener("input", updateOrderSummary);
      
      // Checkboxes SL and TP enable inputs
      let slCheck = document.getElementById("order-sl-check");
      let slPrice = document.getElementById("order-sl-price");
      slCheck.addEventListener("change", () => {
        slPrice.disabled = !slCheck.checked;
        if (slCheck.checked && !slPrice.value) {
          let stock = stocks[state.activeTicker];
          let multiplier = state.orderAction === "buy" ? 0.95 : 1.05;
          slPrice.value = (stock.price * multiplier).toFixed(2);
        }
      });
      
      let tpCheck = document.getElementById("order-tp-check");
      let tpPrice = document.getElementById("order-tp-price");
      tpCheck.addEventListener("change", () => {
        tpPrice.disabled = !tpCheck.checked;
        if (tpCheck.checked && !tpPrice.value) {
          let stock = stocks[state.activeTicker];
          let multiplier = state.orderAction === "buy" ? 1.05 : 0.95;
          tpPrice.value = (stock.price * multiplier).toFixed(2);
        }
      });
      
      // Submit order placement
      document.getElementById("submit-order-btn").addEventListener("click", submitActiveOrder);
      
      // Reset Account balance
      document.getElementById("reset-account-btn").addEventListener("click", resetAccountCapital);
      
      // Settings modal controls
      let modal = document.getElementById("settings-modal");
      let openSettingsBtn = document.getElementById("settings-btn");
      let closeSettingsBtn = document.getElementById("modal-close-btn");
      let cancelSettingsBtn = document.getElementById("modal-cancel-btn");
      let saveSettingsBtn = document.getElementById("modal-save-btn");
      
      openSettingsBtn.addEventListener("click", () => {
        document.getElementById("settings-capital").value = state.startingCapital;
        document.getElementById("settings-tape-speed").value = state.simulationSpeed;
        modal.classList.add("active");
      });
      
      function closeModal() {
        modal.classList.remove("active");
      }
      
      closeSettingsBtn.addEventListener("click", closeModal);
      cancelSettingsBtn.addEventListener("click", closeModal);
      
      saveSettingsBtn.addEventListener("click", () => {
        let cap = parseFloat(document.getElementById("settings-capital").value) || 100000;
        let speed = parseFloat(document.getElementById("settings-tape-speed").value) || 1.5;
        
        if (cap < 100) cap = 100;
        if (speed < 0.1) speed = 0.1;
        
        // If starting capital has changed, adjust balance too
        if (cap !== state.startingCapital) {
          let diff = cap - state.startingCapital;
          state.balance += diff;
          state.startingCapital = cap;
          if (state.balance < 0) state.balance = 0;
        }
        
        state.simulationSpeed = speed;
        saveState();
        closeModal();
        
        // Restart simulator with new frequency
        startPriceSimulation();
        updateSummary();
        showToast("Settings Saved", "Terminal simulator settings updated.", "success");
      });
      
      // Initialize default summary costs
      updateOrderSummary();
      
      // Render Lucide icons
      lucide.createIcons();
    });
  </script>
</body>
</html>

  <script>
    (function() {
      const nav = document.querySelector('.nav');
      const hamburger = document.getElementById('hamburger');
      const navLinks = document.getElementById('navLinks');
      const links = navLinks.querySelectorAll('a');

      // Navbar scroll effect
      window.addEventListener('scroll', () => {
        if (window.scrollY > 50) {
          nav.classList.add('scrolled');
        } else {
          nav.classList.remove('scrolled');
        }
      });

      // Mobile menu toggle
      hamburger.addEventListener('click', () => {
        navLinks.classList.toggle('nav__links--active');
      });

      // Close mobile menu on link click + smooth scroll offset
      links.forEach(link => {
        link.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
          const href = this.getAttribute('href');
          if (href && href.startsWith('#')) {
            e.preventDefault();
            const target = document.querySelector(href);
            if (target) {
              const offset = nav.offsetHeight;
              const top = target.getBoundingClientRect().top + window.scrollY - offset;
              window.scrollTo({ top, behavior: 'smooth' });
            }
            navLinks.classList.remove('nav__links--active');
          }
        });
      });

      // Stat counters
      const counters = document.querySelectorAll('.stat__number');
      const observerOptions = { threshold: 0.5 };

      const runCounter = (el) => {
        const target = parseInt(el.getAttribute('data-target'), 10);
        const duration = 2000;
        const stepTime = 16;
        const steps = duration / stepTime;
        const increment = target / steps;
        let current = 0;

        const update = () => {
          current += increment;
          if (current < target) {
            el.textContent = Math.ceil(current) + (el.getAttribute('data-suffix') || '+');
            requestAnimationFrame(update);
          } else {
            el.textContent = target + (el.getAttribute('data-suffix') || '+');
          }
        };
        update();
      };

      const counterObserver = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
        entries.forEach(entry => {
          if (entry.isIntersecting) {
            runCounter(entry.target);
            counterObserver.unobserve(entry.target);
          }
        });
      }, observerOptions);

      counters.forEach(c => counterObserver.observe(c));
    })();
  </script>

--- FILE: pages/1_overview.py ---

import streamlit as st
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import plotly.express as px

@st.cache_data
def load_data():
    file_path = 'amazon.csv'
    df = pd.read_csv(file_path)
    df['discounted_price_num'] = pd.to_numeric(df['discounted_price'].astype(str).str.replace(r'[^\d.]', '', regex=True), errors='coerce')
    df['actual_price_num'] = pd.to_numeric(df['actual_price'].astype(str).str.replace(r'[^\d.]', '', regex=True), errors='coerce')
    df['discount_pct_num'] = pd.to_numeric(df['discount_percentage'].astype(str).str.replace('%', '', regex=True), errors='coerce')
    df['rating_count_num'] = pd.to_numeric(df['rating_count'].astype(str).str.replace(',', '', regex=True), errors='coerce')
    df['rating_num'] = pd.to_numeric(df['rating'], errors='coerce')
    df['revenue_proxy'] = df['discounted_price_num'] * df['rating_count_num']
    if 'parsed_date' not in df.columns:
        df['parsed_date'] = pd.NaT
    if 'country' not in df.columns:
        df['country'] = 'Unknown'
    if 'latitude' not in df.columns:
        df['latitude'] = np.nan
    if 'longitude' not in df.columns:
        df['longitude'] = np.nan
    return df

df = load_data()

cats = st.sidebar.multiselect('Category', df['category'].unique(), default=df['category'].unique()[:5])
rat_min, rat_max = st.sidebar.slider('Rating', 0.0, 5.0, (0.0, 5.0), 0.1)
p_min = float(df['discounted_price_num'].min())
p_max = float(df['discounted_price_num'].max())
pri_min, pri_max = st.sidebar.slider('Discounted Price', p_min, p_max, (p_min, p_max))

data = df[
    (df['category'].isin(cats)) &
    (df['rating_num'] >= rat_min) &
    (df['rating_num'] <= rat_max) &
    (df['discounted_price_num'] >= pri_min) &
    (df['discounted_price_num'] <= pri_max)
]

k1, k2, k3, k4 = st.columns(4)
k1.metric('Products', len(data))
k2.metric('Avg Rating', round(data['rating_num'].mean(), 2) if not data.empty else 0.0)
k3.metric('Avg Price', round(data['discounted_price_num'].mean(), 2) if not data.empty else 0.0)
k4.metric('Avg Revenue Proxy', round(data['revenue_proxy'].mean(), 2) if not data.empty else 0.0)

c1, c2 = st.columns(2)
top_cats = data['category'].value_counts().head(10).reset_index()
top_cats.columns = ['category', 'count']
fig1 = px.bar(top_cats, x='category', y='count', title='Top 10 Categories')
c1.plotly_chart(fig1, use_container_width=True)

cat_val = data.groupby('category')['discounted_price_num'].sum().reset_index().sort_values('discounted_price_num', ascending=False).head(10)
fig2 = px.bar(cat_val, x='category', y='discounted_price_num', title='Top 10 Categories by Value')
c2.plotly_chart(fig2, use_container_width=True)

c3, c4 = st.columns(2)
fig3 = px.histogram(data, x='rating_num', nbins=10, title='Rating Distribution')
c3.plotly_chart(fig3, use_container_width=True)

fig4 = px.scatter(data, x='actual_price_num', y='discounted_price_num', color='rating_num', title='Actual vs Discounted Price', opacity=0.6)
c4.plotly_chart(fig4, use_container_width=True)

c5, c6 = st.columns(2)
nums = ['actual_price_num', 'discounted_price_num', 'discount_pct_num', 'rating_num', 'rating_count_num']
corr = data[nums].corr()
fig5 = px.imshow(corr, text_auto=True, aspect='auto', title='Correlation Matrix')
c5.plotly_chart(fig5, use_container_width=True)

if not data[['latitude', 'longitude']].dropna().empty:
    fig6 = px.scatter_geo(data.dropna(subset=['latitude', 'longitude']), lat='latitude', lon='longitude', color='rating_num', title='Geographic Distribution')
else:
    geo = data['country'].value_counts().head(10).reset_index()
    geo.columns = ['country', 'count']
    fig6 = px.bar(geo, x='country', y='count', title='Geographic Distribution (Top Countries)')
c6.plotly_chart(fig6, use_container_width=True)

st.markdown('---')
st.subheader('Data Preview')
st.dataframe(data)

st.sidebar.markdown('---')
st.sidebar.caption('Data Source: Amazon Dataset')
if st.sidebar.button('Refresh'):
    st.rerun()

st.markdown('---')
st.caption('Data Source: Amazon Dataset | Built with Streamlit')

--- FILE: pages/2_sales_revenue.py ---

import streamlit as st
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import plotly.express as px

@st.cache_data
def load_data():
    file_path = '/Users/hassanmulla/Downloads/NOVA_Phase2/Test/amazon.csv'
    df = pd.read_csv(file_path)
    df['discounted_price_num'] = pd.to_numeric(df['discounted_price'].astype(str).str.replace(r'[^\d.]', '', regex=True), errors='coerce')
    df['actual_price_num'] = pd.to_numeric(df['actual_price'].astype(str).str.replace(r'[^\d.]', '', regex=True), errors='coerce')
    df['discount_pct_num'] = pd.to_numeric(df['discount_percentage'].astype(str).str.replace('%', '', regex=True), errors='coerce')
    df['rating_count_num'] = pd.to_numeric(df['rating_count'].astype(str).str.replace(',', '', regex=True), errors='coerce')
    df['rating_num'] = pd.to_numeric(df['rating'], errors='coerce')
    df['revenue_proxy'] = df['discounted_price_num'] * df['rating_count_num']
    date_candidates = ['date', 'Date', 'timestamp', 'Timestamp', 'sales_date']
    for col in date_candidates:
        if col in df.columns:
            df['parsed_date'] = pd.to_datetime(df[col], errors='coerce')
            break
    else:
        df['parsed_date'] = pd.NaT
    if 'country' not in df.columns:
        df['country'] = 'Unknown'
    if 'latitude' not in df.columns:
        df['latitude'] = np.nan
    if 'longitude' not in df.columns:
        df['longitude'] = np.nan
    return df

df = load_data()

cats = st.sidebar.multiselect("Category", df['category'].dropna().unique(), default=df['category'].dropna().unique()[:5])
rat_min, rat_max = st.sidebar.slider("Rating", 0.0, 5.0, (0.0, 5.0), 0.1)
p_min = float(df['discounted_price_num'].min())
p_max = float(df['discounted_price_num'].max())
pri_min, pri_max = st.sidebar.slider("Discounted Price", p_min, p_max, (p_min, p_max))

mask = (df['category'].isin(cats)) & (df['rating_num'] >= rat_min) & (df['rating_num'] <= rat_max) & (df['discounted_price_num'] >= pri_min) & (df['discounted_price_num'] <= pri_max)
filtered = df[mask]

st.title("Sales & Revenue")

k1, k2, k3, k4 = st.columns(4)
k1.metric("Total Revenue", f"${filtered['revenue_proxy'].sum():,.2f}")
k2.metric("Sales Volume", f"{len(filtered):,}")
k3.metric("Avg Rating", f"{filtered['rating_num'].mean():.2f}")
k4.metric("Avg Discount %", f"{filtered['discount_pct_num'].mean():.2f}")

c1, c2 = st.columns(2)

ts_df = filtered.dropna(subset=['parsed_date']).copy()
if not ts_df.empty:
    ts_df['period'] = ts_df['parsed_date'].dt.to_period('M').dt.to_timestamp()
    ts_group = ts_df.groupby('period')['revenue_proxy'].sum().reset_index()
    fig1 = px.line(ts_group, x='period', y='revenue_proxy', title="Revenue Over Time")
else:
    fig1 = px.line(title="Revenue Over Time (No Date Data)")
c1.plotly_chart(fig1, use_container_width=True)

cat_rev = filtered.groupby('category')['revenue_proxy'].sum().reset_index().sort_values('revenue_proxy', ascending=False).head(10)
fig2 = px.bar(cat_rev, x='category', y='revenue_proxy', title="Top Categories by Revenue")
c2.plotly_chart(fig2, use_container_width=True)

c3, c4 = st.columns(2)

geo_map_data = filtered.dropna(subset=['latitude', 'longitude'])
if not geo_map_data.empty:
    fig3 = px.scatter_geo(geo_map_data, lat='latitude', lon='longitude', color='rating_num', title="Geographic Distribution")
else:
    geo = filtered['country'].value_counts().head(10).reset_index()
    geo.columns = ['country', 'count']
    fig3 = px.bar(geo, x='country', y='count', title="Geographic Distribution (Top Countries)")
c3.plotly_chart(fig3, use_container_width=True)

fig4 = px.histogram(filtered, x='discount_pct_num', nbins=20, title="Discount Distribution")
c4.plotly_chart(fig4, use_container_width=True)

    df['discount_pct_num'] = pd.to_numeric(df['discount_percentage'].astype(str).str.replace('%', '', regex=True), errors='coerce')
    df['rating_count_num'] = pd.to_numeric(df['rating_count'].astype(str).str.replace(',', '', regex=True), errors='coerce')
    df['rating_num'] = pd.to_numeric(df['rating'], errors='coerce')
    df['revenue_proxy'] = df['discounted_price_num'] * df['rating_count_num']
    date_candidates = ['date', 'Date', 'timestamp', 'Timestamp', 'sales_date']

        if col in df.columns:

import streamlit as st
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import plotly.express as px

@st.cache_data
def load_data():
    file_path = '/Users/hassanmulla/Downloads/NOVA_Phase2/Test/amazon.csv'
    df = pd.read_csv(file_path)
    df['discounted_price_num'] = pd.to_numeric(df['discounted_price'].astype(str).str.replace(r'[^\d.]', '', regex=True), errors='coerce')
    df['actual_price_num'] = pd.to_numeric(df['actual_price'].astype(str).str.replace(r'[^\d.]', '', regex=True), errors='coerce')
    df['discount_pct_num'] = pd.to_numeric(df['discount_percentage'].astype(str).str.replace('%', '', regex=True), errors='coerce')
    df['rating_count_num'] = pd.to_numeric(df['rating_count'].astype(str).str.replace(',', '', regex=True), errors='coerce')
    df['rating_num'] = pd.to_numeric(df['rating'], errors='coerce')
    df['revenue_proxy'] = df['discounted_price_num'] * df['rating_count_num']
    date_candidates = ['date', 'Date', 'timestamp', 'Timestamp', 'sales_date']
    for col in date_candidates:
        if col in df.columns:
            df['parsed_date'] = pd.to_datetime(df[col], errors='coerce')
            break
    else:
        df['parsed_date'] = pd.NaT
    if 'country' not in df.columns:
        df['country'] = 'Unknown'
    if 'latitude' not in df.columns:
        df['latitude'] = np.nan
    if 'longitude' not in df.columns:
        df['longitude'] = np.nan
    return df

df = load_data()

cats = st.sidebar.multiselect("Category", df['category'].dropna().unique(), default=df['category'].dropna().unique()[:5])
rat_min, rat_max = st.sidebar.slider("Rating", 0.0, 5.0, (0.0, 5.0), 0.1)
p_min = float(df['discounted_price_num'].min())
p_max = float(df['discounted_price_num'].max())
pri_min, pri_max = st.sidebar.slider("Discounted Price", p_min, p_max, (p_min, p_max))

data = df[
    (df['category'].isin(cats)) &
    (df['rating_num'] >= rat_min) &
    (df['rating_num'] <= rat_max) &
    (df['discounted_price_num'] >= pri_min) &
    (df['discounted_price_num'] <= pri_max)
]

k1, k2, k3, k4 = st.columns(4)
k1.metric("Categories", data['category'].nunique())
k2.metric("Products", len(data))
k3.metric("Avg Price", f"{data['discounted_price_num'].mean():.2f}")
k4.metric("Avg Rating", f"{data['rating_num'].mean():.2f}")

c1, c2 = st.columns(2)
cat_counts = data['category'].value_counts().head(15).reset_index()
cat_counts.columns = ['category', 'count']
fig1 = px.bar(cat_counts, x='category', y='count', title="Products per Category (Top 15)")
c1.plotly_chart(fig1, use_container_width=True)

cat_price = data.groupby('category')['discounted_price_num'].mean().reset_index().sort_values('discounted_price_num', ascending=False).head(15)
fig2 = px.bar(cat_price, x='category', y='discounted_price_num', title="Average Price by Category (Top 15)")
c2.plotly_chart(fig2, use_container_width=True)

c3, c4 = st.columns(2)
cat_discount = data.groupby('category')['discount_pct_num'].mean().reset_index().sort_values('discount_pct_num', ascending=False).head(15)
fig3 = px.bar(cat_discount, x='category', y='discount_pct_num', title="Average Discount % by Category (Top 15)")
c3.plotly_chart(fig3, use_container_width=True)

cat_rev = data.groupby('category')['revenue_proxy'].sum().reset_index().sort_values('revenue_proxy', ascending=False).head(15)
fig4 = px.bar(cat_rev, x='category', y='revenue_proxy', title="Revenue Proxy by Category (Top 15)")
c4.plotly_chart(fig4, use_container_width=True)

c5, c6 = st.columns(2)
cat_rating = data.groupby('category')['rating_num'].mean().reset_index().sort_values('rating_num', ascending=False).head(15)
fig5 = px.bar(cat_rating, x='category', y='rating_num', title="Average Rating by Category (Top 15)")
c5.plotly_chart(fig5, use_container_width=True)

fig6 = px.box(data, x='category', y='discounted_price_num', title="Price Distribution by Category")
c6.plotly_chart(fig6, use_container_width=True)

st.markdown("---")
st.subheader("Category Summary")
summary = data.groupby('category').agg(
    products=('discounted_price_num', 'count'),
    avg_price=('discounted_price_num', 'mean'),
    avg_discount=('discount_pct_num', 'mean'),
    avg_rating=('rating_num', 'mean'),
    total_revenue=('revenue_proxy', 'sum')
).sort_values('total_revenue', ascending=False)
st.dataframe(summary, use_container_width=True)

st.markdown("---")
st.caption("Data Source: Amazon Dataset | Built with Streamlit")

<script>
  // Mobile Nav
  const hamburger = document.getElementById('hamburger');
  const navLinks = document.getElementById('navLinks');

  hamburger.addEventListener('click', () => {
    navLinks.classList.toggle('open');
  });

  document.querySelectorAll('.nav-links a').forEach(link => {
    link.addEventListener('click', () => {
      navLinks.classList.remove('open');
    });
  });

  // Scroll Reveal
  const reveals = document.querySelectorAll('.reveal');
  const revealObserver = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
    entries.forEach(entry => {
      if (entry.isIntersecting) {
        entry.target.classList.add('active');
        revealObserver.unobserve(entry.target);
      }
    });
  }, { threshold: 0.1 });

  reveals.forEach(el => revealObserver.observe(el));

  // Active Nav Link
  const sections = document.querySelectorAll('section');
  const navItems = document.querySelectorAll('.nav-links a');

  window.addEventListener('scroll', () => {
    let current = '';
    sections.forEach(section => {
      const sectionTop = section.offsetTop;
      const sectionHeight = section.clientHeight;
      if (window.scrollY >= (sectionTop - sectionHeight / 3)) {
        current = section.getAttribute('id');
      }
    });

    navItems.forEach(link => {
      link.classList.remove('active');
      if (link.getAttribute('href') === '#' + current) {
        link.classList.add('active');
      }
    });
  });

  // Form Validation
  const form = document.getElementById('contactForm');
  const nameInput = document.getElementById('name');
  const emailInput = document.getElementById('email');
  const messageInput = document.getElementById('message');
  const successMsg = document.getElementById('successMsg');

  function showError(input, show) {
    const group = input.parentElement;
    if (show) group.classList.add('error');
    else group.classList.remove('error');
  }

  function validateEmail(email) {
    return /^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/.test(email);
  }

  form.addEventListener('submit', (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    successMsg.style.display = 'none';

    let valid = true;

    if (nameInput.value.trim().length < 2) {
      showError(nameInput, true);
      valid = false;
    } else {
      showError(nameInput, false);
    }

    if (!validateEmail(emailInput.value.trim())) {
      showError(emailInput, true);
      valid = false;
    } else {
      showError(emailInput, false);
    }

    if (messageInput.value.trim().length < 10) {
      showError(messageInput, true);
      valid = false;
    } else {
      showError(messageInput, false);
    }

    if (valid) {
      successMsg.style.display = 'block';
      form.reset();
    }
  });

  [nameInput, emailInput, messageInput].forEach(input => {
    input.addEventListener('input', () => showError(input, false));
  });
</script>

</body>
</html>

import tkinter as tk


def on_button_click(label):
    entry.configure(state='normal')
    text = entry.get()
    
    if label == 'C':
        entry.delete(0, tk.END)
    elif label == '=':
        expr = text
        if not expr:
            entry.configure(state='disabled')
            return
        allowed = set('0123456789.+-*/')
        if not set(expr).issubset(allowed):
            entry.delete(0, tk.END)
            entry.insert(0, 'Error')
            entry.configure(state='disabled')
            return
        try:
            result = eval(expr)
            entry.delete(0, tk.END)
            entry.insert(0, str(result))
        except ZeroDivisionError:
            entry.delete(0, tk.END)
            entry.insert(0, 'Div/0 Error')
        except (SyntaxError, NameError):
            entry.delete(0, tk.END)
            entry.insert(0, 'Error')
    else:
        if text in ('Error', 'Div/0 Error'):
            entry.delete(0, tk.END)
            text = ''
        if label in '0123456789':
            entry.insert(tk.END, label)
        elif label == '.':
            last_op = max(text.rfind('+'), text.rfind('-'), text.rfind('*'), text.rfind('/'))
            current_number = text[last_op + 1:]
            if '.' not in current_number:
                entry.insert(tk.END, label)
        elif label in '+-*/':
            if text and text[-1] in '+-*/':
                entry.delete(len(text) - 1, tk.END)
            text_after = entry.get()
            if not text_after and label != '-':
                entry.configure(state='disabled')
                return
            entry.insert(tk.END, label)
    
    entry.configure(state='disabled')


if __name__ == '__main__':
    root = tk.Tk()
    root.title('Calculator')
    
    entry = tk.Entry(root, font=('Arial', 20), justify='right', state='disabled')
    entry.grid(row=0, column=0, columnspan=5, sticky='nsew', padx=5, pady=5)
    
    buttons = [
        ('7', 1, 0), ('8', 1, 1), ('9', 1, 2), ('.', 1, 3),
        ('4', 2, 0), ('5', 2, 1), ('6', 2, 2),
        ('1', 3, 0), ('2', 3, 1), ('3', 3, 2),
        ('0', 4, 0),
        ('/', 1, 4), ('*', 2, 4), ('-', 3, 4), ('+', 4, 4),
        ('C', 5, 0, 2), ('=', 5, 3, 2)
    ]
    
    for btn in buttons:
        label = btn[0]
        row = btn[1]
        col = btn[2]
        span = btn[3] if len(btn) > 3 else 1
        b = tk.Button(root, text=label, font=('Arial', 16), command=lambda l=label: on_button_click(l))
        b.grid(row=row, column=col, columnspan=span, sticky='nsew', padx=2, pady=2)
    
    for i in range(6):
        root.rowconfigure(i, weight=1)
    for i in range(5):
        root.columnconfigure(i, weight=1)
    
    root.mainloop()
